dab zha bzha pa' dkar chag :byud/ 〈li (84)26lda1 'bras bu'i mchog gi rgyud kyi don bsdus 'grel pa paṇ+ḍir thar zhes bya ba/ ༷ 3dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ sems bskyed pa'i le'u/ 10gsum pa/ bstan la phab pa'i le'u/ 1nabazhi pa/ yi ge 'phreng ba bkod pa'i le'u/ 16lnga pa/ sgyu 'phrul sgrub pa ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 2༷drug pa/ dkyil 'khor spros pa'i le'u/ 21bdun pa/ sngags kyi le'u/ 25brgyad pa/ phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u/ 28dgu pa/ rdo rje dam tshig bkod pa'i le'u/ 29bcu pa/ dbang sbyin pa'i le'u/ 361

bas: ba/(byeb/ nga / mdzab/bab /) 6)(1/ 37bcu gnyis pa/ tshogs bsgrub pa'i le'u/ na9bcu gsum pa/ shin tu gsang ba man ngag snying po'i le'u/ 41bcu bstun pa/ skyabanyes pa'i le(1/ ༷ 44bco lnga pa/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor byis rnam par 'phros pa'i le'u/ 4bcu drug pa/ khro bo'i sngags kyi le'u/ 46bcu bdun pa/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u/ grebaco brgyad pa/ mchod sbyin dam pa bstan pa'i le'u/ gobacu dgu pa/ daskyab :ngeg gi le(bye/ 50rta) 〈bye pa/ rten13zug babathab /) mkhye(1/ 52nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ khro bo la bstod pa'i le'u/ 53nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ yongs su gzung ba'i le'u/ 54rgya gar gyi slob dpon ra po bī ma la mi tras mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang /zhus r+ṣa gyi lots+tsha ba ra po a tsar+ya rmā rin phi mchog dang snyags 1 na ku mā ras dpal bsam yas dbu rtse'i par khang du bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(56) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(58)2632 rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud dpal gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba'i spyan 'grel pa'o// 59byud 'di'i srun rnam par dbye ba gsum bstan pa/ 59chos nyid rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor phyi mo'i rigs mi 'gyur ma chad pa/ 59grub pa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug bla na med pa'i rigs bshad pa/ 65

:ngethab :rdorngon tshob44tshod pa/ 65/1pe /bsdogatshod 14/ ( ru 11 14 /bsdogatshod /ba/ ( ( ma65na nyid bshad pa/ 66de nye bar mtshon pa bshad pa/ 66rnal 'byor bar ma'i mtshan nyid bshad pa/ 67rgyud 'byung ba'i gzhi bshad pa/ 68rkyen phun sum tshogs pa bshad pa/ 70don phun sum tshogs pa bshad pa/ 71rgyud kyi cha rkyen phun sum tshogs pa bshad pa/ 81rgyud mthar brtan par bya ba bshad pa/ 82byud 'ji'i rnam par dbye ba'i srun gsum yan lag dang bcas pa'i don le'u rnams so sor bsdu zhing ngo bo bstan pa/ 83byud 'ji'i rnam par dbye ba'i srun gsum yan lag dang bcas pa'i tshig don le'u sum cu rtsa gsum bsnyan pa/ 86le'u dang po/ rnal 'byor thog mtha' bar ma'i mthong sgom brtan pa'i rnazug pazang ba44tshod pa/ 86le'u gnyis pa/ rnal 'byor mi r+ṣa pa gnyis dang bar ma'i lam gnyis bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 97le'u gsum pa/ lam gnyis dang dkyil 'khor bdun gyi tha ma'i cha bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 105le'u bzhi pa/ rnal 'byor dang rigs grangs dang ngo bo bsdu ba thun mong du bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 116le'u lnga pa/ rgyud kyi rgyu dang dkyil 'khor thun mong du bstan pa'i rnam par /badzadaḥd /ba/ 1rtenag le'u drug pa/ 'phrin las bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 1353

le'u bdun pa/ shin tu gsang ba'i khro bo zhes bya ba'i rnam par bshad pa/ 138le'u brgyad pa/ lhag pa spyi ho brtan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 141le'u dgu pa/ las khyad par du ho gyi sgo nas bya ba drug pa'i las bstan pa'i ——zug 25zang tshobasdogatshod 25/ 1zhengale'u bcu pa/ dbang gi las bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 1gale'u bcu gcig pa/ rgyas pa'i las bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 151le'u bcu gnyis pa/ zhi ba lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan dang ting nge 'dzin gyi las bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 154le'u bcu gsum pa/ bdag gzhan gyi don du tshe bsgrub pa bstan pa'i rnam /bshā pa /bgazhatshod /pa/ 1ga 43le'u bcu bzhi pa/ bdag gzhan gyi legs nyes dri ba'i rnam par bshad pa/ 167le'u bco lnga pa/ phyag rgya gcig pa'i rnal 'byor dang lam rim thun mong du bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ ༷ 173le'u bcu drug pa/ bsgom lam gyi rim pa bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 176le'u bcu bdun pa/ bdag dang gzhan kyi don du bdud rtsi sman sgrub pa bstan nga /re chenazug nga zab tshob44ཿda nga / 181le'u bco brgyad pa/ yan lag dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 195le'u bcu dgu pa/ khro bo lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spros bcas rnal 'byor gyi dbang du bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 198le'u nyi shu pa/ thun mong sgrub pa bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 204le'u nyer gcig pa/ lhag pa gzugs brnyan bsod nams rten gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 210le'u nyer gnyis pa/ thabs kyi lam dang dkyil 'khor drug pa bstan pa'i spyod zug tshogashā /bsdodatshod 25/ 218

le'u nyer gsum pa/ cig char pa dang lta ba thun mong du lam bstan pa'i spyod /pa thabapa /bsdogatshod tshong/ 226le'u nyer bzhi pa/ rdo rje zhing chen bsgrub pa bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 23nale'u nyer lnga pa/ lam gyi rnal 'byor gnyis bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 237le'u nyer drug pa/ lam de'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu bstan pa'i rnam par /bas rngod /ba/ rtenazhengale'u nyer bdun pa/ gzhi dam tshig gis gzung ba'i rtsa ba gtsor bstan pa'i :bzug tshongabang /bsdonatshod tshong/ 2zhenale'u nyer brgyad pa/ yang dag pa'i dug lnga la sogs pa'i rtsa ba bco lnga bshad pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 262le'u nyer dgu pa/ rnal 'byor gsum dang dam tshig rgyas par bstan pa'i spyod65 25zang /bsdonatshod thab/ 268le'u sum cu pa/ lam dang 'bras bu bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 311le'u so gcig pa/ mtshan nyid gsum bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 316le'u sum cu gnyis pa/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnal 'byor gsum gyi char bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ 322le'u sum cu gsum pa/ thabs kyi lam dang tshogs bsgrub pa bstan pa'i rnazug pabang ba44da pa/ 325bsdur mchan/(na38) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(3gye)2633 sgyu 'phrul dra ba rin po che 'od kyi snang ba zhes bya ba/ 3nabasdur mchan/(na5na) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(353)2634 thugs kyi sgo lcags bzhugs so// 3545

dang po/ lus kyi bca' bzhi'i le'u/ lda54gnyis pa/ lus kyi bca' bzhi gnyis pa mun pa'i spyod yul bstan pa'i le'u/ 255gsum pa/ byes pa'i shes pa bstan pa'i le'u/ na57bzhi pa/ phyogs ris 'byed pa'i shes pa bstan pa'i le'u/ na58lnga pa/ dbus mtha' dbus med pa'i shes pa bstan pa'i le'u/ na58drug pa/ spong len can gyi 'dod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 360bdun pa/ rnal 'byor nying nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul bstan pa'i le'u/ na60brgyad pa/ rnal 'byor chen po'i gzhung bgrol ba'i le'u/ na61dgu pa/ chos nyid rnal 'byor gyi don bkrol ba'i le'u/ 361bcu pa/ shin tu rnal 'byor gye don dgrol ba'i le'u/ 362slob dpon ra po spyosirnyas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(365) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(365)2635 bces ba6) 11 (1nga ba(1gas (〈// na66slob dpon tha ma las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(367) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(367)2636 casazungen nyid 11na ma ba(1gas so// 368bsdur mchan/(373) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(na7na)2637 sgyu 'phrul khro bo'i dbang bskur ba dkyil 'khor rdo rje las /kye 1sde(ma /ba /notham /bya/ /ba ༷ 37chagabudha ku gyas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(401) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(402)

26na8 sgyu 'phrul dbang gi gal po'i don 'grel/ 403sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad/gnyags tshwa nas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(414) bsdura'abras re'u mig(414)26na9 sgyu 'phrul dra ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba /ba/nu1ga/sa /so// rten1/ sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad/ban dhe tshwa na ku ma ras bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(ga1) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(tso1)2640 gsang ba'i man ngag 'jam pa'i thigs pa zhes bya ba/ tso2slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad/bsdur mchan/(4nan) bsdura'abras re'u mig(434)2641 gsang ba'i thigs pa'i man ngag gi 'grel pa/ 435slob dpon ra po tha ma las mdzad/lots+tsha ba gnya' na ku ma ras bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(44) bsdura'abras re'u mig(dzin)26ga dbang cig car 'jug pa'i man ngag 46bsdur mchan/(dzi6) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(dzi7)264na bde ba chen po phyag rgya'i man ngag zhes bya ba/ dzi8bsdur mchan/(465) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(466)7

264 sgeg rdor gyis mdzad pa'i rgyun bshags bzhugs so// 467bsdur mchan/(469) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(469)26dzi bi ma las mdzad pa'i tshigs rkang bcu dgu pa bzhugs so// gye0slob dpon tha ma las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(gye2) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(gye2)2646 sgyu 'phrul dra ba rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ gye slob dpon rgyal ba bzang pos mdzad/bsdur mchan/(go0) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(ga0)26gye in+d+ra byu ti'i rim pa gnyis pa bzhugs so// ga1rgyal po ā+o tra bhu rnyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(gon) bsdura'abras re'u mig(ga3)26na zhi ba'i lha rgyud ces bya ba/ 54bsdur mchan/(gon) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(go3)26go sgyu 'phrul tshogs kyi 'khor lo thugs kyi sgrub pa bzhugs so// go4bsdur mchan/(50༷) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(500)2650 rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'od kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba go1slob dpon be+e ma la'i slob ma rgyal ba bzang

be+e ma la mi tras 1 na ku ma ra la bka' stsal ste bsdus pa la mos pa'i don du bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(507) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(5༷7)2651 khro bo las kyi 'phreng ba bsdus pa bzhugs so// 508bsdur mchan/(52na) bsdur 'thas re'u mig(52na)2652 khro bo yang dag sgon ma bzhugs/ 524slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad/bsdur mchan/(5na4) bsdura'abras re'u mig(534)2653 lha'i sku sgom pa'i man ngag 5na5slob dpon tha ma las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(537) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(5lda7)2654 phyag rgya bzhi pa'i bsam gtan bzhugs so// 538bsdur mchan/(551) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(551)2655 khro bo phyag rgya gcig pa bzhugs so// 552bsdur mchan/(554) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(554)2656 spyod yul sbyong ba'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 555slob dpon be+e ma la mi tras mdzad/'grel pa rma rin chen mchog gis mdzad/

bsdur mchan/(568) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(568)2657 mdo rgyud rtogs pa'i sgon ma zhes bya ba: 569dang po/ theg chen dpyangs thag gnas kyi lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 569gnyis pa/ mdzad pa cho 'phrul lha'i lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 576gsum pa/ 'phrin las mthar phyin sgrub pa'i lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 582bzhi pa/ gsang sngags nges pa'i don rmi lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 585lnga pa/ lung thams cad kyi rgyal po gsal bar byed pa'i sgon ma'i lung bstan /ba/ri//ba(zu/ / ma (3rgya gar gyi mkhan po slob dpon ra po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba bai ro tsa nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(592) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(592)2658 dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i gtor ma'i cho ga 593rnal 'byor rmi dbang phyug ku ku ri pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(596) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(596)2659 rdodrecad thab rngon/byerngon /pa/ 597bsdur mchan/(598) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(598)2660 sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i man ngag 599slob dpon byā la'i zhabs dngos grub brnyes pas mdzad/rgyal ba a gyi ngo bo kudha tsā tha'i gsung las 10

phyi ma'i gu ru rdo rje'i spun —sngo ṇa bhā las glegs bam steng nas zhus/bsdur mchan/(601) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(601)2661 rdo rje bdud rtsi gsum gye mngon par rtogs pa/ 602rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen gyi zhal snga nas/rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud las phyung ba ste/paṇa chen de nyid dang gzhon nu dpal gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(611) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(611)2662 rdo rje dril thabs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga 612rgya gar shar phyogs kyi slob dpon ga go na shī las mdzad/man lungs dus 'khor ba rad na shī la'i phyag dpe las gtugs shing dag par byas/bsdur mchan/(618) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(618)rgyud/ (yi (44)2663 rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgya cher 'gre' pa/ 621'grel pa mdzad pa'i dgos ched rnam pa gsum/ 62111

rdo rje slob dpon bsod nams 'phel ba'i dgos ched/ 622rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par 'gyur ba'i dgos ched/ 62nasems can thams cad kyis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i don ma nor bar mi shes pa shes par bya ba'i dgos ched/ 62nale'u dang ting lnga 'dzin dang dkyil 'khor dang rigs so sor bye zhing bstan pa/ 624bla ma'i man ngag gi rgyud kyi le'u dang / ting lnga 'dzin gyi mtshan dang grangs bye brag tu bye zhing bstan pa/ 624le'u'i mtshan dang grangs bye brag tu bshad pa/ 624ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan dang grangs bye brag tu bshad pa/ 625dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dang lha'i rigs bye zag /tu /bye /ba/ /sgyurtenartenadakyil 'khor gsum bshad pa/ 6322lnga:re 1sdebakathab /snga ba44tshod nga / 633spob dpon gyi man ngag gis mdo rgyud kyi bshad pa/ 6 5byes/ra bka—1 /ba(1zud /ba/ 6na5dang po/ je bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba pa las ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor byin gyi rlob pa'i le'u/ 715dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags chen po'i tshul stunas bya ba'i ting nge 'a:sdon/ 715gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzhal yas khang byen rmis brlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 751gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs 12

kyi rdo rje dam tshig 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 756bzhi pa/ ye shes kyi sgon ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 803lnga pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i /mtshong /nge par/sdocad/ sa 1tsa)drug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che 'byung ba'i rdo rje dpal ce/sa byu1 balnga/ ting nge 'a:rdon/ 825bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags chen po 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 8na9brgyad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gdon mi za ba'i dam tshig 'ebyethab (1 ngas:re /stepa —nge pa :sdozug/ 851dgu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje 'dzin mnyes pa'i dam :ngeg stunas byu1 ba:re ting nge pa :snan/ 864bcu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su chags par mnyes par byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 868bcu gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags 'dzin pa'i rjes su chags par byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 871bcu gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje bslu ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 876bcu gsum pa/ rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 880bcu bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par byang chub pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'a:rdon/ 885bco lnga pa/ chos rin po che 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 890bcu drug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 89513

gnyis pa/ byang chub sems kyi le'u/ 902dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 902gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 911gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mi bzad pa'i rdo rje zhes /ma nga :re /stepa :nge par:sdocad/ 921bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag med pa'i rdo rje zhes (1 ngab:re nyithab :nge par:sdocad/ 92zhesalnga pa/ ye shes 'od zer 'bar ba'i sgon ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 926drug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzhal yas khang pa'i rdo rje rtenas byu1 ba'i ting nge 'a:sdon/ 929gsum pa/ rdo rje bar+ṣa pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 939dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'pho ba'i sprin bkod pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 939gnyis pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 977bzhi pa/ de bajin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dkyil 47/bo/ra /bye /ba/zu/ 1000lnga pa/ kun tu sbyod pa mchog gi le'u/ 1075dang po/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i /steḥb :nge par:sdocad/ 1075drug pa/ sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis bachab pa'ile'u/ 1156dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 115614

gnyis pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdul dang bral ba'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 1161gsum pa/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i kun tu mi gnyis pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i /stopar /nge /ra/dzecad/ 11( rtenabazhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog dpal rdo rje sgol ma zhes bya /ba/ri /steḥb /nge par/zocad/ 11400lnga pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa rdo rje gdon mi za ba zhes bya ba'i ting /nge /tha/dzi/na/ rten//(7rngonabadun ba/ spyod pa'i mchog gi le'u/ 1229brgyad pa/ bshang gci'i dam tshig gi le'u/ 1na14bsdur mchan/ (1na28)tshe dkar ga gi zur ma na/ chos — (lda663)pa'i gsal bshad deb zhe lnga pa'i dkar chag gi zur mag du gsal/〈〈pe 〉〉〈yor 〉d+kud lhag ma' zur ma na/ 〈〈pe 〉dze'ar 〉snyo na la rgyud dgyes pa rdo rje'i chos skor gyi 'apod dang / rgyud phagasar bcug dbang dang grol byed rim gnyis cha lag nyer mkho sna tshogs kyi skor 7gyi rgyud (chanas 15bar pod bcu bzhi ste bsdoms pod bco lnga bzhugs pa las/ 〈〈sde 〉sko〈co 〉rang dpe sdur byed chog pa phud pa'i chos tshan rnams/ 〈'ar bstan 〉s+dzas bsdur gzhi dang 〈〈pe bstan 〉s+dzas zur blta'i par ma byas te/ dpe bsdur zhus nas dpar du bsgrun pa yin/ spyir 〈'ape bsdur ma 〉thadi nyid 〈〈sde bstan 〉phro gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs shing / pod rtags dang thod yig rnams kyang 〈she bstan 〉rdzar song yod pas gong gi 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉s+dza rgyud lhag ma rnams 〈she 〉snga〈co 〉thastan 'gyur gyi rgyud de'inas mjug rdzogs pa'i yor mthud nas pod rtags dang thod yig rnams kyang rim par rgyud 11nas 15bar byas te bsgrigs pa dang / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉s+dza sde — dang pod rtags ni chos — so so'i bsdur lngos re'u mig tu sor bzhag byas te bkod yod/gsar bcug 'di dag gi gzhung rtsa ba dang mas bu sogs gang ci'i thad nas phrad rnam dbye'i sbyor rdzo dang tha snyad skor la deng rabs su spyod pa'i sum rtags dag gsum dang mi mthun pa mang po mchis pa de dag dus skabs der skad gsar bcad kyis zhus ma thub pa'am lo tsā ba rnams kyi dgongs gzhi dgos pa nges can zhig yod snyam ste zhib 'jug gi gnas su ma bcos par sor bzhag byas yod/15

gzhan yang / pe snar rgyud lhag ma rnams kyi dbu lha phal che ba snar bstan du tshe dpag med bkod 'dug kyang / de gong du sde bstan la bzhugs zin pas/ 'dir tshe dpag med phud pa'i rgyud lhag ma'i dbu lha gzhan rnams snar bstan pod rang gi dbu lha ltar dang / tshe dpag med kyi tshab tu snar bstan du bzhugs pa'i dbu lha gzhan rnams dang bdud 'joms 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i snga 'gyur bka' ma'i glegs bam da pa'i 〈86da thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i rgyud gsang ba snying po 〉tha bzhugs pa'i dbu lha rnams gzhung ngam chos tshan rnams kyi nang don la gzhigs pa dang / yang na mdzad pa po dang / 'gyur ba po sogs la ci 'byor byas te bkod pa dang / mthar bstan pa 'di nyid mi nub yun gnas dang / mthun rkyen 'bad med 'byung ba'i phyir chos skyong dang nor lha'i sku brnyan re bcas bkod pa ste/ deb 'di'i rgyud 'u yu gnyis kyi dbu lha slob dpon ku ku rā dza che dang gsang chen mdzod 'dzin rgyal po dza gnyis 〈〈bka' ma lo chen gsang snying 'grel pa 〉yon bar bcug lha ris ltar dang / paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la gu gya dang mnga' bdag lha ye shes gnyis snar bstan rgyud cha pa'i dbu lha ltar bkod pa yin/

༄ga /'bras bu'i mchog gi rgyud kyi don bsdus 'grel pa paṇ+ḍir thar zhes bya ba/①༄pha /bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam nyid dbyings su bdud bzhi ngang gis bcom/ /phyag rgya'i rang bzhin gnyis med rdzogs par ldan/ /yod med mtha' 'das bdag gzhan yongs kyi dpal—/ /thams cad rang bzhin rtogs dang thugs rje bzang / /kun bzang lha'i lha khyod dbyer med la/ /rtogs dang grub pas rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud 'di nyid/ /don rtogs gsal bar bya phyir bdag gis ni/ /don bsdus rab tu dbye ba 'di brtsams snepas/ /dngosaṃ grub mchog gnyis thob par bya phyir bshad/ /gang gis rgyud 'di rtogs dka' bas—/ /bde rlag du ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /'di yi rang bzhin che ba dang / /mtshan nyid dang ni don bstan phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud chen las/ /mdor bsdus bstan la phab pa yin/ /rang bzhin gsang ba zhes bya ste/ /che 44—3

ba zhes ni snying po'i don/ /de kho na nyid mtshan nyid do/ /nges pas nges don mdor bstan pa/ /de ltar rnam pa bzhi po ru/ /mdor bsdus spyi'i don du bshad—/ /rang bzhin gab dang rbas pa dang / /bstan min zhes bya'i rang bzhin ni/ /mnyam pa nyid dang dgongs pa'i don/ /mdzad spyod gsang ba'i theg pa nyid/ /rnam bzhi gsang ba zhes pa'i mtshan/ /sde snod rgyud kun 'byung phyir dang / /bstan la 'be+ebs dang khyad par che/ /ston pa 'khor dang gnas las sogs/ /mchog tu gyur pas che ba bshad/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu dbyer med pa—/ /don dam kun rdzob gnyis med ni/ /mtshan nyid zhes bya rnam pa gsum//lung dang man ngag nges pa yang / /nges pa'i dbyings nas phyung bas na/ /nges don don ni bstan pa yin/ /nges don spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ /so so rnam grangs don rnams kyi/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i bdag nyid pas/ /ming nyid thog mar smos pa gces/ /rgyu dang rkyen dang gzhung nyid dang / /'gro ba'i don du snang ba'i phyir/ /gleng gzhi dang ni gleng slangs te/ /don dang yongs su gzung ba dang / /rnam pa bzhi ni bsdus pa yin/ /gleng gzhi rnam pa lngar bshad de/ /gang tshe gang gi gang du bshad/ /gang la gang gis bsdus pa ste/ /'byung ba dus dang ston pa dang / /gnas dang 'khor dang sdud pa'o/ /sgo dang skur pa zhi bas na/ /'di skad zhes su bshad pa yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyis bshad pas na/ /ma rtogs skyon dang gsung thos skyon/ /bshad ces pas ni spangs pa yin—/ /bla med 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ /de tshe dus zhes bya bar grags/ /ston pa zhes bya'i ①mtshan nyid ni/ /rang bzhin dang ni mdzad spyod dang / /rnal 'byor rnam gnyis ngo la snang / /byang chub chen po'i rang bzhin dang / /44—4

chos rnams rol par longs spyod dang / /phyogs dus bde gshegs bdag po dang / /chos so cig dang dbyer med pa/ /ston pa'i rang bzhin rnam pa bzhi/ /don dam chos kyi sku'i mtshan/ /mdzad spyod gzugs sku rnam gnyis te/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul sku'o/ /longs spyod sngags kyi bdag po'i tshul/ /rgyal po rgyal mo yang dag ldan/ /sprul pa rdul snyed thub pa dang / /khro rgyal stsogs pa grangs med yin/ /bdag po sgu'i mtshan nyid dang / /zhal dang mtshan dang dpe byad dang / /bsam 'das zhabs dang phyag mtshan dang / /dbu dang sku dang kha dog dang / /rgyal mo'i tshogs dang bzhugs pa'i dpe/ /bcu dang gsum gyis rdzogs par rol/ /ye shes phyi nang med pa dang / /thams cad mnyam par dgongs pa dang / /sems dpa' sems mar ldan pa dang / /bcu drug rgyas btab dpe byad dang / /lus dang ngag sems cis 'dus par/ /de rnyed sku gsung snang ba dang / /thabs dang shes rab snang ba dang / /ye shes drug dang phyag rgya drug /rnam thar sku gsum bsam yas dang / /phung po lnga po'i ngo bo nyid/ /rgyal ba lnga ru rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun kyang kha dog lnga pa ste/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga rin chen mdog /snang bar mnyen dro bskyod dang lnga—/ /dbyings kyi ngo bo rgyal mo ste/ /de bzhin kro te rnam lnga min/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa/ /ston pa'i mdzad spyod rol mo yis/ /til gyi gang bu bzhin du khyab/ /ston pa'i khyad par yin par grags/ /gnas ni rnam pa gsum du grags/ /chos kyi dbyings dang gzhal yas khang / /ba ga ①chos 'byung zhes su bya/ /mtha' dbus med pa chos kyi dbyengs/ /de ni gnas kyi bla mar 'dod/ /gzhal yas gzhi ②dang rgyu dang rgya/ /dbyibs dang blo 44—5

'bur rtse mo dang / /rgyan dang sgo khyud rta babs dang / /mtshan nyid gdan gyi rnam pa ste/ /bcu gcig dag gis rnam par dbye'o/ /gzhi'i yang tshad med 'khor lo ste/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin sden/ /ye shes phyogs bzhi dbus brtags pas/ /rin chen las byas gzhal yas khang / /che chung yo bu ma byas pa—/ /chos dbyings mtha' la khyab par snang / /rgyas par rgyas phyir gru bzhi pa'o—/ /kun las spags pa'i gzungs bzhi dang / /ye shes bzhi'i ngo bo nyid//gcig la'ang ye shes kun gnas dang / /gzhal byas mdzes par byas pa'i phyir//glo 'bur bzhi yang mkhar thabs tshud/ /bum pa'i rtse mo chos kyi rtog /chos kyi dbyings su kun nas gnas/ /glo 'bur lnga'i brgyan rnams kyang / /dbyings dang kha dog bye brag dag /rigs kyi khyad par gyis ni dbye/ /gnas mchog nyid kyi rgyan mchog kyang / /gzugs sgra dri ro reg gi rnams/ /rigs kyi khyad par gyes ni brtag /so sor ma bsgrib ngang gis gsal/ /bar chad med par phyogs bcur 'khrigs/ /stong smon mtshan med 'od gsal 'jug /de phyir ye shes sgo khyud can/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub dang / /bya ba rgyud dang gnyi ga rgyud/ /rnal 'byor skyed dang rdzogs pa yi/ /rnam thar brgyad phyir rta babs brgyad—/ /gnas mchog mtshan nyid brjod pa ni/ /gzhal yas phyi dang chos dbyings nang / /bdag nyid du ni bsdus pas na/ /kun tu nang zhes bshad pa yin/ /de na gnas pa'i gdan mchog kyang / /seng ge glang chen rta dang khyung / /nam mkha' lding gi khri chen la/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin po che/ /lnga rtsegs nyi shu rtsa lngar ldan/ /rgyal po rgyal mo'i gdan mchog la/ /mi 'jigs bzhi dang stobs bcu dang / /rdzu 'phrul bzhi dang dbang rnams bcu/ /thogs med 44—6

'phrin las rnam bzhi'o/ /thabs dang shes rab 'od gsal 'bar①/ /skyon gyis ma gos zad mi shes/ /sngon sangs rgyas dang zag pa zad/ /bar mi chod dang nges par 'byung / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das bcas la/ /'jigs med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /gnas dang gnas min yang dag mkhyen/ /dus gsum las 'das rnam smin mkhyen/ /khams rnams sna tshogs mkhyen pa dang / /pha rol mos pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/ /dbang po mchog dang mchog min mkhyen/ /kun tu 'gro lam mkhyen pa'i stobs/ /bsam gtan thar dang nyon mongs mkhyen/ /sngon rmi gnas mkhyen stobs dang ni//skye dang 'chi 'pho mkhyen pa dang / /zag pa zag dze+emed sems grol mkhyen/ /de bcu stobs bcur gyur pas na/ /'bras bu sngon shes drug yin no/ /'dun dang brtson 'grus sems dang ni/ /spyod pa'i ting 'dzin spong ba yin/ /'du byed rnams te rkang pa bzhi/ /ye shes bzhi grub 'bras bu ste/ /chos dbyings ye shes kun la khyab/ /yo byad skye ba tshe la dbang / /ye shes chos dang sems dang las/ /rdzu 'phrul smon lam mos rnams kyi/ /khams kun gyis ni dbang phyug rgyal/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams kyis/ /thog med las rnams lhun gyis grub/ /ci la thogs pa med par spyod/ /gnas mchog khyad par de nyid kyang / /dbyings ④phyug ba gar bstan pa yin/ /'khor rnams bkod pa ji snyed pa/ /khams dang skye mched yin par grags/ /rnam shes yul dang dbang po dang / /dus dang phyin ci ma log rnams/ /byang chub chen po'i rang bzhin du—/ /lhun rmis 0grub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /mthong dang thos dang snoms dang stsong / /rnam shes bzhi po sems dpar shar/ /mthong bya thos bya sdoms 44—7

bya dang / /stsong bya 'dod pa'i lha mo rnams/ /rnam shes bzhi dang dbyer med par—/ /mdzes pa'i blo 'bur bzhi po la/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin chen gdan/ /mthong byed thos byed snoms byed dang / /myong byed dbang po'i sems dpa' dang / /'das dang da ltar byung 'ong dang / /'byung bar ma nges lha mo bzhi/ /dbyer med tshul du grwa bzhir gnas/ /reg pa reg byed reg bya dang / /yid kyi khams te 'joms byed dang / /rtag chad bdag tu ma yin dang / /mtshan ma ma yin 'joms pa rnams/ /sgo bzhi phyogs su de bzhin gnas/ /kun bzang yid kyi rnam shes dang / /chos ni bya ba kun tu bzang / /mdun dang rgyab tu rnam par gnas/ //de nyid bsdud pa phun sum tshogs/ /bsdu bya'i yul ni chos yin te/ /byed pa po ni kun tu bzang / /thugs kyi thugs te thugs yin no/ /srid gsum 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dag /brjod med brjod kyis mi langs pa/ /de snyed 'khor lo dkyil 'khor du—/ /sngon rdzogs rgyal po de nyid nges/ /gnyis med lhun grub dkyil 'khor na—/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /de nas ston pa bde gshegs rnams/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang gnyis med pa'i/ /gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /rgyud 'di nyid kyi mdo don ste/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gsang ba 'di/ /sku gsung yon tan 'phrin las thugs/ /rdo rje las ni nges par byung / /ngo mtshar dkyil 'khor brjod pa'i tshig /e zhes bya ba ngam pa'i don/ /e ma zhes bya ①rab tu ngam/ /e ma ho zhes bya shin tu ngam/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa bcu gnyis te/ /de bzhin nyid dang rang bzhin dang / /thugs rjes 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang gzugs brnyan 44—8

dang / /lhag pa'i ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dang / /byang chub sems dang lhag byang sems/ /tshogs dang lhun grub dkyil 'khor ro/ /chos kyi dbyings nyid de bzhin nyid/ /ye shes kyis ni dbang sgyur ba/ /rang bzhin thabs kyis dkyil 'khor nyid/ /thugs rje 'byung ba thugs rje'o/ /de nyid thugs rjes 'dul ba'i ngang / /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor du/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par bsgom/ /rten 'byung mtshon par byed pas na/ /gzugs brnyan sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /sgyu ma yin zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /mkha' dbyings gsal bar rnams spyad pas/ /de yang rang snang zhes su bshad/ /sku gsung yon tan 'phrin las thugs/ /de nyid mtshon pa'i thabs tshul du/ /sa la sogs la phyag rgya byas/ /lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan yin par grags/ /dam pa'i don gyi byang chub sems/ /til 'bru bzhin ni kun la khyab/ /a'i bo de rab tu bsdus/ /byang chub rdo rje dri las byung / /lhag pa yid bzhin rin po che//sku gsung thugs ni mi zad pa/ /gter ldan brgyan gyi 'khor lo nyid/ /tshogs chen rdzogs pa ces su bshad/ /chos sku rdo rje mchog nyid do/ /ma bcos lhun grub bdag nyid do/ /mnyam nyid dbyings kyi de bzhin nyid/ /man zhes bya ba snying po'i don/ /da la zhes bya len pa'o/ /yul dang dbang po yin par dgongs—/ /spyod yul kun tu maṇ+ḍa la/ /rdo rje gsang bas gsung ba ①dang / /brjod dka' de nyid brjod pas na/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /brjod du med pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /tshig tu brjod pa ma yin yang / /'dzub mo sgon ma zla ba gser/ /don mtshon tshig ni don dang 'dra/ /don ni mi rtogs med min pa'o—/ /dbul po'i gter dang gyad nor 'dra/ /tshig ni me long sgron me'i 44—9

tshul—/ /'gro ba'i don la brjod par bshad/ /des na bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams—/ /nyid la ①nyid kyis gsung mod kyi/ /'gro la phan pa'i don rmi phyir/ /brjod pa nyid du rgyal bas gsung / /gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas ston pa rgyal mchog gis/ /dkyil 'khor mdo'i don gleng ba/ /de nyid don 'di bsdus 'dod nas/ /yab yum gnyis po gleng ba yin/ /yab kyi ye shes don glengs pa/ /gang gis ji ltar gang glengs dang / /glengs pa'i 'bras bu nyid dang bzhi/ /thams cad kun gyi byed pa po/ /kun bzang yid nyid rdo rje te/ /ye shes rdo rje 'dus pa'i ④tshud/ /rang rig dbyings la 'jug 'gyur te/ /srid dang rnam grol thams cad kun/ /thig le'i tshul du dbyer med pas/ /ston pa rdo rje bde gshegs la/ /kun bzang bde bar gshegs nyid kyis/ /'gro ba'i mched du 'di skad brjod/ /rang gi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor la/ /ngo mtshar gyis ni tshig brjod de/ /srid dang rnam grol thams cad kyi/ /phung po'i yan lag rnam pa lnga/ /chos sku rdo rje yin pa'i phyir//rgyal po lnga ru rnam par grags/ /'gro ba'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /khams dang skye mched rnam pa kun/ /sems pa sems ma'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /khams lnga dbyengs phyug rgyal mo lnga/ /mdor na srid gsum thams cad kun/ /mngon rdzogs rgyal por de nyid nges/ /'di skad tshig tu gleng ba'i tshe/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /'gro ba'i ched du mnyes gyur nas/ /yum gyi dbyings kyi don glengs pa/ /gang gis ji ltar ji skad glengs/ /glengs pa'i 'bras bu nyid dang bzhi/ /bya ba mo ni kun tu bzang / /ye shes la ni 44—10

dbyings phyug 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i mched du gleng ba ni/ /stong gsum rdul snyed phyogs bcu kun/ /dngos por ma grub ye nas dbyen/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i gnas nyid las/ /zhing khams dag las gud na med/ /nyon mongs dus cho lta ba sems can nyid/ /snyigs ma lnga po 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ste/ /bde chen gnas nyid las ni gzhan ma yin/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po las/ /bde gshegs gud na yod ma yin/ /de bas thams cad snying po'i mchog /gzhan du sangs rgyas rtsal ma yin/ /de skad du ①tshig tu glengs pa'i tshe/ /bde chen dbyings su sangs rgyas par/ /ston pa rgyal mchog nyid kyis mkhyen/ /de nas rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang gnyis med pas/ /rnam gnyis glengs don thugs chud ste/ /gzhung don rnam pa bshad pa mdzad/ /rdzogs chen rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rtogs spyod rnam pa nyi shu yis/ /mngon rdzogs rgyal por de nyid nges/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ /thog mar 'gro ba'i lam mchog yin/ /byang chub mchog ldan rnal 'byor des/ /chos kun nges don gtan la phab/ /nges pa'i don nyid rtogs pa'i tshe/ /ming tsam snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /yi ge 'khor lo mngon sangs rgyas/ /mngon rdzogs yi ge de nyid las/ /ting 'dzin rol mo mtha' yas 'phros/ /spros nyid dkyil 'khor bsam yas gsal/ /gsal byed sngags kyis ④yi ge brjod/ /de nyid thugs rtags phyag rgyar gsal/ /ma mthong smongs ④la bstan pa'i phyir/ /bkri dang rdul tshon bstan pa ces/ /dkyil 'khor dag la brten pa'i mi/ /dbang mchog sbyin pa mchog yin no/ /dbang mchog rdzogs nas tshogs la 'jug /tshogs bsgrub yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /tshogs mchog rgya cher spel 44—11

ba yang / /man ngag snying po can gyis bya/ /tshogs dus stong pa glu yis bya/ /gal te zhi bas mi 'dul na/ /rdo rje khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spro/ /khros pa'i sngags kyi bskur ston nas/ /dkyil 'khor nyid du bkod par bya/ /de nyid la ni mchod pa 'bul/ /zhi khro rab 'a ma mchod pa'i tshe/ /sdom la gnas pa shin tu gces/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i skyes bu de/ /rnam bzhi las kyi gzhan don bya/ /khros pa'i glu'i bstod pa bya/ /don dam kun rdzob byang chub sems/ /rnam pa gnyis su ston pas gsung / /rmad du byung ba'i byang chub sems/ /sangs rgyas kun byi gsang ba'i thugs/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin ni/ /skye 'gag gnas dmigs 'gro 'ong rnams/ /don dam med las kun sgrib yod/ /don dam kun sgrib dbyer med don/ /dam pa'i don du bde gshegs gsungs/ /brjod med de nyid brjod pa'i tshe/ /nyid kyi rtso bzungs 'khor lo mnyes/ /don ma rtogs dang snying rje dang / /don mdzad kun rdzob rnam pa gsum/ /rgyal po rgyal mo 'khor bcas pas/ /rtogs dka'i gsang ba rnam bzhir brjod/ /ye nas rtogs dka'i gsang ba dang / /sna tshogs chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin de nyid gsang ba dang / /rang rang chos kyi ngo bo nyid/ /mtshan nyid so so rtogs pa gsang / /snod min gzhan la mi bstan gsang / /ma rtogs don nyid brjod pa yin/ /chos kun rang bzhin sangs rgyas kyang / /de nyid ma rtogs 'khrul 'khor khyab/ /zhen pa bzlog phyir snying rje bskyed/ /rang bzhin gsang ba bstan pa'i phyir/ /chos sgo bsam yas spros pa mdzad/ /rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid las/ /'gro ba 'khrul 'khor snang ba yang / /bdag 'dzin tsam las ma rtogs pa/ /'khrul 'khor dngos nyid ga la yod/ /dper 44—12

na mkha' la mdud 'dor 'dra/ /bdag 'dzin 'ching ba dam po yang / /bcings byed bcing bya ga la yod/ /de bas lhun grub dkyil 'khor che/ /de nyid bstan phyir bshad pa mdzad/ /de skad bde gshegs rgyal mchog gis/ /'khor rnams bde gshegs dkyil 'khor la/ /'gro ba rnams kyi mched du gsung //sems bskyed pa'i le'u ste/ gnyis pa'o// //bstan la dbab par bya ba dang / /bstan la phab pa gnyis su bshad/ /dbab bya sprul skus 'dul bstan la/ /nges pa'i don kyi bstan la phebs ces bya//gang las gang 'thon gang du ci byed dang / /gang gis don mdzad yin te rnam pa lnga'o/ /gang las rgyal mchog sku gsung las/ /thugs rje rig pa'i thub drug mthon—/ /gang du las kyi 'bras bu ste/ /stong gsum cig la chags tshul drug /sprul sku cig gi zhing du grags/ /drug gi 'jig rten de nyid na/ /gling rnams bye ba phrag brgya yin/ /sprul pa bye ba phrag brgyar snang / /gling rnams re rer sprul pa re re ①yang / /'gro drug las kyi drug tu snang ba yin/ /dper na bar snang zla ba cig shar bas/ /'dzam bu gling gi chu rnams kun tu chu zlar snang / /chu cig nang na snang ba'i zla ba yang / /'gro ba so sos bltas na re re'i mdun na snang / /de bzhin sprul sku cig la gling rnams snang / /gling rnams cig las 'gro ba drug tu snang / /tha dad de kun sprul pa cig tu grags/ /de 'dra'i stong gsum mtha' yas mu med na/ /de 'dra'i sprul pa re res 'gro don de ltar mdzad/ /ci mdzad 'dul ba rnam pa bzhis/ /gang gis 'gro ba lnga don mdzad/ /mngon gsum rdzu 'phrul bsod nams rig pa bzhis/ /theg 44—13

lnga'i rigs can 'gro lnga'i don rnams mdzad/ /mngon gsum 'dul bas sangs rgyas mdzad pa ston/ /brdzu 'phrul mthun mongs ma yin sngon shes drug /bsod nams kun tu sku dang gsung thugs zhal/ /bsam byis mi khyab grangs med phyogs bcur snang / /rigs pas theg dang brgya bcur bzhir gsungs pa/ /'dul ba'i dbang gi theg lnga'i rigs dang sbyar/ /nyon mongs rnyen por sgo mang dus gsum gsungs/ /gzugs 'dzin phyi nang rten 'byel 'dul rnams la/ /mi dang lha dang nyan thos rang rgyal bstan/ /'khrul 'dogs las 'bras chud mi zas 'dul la①/ /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pas phan 'dogs so/ /las 'bras mi rtsog ①rtogs pa'i blo ldan la/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i mthar thug go/ /de kun 'dul ba'i dbang ste bkri ba'i don/ /de dag nges par bstan la dbab pa yang / /bde gshegs rgyal bas 'gro ba'i ched brjod pa/ /lha mi nyan thos rang rgyal theg pa la/ /mi rigs gzugs 'dzin phyi nang rten 'byel 'khor/ /mi mthun bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyang / /'khrul pa de nyid snang ba ma gtogs par/ /rang bzhin dbyings las nyams pa med ces gsung / /bden pa gnyis rtogs byang chub sems dpa' yang / /gnyis tshul bdag dang bdag gis gzhan med de/ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyengs las gnyis su med/ /bdag gzhan rtog pa tsam ste don du med/ /log rgyud nyid rtog rang sems skad cig ma/ /skad cig gzhi rtsa med pas ①chos kyi dbyings/ /bla med dngos grub gzhan nas re ba yang / /bdag dang gzhan du rtog pa'i rgyun yin pas/ /nyid la nyid spyod nyid la nyid dbang bsgur/ /theg pa'i khyad par rnam lngar bstan pa yang / /'bras bu rdzogs chen theg pa cig tu gnas/ /bsod nams 44—14

bsam gyis mi khyab snang ba dang / /khyad par sngon shes drug tu snang ba yang / /bsod nams rgyu las grub pa ma yin te/ /de nyid yang dag rtogs pa'i byin rlabs las/ /rang bzhin med las cir yang grub/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa rims pas stod ①pa yang / /'gro ba 'dul ba'i thabs las ma rtogs pa/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya mya ngan ci la 'da'/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang nub par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di skad bshad pa zhes kyang de phyir brjod/ /zhing khams kun tu grags pa'i snying po 'di/ /sde snod kun dang rgyud kun 'byung ba'i yum/ /de phyir snying po zhes su rgyal bas gsungs so⑧/ /de dag bstan la 'be+ebs pas nges pa'ang yin/ /de phyir bstan pa yongs kyi 'byung gnas yin/ /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong snyen po ru/ /ming dang tshig tu sgo rnams bstan pa yang /'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang tsam ma rtogs pa/ /ston ming tshig la dngos po gang ①la yod/ /de kun tha snyad yin zhes rgyal bas mched dudu brjod/ /de nas nyid kyi gsang ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gsang ba 'di/ /sku gsung rdo rje nyid las byung / /a ni skyed med shes rab dbyings/ /ho ni thabs mchog cho 'phrul rol/ /srid gsum 'khrul 'khor thams cad kun/ /log rtog nyid las ci yang min/ /log rtog bzhi rtsa med dbyings yin/ /rang rig ye shes bdag med thugs/ /bya byed med pas kun dbang bsgyur/ /de nyid yon tan zhing khams las/ /gzhan med rang rig de ltar snang / /rdul snyed sprul pa bsam yas kyis/ /'dul ba'i dbang gi dugasungs pa kun/ /bla med nges pa'i don 'di ru/ /'dus par bde gshegs nyid kyis mkhyen/ /bstan la phab pa'i le'u ste/ gsum pa'o// //44—15

yi ge 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /gang las ji ltar gang phyung phyung ba'i 'thu/ /don bshad gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor phyung ba dang / /rnam pa 'di drug yi ge 'khor lo bshad/ /gang las byung ba rnam bzhir shes bya ste/ /dgongs dang ting 'dzin ming dang 'byung khungs so/ /bde gshegs mnyam nyid dgongs pa gcig tu gyur/ /mnyam nyid rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /chos kun ye nas sangs rgyas ting 'dzin bstan/ /kun rdzob ming tsam yi ge 'phreng zhes bya/ /byung khyangs ston pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /ji ltar a byung a las ming tshogs byung / /a dkar bzhi las a rnams phyogs bcur 'phros—/ /phyogs kun gsal nas sbar 'dus gzhi la thims/ /'phros pas 'grib med sdus pas 'phel med pa/ /spros pas gzhan don sdus pas bdag gi don—/ /a 'dang ka la sogs pa bzhi bcu gnyis/ /shin tu phra ba'i tshul gyi spro bsdu ba/ /mi 'grib mi 'phel bdag gzhan don du bshad/ /a nyid rgyu ste ming tshogs 'bras bur gsungs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi klong nas a 'byung ste/ /a ni khongs nas 'byung bas skye ba med/ /a las 'od zer 'gur gyi gsang bar 'khyil—/ /'od 'phros ka la sogs pa 'bru lngar shar/ /a'i 'od zer zla kham ljags la 'khyel/ /'od 'phros rtsa la sogs pa 'bru lngar shar/ /a'i 'od zer ljags kyi rtser 'phros pas/ /cho 'phrul ta la sogs pa 'bru bcur shar/ /zhal byi sgo mor a'i 'od 'phros pas/ /cho 'phrul pa la sogs pa 'bru lnga yin/ /a las phyi rol yul la 'od 'phros pas/ /cho 'phrul yi ge nyi shu sku las 'phros/ /ya ni byin pa las byung wa ni sku khab las/ /ra ni rtag zur la ni dpungs pa las ni byung / /thugs kha'i 'od las sha byung phyag 'thil las ni ṣa/ /mdzod spu 44—16

'od las sa byung zhabs 'thil gnyis las ha/ /gsang ba'i 'od zer las ni cho 'phrul k+ka ①ru shar/ /spyan gnyis las ni cho 'phrul i gnyis shar/ /snyan gnyis las ni cho 'phrul u gnyis shar/ /tshems gnyis las ni 'od 'phros e gnyis shar/ /shangs gnyis las ni 'od 'phros o gnyis shar/ /skyes bu'i spyi gtsug 'od 'phros mgo zhes bya zer/ /'khru tshad lta ba las ni 'od 'phros shad ces bya/ /skyes bu chen po 'tshogs ma'i 'od las thig ces bya/ /gar byung bzhi bcu rtsa lnga de nyid yin/ /phyung ba'i nus mthu 'jig rten bsam yas g.yo/ /don bshad rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid don bshad pa'o—/ /spyi'i don ni rnam dgur shes bya ste/ /don dang che ba las dang mtshan nyid drangs/ /dbye ba rang bzhin cho 'phrul nges tshig go/ /don ni bden pa gnyis su shes dze+ebya ste/ /a ni don dam mtha' gnyis dbus mi dmigs/ /kun rdzob ming tsam yi ge 'phreng ba nyid/ /chos kun sgyu ma ming tsam nyid la gnas//a las yi ge'i tshogs 'byung sgra dang bcas/ /ming tsam tshig gi bsdus pa'i mngon rdzogs nyid/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas te yi ge'i che bar gsungs/ /las ni ya mtshan bzhi bcu rtsa lnga yis/ /ming tshig don mtshon sna tshogs smra zhing ston/ /mtshan nyid don dam dbyings las dmigs med kyang / /kha dog ming dbyibs rol pa sprul cing ston/ /rnam grangs dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa lnga nyid/ /re re la yang sku gsung thugs su bshad/ /thugs ni rgyud ①nyid a yis kun la khyab//sku ni so so'i kha dog dbyebs su ldan/ /gsung ni sgra yi ming gis thams cad bsdus—/ /de phyir phyogs bcur rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs/ /bzhi bcu rtsa lnga gsum 'phror 'gyur zhes gsung / /dbye ba lus dang yan lag gnyis su dbye/ /44—17

lus ni mgo nas k+ka'i bar du rdzogs/ /yan lag 'drin dang grag po bzhi gnyis yin—/ /rang bzhin sems nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin ste/ /sems dang yi ge'i dngos po yod ma yin/ /cho 'phrul mtshan ma dbyengs las sna tshogs sprul/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi cho 'phrul rnams/ /yi ge mthu'i 'gug cing byed nus na/ /'jig rten cho 'phrul gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /nges tshig bris pa'i phyir na yi ge ste/ /mtshan med dbyings la dbyings kyi bris pa yang / /a nyid dbyings las sna tshogs 'byung phyir ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid so sor bshad pa ni//bzhi bcu rtsa drug rang bzhin las rnams yin/ /mgo'i rang bzhin ma nor de nyid rnam pa gsum/ /las ni lam yin rtog pa rnam pa bzhi/ /thig gi rang bzhin shes rab rnam pa gsum/ /las ni de nyid mtshon byed ming du smra/ /shad ni rang bzhin thabs chen snyan bsgrub bzhi/ /las ni mtshon pa'i ming rnams tshigs su gcod/ /a'i rang bzhin skye med dbu ma'i dang / /las ni de bzhin nyid mtshon dag mnyam bzhi/ /a mgo thig bshad ting 'dzin bzhir bshad de/ /de bzhin nyid kun snang sgyu rdzogs zhes bya/ /des na sngon rdzogs phyag rgya'i rgyu bzhir nges/ /tha sogs bde gshegs lnga rdzogs phung po lnga'i/ /rang bzhin sgyu 'phrul yin te las ni rigs lnga'o/ /tha sogs lnga ni btsun mo'i dbyengs rnams lnga/ /rang bzhin dra ba las ni 'byung lnga nyid/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba zhes kyang rtso dang gzungs la grags/ /ka la sogs pa sems dpa'i yi ge lnga/ /rang bzhin thugs ste las ni rnam shes khams lnga yin/ /tsa sogs yul kyi sems bzhi rigs dang rnams lnga po/ /rang bzhin sku ste las ni yul gyi khams lnga yin/ /sa la sogs pa sems dpa'i yi ge lnga'i/ /rang bzhin gsungs te las ni dbang 44—18

po'i khams lnga yin/ /ya la sogs pa reg ma'i yi ge bzhi/ /rang bzhin dag pa bzhi ste las ni dus rnams bzhi/ /sha la sogs pa rigs ma'i yi ge bzhi/ /rang bzhin med pa bzhi ste las ni mtha' bzhi 'joms/ /k+ka ni sdud ①pa'i rang bzhin thugs kyi thugs ste las ni ye shes yin/ /i la sogs pa sprul pa'i yi ge rnams drug go/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin bsam yas rdul snyed las ni rigs drug 'dul/ /o ni yid dbang rig pa'i rgyal po'i yi ge ste/ /rang bzhin byang chub sems ste las ni thams cad 'jig /oṃ ni sdud bya kun tu bzang mo'i yi ge ste/ /rang bzhin chos rnams thams cad las ni kun bzhi yinarka/ /las dang rang bzhin 'byel pa'i 'khor lo'i tshogs chen 'di/ /re re la yang sku gsung thugs kyi maṇ+ḍal rdzogs pa'i 'phreng / /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen zhes su brjod/ /yig 'bru gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gang byung gang las ji ltar byung / /byung ba'i 'bras bu nyid dang bzhin⑤/ /gang byung bder gshegs thams cad kyi/ /rab tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /gang las sku gsung rdo rje las/ /ji ltar yab yum dgyes sprin las/ /ar gsal a las yig 'bru tshogs/ /de la sngon rdzogs skur gsal ba/ /yum gyi mkha' la rdzogs par rol/ /lhag pa'i ting 'dzin zhes su grags/ /de nyid las ni phyi rol gyi/ /dkyil 'khor 'don par rgyal bas gsungs/ /bha ga dkyil 'khor ling ga a/ /'dus ma byas nyid rdo rje las/ /'dus byas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /'byin pa'i dam tshig 'da' mi 'gyur/ /ci phyir thabs dang shes rab kyi/ /rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i mthu chen yin/ /de'i 'bras bu yi ge nyid/ /rgyal ba mngon par rdzogs pa'i sku/ /dkyil 'khor nyid du lhun gyis grub/ /yi 44—19

ge 'phreng ba bkod pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul spros pa 'di/ /gang las gang spros thabs dang mnyes pa bzhi/ /gang las sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor bkod pa las/ /gang spros ting 'dzin rnam par spros pa 'di/ /thabs ni bdun gyis bsgrub thabs sdebs bshad pa—/ /ting nge 'dzin dang rdzogs dang thun mong dang / /dpe ①dang sgyu dang gags gsal mchog rdzogs 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin de bzhin nyid dang kun snang sgyu yin te/ /ting 'dzin de bzhin rang sems mtshan nyid ni/ /gang gis mi shes chos kyi dbyings mi shes/ /dmigs med mi shes rtag chad 'jig mi 'gyur/ /de phyir rang sems dbyings nyid thabs kyi rgyu/ /dngos po rnam pa brgyad sogs gang yang min/ /min pa de nyid de bzhin nyid ces bya/ /de nyid gsal bar sgom pa thabs kyi rgyu/ /kun khyab snying rje rang bzhin kun snang yin/ /rgyu ni sems nyid a'i rang bzhin ste/ /a nyid yid bzhin rin chen sprin dang mtshungs//a las sgyu 'phrul bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis 'byung / /de nyid thabs las thabs byung thabs bsam yas/ /thabs nyid dra ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i sku/ /rdzogs pa'i yig 'bru phyag mtshan sngon rdzogs sku/ /don dam dbyer med kun rdzob tha dad pa'i/ /nang gi rnam shes nang gi dbang po dang / /phyi rol yul gyi rnam pa thams cad kun/ /bsam yas dkyil 'khor kun bzang phyag rgyar rol/ /de nyid sgyu 'phrul mngon rdzogs rgyal por des/ /dngos grub thun mongs rnam pa sna tshogs kun/ /glang chen stsos 'dra'i sems ni ting nge 'dzin gyi btul nas su//sgyu 'phrul sngags dang phyag rgya rab tu bstan byas nas/ /thun mongs dngos grub 44—20

ya mtshan 'di kun 'grub/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor grub nas rgyal ba'i dpal/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig ting 'dzin mthu yis grub/ /dper na sgon ma gser 'gyur sman kyi dug gsel dang / /zangs las gser 'gyur dug las sman 'gyur ltar/ /ye shes rang snang ming tshig gzugs sogs las/ /yid bzhin dngos grub ji ltar sgyur bas 'grub/ /bla ma mchod ldan rtogs gsal dam tshig ldan/ /sngags shes phyag rgyar shes shing yo byad lnga ldan na/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub yod par rgyal bas gsung / /de nyid mi ldan dngos grub med de de nyid rlab ①par 'gyur/ /de dag thob pa'i rgyu dang mi thob gags zhes bshad/ /mchog de nyid ni rgyal ba'i thugs chud dngos grub snying po ste/ /mi zad 'phel 'grib med pa yid bzhin mdzod dang 'dra/ /dngos med ting nge 'dzin las dngos po yi ge sprin/ /mchog gi rnam pa sna tshogs ji ltar 'dod 'byung 'gyur/ /dngos med dngos nyid rtog pa'i ting 'dzin mchog gi mthus/ /dbang sgyur bder gshegs kun gyi bdag nyid de yin no/ /de skad gsung bas 'khor gyi bde gshegs thams cad kun/ /mchog dang thun mong gzigs mos mnyes par 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul sgrub pa ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u ste/ lnga pa'o// //de nas sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor spros bshad pa/ /gang gis gang du gang spros ji ltar 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor spros te rnams ②lnga yin/ /gang gis ston pa bde gshegs thams cad kyang / /rang bzhin gcig dang du med bden gnyis dbyer med pas/ /gang du 'jig rten drug gi bsam yas thams cad la/ /rgyal ba nyid kyi sku gsung che ba'i dkyil 'khor 'byin par dgongs/ /44—21

gang spros rtogs dang spyod pa gnyis su bshad/ /rtog pa ji ltar gang rtags gang gis rtags na don 'byung ba'o/ /de ltar phyogs bzhi dbus lngar ye shes lngar rtags te/ /gang rtags bsam yas 'jig rten lhun grub nyid ①par/ /gang gis bde gshegs rdzogs pa rtog pa'i rnal 'byor bde gshegs mtshungs/ /brtags nas don 'byung kun 'byung dkyil 'khor chen por spyod/ /mdzad spyod rnam pa bcu yis lhun gyis grub/ /gzhal yas brgyan dang gdan khri bzhugs tshul dang / /bzhugs gnas thugs mtshan sku mdog tshul dgu dang / /'od zer 'phro dang khyab pa che ba'o/ /gzhal yas 'khor 'khyud gra rnams gru bzhi sgo byedad bzhi/ /brgyan ni rol mo'i sprin phung lha mchog bzhi bcu gnyis sogs yin//gdan mchog lnga rtsegs nyi shu rtsa lnga po/ /bzhugs tshul sangs rgyas rdzogs dkyil byang chub sems dpa'i byed/ /sprul pa gzhengs byed sgo bsrungs stang stabs byed//gnas ni 'khor lo rtsibs la rgyal po rgyal mo bcu/ /glo 'bur bzhi la rigs bzhi yul bzhi zung bzhi 'khril/ /gra bzhir dbang po bzhi dang dus bzhi zungs 'khril nas/ /'khyams la thub drug bya byed nub dang shar/ /sgo bzhir 'joms pa 'joms ma de bzhin du/ /thugs mtshan rgyal po phyag drug phyag rgya drug /drug lnga sum cu ye shes rtags su bstan/ /rnam shes rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo g.yas/ /dril bu rin chen pad+ma g.yon na 'dzin/ /gzugs ni 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje g.yas/ /dril bu pad+ma rin chen g.yon na 'dzin/ /tshor ba rin chen 'khor lo rdo rje g.yas/ /dril bu pad+ma ral gri g.yon na 'dzin/ /'du shes pad+ma 'khor lo rdo rje g.yas/ /dril bu rin chen ral gri g.yon na 'dzin//'du byed ral gri 'khor lo rdo rje g.yas/ /dril bu rin byed pad+ma g.yon na 'dzin//44—22

rgyal mo g.yas kyi dang po dril bu ste/ /g.yon pa rang rtags bzhi bzhi rtso dang 'thun| /shes rab yum yang drug lnga sum cur bshad/ /ut+pal klu shing po ti pad+ma dkar/ /dri spos me tog mar me dbang bzhi dus bzhi yin/ /shes bzhi myu gu ral gri pad+ma rdo rjes①/ /mdzes 'phreng gi bang gar ni yul bzhi'o/ /pi wang sreg par go cha po ti dang / /rin chen sgom dang me chu thub par grags/ /mnyam gzhag sdeting 'dzin phyag rgya yid skechos yin/ /'joms ni mgo dang thod sbrul rdo rje rgya gram gnon/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'joms mtshan/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis mjos pa'i yo byad 'dzin/ /mdog ni rtso bzung rang rig kha dog lnga/ /gcig la yang lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lngar brtags/ /thub drug mdog ni cis 'dul nges pa med/ /yid chos 'thing ka nam mkha'i mdog du bstan/ /gzhan rnams rigs kyi bye brag dag gis dbye/ /tshul ni bsnyen lcugs 'khril ldem gzhon chas can/ /gsal la 'tsher la lhun sdug gzi byin ldan/ /'joms pa 'joms ma rtogs tshul dgu po/ /'od zer 'khyil cing brgyan yang 'khyil pa ste/ /'od zer lnga la nyi shu rtsa lngar 'phros shing 'khyil/ /stong rtsa lnga bcur phyogs bcur 'phros gyur kyang / /stong phrag bcu dang brgya phrag lnga yin no/ /'byung ba'i gnas kyi tha dad brtsis 'gyur na/ /bcu po gcig la 'ang spyan drug snyan drug ste/ /de bzhin shangs ljags sku dang thugs mtshan drug /sum cu drug la nyi shu lnga lngar 'phros/ /spyir ni stong phrag dgu ni bshad pa yin/ /sum cu gnyis po gcig la'ang bcu dang gnyis/ /de bzhin spros na stong dgu brgya phrag drug /stong phrag bco brgyad brgya phrag drug ces bya/ /de las phyogs bcur spros na khri phrag ni/ /bco brgyad stong phrag drug du bshad pa 44—23

yin—/ /de ltar phyogs bcur 'gro drug don byed tshe/ / bya ba phrag ①khrig drug cu 'phro zhing 'khyel/ /yan lag nying lag tshul dgu'i brgyan rnams las/ /legs par rtsis na rtsis las 'das pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas zhes kyang de la bya/ /rgyan ni dbu brgyan snyan cha 'gur chu dpung brgyan dang / /phyag rdub zhabs rdub sku regs se mo do/ /rin chen rgyu las grub ste dbyengs dang ye shes brgyan/ /bcu po dag la yang ②dbu brgyan rigs lnga ste/ /sum cu gnyis la bdag po re re yin/ /bcu po lnga ni snyan cha drug drug ste/ /gzhan yang gnyis gnyis 'gur chu gsum dang gcig /dpung brgyan phyag rdub drug dang gnyis de bzhin/ /kun la zhabs rdub gnyis gnyis brgyan par bshad/ /sku regs se mo do ni re re'o/ /bcu po re re la yang sum cu ste/ /gzhan dag la ni bcu dang gnyis kyis brgyan/ /spyir ni drug brgya dang ni brgya bcu bzhi/ /des na brgyan gyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /khyab pa'i che ba nam mkhas gar khyab pa'i/ /bsam yas dkyil 'khor gyis ①ni khyab par grags/ /drug cu rtsa gnyis spyan gyis drug cu rtsa gnyis mtha' la gzigs/ /de bzhin snyan rnams kyis ni drug cu rtsa gnyis mtha' gsan cing / /shangs nas drug cu rtsa gnyis sprul pa 'gyed/ /ljags kyis drug cu rtsa gnyis rdul thabs 'chad/ /sku ni drug cu rtsa gnyis 'dul ba mdzad/ /thugs ni drug cu rtsa gnyis phyin ci ma log mkhyen/ /sum brgya bdun cu rtsa gnyis dgams ④pa bsam mi khyab/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub ces kyang de la bya'o/ /ji ltar gyur na 'di ltar spros pa'i tshe/ /'jig rten mtha' yas mu med thams cad kun/ /rdul snyed brjod kyis mi lang dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /khams gsum sems can gcig gis rgyud la yang / /44—24

de snyed dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis grub/ /ting 'dzin gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor spros pa yang / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje nyid las 'byung / /dkyil 'khor dmigs par bya ba byed pa mi dmigs te/ /dpag cing bsam 'das brjod med dkyil 'khor de nyid rang rig yin/ /de nyid mnyam dang mi mnyam chos la khyab tsam nyid na khyab pa med/ /khyab med de nyid khyab pa'i dbyings te rang rig kun la gsal/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas rnam par spros kyang spros pa rdul tsam med/ /dkyil 'khor spros pa'i le'u ste/ drug pa'o// //snying po 'byung dang byin bsdu rnam pa gnyis/ /snying po 'byung ba rnam pa drug yin te/ /gzhal yas bskyed dang sku bskyed spyan drangs dang / /dngos grub blang dang grangs dang gsang dbang bskur/ /sku gsung thugs nyid rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor las/ /gzhal yas sa bon yi ge bye yin te/ /gtsug tor 'khor lo rngon lam rang gi sngags/ /sngags kyis tshogs kyis gzhal yas rdzogs par bsgom—/ /dper na sa bon 'byung bas bskyed las 'bras bu smin tshul du/ /sa bon yig 'bru las ni 'bras bu sngags kyi rdzogs/ /sa bon bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyu yin te/ /sngags tshig sku bskyed rkyen gyi sngags ces bya/ /e te ba ga bhan ma ha ka ru ni ka tri sha tsā/ sa ma ya sto/ dza hūṃ ①baṃ ho/ ces spyan yang drangs/oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya oṃ ces pa la sogs pas bskul ba yin/ dngos grub tshe na tshig bshad sngags bcas brjod/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /phrin las dag dang lnga po re re yang / /rnam pa lnga lnga mkhas pas bshad pa de/ /de khrurtogs dang bdag nyid mnyam par sbyor ba yin/ /sku lnga rmad du byung bar 44—25

bstan pa ni/ /chos sku longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul sku dang / /mngon par byang chub rdo rje'i sku dang lnga/ /rtag tu mkha' 'dod bde spyod zas sbyin 'dod/ /mngon par byang chub lnga sogs 'dus ma byas/ /gsungs ①lnga rmad du byung bar bstan pa ni/ /yi ge med rigs longs spyod rdzogs gsung dang / /tshangs dbyangs yan lag gsungs dang rdo rje gsung / /brjod bral rtogs med me long gzugs lta zhing / /yan lag drug cu brjod sgra 'dus ma byas/ /thugs lnga rmad du byung zhes brjod pa ni/ /mi rtog ci yang gsol sdebade ba che/ /'gro ba sgol dang rdo rje'i thugs dang lnga/ /me long mi rtog kun mkhyen mnyam pa nyid/ /nan tan las te ma skyes chos kyi dbyings/ /yon tan rmad du byung ba lngar bstan pa—/ /zhing khams gzhal yas 'od zer gdan khri dang / /che ba'i longs spyod bsam gyes mi khyab pa/ /thugs rje sprul cing byams pa'i khyim du bsdud/ /btang snyoms gzer 'phros sgrib bsel yon tan brtags/ /khar zhugs dag pa lnga spyod re 'dod rkong / /'phrin las rmad du byung ba lngar bstan pa/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod lhun grub pa/ /ma skyes kun tu bzang po rang bzhin mngon du gyur/ /rgyu rkyen 'bad rtsol med pa ye nas yin/ /sdug bkren log lta kheng sems thams cad 'jomasaske/ /de dag gcig la'ang de ltar brtsis gyur na—/ /thugs rjopa med par mi zad brgyan du snang / /rmad byung chen po zhes kyang de la bya'o/ /grags pas bsam yas gsung gi dkyil 'khor byis/ /bsam yas dkyil 'khor dag du rab tu grags/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /gang gis gang zhig gang la ji ltar bskur/ /gang gis rgyal po rgyal mo rtso gzungs kyis/ /gsang ba de nyid thugs la bsdu bya'i phyir/ /gang 44—26

zhig gis ni lhag pa'i sbyor sems kyis/ /lha mo brgyad kyis sbyor ba brda' sgos te//sa ma ya sto yum gyis bskul ba yin/ /bdag ni dam tshig bstan ma zhes ni de la bya—/ /sa ma ya ho rtso bos lan byen te/ /khyod ni dam tshig dga' ma zhes su bya//ra ho haṃ ni brtso la bskur ①ba ste/ /bdag ni chags pa can pas chags mdzod che'o / /ra ga ya mi bkul ②ba'i lan yin te/ /khyod ni chags pas chags pa'i gnas ces bya'o/ /0na dang 'jug dang ldangs dang gnas pa'i/ /byang chub rnams ①bzhir yang mkhas pas bshad/ /dzā ni lcags kyus gzungs nyid 'dren pa yin/ /hūṃ ni zhags pa'i phyag rgyas 'khyud pa mdzad/ /baṃ ni sgrog ste dbang po bsdam pa yin/ /ho ni dril bus mnyes par byed pa'i brda'/ /phyag rgya bzhi zhes kyang ni mkhas pas bshad/ /pra pe shas ni pad+ma'i sgo phye yin/ /a pe shas ni 'bebs pa zhes su bshad/ /pu ke zhes bya bde bar rdar pa'o/ /byed byang chub sems kyi thig le nyid/ /g.yo dang / reg dang / myongs dang /pyongs zhes pa/ reg pa rnam pa bzhir yang mkhas pas bshad/ /gang la yid ches gtso bzungs rjode nyid la/ /ji ltar byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor de/ /gsang ba bsdu phyir gnyis med dbyings su stem/ /gsang ba bsdud pa yin zhes de phyir brjod/ /ye shes byin sdu ⑤zhes bya ba/ /gang las gang byung ji ltar gyur pa dang / /gsung gi rang bzhin bstan te rnam pa bzhi/ /gang las sku gsung thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul las/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs nyid dang / /chags dang mchod pa byen rlob snying po 'gyurarjo/ /ji ltar ye shes kyis ni thims par 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs su dbang bskur gsal bar 'gyur/ /chags dang mchod pa shin tu gsal bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin ngo mtshar sangs rgyas 44—27

kun gyi gsungs①/ /sgra dang ming tshogs ⑤kun las 'das kyis kyang / /tshig gi sna tshogs sgra rnams go bar bsgrags/ /de phyir ljags nyid drug cu rtsa gnyis yin—/ /de dag gcig la 'ang 'gro drug so so'i skad/ /drug po de nyid phyogs bcur bsgrags snang bas/ /gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu de la bya/ /'gro drug gcig la'ang sgra skad tha dad pas/ /bsam gyes mi khyab sgra skad tha dad grags—/ /de phyir gsung gi dkyil 'khor mtha' yas mchog /ces gsung sne/sngags kyi le'u ste/ bdun pa'o// //phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bshad bya ba/ /gang gis ji ltar gang gsungs pa//gang gis rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs/ /ji ltar yan lag dkyil 'khor de/ /dbu ni bde gshegs rigs yin te/ /lag g.yas rdo rje mi skyod 0pa/ /lag g.yon rin chen sems dpa'i rigs/ /rkang g.yon chos kyi sems pa ste/ /rkang g.yas las kyi sems dpa'o/ /dkyil 'khor nyid du lhun gyis grub/ /de ni lhun grub phyag rgya yin/ /lag sor g.yas g.yon yab yum bcu/ /nyi zla'i 'od bkod 'bru byin rlabs/ /gung gnyis la ni hūṃ dang sum̐/ /'dzub mo gnyis la oṃ dang lang / /dbang po gnyis la sa dang paṃ/ /chung ngun ⑤la ni oṃ dang spyo/ /sbom po gnyis la ha dang lta/ /de ltar byin gyis rlabs bya ste/ /phyag rgya bcings par gsungs pa yang / /nges pa'i tshig dang 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /spyi dang so so rnams bubazhi'o/ /nges tshig sgyu 'phrul phyag rgya kun rdzogs dang / /don dam chos sku byang chub mchog gi⑦/ /gsang 'di phyag rgya ma lus rgyas btab pas—/ /thams cad phyag rgya nyid las ga la 'da'/ /rgyu nyid g.yas g.yon nyi 44—28

zla sbyor spro bsdu/ /phyi ni phyag rgya ma nges spros pa ste/ /oṃ dang sum̐ sbyar hūṃ dang lo du sbyar/ /e dang tai sbyar haṃ dang bye sbyar ba/ /swa dang oṃ sbyar yab kyi spyi rgya ste//dbang mchog sbyin pa'i dus su bsngags ①pa yin/ /yang na de nyid thal mo sbyar ba las/ / so dang bye ②sbyar i dang sum̐ du sbyar/ /haṃ dang tai du sbyar ste gnyis ji bzhin/ /yum gyi spyi rgya yin te las mchog dus su sbyar/ /so so'i phyag rgya bcu po re re la/ /rigs ni lnga lnga dag dang ldan par bshad/ /thugs kar bkan ①bde gshegs rigs yin te/ /rang rigs sor mo yig 'bru rdo rje rigs—/ /zla bsdul 'bru sbas dril bsil rin chen rigs/ /'khril tshul chos la brtan pa pad+ma'i rigs/ /de nyid byed pa las kyi rigs/ /yum yang thugs brtan bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs/ /dril bsel rdo rje las 'khril las su bshad/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan rin chen rigs zhes bya/ /yum gyi rgya bcas gsum te pad+ma'i rigs/ /de ltar bcings pas lnga bcu'i phyag rgya rdzogs/ /sems dpa' la sogs bcings pa dam tshig rgyal/ /kun bzang yab yum ting 'dzin phyag rgyar bya/ /yang na kun bzangs rjoyab kyi spyi rgyar bshad/ /yum ni thal mo'am yum gyi spyi rgya yin/ /rigs kyi bye brag kun la shes bya ste/ /de ltar brtsigs na nyis brgya bcu yin no/ /de ltar spros pas phyag rgya bsam mi khyab—/ /phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u ste/ brgyad pa'o// //de nas mnyan ma'i dkyil 'khor bshad bya ba/ /gang gis ji ltar gang bshad rnam pa gsum/ /gang gis bde gshegs yab yum dgyes chen pos/ /ji ltar phyi rabs rnal 'byor snyom ⑤'jug phyir/ /gsang ba dam tshig bkod la 44—29

snyoms zhugs nas/ /'gro ba'i ched du 'di dag bshad pa mdzad/ /'dul dbang che chung rims pa'i bye brag ni/ /sor bzhi pa dang sor brgyad khru gang dang //khru bzhi pa dang khru ni bcu gnyis dang / /bcu drug nyi shu nyi shu rtsa lngar bya/ /rgyang grags dpag tshad mtha' mnyam par/ /che chung rims pa bcu gcig rnam grangs yin/ /sor bzhi dkyil 'khor 'bri dang mchod pa dang / /'jug dang slob ma dbang skur rnams ①bzhi yin/ /dgongs dang gang du gang zi ji tsam tshad—/ /mgo ma ye dang thig gdab dbyibs dang ni/ /gdan dang dgod thabs rgyan dgod dang ni bcu'o/ /dgongs pa shin tu 'phra la rab sbyangs nas/ /ting 'dzin las su rung zhes mkhas pas bshad // //sderten bcas dngos grub mi 'da' thob par bshad/ /gang du bdag nyid rnal 'byor rab ldan pa'i/ /phyag mthil nyid dang shing leb lta bu rung / /gang 'dri rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi rtsa gzhi yin pas thugs/ /tshad ni ma nges 'dir ni sor bzhi pa'o/ /sku lnga las lnga yon tan lnga thugs lnga/ /gsum lnga rigs ni rnam lngar byin brlabs las/ /'bru spos rin chen snying pa sman bdud rtsi/ /sum cu cha bsnyams 'go ma yeng du bya//rig pas bcad bri 'am sems kyis dgod/ /gzugs brnyan nyid kyi dkyil 'khor zhes kyang bya/ /dbyibs ni rang bzhin ting 'dzin ci 'dra de nyid yin/ /gdan lnga 'phra mo tsam du rim pas dgod/ /yig 'bru phyag rgya dgos pa de bzhin no—/ /rgyan ni kha dog bcos pa'i sna tshogs ras/ /bla rgyan 'og rgyan bar rgyan mdzes pa dang / /rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pa'i 'phreng bas bskor/ /gzugs sgra dri ro bza' btung de bzhin bskor/ /mchod pa phyi dang nang dang 44—30

sbyin sreg dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs mchod pa dang / /khyad par chen po'i mchod pa dang / /yon tan dang ni mi dmigs bsgom/ /rnam pa dgu por shes par bya'o//phyi tshul glu tshig bro gar rol mo'i/ /tshogs mchog sprin phung rnyed kyis mchod par bya—/ /nang tshul lha mo rnam pa bcu gsum rnams/ /ji ltar 'tshams pa'i las bzhin byen rlabs mchod/ /sbyin sreg rims ①par mchod sbyin rnams kyis mchog /zlum po gru bzhi zla gam gru gsum dbyebs/ /dkar ser dmar nag bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje rin chen mda' gzhu thod pas mtshan/ /lha tshogs kun gyi zhal ni mi rnams 'bod/ /bza' btung las bzhi'i mchod sbyin mchog yin no/ /zhing dang rgyas pa zhi ba'i tshogs la ste/ /dbang drag gnyis la 'phros pa'i dkyil 'khor bya/ /de yang sor bzhi pa la tsam nas su/ /nam mkha' mtha' snyams ⑦bar du de bzhin bya/ /ting 'dzin cho 'phrul mchod pa bya ba dang / /rang rig mchod sprin sna tshogs snang bas na/ /zhing khams longs spyod sna tshogs ldan pa ru/ /rin chen gzhal yas brgyan mchog mdzes spras pa/ /der ni lha dang lha mo mdzes ldan rdul rnyed dag /bro gar glu tshig tshogs rol 'jig rten khams bkang 'bul/ /kun bzang mchod pas bskal ldan rtogs khyad par/ /blo'i khyad par dus gcig gi ①rims kyis/ /chos dbyings mnyam sbyor mchod sprin phyag rgya bsgom/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor ma'am byin gyis brlabasarjo/ /gnas lngar rigs yum lnga dang yan lag khro mo bzhi/ /yab yum gnyis med lhag pa'i sbyor sems las/ /gzhal yas dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i dpe brjod pa/ /nyung 'bru nang du stong gsum shongs tshul du/ /44—31

yum gyi mkha' dbyings gnyis las brnyan mar gsal bton te/ /gnyis med lhag pa'i sems kyis mchod par bya/ /mnyes nas grub ste dam tshig mchog du gsungs—/ /khyad par bdag nyid mchod pas rgyal bas mnyes/ /'gro rnams dga' bas sbyin pas khyad ①par 'gyur/ /de bas thams cad mnyam pas dbyings gcig go/ /yon tan sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor bstan byas na/ /phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / /'gro rnams bsod nams mngon thob 'gyur—/ /bdag gi lus ngag sems dang phyi nang chos rnams kun/ /don dam mi dmigs kun rdzob dmigs g.yor sdetshul snang ba/ /dmigs med nam mkha' la ni sgyu 'phrul nam mkha' bsgom/ /'jug pa'i dang po bdag nyid de nas slob ma 'jug /las rnams kun byas bdag po rigs pas 'jug /de nas slob ma'i spyi bor dkyil 'khor bzhag pa slob ma 'jug pa yin/ /de nas dbang bskur phyir ni ①yon mchog dbul bar bya/ /bde gshegs rigs kyi rgyal srid yon yin te/ /rang lus rdo rje rigs te bu dang chung ma pad+ma'i rigs/ /nor ni rin chen gces dang yid 'thad las rigs yin/ /'dod yon lnga ni lha mo'i rang bzhin bla ma mchod byas na/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor mnyes ste bla ma de nyid dkyil 'khor na/ /nye ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mnyes pa smos ci dgos/ /slob dpon mnyes na 'di dang gzhan ma'i nyes pa dag par 'gyur/ /slob ma dad dang brtson 'grus brtul shugs rtog pa mchog ldan na/ /phan dang nus pa phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams kyang / /snod kyi rims par dusbyar te chud ma zos par sbyin/ /thal mo rab snol sor brgyad dkyil 'khor yang ni de ltar bya/ /khru gang bzhi dang bcu gnyis sa gzhi rab mnyam te/ /sa gzhi gzungs phur dang 44—32

ni thig skud tshon byed dang / /chas gos lnga dang tshad ldan sngags g.yon ldan par byarka/ /zig gdab cho ga la sogs mkhas pas bsgrims te bya/ /'khru ni bcu drug nyi shu 'am nyi shu rtsa lngar 'ang de bzhin bya/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid ye shes lnga'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms par bya/ /rgyal ba'i gzugs dang yi ge phyag mtshan ldan pa'i gzugs kyang dgod/ /'khor rnams phyag mtshan phal pa la ni yi ge dgod—/ /rgyangs grags dpag tshad mkha' dbyengs bsam yas ni/ /rig pas dpags te 'di yang gzugs brnyan yin zhes bya/ /rdul tshon bri ba'i dgos pa dang ni tshon dgye dang / /chen po gsum gyi dgongs dang byin rmis brlabs pa dang / /spyan drangs bsnyen pa bya dang dngos grub mtshan nyid dang / /bsgrub pa'i yan lag yo byad dus dang 'bras bu dang / /yi dam gzugs dang me tog dor dang gags bstan pa/ /rnam pa bcu gsum gyis ni 'grub par gsungs//tshon gyi dgos pa rang bzhin ting 'dzin nyid/ /gsang ba ma mthong rmongs la bstan pa yin/ /tshon sna lnga 'am nyi shu rtsa lnga nyid/ /dkar dmar ser ljang mthing kha rim bzhin dgye/ /de nyid 'bru lnga ye shes lngar byin rlabs/ /rgyangs grags dpag tshad nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa/ /nying 'dzin rgya cher glo sbyangs rol mo mtha' yas mchog gi phyir/ /byin rlabs tha sogs yi ge 'am nyi zla'i gdan—/ /hūṃ sogs snying po 'am rdo rje la sogs thugs kyi rgya/ /gzugs kyi sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan ldan par bya'o/ /de yang ting 'dzin bstan pas byin rlabs bya/ /chen po gsum yang dngos su bya bar dka'/ /'di yang byen gyis rlabs te yid kyis dgod bya na/ /ya mtshan sman gyi dngos grub sangs rgyas kun gyi dam mi dha/ /sa la sogs pa gzugs brnyan lus la sogs bya ste/ /mtshan 44—33

ma'i brten du byas na rnam grol rim grub ni/ /rang rig ye shes kyis ni rims bzhin byin rlabs te/ /sems kyis sbyangs na spyi ①smos de nyid ye shes yin/ /spyan drangs phyogs dus rang bzhin thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid du thams cad spyan drangs pa/ /sgyu 'phrul nyid las dza spyos ②thams cad dgug par 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa'i mtshan nyid rang rig dkyil 'khor la—/ /gnyis med 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid rab sbyor bas/ /bzlas brjod byin dang bsdu ba'i bsnyen pa yis/ /phyogs bcu bde gshegs dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang / /mtshan ma dus dang grangs kyi bsnyen pa rab tu rdzogs/ /dkyil 'khor nye bar gyur te mchog gi dngos grub zar mi dha 'grub/ /dngos grub mtshan nyid rang sems bsod nams nyid/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub yin te gzhan na med/ /'khor lo sgyur rgyal dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang / /'dod pa'i longs spyod de dag rang sems snang las gzhan ma yin/ /sangs rgyas cho 'phrul ngo mtshar smad 'byung yang / /rang sems shes rab thabs nyid de ltar de bzhin nyid las thabs kyi phyag rgyar snang ba yang / /ye shes rang snang la ni ye shes rol pa bzang ①/ /ye shes nyid kyang sgyu ma yin phyir gsog /rang snang bsod nams ye shes de nyid 'jig rten 'das sogs dngos grub po/ /rgyal ba gzugs sku mngon 'byung bskyob dang byin rlabs ston pa yang / /rang sems rnam pa yin te gud na med/ /rang snang sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor bya ba byed nus la/ /gzi byin byin rlabs 'gro la phan 'dogs pa/ /de bzhin nyid las mi gnyis 'dus ma byas pa 'ang / /mdor na rang snang sems nyid de bzhin yin phyir ro/ /sems nyid snang ba kun yang rdo rje 'dus ma byas ces mkhas pas 44—34

bshad—/ /bsgrub pa'i yan lag cho ga rnam pa ①lnga rdzogs par bya/ /dang po stong pa byang chub gnyis pa snying rje chen po yin/ /gsum pa yi ge bzhi pa la ni dam tshig rgya/ /lnga pa ni gzugs rdzogs gzugs ldan yin/ /yo byad gnas mchog yid 'ong dang gdan mchog nyi zla pad sogs dang / /phyag mtshan rdo rje dril bu'i gzungs ma mtshan ldan dang / /a mri ta sogs phyi nang 'byor pa'i yo byad pa ldan bya/ /snying khar ye shes sems dpa' bsgom de'i snying khar nyi zla'i dkyil / /dam tshig phyag rgya bzhag te de stengs yig 'bru bzhag /zla tshes spros bsdus bzlas pa'i yan lag yin/ /bca' lnga ldan zhing dam tshig ma nyams bsgrub la brtson na 'grub/ /dus ni zla ba drug dang bcu gnyis bcu drug gis/ /tshe la dbang sogs rig 'dzin rab 'bring tha ma 'grub/ /'bras bu tshe dbang rig 'dzin de nyid kyis/ /tshe lo bcu drug gis ni sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /de ltar rig 'dzin khyad par de dag kyang / /ye shes nyid la nyid snang bsam yas mchog /zhing khams mi zad brgyan gyi 'khor lo ni/ /sprul pa bsam yas zhal mthong dang / /mnyes nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin/ /rig 'dzin rtsal gyi khyad par de nyid kyang / /tshogs gnyis mthun te ye shes rang snang ba'o/ /gcig dang du mar bral ba'i mtha' 'das de bzhin nyid/ /rgyal bas kyang ni gzigs pa ma yin te/ /rang 'byung ye shes nyid la mi gnas tshul tsam snang bar zad—/ /log par rtogs ②pas brtags pa kun kyang ye nas rnam mar ④cing / /rang snang ye shes dbyings dang de bzhin nyid las gud na yod ma yin/ /de phyir thugs rje chen pos 'brel pa'i 'gro drug dus gnas mun sel snang / /des na 'bras bu rang snang dkyil 'khor nyid du chos kun 'byung bar nges/ /don dam 44—35

dkyil 'khor nyid ni stang ①dbyal gnyis bsam bcu/ /gsal byas dad pas zhugs nas dngos grub yid 'ong mnyam par 'gyur/ /me tog dor te skal mnyam ye shes gang gnyer ba/ /gang gnyer ya mtshan dngos grub 'byung bar nges//bca' lngar mi ldan dad med dam tshig nyams na brlag par 'gyur te/ /mi 'grub gags su 'gyur ces rgyal bas gsung / /rdo rje dam tshig bkod pa'i le'u ste—/ dgu pa'o// //de nas dges chen rgyal pos sbyin la snyoms zhugs te/ /dbang mchog sbyin pa 'di nyid 'gro ba'i mched du brjod/ /spyi dang khyad par ma thob bskyon dang rdzas dang 'bras bu lnga'o/ /spyi ni yab yum phyag rgyar bsgom te sbyor ba las/ /bde mchog yig 'bru tshogs su rdo rje'i lam nas mkha' la 'khyil/ /rdo rje rtse nas gan du stems zhing so so'i dkyil 'khor bsgyur/ /so so nyan dang bsgrub dang las 'chad slob dpon nyid dang lnga'o/ /nyan pa sna bar sems spros gzhal yas bdan dang bcas/ /tram̐ gnyis las ni rin chen phyag rgya bskur gyur gsal spro thims—/ /gsang gsum mnyan cha mi smra tshig bshad bsgrags/ /bsgrub pa snying khar de bzhin sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rdo rje gzungs dang mchod dang sbyor dang tshig bshad bsgrags/ /las ni lag par de bzhin las rigs spro stem bya—/ /las dang pho nya byed par bka' yis rab tu bsgrags/ /'chad pa lce la pad+ma'i rigs yin te/ /snod mthun gsang ba grags pa'i tshig bshad brjod/ /slob dpon yan lag lnga la zhi khro'i tshom bu lngas/ /dkyil 'khor byed dang dbang sbyin ces par bka' yis bsgrags/ /skyon ni bla ma ma mnyes lnga po ma thob par/ /44—36

lnga por rtsom pa dngos grub med brlag nges/ /de dus rdzas kyi rnam pa dgos pa yang / /chos kyi rgyal tshab thob phyir rigs lnga'i dbu brgyan sbyin/ /shes bya ma dmongs sna tshogs dar byi gcod pan te/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin me tog 'phreng ba btags/ /gzhan gyis mi thub brgya gram go cha bskon/ /bdud las rgyal ba'i chu srin rgyal mtshan btad/ /mi dha mi shig rigs kyi phyag rgyas btab/ /tsha gdungs bsel phyir skyob pa gdugs kyi dgab/ /bag chags sbyangs phyir yum lnga'i bum pa bstan/ /'dod pa'i yon tan longs spyod bza' btung btab/ /nges pa'i 'bras bu smin phyir snying po lnga/ /'di dag rdzas su sbyin ces rgyal bas gsung / /'bras bu rgyal sras ngan song med pa dang / /'jig rten tshe dang bde ba thob pa dang / /mtho rigs lha mi thar pa'i chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /dbang sbyin pa'i le'u ste/ bcu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos/ /rgyal po'i tshogs su dbang bskur mnyam gzhag ①te/ /bde ba'i mchog gi le'u 'di 'gro ba'i mched du brjod/ /rnal 'byor dgongs pa'i khyad par dang / /byin rlabs bya dang sbyor sgol dang / /'jug pa 'bras bur bcas pa dang / /zhi khro tshom bu'i drangs bstan pa/ /rnam pa drug gis yang dag bshad/ /dgongs pa rgyu gcig yig 'bru byin rlabs mngon sum rtogs rnams ⑤bzhi/ /rgyu gcig don dam kun rdzob dbyer med pa/ /ma skyes sgyu ma snang dang rang bzhin med par gcig /a khro ā+oṃ ste sku gsung thugs rang bzhin/ /ma skyes sgyu ma dbyer med yig byeda'i byed//ras dkar dmar po don ①gyi bsgyur byed du/ /rgyu gcig yig 'brus chos kun 44—37

byin gyis zlobs/ /lung dang man ngag mi brten mi 'gal bar/ /rang rig blo yis mngon gsum rtogs zhes bshad/ /rtogs gzhis chos kun mngon rdzogs rgyal po che/ /gang zhig de rtogs tshogs kyi bdag por gsung / /rdzogs chen rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes kyang de la bya/ /ji ltar yan lag lnga dang dbang po lnga//rnam shes lngas bsdus rnams smin oṃ du bsgoms/ /zhi khro rgyal ba yab yum byin gyis brlabs/ /'dod yon lnga sogs yul gyi rnam pa kun/ /rnam pa ma yin yi ge sum̐ du bsgom/ /zhi khro dbyings phyug yum du bsgom par bya/ /gos brgyan bza' btung glu tshig bro gar sprin tshogs kun/ /byang chub sems tshogs yi ge hūṃ du rab bsgoms te/ /spyad dang dngos grub 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor mnyes/ /oṃ sum̐ hūṃ nyid sku gsung thugs yin byin rlabs bya/ /sbyor ba'i gzungs ma lha klu'i bu mo 'am rigs ngan sogs/ /zhi rgyas dag la dbye ba 'am dbang drag dag la mi dbye bar/ /mnyes ①bsgrub rnams bzhi rim pa rab tu tsam/ /bsnyen pa don dam byang chub sems shes yin/ /nye ba'i snyen pa bdag nyid phyag rgyar bsgom—/ /bsgrub pa yum nyid gzungs su byin rlabs bya/ /bsgrub chen yab yum gnyis med byin rlabs la/ /mkha' las ④sems 'phros bdag mchod rgyal ba mnyes/ /'gro tshims nyi zla rdo rje lce yis dngos zos na/ /nam mkhar 'gro dang mdog mdangs tshe ring ba/ /thun mong mchog gi bsgrub pa yin bzhin bdag por 'gyur/ /bsgral ba'i zhing 'gyur rgyu mchog rnam lnga pa①/ /a 'bras rgun 'brum pa na se dang ge rgyas a ga ru/ /mchog phran gzhan yang mchog gi bsdus pa kun/ /blo ngan 'jig rten zhes dusu bde gshegs gsung / /mkhas pas a ma las ni nyi zla'i steng du bzhag /gtsug du ye shes sems dpa' 44—38

ngan song sbyongs/ /che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed cing sor mo 'bru bcu bsgom/ /'bru bcu'i 'od kyis rnam shes bsregs nas hūṃ du dag /hūṃ nyid mkha' la thims par 'phangs te phyag rgyar bsgyur/ /de las skur gsal 'od 'phros brgyan dang ldan / /gnyis su med par bsgral zhes de la bya/ /don dam skye med kun rdzob mig g.yor tshul/ /sbyor bsgol byas kyang rdul tsam bya mi dmigs/ /'jug pa 'bras bcas dag mnyam gsum dang bzhi/ /snod ni 'byung lnga gzhal yas yum du dag /phung po bcud rnams rgyal ba yab du dag /tshogs brgyad sems rgyud ye shes lngar dag rtogs/ /de tshe don dam ma skyes dbyings su mnyam/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma phyag rgya chen por mnyam/ /shes rig lha dang yul rnams lha mor mnyam| /des na thams cad dkyil 'khor kun du bzang po'i zhing / /byed spyod nyid kyang tshogs gnyis rdzogs par rol/ /de phyir rang bzhin lhun grub tshogs zhes gsungs/ /bkra drangs tshogs de dkyil 'khor byed pa'i tshe/ /yan lag lnga po ma nyams yo byad rnams lngar ldan/ /cho ga lnga rdzogs tshogs 'dus dkyil 'khor gyis/ /nges par legs pa'i dngos grub dgongs pa 'grub/ /tshod bu'i grangs kyang lnga dang gsum dang gcig /rigs lnga rigs gsum rigs gcig tshom bu la/ /khro bo khro mo nyi shu'i 'khor lo bskor/ /tshom bu de kun gtso gzungs zung du 'khril/ /khro bo'i tshom bu grangs kyang de bzhin te/ /pho nya phyag brnyan bka' nyan ci bgyi rnams/ /'khor bar dngos grub las rnams rdzogs par byed/ /tshogs kyi le'u ste/ bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas rgyal po dgyes chen pos/ /rol mo sprin 'phro brgyan bkod rnams 44—39

bzhugs te/ /tshogs bsgrub le'u 'di 'gro ba'i mched du brjod/ /longs spyod so sor 'grub pa'i khyad par dang / /rig 'dzin spyi dang rigs kyi rnal 'byor dang / /'bras bu'i khyad par gegs med khyad lnga'o/ /so so'i sgyu 'phrul bstan pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyag rgya lnga'i dngos grub rnam pa lnga/ /lhun gyis grub par bde gshegs rgyal bas gsung / /rig 'dzin shes 'jug 'bras bu khyad par bsam yas pa/ /rtogs gzhi tshul rig shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /yang dang yang du gom pa 'jug pa ste/ /goms mthus ①sngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid yin/ /rgyu rkyen 'bras bu nus 'thur gang gyur pa/ /rig 'dzin zhes su rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /'dod khams lha mi tshangs pa'i skyes gnas su/ /skye gzhi rnam par dag pa 'dzin mod kyi/ /rtog pa'i khyad par sa la gnas 'gyur yin/ /byang chub sa bcu bde gshegs sa gsum ste/ /de nyid dus ni pha rol phyin bcu byang chub pa'i rgyu/ /sbyin sogs rab dga' la sogs lhun gyis grub/ /thabs kyi kun tu 'od yin shes rab pad+ma can/ /thabs dang shes rab ②mchog 'khor lo'i tshogs chen te/ /rgyu 'bras rims don ma yin lhun gyis grub/ /khyad par sa zhes lhun grub nyid la brjod/ /rigs kyi rnal 'byor rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /steng dbyal mkha' dbyengs nyi zla'i steng bsgom nas—/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus bsgom par 'gyur/ /de phyir rigs kyi rigs zhes brjod pa yin/ /phyogs dus kun nas sangs rgyas brtsal kyang mi rnyed te/ /rang rig sems nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor yin/ /de phyir sems las ma rtogs sangs rgyas gzhan du ma 'tshol gcig /rang sems rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun du rab sbyor bas/ /de phyir dkyil 'khor thams 44—40

cad 'grub par 'gyur zhes rgyal bas gsung / /rang sems dkyil 'khor nyid du rtogs chud na/ /cho ga lhag chad skyon min gags med yin/ /de skad brjod tshes rol mos bde gshegs mnyes/ /tshogs bsgrub pa'i le'u ①ste/bcu gnyis pa'o // //②de nas bde gshegs kun kyang cig du dgongs 'dus nas/ /lhun grub dam tshig snying po'i sprin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /mdor bsdus gsang ba 'di nyid 'gro ba'i ched ①du brjod/ /gsang ba'i spyi dang mdo dang rgyas dang mos pa'i yon tan dang / /rnyed dka' lam gyur rtad dang skyon dang rnam pa brgyad/ /spyi ni ma rtogs phyal dupa rgyangs phan dang / /log par rtogs pa mur thug mu stegs dang / /phyogs rtogs nyan thos rang rgyal rigs can dang / /yang dag ma rtogs byang chub shes bya'i bsgrib/ /'dul ba'i las ni bya ba gnyis ga rgyud/ /dgongs pa'i don sangs phyi sa thub pa'i rgyud/ /rang bzhin sku gsung thugs gsang rgyud rnams kun/ /bkri phyir rang bzhin gsang don rbas pa rnams/ /yi ge sgra btags tshogs 'byel ming tshogs la/ /rten pa'i tshig rnams kyis ni rab mtshon ste/ /dgongs pa'i dbang gis don gnyis gab cing sbas/ /kun gyi khongs na gnas pa'i don de gsang ba 'di las 'byin mdzad pa'i/ /theg pa kun la mkhas pa ston pa'i thugs la gnas/ /de phyir gsang ba'i snying po de kho na//de nyid nges pa'i khongs nas phyung zhes ston pas gsungs/ /'byung gnas bstan la phebs ces de nyid yin/ /sna tshogs don 'chad smra zhing ston ces de la bya/ /mdo don dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis bsdus bshad pa/ /dkyil 'khor de bzhin 44—41

nyid ces bya bar bshad/ /de bzhin nyid ldan rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gyis/ /gzugs brnyan lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor la/ /ting 'dzin lhag pa'i ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /tshogs chen bya ba dkyil 'khor nyid yin te—/ /dkyil 'khor las byung thugs rjes 'dul bar bshad/ /thugs ni byang chub rnams gnyis dkyil 'khor yin/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog du gsung / /bcu gnyis nyid du rgyud kyi don rdzogs te/ /gsang ba'i man ngag ces kyang de phyir brjod/ /rgyas pa de bzhin nyid ni rtogs dka' gsang ba spros med thika le te/ /dkyil 'khor kun 'byung phyir ni dbyengs ①ces gsungs//rang bzhin 'byung lnga dngos med shes rab yum/ /chen po rags pa thabs te yab lnga yin/ /gnyis med sems las sprul pa'i lha tshogs ni/ /dbang drug yul drug dus bzhi rnam pa drug /snephyin phyi ma log rang bzhin dkyil 'khor yin//rang bzhin kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thugs kyi ye shes lnga nyid byang chub sems yin te/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid chen po'i byang chub sems/ /snying po'i thig ler chos kun mnyam sbyar lhag par bshad/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i tshogs mchog mi zad rol mo kyis④/ /ye shes dges pa'i lha la mchod 'bul tshogs zhes bya/ /zag med rang rig bsod nams rgyu nyid kyis/ /ye shes rang snang sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor rol mo mtha' yas mchog /de nyid ting nge 'dzin te lhag pa'i ting 'dzin gsang ba'i thig le yum gyi dbyings/ /thig le de nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos gzhi yin/ /bde gshegs sku sogs bdag gi zhal mthong ba/ /rig pas dbang bsgyur dngos grub dam pa gzugs brnyan rnams gnyis yin/ /lhun grub dkyil 'khor la gnas dkyil 'khor ma lus nyid//44—42
