rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid du ma lus lhun gyi grub/ /des na dkyil 'khor mi zad brgyan du ma lus de dag bdag gis thogs/ /thugs rje rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mnyam sbyar las/ /snying rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor mi zad yongs kyi 'byung / /phyogs dus 'gro ba'i dkyil 'khor sprul pas 'dul ba yis/ /mgon po ji snyed sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor thabs kyis sgol ba yang / /bya byed med par spyod pas 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor yin par bde gshegs gsungs①/ /mos pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis shes rab gsum gyis mnyam sbyar bas/ /rang 'byung dkyil 'khor stod dam lhun gyis grub/ /'di las rgyal ba mchog kyang dha bar ga la mdzad/ /gang zhig dkyil 'khor 'di dag kun la mos pa'i skyes bu la/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun/ /sras kyi dam pa mchog du dgongs par 'gyur/ /'di ni rnyed dka' bskal pa rdul rnyed sbyangs pas snyen pa'o—/ /'bras bu gsang chen nges pa 'di yin te/ /drug gi 'jig rten phyogs bcu 'das dang da ltar rgyal ba yang / /gsang ba 'di snyed sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /de bzhin 'byung dang ma 'ongs ④'di yis grub/ /de'i ④phyir 'di ni gsang chen nges pa'i 'bras bur bulam gyur yin/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun la'ang 'di las nges don gzhan mi mnga'/ /gzhan nas rtsal bas rgyal bas kyang ni rnyed par ga la 'gyur/ /'di gtang rgyud kun las ni 'byung ba'i phyag rgya'i mchog /shes rab gsum gyis sbyangs pa'i dmigs ldan rnams kyis gzung ⑤/ /snod ldan ngang tshul bzang la blo brtan pa/ /lus dang longs spyod stong phod tsam las ma rtogs gzhan du mi sbyin no/ /gal te sbyin na rmongs 'phyar de nyid srog zad ngan 'gror ltung / /shin tu gsang ba man ngag snying po'i 44—43

le'u ste/ bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas dges pa chen po'i glu 'di blangs/ /glu drug blangs pas sangs rgyas che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs phyir/ /dang po tshogs chen gnyis su brtan pa dang / /gnyis pa rdo rje rnas bzhir brjod pa yin/ /gsum pa rdzogs chen rnam pa bzhir grags so/ /bzhi pa las ni mtha' yas bzhi zhes bshad/ /lnga pa rdul snyed rnam pa bzhir stong ①pa/ /drug pa sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa bzhi/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi bstod pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /mnyes pa'i le'u ste/ bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas bde gshegs rgyal po'i rgyal ba bdag po des/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor nyid du mngon par 'du ②mdzad de/ /ci'i phyir ji ltar 1la nas las bskos mdzad dang gsum/ /ci'i phyir 'dul mdzad rnam pa gsum yin te/ /khams gsum pa'i rgyu dang rkyen dang 'bras bu'o/ /rgyu ni bdag rtogs la sogs dmongs pa'i bar/ /srid pa'i sa bon rtsub mos 'phangs pa rkyen yin te/ /'dis bu dmyal ba yi dwags srin po gsum/ /ru tra rnam gsum zhes kyang de la bya//ji ltar 'dul dbang dag gis drug 'dul te/ /che mchog nyid dang khro bo mchod pa dang / /rdo rje zhe sdang dang ni rdo rje srin po dang / /rdo rje khro bo dang ni 'jigs byed khro bo'o/ /che mchog khro bo'i ting 'dzin snyoms zhugs nas/ /gnyis med mtha' las khro bo 'chod pa bstan no/ /de ni che mchog dkyil 'khor dang po yin/ /khro bo 'chol ①pas rdul snyed cho 'phrul ston/ /phyogs bcu'i de pa thams cad 'dul bar mdzad/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa zhes ni de la bya/ /44—44

de nas che mchog dbus kyi rtsor bsgyur te/ /phyogs bcu'i khro bo 'dus nas rigs bzhir gyur/ / gzung bcas gregs ①pa gnon pa'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /zhe sdang rdo rje zhes bya'i dkyil 'khor gsum pa'o/ /dreg pa nga rgyal ston pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /de nyid dbu dgu srin por snang bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje srin po bsgral nas zhal du stob/ /dbang phyug ma rnams sngags kyi bsdu ba mdzad/ /de ni srin po'i dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'o/ /de nyid khrag 'thung rigs lngar snang byas te| /dbang phyug ma rnams so so'i sku la 'khril/ /re re las kyang phra men nyi shu'i tshogs bston ①te/ /rang rang gnas nas su ni mkhod par bya/ /de phyir byi mo zhes kyang de la bya/ /phra men re re la yang tshogs zhes de phyir brjod/ /de nas 'byung mor rang rang gnas su phaṭa kyis 'phags/ /dbang phyug chen mo kun mi rtsang rnams du gton/ /rnams ④nas u rtsus phyung ste 'dam 'thung blar dudran rnyed/ /de ni dkyil 'khor lnga pa zhes su bshad/ /de la 'jigs byed dbu ni dgu rgya pa/ /kun las phyag rgya sprul las ⑤'jigs par bston0/ /de tshe 'dul ⑦thabs bsam yas tha dad pas/ /phyi nang bdud tshogs thams cad dus gcig stul/ /de ni 'jigs byed ces kyang rug par bshad/ /las bskos pas ni de dag 'dar byed nas/ /'bangs ⑧su gnas bor dkyil 'khor gdan la bzhag /rang rang gnas su ma sring bu mo chung ma rnams/ /phul ste tshogs kyang mkhas blangs gnas bor ro/ /grub pa lang ka'i tshogs su mkhas 'ches so/ /ma sring bu mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /'khor du 'dus te las kyi dngos grub mnos/ /ming brtags lag du rdo rje byin nas dkyil 'khor phyi rol bkod/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par 'phros pa'i le'u ste/ bco lnga pa'o// //44—45

de nas bcom ldan dges chen pos/ /khro bo gsung phyung ba/ ci'i phyir gang las gang phyung phyung ba'i mthu dang bzhi/ /spyi phyir khro tshogs byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /gang las khrag 'thung sku gsung thugs rdo rje las/ /gang phyung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad gsang sngags dang / /spyan drangs bzhugs dang dngos grub blangs pa dang / /mchod dang dkyil 'khor ston te rnams drug yin/ /lnga bcu rtsa brgyad khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ /ta tha ga ta badz+ra rad na dang / /pad+ma karmā rtsa ba'i snying po ste/ /ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa la sogs las kyi yin/ /kar mo la sogs sa bon ha brgyad te/ /badz+ra ko'u ri la sogs rtsa ba'i sngags su bshad/ /seng ha la sogs brgyad kyang de bzhin no/ /dza hūṃḥbaṃ ho sgo bsrungs sa bon yin/ /rang rang rigs ces rtsa ba'i sngags ces gsungs/ /phra men nyi shu'i tshogs la mgo dang mjug ①nyid du/ /ā+oṃ dang hūṃ phaṭa brgyan te zlas byas na/ /ci 'dod las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad bh+yo yis bskul bar gsungs—/ /e ha te a na ya dzā hūṃ baṃ ho ram̐ gyis spyan yang drangs/ /ā+oṃ badz+rar ②kro ta sa ma ya hūṃ gis 'jug pa nyid du bya/ /dngos grub blang phyir bskul tshig 'di dag brjod/ /dregs pas khro la thugs rjes 'phros pas dreg pa ngang gis zhi mdzad pa/ /thugs rje dpal chen rngams pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa rnams/ /khro rgyal rngams pa'i sku gsung yon tan 'phrin las dmad po che/ /dus 'di nyid du rnal 'byor bdag la brtsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ya sto phaṭa ho/ces pas blangs par bya/ de nyid khrag 'thung sbyor ba'i bdar yang mkhas pas bshad—/ /a li u li ta la ta pa li tram̐ kho na ro'u tri/ kha ram̐ yo gi ni khahra ho 44—46

zhes mchod par bya/ /de nyid gnyis med po de bstan pa'i bdar yang mkhas pas bshad/ /hūṃ ha he phaṭa ces pa snying po'i gdon/ /de nyid mkha' la gdon par yang ni rgyal bas gsungs/ /nus mthu yis tshig 'bar gang bar che 'bring rnam pa dgu'o/ /khro bo sngags kyi le'u ste/ bcu drug pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das dgyes pas nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir/'gro ba'i ched du dkyil 'khor de nyid ched du brjod par mdzad/ /dbyibs brgyan ①gdan dang mdog dang cha lugs dang / /chas dang gsung sgra phyag mtshan btsun mo nyid dang 'khor/ /rnam pa 'di bcus 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /dbyibs ni ye shes me 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ /mu khyud gru chad sgo bzhi bar 'khyams gnyis kyis gru bzhir mdzes/ /gnas kyi brgyan mchog thod pa'i 'phreng ba tshar gsum dbang tshad sgol/ /sprul lnga rigs lnga mnga' mnyes dug lnga lhun gyis grub/ /nyi ma gsal sreg ②rang bzhin mdzad par bshad/ /me'i rang bzhin 'bar ba la ni 'phro ba mang po 'khrug /gdan mchog 'dul dka' mi 'jigs khyu mchog dang / /stobs mchog ma hā hes thig le blong yang gzigs/ /dpa' bstun za byed stag dang gtum tum ④dom gyis sder mo yis/ /dbang phyug che dang dri za gnod sbyin srin bu rjogashin rje so sor gzung / /de phyir che ba'i che ba dbang phyug yang ches gnon ces bshad/ /sku mdog drag po'i kha dog lngar snang ba/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga drag po'i mdog yin no/ /tshul dgu ldan phyir 'jigs pa'i sku zhes bshad/ /cha lugs rnam sa ⑤thar dbu gsum pha rol phyin drug phyeg /zhabs bzhi bsgod med mthar phyin lam zhes 44—47

bshad—/ /chas ni zhing dang glang chen ko rlon stag sogs sku la gsol/ /thod sbrul nyi mas dbu dang 'gur chu phyag zhabs bskyed par brgyan/ /gsung sgra hūṃ phaṭa la sogs 'jigs par bsgrags/ /stong gi 'jig rten la sogs phyag mtshan mtshon char bsnams/ /cis 'dul thabs kyi rang rang lag cha ma nges sna tshogs bsnams—/ /btsun mo'i tshogs ni cha lugs yab dang 'thun par 'khril/ /de ltar yab yum bcu po che bar ①brtsis 'gyur na/ /dbu ni sum cus rnam thar sum cu mtshon pa ste/ /rig lnga dbyengs dang ye shes rnam thar sum cu yin/ /dgu bcu'i spyan gyis nyon mongs dgu bcu'i mtha' la gzigs/ /drug cu'i snyan gyis lta ba drug cu'i mtha' bsan ④cing / /drug cu'i shangs nas drug cu'i 'dul ba sprul pa 'phro/ /drug cu'i ljags kyi lta ba drug cu'i dul thabs 'chad/ /drug cu'i gnas su drug cu'i skur ston pa/ /drug cu'i thugs kyi drug cu'i 'dul thabs mnga'/ /zhabs ni bzhi bcu lam yang bzhi bcu bsgrod med bkrol/ /dbyings dang ye shes kyis ni stag ①chad mtha' bcom pas/ /lta gnas drug cu rtsa gnyis 'joms zhes mkhas pas bshad/ /spyir na bzhi brgya drug cu'i dgongs pa bsam mi khyab/ /bsnams pa brgyan gyis che ba bshad pa yang / /dbu brgyan dang ni 'gur chu gsum gsum ste/ /dpung brgyan dang ni phyag rdub drug drug yin/ /sku la g.yang gzhi ko rlon sham thabs rkyed ④bcings bzhi bzhis brgyan pa'o/ /zhabs rdubs bzhi yin mi ris brgyan pa ste/ /lnga gnyis dag la spyir na nyis brgya bdun cus brgyan/ /de dag mtshan ma'i gnyer gyis ci rigs bshad par bya/ /gnas yul sgo bskyongs ⑤blas dang byi mo'i tshogs/ /zhing gi stan dang rang rang lag char bcas/ /ci bgyi zhes tes ga bzhugs chas 44—48

nas gnas/ /de dag dbu cig spyan gsum snyan shangs ljags dang ni/ /sku dang thugs dang zhabs ni gnyis gnyis te/ /re re la yang bcu drug cha dang ldan//bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad tshogs la rtsis 'gyur na/ /bdun brgya drug cu rtsa brgyad rdzogs par bshad/ /spyir na brgya phrag bcu gnyis dang ni nyi shu rtsa bzhir bshad//dbu brgyan 'gur chu dag ni re re ste/ /dpung rgyan zhabs rdub phyag rdub gnyis gnyis yin/ /g.yang bzhi ①la sogs lnga po btso ②dang 'thun/ /de ltar rtsis na drug brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin/ /spyir na brgyan byi che ba brgyad brgya dang ni dgu bcu bzhi'o/ /de ltar stong phrag gnyis dang brgya dang bco brgyad kyis/ /gdul bya'i dgongs pa bsam yas lhun gyis grub/ /'gro ba gcig la'ang de kun tshang bas na/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor yin ces rgyal bas de phyir gsung / /de bas de phyir rtsis las 'das ces mkhas pas bshad/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u ste/bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas ston pa mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'gro ba'i don du 'di brjod pa/ /sbyor dang sgol dang bdud rtsi 'dod yon dang / /'bras bu dang ni the tshom gsal ba rnam drug yin/ /sgol ba bdag gzhan gnyis su med pa ste/ /thog mar bdag nyid mnyam pa'i don rtogs dang / /bstan par bsgom ste sgral ces rgyal bas gsung / /gzhan ni rtogs ldan gnyis med blo can gyis/ /ma gtogs sems can snying rjes bsgral ba'i phyir/ /bdag gzhan gnyis med dbyings su gcig par bsgral/ /gnyis med 'khril ba'i lhag sems mnyam sbyor gyis/ /44—49

bdag nyid bde spongs bde gshegs mchog sbyor yin/ /mnyam pa'i grub rdzas bdud rtsi rnams lnga po/ /bdag dang mnyam pa'i bde gshegs tshogs la 'bul/ /'dod yon bza' rtsang bgo dang longs spyod lnga/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor yin te dkyil 'khor tshogs la 'bul/ /'bras bu rang sems bde gshegs yon tan te//lha klu mthu chen gzhan las ga la 'byung / /de phyir sems nyid las su rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rang lus phyag rgyar gsal cing som nyi med gyur na/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dngos grub 'bar ba 'grub/ /de skad brjod pas mchod pa thams cad kun du khyab/ /mchod sbyin dam pa bstan pa'i le'u ste/ bco brgyad pa'o// //don rnams yod par bya ba'i phyir/ /dam tshig 'gro ba'i ched du brjod/ /phun sum tshogs dang rnam dag dang ni mnyam nyid dang / /rtsa dang yan lag nyams rkyon yon tan dang / /grogs ngan spangs dang rang bzhin dbye ba dang / /dgongs pa'i don dang grub dang yon tan rnams/ /rnam pa bcu gsum gyis ni yang dag bshad/ /phun sum tshogs pa bla med theg 'di la/ /nyon mongs spyad kyang 'bras bu tshogs 'gyur te/ /tshogs kun rdzogs pa tshul khrims phun sum tshogs—/ /rnam dag bla med mchog gi dam tshig 'dis①/ /'dul dbang sdom pa ji snyed gsung pa yang / /'dir 'dus 'dis bsung ②ngang du rnam par dag /mnyam nyid zhes pa bzhi po ma grub te/ /don dam yod med dbu mar mi dmigs shing / /kun rdzob snang ba sgyu ma mig yor tshul yin pas/ /srog dang srog gcod bcad pa ga la yod/ /srog dang skyes bur brtags pa'ang log par 44—50

brtags—/ /bden gnyis dbyer med dbyings su ro gcig pas/ /thams cad rang las sprul te longs spyod ste/ /de bas rdzas dang ma byen len dang blang mi dmigs/ /chos kun sgyu ma ming tshig brtags ①kun brdzun/ /brdzun la ②brdzun spyod brdzun btags ga la yod/ /chags med dbyings la rigs ④pas chags pa dang / /chags spyod nyid na chags dang chags med chags yul med/ /ma tshangs spyod nyid tshang mchog tshang chen yin/ /de bas byed spyod thams cad tshogs chen rdzogs par rol/ /rtsa ba rnam lnga bsgrub dang gsungs pa'i dam tshig yin—/ /yan lag bcu ni ye nas dag mnyam rtog pas spyad/ /rtsa ba lnga nyams sangs rgyas rigs med skyon/ /'dir yang bsgrub pa log 'gyur phyi mar yid du mi 'ong 'gyur/ /yan lag brda dka' 'bras bu med de ngan song ltung / /ma nyams yon tan sangs rgyas mnyam thob 'gyur/ /grogs ngan rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa'i 'chal ba dag /nyams na myur du gso' la mi brtson pa'i gang zag dang / /skad cig smras pa tsam gyis nyes pa brjod mi lang / /rang gzhan rdo rje sangs rgyas bdag nyid yin/ /dbye ba rtsa ba'i dam tshig lnga po gcig la yang / /rang gi mtshan nyid thabs dang rang bzhin med pa shes rab gnyis ces bya/ /gcig la'ang rigs de la sku gsung yon tan 'phrin las thugs/ /gzhi dang yan lag de ltar bcu phrag gsum zhes bya/ /de'i steng du gzhi mo yum bcu snan nas brgya drug cu/ /yan lag bcu po cig la'ang ni rigs lnga ste/ /de las sku gsung thugs te nyi shur 'gyur/ /de ltar spyir na gsum brgya drug cur 'gyur/ /dgongs pas 'gro ba'i rnam rtog ji snyed pa/ /de 'dul snyen por dam tshig de nyid 'phro/ /kun bzang chen po yon tan ji snyed pa/ /bsam yas dam tshig 44—51

'dis ni 'grub par gsungs/ /yon tan dam tshig bsrungs pa'i rig 'dzin ste//srid gsum brtso dang de'i 'khor gyis bkur/ /sangs rgyas sras mchog dpa' bos spun du dgongs/ /bde gshegs thun mong min pa'i yul du zhugs/ /kun bzang 'jigs med phyag rgya chen por sbyor/ /bde gshegs spyod dang 'dul thabs bsam yas pa/ /de dag kun kyang rnam dag lhun gyis grub/ /dam tshig nyams kyang gso' ru rungs zhes bde gshegs gsung / /gzhan yang bsam yas yon tan brjod mi lang / /de skad brjod pas sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /dam tshig gi le'u ste/ /bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan bder ①gshegs dgyes chen pos/ /lhun grub byin gyis slob par mnyam gzhag snenas/ /rnam pa bzhi yis 'phrin las 'gro ba'i byed ①du brjod—/ /thabs kyi bye brag dang ni khyad par 'phrin las dang / /phyi nang gsang ba gnas kyi khyad par gsum/ /thabs kyis bye brag so so maṇ+ḍal dang / /lha'i khyad par dang ni ting 'dzin dang / /mchod sbyin dang ni rgyu dang gzugs bya dang / /dgug dang gdab dang tshogs la dbul ba dang / /phyag rgya dang ni dgongs pa gang yin pa/ /lhag ma byin ste rnam pa bcu gnyis yin/ /dkyil 'khor e baṃ ma ya tshogs mchog rnams/ /gru gsum zla gam gru bzhi rlum por bshad—/ /gtum chen rngams dang gzi brjid lhun chen dang / /'du 'phro gzi chen gsal ba'i gzi brjid ni/ /drag dbang rgyas shing lha'i khyad par yin//khro bo chags ④dga' ba dang ni ting 'dzin dang / /de dus 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro tshim bya/ /ling ga'i rgyu ni bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga las/ /gang 44—52

'dod gzugs byas snying khar ming bris te/ /de'i rnam par shes pa dgug ste dbab / /khro dang chags dang nga rgyal dga' 'phro dang / /lhan ṣ+pe gsal ba grub pa las bzhi'o/ /dbyebs dang kha dog mtshan ldan rab tu gdab/ /de nyid so so tshogs la stems par dbul/ /de ni lu gu rgyud du 'byel gdam bcings bskyod bya/ /dgongs pas ①sangs rgyas sku yang stsos gegs tshig pa dang //dgug 'gyur phyir 'byeng dbang du gyur pa dang / /yid bzhin gter gyis nam mkha' 'gengs pa dang / /gtum chen rngams pa'ang mig yor ldan ṣ+per 'gyur/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo ②bran du bcas pa la/ /lhag ma byin te gang 'dod de la bsgo| /khyad par 'phrin las khrag 'thung tshogs rnams kyis/ /bskyod pa'i bro dang phyag rgya'i gar dang ni/ /snyan pa'i gru blang sngags kyi tshig rnams kyis/ /ci 'dod la sogs las rnams 'grub par gsung / /zhi rgyas dbang drag phyi nang gsang ba'i gnas/ /ljon shing can dang lcug bran rgyas pa'i tshal/ /shing gcig drung dang mes tshig phyi'i gnas/ /ma smras pa dang pu tra ma 'phel dang / /skye rgyud med dang bkra mi shis gsang ba/ /ting 'dzin rnam pa bzhi ni nang gi yin//'phrin las kyi le'u ste/ nyi shu pa'o// //de nas bde gshegs nyid kyis dkyil 'khor che ba'i glu blangs pa/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi①/ /rang bzhin spyir stod pa ste glu drug yin/ /re re la yang dbye na bzhi bzhi ste/ /che ba nyi shu rtsa bzhir shes par bya/ /de kun las dang rang bzhin 'thun dpes bshad/ /khro bo la bstod pa'i le'u ste/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //44—63

de nas bcom ldan dges chen pos/ /gsang ba 'di nyid snang bya'i phyir/ /sdud pa kun tu bzang po la/ /bstan pa gzung bar ched du brjod/ /kye zhes su bos ①nas su/ /gsang ba bsdu bar gtad pa mdzad/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs ngo bo las/ /gzungs 'dzin spros pa mchis ⑧pa'i ngo bor 'khor / /de nyid bzlog phyir sangs rgyas rims bkod pa/ /gsang ba'i snying po'i ngang du bkod par zad/ /bde gshegs ngo 'tshar bsam yas dkyil 'khor kun gyis bshad pa yang / /'gro ba'i don du 'gyur zhes rgyal bas bshad/ /de kun nang na bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya gsang chen snying po mchog du gsung / /mchog 'di rtogs nas 'chad par byed pa'i skyes bu ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid yin te gsang ba'i dbang yang rdzogs/ /ci'i phyir zhes na rgyal ba kun la yang / /gsang ba 'di las gzhan mi mnga'/ /yod med sgo bkur zhi ba'i gsang ba 'di/ /rgyal ba kun gyis dgongs nges pa'i glong nas phyung / /gsang ba 'di nyid su 'dzin de ni nges par lung bstan te/ /rgyal ba'i thugs las skyes pa'i sras mchog yin/ /sangs rgyas sar gnas rigs 'dzin de la gsang ba 'di nyid gnas/ /de skad brjod pas rgyal ba thams cad gnyis med don la dges ①nas/ /dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid de chos kyi dbyings nyid du/ /rtsag po bkod pa'i brgyan la thims te bzhugs/ /yongs su bzung ba'i dhile'u ste/ nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //bka' gsang rgyal po thugs kyi yang gsang 'di/ /bde gshegs dgongs brgyud thun mong ma yin pas/ /rtog ge bdag 'dra'i spyod yul ma yin zhing / /44—54

rtsing po'i blo yis spyad par mi 'os kyang / /phyi rabs dad pa can la phan bdags phyir/ /mdor bsdus dbye ba'i rim pa 'di tsam pas/ /tshig don gsang ba ci dang ci 'gal ba/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug spyi la bzod par gsol/ /thugs kyi sgon ma gsang ba'i 'grel pa 'di/ /lung dang man ngag rig pas brtan la phab/ /dngas pa'i blo la rang bzhung rnams bye bas/ /rtogs dka' gsang ba'i theg pa'i don rtogs nas/ /shes dka' gsang ba'i theg pa'i don shes shing / /gsang sngags rgya mtsho khongs su chud par shog /gang gis gsang ba'i brgyud 'di rab tu rtogs dka' bas/ /tshig gi sgon mas don gye gser 'tshol ste/ /bde lag tu ni rtogs pa'i bsod nams gang / /mtha' yas sems can kun gyis thob par shog /'phags pa rtogs pa'i rgyal po rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba le'u stong phrag brgya pa las/ mtshan nyid dang brgyud thams cad kyi lung gi spyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba/gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las/ thams cad ma lus par 'phros te 'khor lo bskor ba de dag gis 'bras bu'i mchog gi rgyud kyi don sdus 'grel pa paṇ+ḍir thar zhes bya ba/ rgya gar byi slob dpon chen po bī ma la mi tras mdzad pa'o//paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / zhus chen byi lots+tsha ba chen po a tsar+ya rmā rin chen mchog dang snyags dz+nyā na ku mā ras dpal bsam yas dbu rtse'i par khang du bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //44—55

༄ga /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud dpal gsang ba'i sgong po zhes bya ba'i sprun 'grel pa'o//①༄4/ /rgyu bye ma las stod smad rin chen mchog gi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud 'grel zhing ma hā yo gar gtogs mtshan des las rab 'dzing gsum char gyi don du dbu zhabs su lnga ste/ mtshan dang phyag dang dam bca' ba dang gzhung dang 'jug go/ /dang po mtshan bstan pa rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra swad ta ma ya dza la tan tra shi 'aghu ②ha garba 'bri ta tsag kyu ti ka /bod skad du/ rdoka rje sems darbe'i sgyu 'phrul dra baṃ'i rgyud dar+shal gsang rbe'i snyirja po zhes bya ba'i spyan 'grel pa'o/ /lngas mdzad pa'i gnyis pa phyag la yon tan ①gsum gyi dang po brten pa rang 'byung kun bzang la tsal lo buche/ bzhimadzod gter kyi bdag po mchog / chebarjolha'i lha la gnyis med 'dud btsal lugs so ༷/ /'chad pa'i skyes ku ladagongs mdzad yonatan mtshan dpe ngoboganas kyi bdag /khye/sa bu rigasakyi dbye ba thugs la gnyis med 'dud btsal lugs so dri ba rgyud la btsal lo bcus bstan mi 'ahūṃr mi phyed 'joms pa che/ /mi giyo gsal ba mtha' bral bas /da4'a po ye shes rkyen bral ba/ /gyen 'byung dkyil 'khor sgyu 'phrul che/ /ci 44byed59

yang min las cir yang snang / /marja la 'brel pas tra ba'i rgyudadon/ /yurla min brtag dka' zab cing 'phra/ /bsten pa'i rgyu 'bras snying po'ikhas rtsa drang bcudaske/ /sngagasaskyon gzhan min de nyid nges ①don la/ /don dam kun rdzob dbyer med rnam gsum tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhi dri ba dam bca' ba bstan ④'khrul pa'i rang bzhin rkyen gyis spyan mdongs pas/ /sneshes bya gzhilamaganyis la rmongs pa dag /bugazhimathong nas 'brasabu thob phyidangosayige rgyud—/ /spyan gyi mchog gzhilam 'bras bu gsum gsal bar bye/ /spyi don bzhi pa la dri ste che ba dang mdor bstan pa dang rgyas pa'o/ /dang po che ba bstan de 'a nges palnga/ don gyi rgyud/ /thun mong thams cad rang rig mayin pa'i nyi ma 'dra lungabar gyi mi/ /sde sgod kun dang mababe+ed nam mkha' 'dra ⑤parargyud thams cad kyi rgyal po ston pa'i mchog /bka' thams cad kyi 'grel pa rnam pa kun lam khri lam thugs bka' gsang thob pa rjochudargyal ba'i dal ma lus pa theg pa bzhi yis ⑦mthara'abras thugapa'i 'dren pa ⑧don theg pa thams cad rdo rjes / ri rgyal 'dra ⑩bla na med pa theg pa'i rtsa kunamakha' las 'byung lnga gyi 'dul ba ste drang ⑪yum du ⑫byu/ra pa/ gnyis pa mdor bstan pa la gnyis kyi dang po rigs pas mdor bstan pa jugag dkrugs pa sdebasate/ don bshad pa'i rgyud 'di'i spyan rnam par dbye ba yang rnam pa gsum ste/ gang zhe na/chos nyid rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor phyi mo'i rigs mi 'gyur ma chad pa nyid dang /mngon tu byed pa'i rnal 'byor rgyud du 'byung zhing mi gtong bar byed pa rtsol ba'i rigs dang / mthar thug gi rnal 'byor bya ba med pa'i rgyud du byung zin pas mi 'gyur ba 'bras bu'i rigs so/ /gnyisapa lung gi bstan pa'o/ /de yang bye brag bstan pa las/ gtan tshig tshad ma lung man rig pa gsum gyi dngos po yi / /rnal 'byor gsum gyi phung po gzhalayasal/ /lha rigs brgyadadang snang ba'i yan lag gzhag na/ /44byed60

de nyid ramadrithur ma'i mchog tu nges so/ /ces gsungs so/ /rgyas pa la dri'i dang po rang bzhin snang ba bzhi'i dang po phyi mo'i 'dug tshur la gnyis kyi dang po ngo bo je/ 'ab bye brag bstan pa man ngag gi rjes su 'grel pa'i lugs nyid ni 'di lta ste/ thog mar phyi mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ brtags pa'i yul spros pa dang bral ba las dbum pa khyad par du ngo bos gyur pa chos nyid kyi rigs ste/ bstsal bya lamaril gyi dngos gzhi 'phel 'grib dang bral ba kho na ste/ bzhide la ni selam bslad thasnyadadu ma brtags ①ji bzhin mabacosapa'i phyir/ bye brag mi byed pas dang po'i ming nges par 'thob po//spyi don gnyis pa lung de lung gis brtan ①par gnyisapa nges tshig bya gzhung nyid las/ de la rgyas pa nas chos nyid kyi rigs ni kun la khyab par yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /nam mkha'i rgyasapa nas dbyings ni bsam yas par ces pa'i nyi zla gza' skar mtshan glog 'bum ces pa tshigs bshad brgyad gsungs so/ /spyi don gsum la gnyis kyi ngo bo dang de la ni tha snyad du rang bzhin gyi snang ba zhes kyang bsnyad de btags/ rang bzhin snang ba'i snang tshul ston 'on kyang phan tshun las grol bar 'chad pas/ yuladangayul can du mi 'gyur te/dper na rgya mtsho nyid rlabs lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin snang ba'i nges tshig go de yang shes rab dang gtan tshigs kyis byas pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ nges tshig 'grub pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa la gnyis kyi ngo bo dang rgyas pa'o 'di nyid kyang rnam pa med pa'i rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur te/ /spyi don bzhi pa la gnyis te mdor bstan dang rgyas pa'o ji bzhin pa rang bzhin gyi de kho na nyid dang / mun pa'i rang bzhin glo bur du snang ba'o/ /rgyas pa la gnyis kyi dang po 'khrul snang la gnyis kyi dang po ma nges pas 'byung bar 'o/ na de rgyu cis snyam pa 'ab/dang po la rnam pa med kyang gnyis pa la gnas pas/ mthong ba nges par shes par ma byas pas/ rnam pa med pa rangacharnam grangs la yod par mthong ba ni/ me long 44byed61

g.ya' can lta bu ste/ 'di nyid las/ me long g.yas yog pa dang 'dra ste/gzugs brnyan snang ba'i bya ba byed mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin ma nyams pa med pa 'di nyid kyi don nges par khongasasu chud par bya ba'ang / rgyal po drag shul can gyis zhus pa'isgyu'aphrulalas/ gser la bzo'i ①rnam pa ltar/ /snang ba dang po rang rig pa/ /yul med kyang gzung 'dzin gnyis phyir mthong med phyir//brtags pas tha dad gyur pa ste/ /thadad pa de yang 'byung tshul baṃzhi gnyis brgyad du 'gyur—/ /des na ma nges chad pa'i rigs/ /rang gi ngo bos dang dgapapo nyid yin kyang / /skabs ming rang bzhin dang 'khrul snang gnyis su gyur pas phye/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ ji ltar zhe na/ dper gser la 'du byed kyis mchod gnas dang / rgyan gyi rnam pa dang / snod ji ltar snang la ngo bo gcig pas/ nye bar mtshon pa ni/ ji bzhin pa'i rnal 'byor te de yang ngo bo dang mtshan nyid ril lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag nyid ni/ mtha' kun bral nyag cig ci yang ma spangs pa/ phyogs med phyogs kyi dngos gzhi pa/ ris can ris dang bral ba nirka/ sgon ma sprulapanyid kyis kyang 'di zhes brtag par mi zin pa ni/ sgo skur dang ngang gis bral bas skabs las nges pa'i lung zhes kyang bsnyad de/ 'di nyid las/ thams cad rang rig byang chub sems/ /de ni lung gi tshad mar bshad—/ /tshad bzhi phab pa'i don yin te/ /zhe'o/ /'khrul snang gi gnyis pa la gnyis kyi dris pa 'o na mun pa'i snang ba byung ba rigs dang rgyu rkyen gnyis kyi dngos po 'di dag 'byung bar mi rigs so snyam pa la/ lan la gnyis kyi mdor bstan de ni rang gi byung tshul brgyad kyis 'grel ②te/ hūṃ rkyerja 'byes bu 'byeng ba'i dus/ /tshur+sha dang nyese pa 'ahūṃb byed pa/ /nye’ bar mtshon pas rnam 44—62

par dbye/ /zhore la spyi'i dgos brgyadaka'i bshad pa bshad pa'o/ /ces 'byung bas/rgyas pa la dgu'i dang po rigase kun rla 'jug pa chosanyidadang / rigasachad pa'i 'gro ba grong khyen snang ba mi snang byed snang gsum du 'khor ba dag gi rgyu ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ma rig rtog pa'i gzung 'dzin rmis/ /zhes pa dang / sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las kun gzhi snang ba nyid dngabral te mashes/ /rtag tu rang mtshan mthong 'di gsal 'gyur kyang / /gzung 'dzin zhen pas donasnang bar ma gyur na/ /desamig gis mig bzhin ma rig pa'o—/ /zhes gsungs ste/ rme rig pa dang / bag chags dang / lami dang / nyoṣ+pe mongs pa ni/ lhaṣ+pe cig byed pa dang / nyekha bar len pa dang /martsengs par ldan pa'i las kyis phye bas rgyu kho na'o/ /gnyis pa rkyen 'khoraka ba'i rigs gzunga'adzin gnyis kyi rkyen ni/ bsod nams dang / bsod nams ma yin pa dang / mig g.yo ba'i las dang / nyon mongs pa brtags pa lnga khams dri med kun yod 'phra rags dang mang nyung gis so sor sbyar ba'o/ /de yangedagebacudage bcu spyod cing mi dge spong byed pa/ /zhes pa dang / thamarme cad mnyam par nganasong gi rgyu ma shes na/ /ma lus kun la zhe sdang cing / /zhes pa rnams dang / yang migayoba'i las tshad med bzhi spyod mi g.yo sgom byed pa/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas par bstan to/ /gsum pa 'bras bu smiṣ+pe pa ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang / /zhes pa dag gis ston to/ /bzhi pa dus snang ba'i dus ni/ thog ma med nas sems yan btang / /zhes pas ston te/ ltos pa'i glo bur sdugabasngalab yin no/ /44byed63

lnga pa tshulade'i tshe 'khor ba rten cing 'byel pa'i grangs dang rten 'brel khams cha 'phrar yod pas phra rags kyi chas gnas so sor 'khor ba ste/ rtsa ba snyingapolas/ phyi nang rten 'byel gnyis su 'khor/ /ces gsungs so/ /drug pa nyes pa tshur+sha des na yang dag pa'i lam dang bral zhing sna tshogs kyi ①gtse ba myong ba'o/ /de yang mi mthun bde sdug myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang /ye shes lnga'i don ma rtogs pa④/ /zhes pas gsal lo/ /bdun pa byed pa po de grubaṃ par byed pa'o ni/ skad cig ma gnyis kyis rang bzhin ④dang rgyun gyi snang ba'i phyogs gcig rgyudakyi skad cig ste/ ma bcos rgyun kyi skad cig ma/ /de yis ma byas gang yang med/ /ces gsungs so/ /brgyad pa dpe denya dag nye bar mtshon pa ni/ /rtswa darja sog me 'khore lo bzhin/ /rtog pa long btagasaka rgyas shing brgyudi par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dgu pa zhar rjol bshad pa la dri la dang po gnyis med du de jita ltar snang yang rang gi ngo bo rtag ther zug rgyun bzung 'dzin pa gnyis bya ba rdzogs pa dang dus kyi mthas dang bral ba thog ma'i rnal 'byor nyid do/ /de yang / spyir ni log rtog bsam yas pa/ /ye nas yod pa ma yin te/ /ci yang med las cir yang snang / /snang ba nyid na ngo bo med/ /ces pas gsungs so/ /de dag gnyis pa brgyad po'i dgos ched dang bkod pa ni ngo bo nyid de snang stong gnyis med pa lta bas na/ dngos po rgyu rkyen sogs pa brgyad so so nas rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas pas/ cig dang du ma las grol ba'i rigs rtogs par bya ba'i ched brgyad por bstan pa par do/ /dri ba las nor yang rang bzhin ma nor ba'o de bas ming gis phye yang brgyadadungo bo la tha dad med pa'i phyir/ ye nas ngo bo yod yin na/ /44byed64

nyon mongs spangs ①zhing byang bsgrub med/ /ces gsungs pa la sogs pas gsalayangaleces pa te/ las nor ba tsam gyis basbal phye'ipa'o/ /de yang gzhung 'di nyid las/ ngan song 'gro drug sna tshogs rgyu ba yang / /'khrul ba'i blo ②log rtog pa nyid snang ste/ /de bzhin nyid sa①la gyur cing nyams pa med/ /ces pas snang ba'ang 'gyur ro // //rjospyi don gnyis pa 'bras bu la bzhi ste mdor bstan lnga dang de la grub pa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug bla na med pa'i rigs bshad pa ni/ bye brag bstan pa las/ bla med rigs tshel rgyu 'bras 'brasakyis/ /phye bas tshedabangabaradang tha mar 'bras bu mthar phyin 'gyur—/ /de la gnyis po mthar thug skabs kyis mthar thug pa'i/ /snang ba de nyid rnam par 'bye/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ngesaṃ tshig dang / dus dang / ngod bo budang / marjan nyid dang / de nyepa bar mtshon pa dag ni bla na med pa'i theg pa mthar thug pa dag la phye ba ste/spyi don gnyis pa la lnga'i dang po nges tshig de1 yange thabs lamarjoganyis kyis rang gi ⑦rang bzhin rnalamangon du byas pas tha mal pa skyebadang / kun 'od bcud ⑧gcig pa'i zhen pa man chad spangs pa'i ye shes ni/ ril lhun gyis grub pas/ 'bras bu ⑨skyed du bya ba med pa dang / spyod yul ⑩bral bas ming nges par 'grub pa'o/ /lnga'i gnyis pa dus de ltar 'thob pa'i skabs kyang 'bras bu ril bdag nyid pa'i phyir—/ gtan tshigs 'bras bus thob bya gzhan du rag ma lus pa'i phyir na rkosapa/ tha 44byed65

mal pa'i dbang du yang gnyer 'og ma dang sdeb po ①lhaṣ+pe ma'i lus 'di nyid dang lam du gyur te 'bras bu bar mar sbyor ba'o/ /lnga'i gsum pa ngo bo range gi ngo bo ni gnyis ste/ thun mong gi sangs rgyas dang / bla med rigs ④thun mong min pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /tha ma'i yon tan la lnga ste/hūṃ rdeng / gsum̐ng dnge / thurges dang / yoṣ+pe tanag dang / 'phriṣ+pe larme ste/bye/ brag re rel yang lnga lngar lnga lngar byu/ra pa'o// /lnga'i bzhi pade dag gi mtshan nyid ni gcig dang du ma'i cha rnams ma bsnyigs bral bas gzung dka' ba'o/ /lnga'i dpedepa dag nye bar mtshon pa ni/ spyidang bye brag nor bu rin po che yon tan dang / 'phrinagare mkhan dang / gsungabrarge cha dang / thugasanyi rme rgya mtsho dang /sku sprulaka sgyu lta bu'o/ /spyi don gsum pa khungs bstan pa de dag kyang / rgyal po in tra pu tis zhus pa'i sgyu 'phrul las/ dang po kuna'od sangs rgyas thun mong nyid/ /smon lam tshogs snang ngo bo skudrigasum/ /thun mong kuna'od dang tha ma'i dri can ltabasgrib ①la/ /kun gyi sa bcu'i tog kun 'od tog tu gyur snang ba/ /sabacu'ide nyid dutha ma'i tha ma'i kun 'od / /dri can labadag pos rgyalabadrug pas dbang bskur nas/ /yang dag rdzogs par rang snang ba/ /nyishulngalnga rdzogs 'bras bu brjod las 'das/ /zhes gsungs so/ /44byed66

de dag ni slob dpon gzhan dag gis 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /zhes bsnyad pa mi 'dod pa ma yin no/ /yidasha ches pa'i gtanatshig 'di nyid las lus ma spangs par rig 'dzin sa/ mthong ba'i chos las mya ngan 'das/ /zhes pa dang yang /dper na lelagalas khyangaka dang seng ge bu/ /zhes pa dag dang / hūṃ nyid le lag gsung gi dkyil 'khor snang / /zhes pa dag dang / byeng brag bstan pa nges tshig bstan las/ byedas bu ①grub pa'i rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /lhun grub ji bzhin mngon byas pa'i/ /byedasabuzhes btags pa tsam ste thobabyaganyis pa med/ /medapade phyir de la gnyisamed de lngos bubarjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / thabs kyi zhags pa las kyang / rgyal ba'i rgyal ba rnams kyi sku/ /sna tshogs cir yang snang mod kyang / /kun tu rin chen yonatan lta bu ste/ /zhes pa dang / rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dpere na 'phrinalas gar mkhan nyid 'dra ba/ /lus las ma god ④sna tshogs ston/ /dper na gsungabrag cha'i sgra bzhin no/ /skuston nyid sgyu ma mig yor tshul/ /ces pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /bzhi pa mjug bsdus te bstan pa'o de bas na 'di nyid las/ mthon dman kun gyi gzugs snang dang / /bla med byang chub sbur snang ba/ /me long lta bu tshul bzhin du—/ /sna tshogs kha dog dbyibs su snang / /ces gsungs pas/ de la ni bde bar gshegs pa'i snang ba zhes kyang bsnyad do // //snedri ba la gnyis te mdor bstan pa de la rnal 'byor bar ma'i mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/sgyu 'phrul bye brag bstan pa las/ /rang bzhin demangon dubyed pa'irnal 'byor pa 44—67

ni—/ /ngoka bo dngarkyerja gyis rnal 'byor gnyisasudabye/ /rigaso rgyucanadang dang rigs su sems bskyed nas mi ldog pa'o nges pa'i sa/ /dnge po la 'ang rnam pa rgyas pa la gnyis kyi dang po dpa'i dbye ba dang gnyis 'byu/ra ba/ /lnga sems g.yo ldang gnas smon 'jug mthar phyin ldan pa'i shes rab nyid/ /skye ba'i rgyurkyen drug 'byul gzhin dang skyes nges pa/ /mngesapa gzhi rig gcig dang lam rigs mi lha nyan rang byang sems bzhi/ /gsange chen bla med mi ldog 'khor bar 'dod/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyas pa'i gnyis pa rkyen la dri ste man ngag dang rig pa dang lung ngo / /dang po man bstan sa pa dren dranab/ bstan pa las/ gnyiso pa lamarkyen gyi rnam par 'dod/ /de nyid thun mong dang thun mong ①ma yin pa'i la②/ /dbye bas sngagasabye na gnyis su 'gyur thunamong mayin pa nangal 'a nga / /shes pa mun pa pa log sred pa'i byis pa sa phyogs dam pa'i lngalnga( sgra/'ab ཿ/na palnga(/ /dam pa'i shes pa gnyis pa'i gsang sngags/ /yulanang pa'i spyod pa 'gyur dengo bo rgyu 'bras kunagyi spyi ru kyis/ /lung gi spyir ru grags pa nyid/ /rnam par bshad pas lnga ru 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa rig pas lngar bstan bka'i nying khu 'di dbu zhabs su don lnga ste/ gang zhe na/rgyurde bzhi'abyung ba'i gzhi dang / rkyen phun sum tshogs pa dang / don phun sum tshogs pa dang / rgyud kyi cha rkyen phun sum tshogs pa dang / rgyud mthar ① brtan par bya'o/ /de rla khungs la khyad par dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par la lnga'i dang po bstan pa rgyud kyi gzhi ni/ ngo bo drug ste/ de la ston pa ni/ sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/ston pa 'khor lo dbang bsgyur shin tu dhi'abar ba'i lte ba la/ /bdag po kun bzang 'khor lo bskor⑤/ /skyes bu bka' sdod mdun na gnas/ /brjod pa med 44—68

bzhin go bar mdzad/ /zhes gsungs pas gsal lo/ /gnyisapa gnas gnas kyang /rgya cha 11 'a sa/ 'a :drog rten phyogs bcu dus bzhi ma lus pa thams cad kyi bzhugs gnas gzhal med rin chen sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa tshad dpag tu med pa rgyas pa mtha' dbus med par khyab cing 'od zer sgrib pa med par byung ba la bzhugs gnas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do gzhal yas khang gi rgyu ni mtshan 'dzin 'das pa mchog gi rgyu las byung ces pa'o gnas kyi 'og min drug①las/ /gdul bya'i nyis 'gyur shin tu spags pa'i dag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'og min gnas bzhugs te ④gnas/ /ngo bo mtha' gsum las 'das pas/ /ma spangs rgyan rdzogs gzhal yas khang / /ga bag tsi yon tan yon tan lnga'i bdag nyid de/ /dbyibasagrub bzhi spyi bo 'khyil snang ba'o/ /gsum pa 'khor de bzhin thugs gzung 'dzin bral ba'i bla med rjes 'od dang 'jig rten 'khor gyi btsos ①sku dbang phyug dang gzhan yang 'jig rten phyogs bcu khams gnas dang dukyi khyad par las/ /rang snang rgyal ba sems sogs dang / /kuna'odadang po'i dusangs rgyas rjoyi ge 'khor los rgyal ba rigasalnga④/ /sems dpa' chen po dnga'ajoms pa che/ /mngatshadabarjod kyis mi lang rgya che ba'i tshad tshad rnyed dang / /bzhugasatshul rnam gnyis tshul du nang tshul du thig le thig bran du phyi tshul du ston 'khor du bzhu/gas pamadza/ /bzhi pa bsdud pa shes rab mchog gi ma lus yongs bsdus la bder gshegs mi gnas mnyam nyid ngang du byon 'khor gyi nang nas skal mchog ldan/ /'dul ba'i dus bab gsang ba'i bdag /lag na rdo rjes bsdu ⑧ba mdzad/ /lngapadus de tshe dus nyid mtha' bral phyir/ /ngo bo dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid/ /rgyarla ba drug pa bstan pa bdud rtsi ro yis ska ba bde chen 'grub ces pa semasaṃ dpa' rnalag 'byor pa/ /dgorjas ⑨pa rirge pa rna bsaṃ brgyud/ /gangabargyud na gsang ba'i snying po de kho na/ /nyid de nges pa'i dbyings nas phyung / /zhes gsungs pa dag ni gzhi ste/ skabs 'dir rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa dang / de nyid dkrugs pa rgyud kyi phyir klad du ma bkod de/44byed69

rtsa rgyud las rkyen yang rjes su mthun par sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la gnyis kyi dang po gsang bar dkyus kyi nges bzung ni rtsa ba'i rgyud ltar ro/ /'di dag gdul bya'i skabs kyis snang ba gzhan dag kyang gnyis te/ sgyu 'phrul gye rgyud las/ 'di zhes nye bar mtshon pa ni/ /e sogs rnam bzhi dbyibs can gnas/ /skad ni gsal byed las ming can/ /baṃ dbyibs thig ler bcas bshadargyud ston pa'o/ /ma ta ma nu sdom byed yid/ /'khoralas chen rnam shes de dag la/ /gsal bar snang ba bshad sdud 'dod/ /stanapapa sgra don dam nges pa'i rgyud/ /baṃmayaya na theg chen 'di yin no/ /dus ni bsam gyis mi khyab dus/ /na ma de ming zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang yang / gnyisapa nang bshad sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ dar ma tshag kra chos kyi gnas / /'od bzhi e sogs dbyibs su gnas/ /mi shigs thig le baṃ dbyibs can/ /rang la bde ba gsal byed bdag /ma nu yid sogs rnam shes bzhis/ /ye shes pyong ba bsdus bshad pa'o/ /ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs skyes pa/ /pa ra ma rta don zab mo/ /bde ba'i dus nyid snga phyi bral/ /dus gsum kun gyi ngo bor gnas—/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i phyir skal ba mchog gi gdul bya mthar nye ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i grolathar thabs gnyis kyis 'dul ba dag la rgyu glengagazhi des rgyud snang bar byed do/ /gnyis pa rtsa ba'i rgyud shes par gnyi.oṃ pa rgyud kyi rkyen gleng bslang ba ni/ snying po le'u gnyis par bstan gyi/ 'dir bskal pa rgyud dkrugs pa/ rgyud kyi phyir dngos su ma gsungs te/ shugs kyis sbyar ro/ /44—70

gsum pa la gnyis kyi dang po mdor bstan gsum̐m pa ni don du dngosatshig gnyer bar byed pa'i phyir dang / don du bya ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de la yang gnyis te/ larme 2)nga / zu bye/zug ba/3)sa rus/ /rgyas pa la gnyis kyi dang po lam gyi ngo bo la gnyis te lam nas skye ba dang gzhi nas sa lam nas skye ba la gnyis te khungs so de 'a 'bam ni gnyis te/ rje/ 'a ju/'a rgya ma41 'a sa/rigs kyi dbye bas lam dbye ba/ /waṃ daji gcirge gis rgyu 'bras lngagaciga'agyur/ /rigs maka nges paspyi'i rigs dbye sa ste/ /sngon du so zin pa dang byed pa'i phyir bzhikha ni nges 'byung thun mong lam/ /deg bzhin rigs gcig thun mong min/ /de nyid phyi nang cha snang ba/ /phyi rol ltos nangapa'i thun mong lam/ /skabs mi dang nyan rang byang sems 'dir bzhi gsum thun mong gnyis brgyad/ /'dir lam du rtsis 'gyur snyam ①pa la phan chad sbyangs pa rgyu'i phyir/ /rang bzhin sngon du song ba dang / /ched du sngon du bsdur bas 'gro/ /des na thun mong sngon rdzogs yul/ /skyebagazhi dang skabs de la'ang rkyen drug nas skyes semasa'agyur sa/ /grol thar gnyis su lam du rnam par bstan/ /de de'i gcig car rims 'jug pa/ /snod kyi rim pas rnam par snod1/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thun mong gi bzhi bstan 'dir thun mong gi larme ni bzhi ste/ lha dang mi'i theg pa'i rigs dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa'i rigs dang / rang rgyal ba'i theg pa'i rigs dang / ltos pa'i bla na med pa'i theg pa'i rigs te/gnyis pa sngags nges 'byung nas skyoba'i lung rigs dang de'i lam du cis 'gyur zhe na/ sngon du song ba dang / byaje ba'i sgophyir/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ larme stegs nyid du pha rol phyin bcu rgyu 'bras rdzogs par spyod/ /zhes pa dang / sa rnams khyad 44—71

par bkod pa yang / /gsang ba'i snying por 'gro ba'i lam/ /zhes pa dag dang theg pa bzhi yis nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gis 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes pa'i don gyis the tshom med/ byange ba'i sgor bsdus la shes par bya ba yin te/'jug par bya ba ni ma yin te/ lam gyi sgosached ltung sa brtag pa dang / nye lam las mi 'gyang ba'i ①bya ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gzhi nas skye ba la gnyis kyi mdor bstan maka nges pa dang de dag nas rkyen 'byel bzhis blo 'gyur te/ sems lnga rim par skye ba'i sa 'bras bu'i theg pa 'di la 'ang gdul bya sbyangs pa dang / nyon mongs lngapa dang mos pa mi mthun pas bstsal nas/ lam gnyis su 'gyur ba ni gang zhe na/ grol ba'i lam dang /thar pa'i lam mo ②rgyas pa la gnyis te lam gnyis ka'i khungs bstan pa dang so so nas bstan pa'o/ /khungs ④la gnyis te grol lam gyi khungs de yang gzhung nyid las/ thos bsam sgom rjopa'i mnyam sbyor gyis/ /rang 'byung kun ngam lhun gyis grub/ /zhes pa dang /gnyis pa thab lam gyi'o phuṣ+pe sum tshogs pa'i lhun grub rnams/ /gsang dbang mchog gis 'byin par byed/ /zhes gsungs so / /⑤so so nas bstan pa la gnyis kyi grol lam gnyis kyi mdor bstan de la grol ba'i lam la gnyis te/cigaka car ba dang / rimakha 'jug go/ /rgyas pa gnyis kyi cig char ba las gnyis kyi dang po cig char bas shes par bya ba'i lta ba dang de yang bye brag bstan pa las/ dgos 'byel bsnyen bsgrub mtshan nyid dang / /lta 'phreng las dal du zhugs pa la sogs pa'o dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i sgo bzhi dang / /rtogs pa rnam bzhi dag mnyam bden/ /gcig bzhirjol tshularim dang cig char rmis gnyis 'gyur ba/ /lhun gyis rtogs nas lhun gyis bsgom/ /44—72

'jug men ①rim bral de nyid gsal 'gyur 'drel ⑤sabazhi/ /gnas skabs kyis rdzogs pa chen por brjod do/ /gnyis pa sgom pa'o bar mas lamaphye ba'i rim pa nyid/ /mthong bsgom zung du 'byel bar bshad/ /bsgom pa'ang cig charabs dbyebs de steng kun rgya gsumagacig dbyer med du gcig 'gyur mtshananyid dri/ /zhes gsungs pas/ snga bar rim slob sbyong sbyong ba dang 'dir dang po nas snang byed lnga dus gcig du cig car pa cigacharab ni gtan tshigs kyi sgo nas rang bzhin gyi don gtings phyin nas yul med par rang gsal du bslad pa med pas gzhag pa dang / lha yang skad cig gis gsal bas de nyid stobs su gyur pas mthar phyin pa ste/ de la skabs kyis bstan pa'i rim pa tingange dri gsum las donal gsum du mi snang ste/ yon tan rgyas pa'i rgyud las/ gcig char ba'i khungs ma bcos ji bzhin ngang bzhag dang / lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ngo / /zhe'o/ /rgyas pa la gnyis pa rim gyis pa la dri'i dang po rigs pa dang gcirge shos rnam par dbye ba ni/mthong byacigab la tshad du phyin cigachar ma phyin rims las thabs la grol lam du 'dra'o bye brag med na lam pa'i blo la yod yang / lam du 'jug pa rim gyi 'jug mtshan nyid bar ma'i rim 1pa tha dad pa ni/ gange zhe na/ dang po stong pa'i rnal 'byor dang / snyibaṃ rje sprul pa'i rnal 'byor dang / slabathabs gnyis phyagag rgya gcig pa'i rnal 'byor dang /slab thabs dri spros pa dang lugasaganyis bcas pa'i rnal 'byor dang / rigasa'adzin rarja dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor ro// //man ngag dang de yang gnas skabs kyi ming du ma 'ang ngo bo gcig pa ni man ngag byebragastan las las/ stong pa'i sgo ni dang po detingaste/ /bsnyen pa rnam pa gnyis de nyid do/ /rgya)ngaganyis pa mtshan ma med pa'i sgo/ /bsnyen cha de nyid gsum 44—73

paphrarags ting nge ni/ /smon pa med sgo nye gnyen pa/ /sgo bzhi pa spros pa dang tshogs sgrub pa'o nibasgrub dang bsgrub chen cha so gnyis dang sbyar te/ /ting 'dzin spyod pas rnam par phye/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal sgo yang de/ /lnga pa sgrub①ra po 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid de/ /tshig zur rim pa drug pa dgos pa'i dgos pa mthar phyin 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni/ byang chub sems kyi rim pa dang sbyar na/ dang po tshigalamapa'o g.yo ldang byang chub sems//gnyis pa semasasmon pa gsum 'jug sems lta ba mthong lam pa/ /ting nge bzhi ni sgom lam sems gnas rdeng mthar phyin lnga pa bzhilnga pa 'bras bu'o/ /sems gsumagayo ldang tshon 'jug mthong lam ⑤gnas tingapa bzhi dang ldan/ /lnga pa lnga pa nyid du sbyor/ /ting nge re re la nyams lnga lnga 'byung yang na rnal 'byor gcig sems lnga ka la yang tshang lngaraldan/ /zhes khungs las rig pas yi ger ma bshad pa la bya'o/ /gsungs pa go bla bas ma bshad do/ /khungs la gnyis te khungs so sor sdebs la bstan pa dang rigs pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /de kyangang 'a di nyid las/ yanges shing rgya che lhun grub ni/ /phyi nang snod bcud ye nas dag/dag rtogs nyid kyang dbyings nyid yin/ /'di ni rdo rje mnyam yin no/ /rims kyi pa'o dngosaṃ grub mtharaphyin 'bras bu ①myur du grub 'dod na/ /lasatham shin tu 'phra zhing zab par bsgom/ /brdeg dang bdag gis gzhan rnams ni/ /shin tu mi dmigs dbyings su bsgom/ /ting 'dzin de ni goms pa dang / /thams cad sgyu ma'i dmigs yor dang / /zungasarjo'abru dang sprul pa sprul pa'i tshul du shes par bya—/ /de bzhin yang nas yang goms nas/ /de nas phra ba'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ /cig char ba'i zhesapa dang / snyingapolasayang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ yan lag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /de nyid yan lag spros bdag ste/ /zhes pa dang yang / nam mkha'i dbyengs ni bsam yas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor sna tshogs bsgom/ /zhes 44—74

pas gsal lo/ /gnyisaparigs pa de dag kyang zhi ba dang / khro bo gnyis gnyis su mos pa'i dbang gis/ de ring dang sgru ma ①men pa 'phra ting nge gsum pa yan chad la sbyor ①ro/ /gnyis pa thar lam gnyis kyi mdor bstan thare pa'i lam dam pa ni gnyis te/ cirge car ba dang / rirmis kyis pa'o// //rgyas pa la gnyis kyi cig char ba de la cirge car 'jug pa'i ni 'di nyid las/dbang lnga rdzogs pa'i dam tshig gi phyir gsal te ye nas lhun gyis rigs pa'i rab rdzogs pas ri mo'i dkyil 'khor la mi rten par thig le rnamagrangs mtshan ldan gyis rdzogs pa ste/ bla ma'i zhal du rags lus pa'o// //rims 'jug la gnyis te rig pa dang khungs so/ /de las rigs pa bstan rim par 'jug pa ni gnyis te/ rlung gi las kyis phyebasastenge dnga'orge gi sgo la rten pa'i bye brag go/ /khungs la gnyis te mdo dang rgyas pa'o/ /mdor gnyis de yang sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/ bye brag rlung las gyur pa ni/ /ye shes 'byung ba stenge 'orge sgo/ /dbyeg stengadang babyeg 'ogapa'i thabs nyid de/ /steng sgo 'khorarnga lo rgyas pa la gnyis kyi dang po ste drug gsum gnyis sgrong⑦ srog shing rtsadugasum/ /me rlung 'gro bas nam mkha'i ba/ /bzho ba steng du rnam par grags/ /bskug pa 'og sgo bstan no steng 'og snang ⑤rtse'i bde ba phrad pa'i g.yo ldang la sogs pa gsum gyis sems lnga'i rims/ /bdebaskyed pas rgababacu drug gyings job pa'i /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i phyir/ /ngesatshiga'aching ba nyid kyis thar pa'i lam/ /zhes gsungs pas mar 'bab pa yar bzlog rjopa rgyu 'bras kyi tshul gyis gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la dris te ⑦rigs pa bdun du bzhag pa dang lam gyis sderkyen yan lag bstan pa ni/ ji lta bu zhe na/ spyod / dang / dkyizla 'khor dang / darme tshig dang / 'phriṣ+pe las 44—75

dang bro stabs gar gyis bya/ /rnar+sha 'byor de ringakun snang gnyis gsum goms pa bas /dang blang gsum rgyacig rgya spyos bzhi smos ci dgos/ /grangs gnyiso pa'i phyi nang gsang ba gas/ma pa drigasang gnyis gnyis palnga( gsang ba ma/tha' khams bzhi/ /thabs lama' gnas pas brtsam par bya/ /phyi'ihodange po'i dang po rangabazhin ā+oṃ dang por bzhidang sbyar/ /phyi'irtswa dang po'i thugs rdo rje'i ā+oṃ gsum pa 'brasaburagasum par sbyar/ /lhag ma gzugs brnyan ting nge lhag ting longs spyod lam du sbyar ro de nas gzhan rnams dbul rims bzhin/ /zhes ba/sdo/ngas dres ①lnga pa mdo rgyas kyi mdor bstan bsgrub pa ni gnyis te/ thun mong ma yin pa dang /thun mong ngo / /rgyas pa la gnyis kyi dang po thun mong ma yin pa le'u bco lnga pa dang bcu drug pas ston la—/ phyag rgya la brten te bsgrub pa dang / khro bo phyag rgya spros pas ston gro gar cho gas bsgrub pa'o/ /rigs pas bstan pa dang thun mong bsgrub pa la drug ste/ bdud rtsi bcu bdun bsgrub pa dang phra④/ bcugasum tshe bsgrub pa dang / pra dbab bsgrub pa bcubazhi dang / nyishupargyal po chen po bsgrub pa dang / lha chen po bsgrub pa dang / nyer bzhi parolngas bsgrub pa'o/ /mnangag gis so de yang bye brag bstan pa las/ bdag gzhan ched du gnyer ba'i rgyusadon/ /gnas dang rgyal po chen po bzhi dang lha chen po gsum la dri yo byad rdzas sngon bya/ /dkyil 'khor las rim gags gsal dang / /dngos grub blang thabs grub pas 'brasabu rdzogs/ /grub pas dbye bas thun mong dang thun min gnyis su 'gyur/ /ting kun te rgyu ting rnal 'byor gnyis pa lam du brtse ba gsum sogs lam brtan pa yis/ /dang po snang byed ma thob gang du rnam gnyis bdud rtsi tshe sngon bya ba'i/ /tshe la thun mong dngos grub thob par byas la gnas pa'i bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /dgragasum po tshe 'grub mi 'grub bar chad 'ong mi 'ong dri dag la legs nyes 'byung / /de'i ④phyir de sngon du bya ba 44byed79

kun sngon de bya'o/ /bdag phyir de bzhin byagazhan phyir ru/ /rnal 'byor rjes mthun skabs su gzhan don du brtsam/ /spros bcas brtan nas the tshom med/ /de tshebar chad med lam du tshom bu bsgrub par bya'o/ /drug pa mchod pa de dag gi cha rkyen ni/ ting nge 'dzin kyi mchod pa la sogs pa dang / thabs sbyoragrolakyimachod pa dang / tshogasabadud rtsi rdzas kyi mchod pa'o/ /bdun pa lta ba la gnyis mdor bstan don rtogs pa'i cha skyem gtan tshigs kyi ①yan lag gzhal bya rtogs par byed pa'i thabs ni/ gnyis te/ thabs kyi tshul ni shes rab kyi 'dre'o thabs dang / shes rab kyi nges par byed pa'o/ /rgyas pa la gnyis te mdor bstan pa dang shes rab la gnyis te/ rtags dang mchod rten gdab pa la sogs pa dang brgyud pa nye ring gis nges pa dang / gtan chi1gas so/ /rgyas pa la gnyis kyi ④mdor bstan de la gtan tshigs gnyis ni tshad ma bka' gzhung gi gtan tshigs dang / thun mong ngo / /rgyas pa la gnyis kyi dang po de la yang dag pa gsum bzhi dang / mnyam pa bzhi lnga dang /bden pa bzhi dang / bdag nyid chen po'i gtan tshigs dang / rtogs tshul bzhi dang / bden pa gsum mo/ /de yang gzhalabyabya ba dang / byed pa gtan tshigasadang / byas pa'i tshul grub mtha' nasagatan tshigs de rang gsum char du 'gyur kyis kyang / rnam grangs smos pa'i phyir/ gtanatshigs du ④gtan la 'be+ebs par 'thad do/ /gnyisapade la thun mong la'ang bzhi ste/ gcig dang du mar bral ba'i mtha' dang bral ba'i gtan tshigs dang / thamasacad ma lus bdag rang bzhin dang / nyon mongs rang dang rang spyi dang / 'byung ba chen po lnga rnams la rnam par dbye ba ste/ de dag ngo bo gsal bas ma sprad na'ang / skabs su rigs par sbyar ro / /du44byed80

spyi don bzhi pa rgyud kyi cha rkyen la gnyis kyi mdor bstan rgyud kyi cha rkyen la gnyis te/ bshad pa'idabang rab 'dzing gis ①gsum mo thabs dang / rgos 'byel bstan pa'o/ /de la rgyas pa'i dang po bshad thabs gsum du bshad pa'i thabs ni/ byer rangamatshan dang bsdus pa'i don/'bring rgyu rkyen don gtad pa'o rnam par dbye ba'i don/ tha ma 'dren pa'i tshigs bcus 'bru bshad rab tu spros pa'i don te/ gang zag gsum gyi ched du gsungs pas rtsa ba'i rgyud las ston te/ 'dir gnas skabs kyi don tsam gyi phyir dang / rgyud nyid kyi tshigs gis lugs kyis rim par ma bstan te/ khong lugs kyis ②de ltar yang ston mod kyi/ 'dren pa'i dbang du brgyad de 'on kyang 'dir spyi don sdus khogadon pa'i tshig tu 'grel pa rgal dro dang / sa gcod de sde dang tshan du rnam par dbye ba'i tshig tu 'grel pa dang / gorim①dgos par 'byel pa'i rgosacheda'abyel pa'i tshig tu 'grel pa dang /tshig gi 'tshams gnas skabs sengaphruga'aphen sdud 'khrugasasdebs pa'o kyis 'grel pa dang /don gyi bcud 'bru ma bshad don bshad ston par 'grel pa dang / gnas bshad cing bsdu ba skabs le'u de'i don gcig tu bsdu ba'i tshig tu 'grel pa dang / sgra ldem dgongs su don bsgyur bar go rims 'dug na brtag go 'grel pa dang / bye brag gi ru sbal lta bus 'bru dubashad zinag tu 'grel par bshad pa'o // //⑤gnyis pa la gnyis te rig dang lung ngo / /de la rig pa'o/ /dgos 'byel ni brjod bya dang /'byel pa dang / dgos pa dang / dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'o// //gnyis pa lung la lnga dang po de yang dri/ 'phrul phyi ma thal ba las/ rang bzhin rgyud kyi dgos 'grel lo rnal 'byor dang po bzhibarjod bya'i don yin/ /rkyen yige rgyud dang ston pas snang bar rjobyed/ /dngos lnga la gtad pa'o rgyu'abras tshul 'grel pa yin duzin/ /lam bstan pa ngobo dbu ma donaphun sum tshogs dgos pa'i don/ /rigasa'adzin te mtha' ma'i rnal 44—81

'byor yang dgos pa'o/ /shes rab yi ge rgyud yi ge rgyud kyi gzhi bshad pa rkyen la rgyu rkyen brjod byed de/ /rgyudadonango bo brjod bya desngon du snang sems dgos pa 'ang de'o/ /gzhi lam dang po gnyis rgyu gsum rigs 'dzin 'bras bu/ /rgyu'abras kyi ①'byel pa'o mthu can rigs 'dzin de yang dgos brjod byed yid ②don/ /lta ba donaka rnams don 'ba' zhig bye brag du sbyar ba'olarme kun hūṃ 'bras tshul/ /cha rkyen rgyu rkyenagazhung bshad pa ④dgos pa'o 'brasabugong ma rnams/ /skabs kyis rjodagos pa'i dgos par 'gyur zhe'o/ /yang / nang gi ⑤rabaṃ rig 'od gsal nam mkha' che 'odagasal de / /bde ba'i ye shes brjod bya'o0de—/ /tsakra nas me rlung dang namaka mkha'i rtsi 'be+ebs thabs rkyen dang / /thig le sgom gnyis ye shes snying pos thig ler brjod byedado/ /khel pa de nyid thabs dang tharbes dam tshig la sogs pa ⑦byung sngonal/ /gnas bzhi'i thabs sogs dgos pa'i don/ /bde ba rgyas pa rgos pa'i bde ba'i khams rgosapani des bsgrubs ⑧pa'o/ /gsangaba'iyo ga gsum ril gsum lhun grub de rdzogs bstan rgyudalabya'i don brngodabya'o/ /gsang yul dbang po rnam shes reg /'dus spyad zig les brjod byed do cing / /yul dbangashes rag pa bzhi 'dus tshe na phyag rgya bzhi/ /byed sdom thabs rnams dgos pa'i phyir/ /tsakrabazhis bde ba skyes pa de 'byung 'brel pa dang rgos pa gnyi ga'o/ /ye shes rgyu 'bras thabs yerangabazhi lnga'i bde ba chen po ye shes mthar thug pa'o yangargosazhe'o// //spyi don lnga pa bstan pa gtad pa dang zhar la nges tshig bstan pa'o/ /bstan pa dar bar bya ba ni/sdud pa po dang skal ba mchog la gtad pa ste/ rgyud kyi rtsa ba ⑨dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po phyi ma las gsal bas ma bkod do/ /gnyis pa nges tshig la gnyis te dang po gdul 44—82

bya'i snang ba'i nges tshig dang de dag la ni mos pa'i dbang gis gdul bya'i snang ba'o zhes bsnyad do/ /de yang mosapaspyod pa pa las cha dag pa dang / thun mong byang sems pa dag pa dang / btagasapa'i de ba'o mthar zad pas phye bas tha dad par 'gyur te/'dir tha ma'i snang ba dang / de dag gi rgyud du nges par byung ①ba'i snang ba'o/ /de yang khungasartog pa rnams la 'khor ba'i lus/ /thar pa rnams la dag pa'i sku/ /ji ltar mthun pa bzhin tu snang / /zhes gsungs te/ rgyud yin pa'i gtan tshigs ②de bas na cha rkyen tshang ba 'di ni gnas skabs kyi gleng bzhi gleng bslang ba gtad pa med pas mtshan gsum gyis rgyud du ma longs pa 'dra na yang / bshadargyud sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/bslad pa'i tshig bral sgo skur med/ /rgyu rkyen 'bras bu bdag po dang / /'drel tshad 'khrugs bsnol bka' rgyud yin/ /zhes gsungs so// //de ltar ston pa'i rgyud ①'di dag 'grel pa rjobargyad kyi dang po spyi don sdus pa'o/ /dang po'i dbang du na/ 'di'i rnam par dbye ba'i spyan gsum yan lag dang bcas pa'i don le'u rnams so sor bsdu zhing ngo bstan pa ni/ bzhibastan le'udang phyogs bcu dus bzhi sgod bcud bdag la lus pa'i le'u dang pos rnal 'byor dang po dang gsum̐m pa'i don dang b.re ma'i mthong sgorme ston to/ /bzhi bstan yum gyi dbyings su 'dus pa'i le'u bsdus don gnyis pa le'u re nas chos gang gang ston par ngos gzung ba'i⑤le'u gnyis pas/ grorla thar larme gnyis ka dang rnal 'byor bzhidang po dang lngosabutha ma'ang ston to/ /mtshan nyid med par thim pa'i le'ule'u gnyis kyi gsum pas/ thabaṃs kyi lam dang grorme ba'i lam ston to/ /bzhis rigs brgyad dbye ba'i le le'u bzhi pas rnal 'byor gasrim dang rigs kyi ngo bo ston to/ /44—83

gzhal yas khang dbub pa'i le le'u lnga pas driyis dkyikla 'khor rang gzhan dang lhag steng rnam gnyis dang / rgyurde kyi rgyu lta bur yang ston to/ /rang rigs pa'i mes sbyong ba'i le le'u drug pa dang bsgrubapa'ile bdun pa dang / brgyad pa lhag ting gi ho kyi le dang / dragapo'i.ā+oṃ le dgu pa dang / bcu pa dbanga.ā+oṃdang / bcu gcig pa rgyasa.ā+oṃdang / bcu gnyis pa zhi rtswa rnams ni lam①'phrin las ston te/ phramornal 'byor gsum char ston te bar ma shas che bar sbyar ro/ /le'u bcu gsum pa ni bdag gzhan don du tshe bsgrub pa'i le'uste/ bdag sngon du bya bar bstan to/ /le'u bcu bzhi prabam papas bdag gzhan gyi legs nyes 'dri ba ston to/ /gcigale'u bco lnga pas mang po mi nus pa'i le'u grol lamaba'i rim 'jug ston pa'i de nas bdag gi snying kar a dkar la 'tsher ba gcig bsgom pas bar ma'i gsum pa ston to/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub pa'i le gnyis su de bzhin nyid dang mnyam sbyor zhing 'di ltar bsgrub pa'i rigs mchog de bcu drug pas grol lam zhabs nas rim 'jug dngaphan yon dang bcas pa tshang bar ston to/ /gcig tu bcu bdun pas bdag gzhan don du bdud rtsi bsgrub pa'i le'u ston to/ / gnyis su ④lhag nying gi le chos rnams thams cad gnyis med pa'i dbyings su thim nas 'od zer 'bar ces pa bco brgyad pas dkyil 'khor rnam gsum dang grangs ston to/ /gcig tu khro bo phyag rgya spros pa'i le'ubacu dgu pas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams 'chad de/ spros bcas rnal 'byor gyi yul lo/ /gnyisasu nyi shus pas snya chen po dang rgyarla po bsgrub pa ston to/ /rnal 'byor gsum pa phra mo yan ra yan lag gi spyod yul lo/ /nyer gcig cigapamachodarten gdab pa bdag gzhan don du lhag pa gzugs brnyan bsod nams rten gyi dkyil 'khor 'chad te/ rnal 'byor kun gyi yul du ston to/ /gnyis su nyeraganyis pasaṃ khams rtse gcig pa byang chub sems kyi 44byed84

dkyil 'khor dang / thabaso kyi lam ston to/ /gnyisanyer gsum ①pas cirge car pa dang thurja mong lam ston to/ /bzhisanyer bzhi pas rolangs rnal 'byor gasrim gyis rdo rje zhing bsgrub pa ston to/ /gnyis su nyeralnga pase shin tu gsang ba dngos grub myur du bsgrub pa'i le grol ba'i lam gnyis kyikha grangs ston to/ /gnyisanyeradrug pas ①sku dal sngon du phyung ba'i le rnal 'byor tha ma ston to/ /gsum du nyer bdun pas rtsa ba bco lnga pa'i ledam tshig rtsa ba ston to/ /larme kyi ngo bo'i chakha rkyen yid dang chos 'dus ①dang gol saṃ ston to/ /gsum du rtsa ba bco lnga mdor bsdus pa'i le nyer brgyad pas rtsa ba bco lnga mdor bsdus rjopas lamake dang / rnal 'byor bzhi⑤dang 'bras gnyirdzu pa'i shas kyang ston to/ /gsum du dam tshig rgyas par bstan pa'i le nyer dgu pa'i le'u 'is rnal 'byor sgasum dang snang ba bzhi rgyas par ston to/ /gsum du sum bcu pa rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthonge gi le'us mthong lam dang bskyede rims kyi yon tan dang 'bras bu ston to/ /gsum du so gcig pa lam du gyur pa'i 'bras bu bstan dbang po yul dus kyi le'u 'is rnal 'byor gag+gum char ston to/ /gsum du so gnyis pas phyag rgya dam tshig gi rnal 'byor gasrim gye cha ston to/ /gsum du so gsum pa bro gar rtse 'jo'i mthar nye ba'i spyod pa tshorges bsgrub pa dang / thajis kyi lam dang yoṣ+pe tan ston to/ /de ltar de bzhin gsum du bsdus nas gsum yang skabs rjoming tsam ste/ rgyu 'bras gnyis med pa'i phyir/ ngo bos shin tu gcig par ston to/ /don zhib du de dag las man ngag gi sbyar de ltar che long rnam par gzhag par sbyang nas/ 'grelalugs tshul brgyad dang /gleng gzhi la sogs pa lnga lnga bcu'is 'grel cing bshad pa ni dbangapo tha ma'i dbang du 'bru 44—86

gnyer 'dren pa bcu'o la 'jug pa brtsam par bya'o/ /gsum pa tshig don la sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dang po del rnal 'byor rnamagasum ①thog mtha' dang bar ma'i mthong sgom bstan pa'i phyir/ de nas ldas de baṃzhin gsherges pa dgyes pa cheṣ+pe pos/ mnyam ṭ+wā'i dkyil 'khor la zhugs nas nyilda kyi sku la thams cad ma lus par 'dus par bstan nas/ ched thadu brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /zhes pa—/ spyi'i'agrel lo/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gnod 'dul nyid kyis phyung ba'i tshig ste—/ bka' lung gi dgos ched du 'chad do/ /denasaces pa de la thorge mar gnas skabs 'phen sdud kyi tshig smos pa ni/ dam tshig mchog gi rgyud 'di nyid dgos ched dang / ngo bo'i phyir dkrugs pa dang / 'khrugs pas skabs kyi dang po rtsa ba'i rgyud ltos pa'i tshigs ②dang por phyung ba'o/ /debazhin rnalakha 'byor bzhidang po gshegs pa 'bras bu mngoṣ+pe du byas pa'i bdag nyid ni/ longs spyod chen po mnga' ba'i phyir thams cad kyi byed pa por gyur pas rnal 'byor gsum gyi don gdulabya gnyis kyi ched du brjod pa ltar snang ba de/ nyidaskudagongs pa gang gi dbang zhe na/rigs kyi bdag po nyid dngos po 'khora'adas gnyis kyi lus can du bzhugs pa de bstan par dgongs pa'o/ /de gzhi ci las zhe na/ 'chade pa'i dus bzhi dang /mtshan nyid spyidang rang gi gnyis dang / dngos po bdenapaganyis rang rig pas mi mnyam pa nyid blang dor med pa lhun gyis grub pa 'ba' shig las ma g.yos pa las yul med pa nyid gdul bya'i snang bas dgongs par snegazhan par snang ba'o/ /thal ba bshad pa gzhan du sgyu 'phrul phyi ma las/ denas ces thadzos kyis gnyis med 44—86

bde ba che/ /radzo bzhin lhan cig skyes yul bral/ /phuj-i sogs lha'i jos gzhi pa—/ /gsal tshobar snang ba brjod par 'dod/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ngo bo bstan bzhi'i dang po gzhi bstan khasaka blangs stod du 'chad pa'i dus bzhi ces khas blangs pa'i rnal 'byor thog ma mnyam pa dang po gang snyam pa lam̐/ rang bzhin gnas lugs 'dasaṃ dang da ltar ma 'ongs dang / 'byung bar ma nges dus 'di dag /waṃ phyi med par mnyam yin par—/ /ngesag pa med par yangang dag gsungs/ /ces chi'i ngo bo dang don bshad pa'i ni/ thun mong du grags pa'i rgyu 'bras spyad zin pa dang / rgyu rkyen spyad la daltara'abras bu ma spyad pa dang rgyu rkyen ma'ongs pa 'tshogs la ma spyad pa dang /gnyis po 'gyur bar ma nges pa yod la ma tshogs stipar rkyen la rag las pa'i ngo bo ni/rtoshaṃ pa'i blos de ltar gzung du zad kyang rnal 'byor dang po'i ngo bo nyid gzhi nas rgyu rkyen ngang gis dag pa'i phyir/ rim pa dang bye brag gi blang dor bral ba'i don ma nor bar gyur pas/ rgozhi ngo bo yongs su mi zin pas ma nor mi slu bar bka' stsal pa ni rkyen gyi dbang du gyur pa ma yin pa kho na'o/ /de dag gi ngo bos mnyam pa dang po'o/ /de dṛg don bstan rtogs par gsum pa lta ba gtar ga bya ba'i don du na—/ snang ba gsang ba ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid las 'khrul de las lam du bzhirim pa desa'abras bu dag ste/de 'ang spyi'i snang ba po ngo bo nyid yang snang ba dang po'i ngo bo las mnyam pa'i rim pa dang /bzang ngan gyi rngo gzhi mi zin pa kho na'o/ /ngo bos mnyam pa dang blos mnyam gnyis thun mong du bstan pa'i phyir/ 'jirge rten 'idas dang ②'jig rten pa'i/ /range dang spyi ru bstan pa dang / /'jig rten brtan g.yo la sogs pa zhes pa 44—87

'khor 'das 'khrul pa gnyis kyi ngo bo las yang dag pa'i 'dasapasnang brtags dang /'jig rten pa'i log pa'i snang brtags gnyis te/ de dag kyang rangaspyisgra don kyi dbye bas sgra spyi don spyi sgra rang don rang ngo gnyis bzhir gyur pa dang / 'dzam gling lta bu gcig la 'ang phyi nang tshad de rdeg las nang rigs kyis snang ba phyogs gcig la'ang snod bcud bsam yas par snang ba dang / sdude pa'i don gyis sogasaltos pa'i 'khrul pa'i bye brag rnams te/ snang bde dag ni mi mnyam pa lta bur snang ba'o/ /de dag gi ngo bo dang mtshan nyid ci zhes na/ sgyuka ma dpedamig yor tshul yin te/ /zhes pa nye bar mtshon pa gnyis dpeni/ don gyis bye ba ste/ lhag pa'i kun rdzob dang /don dam pa'i ngo bo snang stong la sogs pa'i mtha' las grol ba'i mtshan nyid dang /bden gnyis tshul gnyis su ston pa las bye brag med do/ /lhag ma ni lam dang 'byel ①par ston tsho/'o/ /bzhis④sgom pa rjes su bsgom lam bstan pa'i phyir/ ci snyam pa la—/ skyesaka bu blo stsal rab ldan 4sa/ /de ṭ+wā rtarge tu mnyam sbyor zhing / /ces pa'i/ ngo bos ltabaganyis med mnyam pa'i don gtan tshigs kyis sgo ①nas thag chod pas bdenaganyis ji lta bar rang rig pa'i mngon gsum du byas pa'i shes rab kyi spyan su la yod pa ni shes pa'i rguganyisamatshan nyid thog ma mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pa'o—/ /byelda pasapa'i sgra ni mtshan nyid bar ma'i de nyid la 'jug ste sgom lam dang po'o thog ma la 'jug pa'o/ /snyerges pa dang ladugazhire ston pa ni mthonge ba dag pa de bzhinasgyu ma'i ting nge yang bshad nyid kyi don la spyod lam 'gro nyam rjo'adug sdod bzhir rig pa yul med pa bzhag pa med par rang mi g.yo ba ni blos mnyam pa ste gnyis med pa'o/ /sbyor zhing margyalas sbyor ba'i tshig ni ting nge 'dzin gnyis pa asnang la brten nas slob 44byed88

pa'o / /sgyumabastan de nyidzo bstan pa'i phyir/ sermes can lkun ①rmya zhing 'gyur ba//de dadzo gnyis med dbyings su sbyor zhes pa/ gdulam̐ bya 'khrul pa ji snyed pa ril gyi byang chub sems lnga bskyed pa'i gzhi ni/ yurla dang bral ba'i snying rje chen po gdung ba med la rgyun ma chad pa'i don de nyid rig pas/ yul med par/ ye shes rang gsal du bsgom pa ni/ mnyam pa'i dbyings dang mi phyed pa nyid do/ /'phra mo'i phyag rgya gcig pa tirja 'dzin gsum pa gang snyam pa la/ thamaso cad athabarme kyi mtshaṣ+pe nyid de/ thabs t+pa thabs ni rnam par rol zhes pa/ dngoso po gnyis ril rabaṃ rig pa'i ngo bo nyid ni gsung lnga 'am lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/ ma— nyid sermes nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin yin pa'ang rgyu dang ngo bo'i ④don gyis yam skyes pa dang / hūṃthugs kyi yi ge ste lhun byis rdzogs pa'i thabs so/ /de nyid la de ltar mthong ba'i rig pa 'jug byed med pa ni 'be+ebs pa'i thabs so/ /de la 'phra ba rnamaparasbyor gsum dang ragasapar sbom po'i rnal 'byor du chogadrislob pa ni gnas skabs kyi chas dran pa cig kho na'o/ /sprosapadang tshogs bzhi lnga pa bstan pa'i phyir thabaṃs che2 gas bas pa thabaṃs rigs 'dzin thob pa las byung ba'i zhes pa cirge las du ma'i tshul gyis/ sku gcig yul med par bstan pa las/ rgyal ba du ma'i skur shar ba'i ni mtsho dang skar ma lta bu ste phyi nang med par rang gsal ba ni snang ba mi 'gog pas thabs so/ /dekha nyid bstan pas dbang sgyur gyi rnal 'byor thob pa'i tshe rgyal ba grangs med par gsal ba sa bcu gsum pa'i rjes su slob pa dang rdzu 'phrul ci yang 'byin nus pa ni bsam gyis mi da pa'i thabs zhes bya'o/ /de 44—89

bas spros bcas kyi tshe na'ang ①shas yod med kyi 'di tshe cho 'phrul bzhi the tsom med par snang ba'o/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu rnarla 'byor 'brasabu tha ma bstan pa'i phyir na/ deka ni byengakha hūṃb rdo rje mchog zhes pa/ desnye/sa pa ni yige'akhor lo bcu gsum pa'i rjes su slob pa'i ting nge 'dzin de las su rung ba las rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang bskur nas/thob pa'i rig pa ni/ bde2 pa gnyis med byangachubarangab rig pa'i mngon sum du byas pa ni/ 'joms rdo rje zheṣ+pe mtha' ril dag pa dang / miphyedabade2 pa res 'jog med pa dang / btsalalhun kyis grub pa'i phyir rdo rje ste/ snying por gyur pa kho na'o/ /de yang rgyud kyi rgyal po phyi ma thal ba grol lam du las/ tsa tram̐ mthong med tsag zhu na spyan lta mthong ba'i don/ /yasnem skye/sa 41 yis ①ya phung bha ba de ting mi g.yo ba/ /tu na ka rwa1sa sgyumathugs rjes rnal 'byor sbyo/da/ /a phyag rgya gcig pa ya'i 0'greng bu latsu/yi ge na cig dbyug ldan ka sbyar ba/ /dran pa gcig par nga nyid smra/ /dz+wa/rgya kros ⑤pa srogs byed pa'i tshogasabasgrub dang rnal 'byor lnga/ /zhes gsungs pas kun snang bstan the cha ma med do/ /lam gzhan du na sgyu 'phrul rgya mcho las/ thabs lam du rang bzhin gnas lugs so rang bzhiram̐ ye shes mthadzo bral ba rjothabs lta ba ces bya mthong lam ces bya dang las can skyes bu yis/ ltabalaspyodṛ lam detingakun tu blang bya 4/ba/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyu/ /chagatsu/ pa'i dam tshig gi chibang bar bya/ /ku2/ / kyang 'phra ting dam rgya gcig pa thabs dang shes rab phyir/ /snang ba rnam 'byed ces phyag rgya spros pa pha2 tshun 'gyed pa'i thabs nyid ni/ /sems mtha' 'ong bas go bye nas/ /bar chad med pa tshogs rang 3nga thabs kyis gnas sbyar ba'i/ /tshedabang zung 'jug thabs chen de 44byed90

las byung / /asabuganyibam̐ med ye shes rdo rje che/ /dzhai rkyen gzhan las byung ba min① / /zhes gsungs so/ /'okha na 'bras bu de lam gyis bapal bas gzod 'byung ngo zhe na/ jikha snyed brjodakha pa'i kha brgyud kyange / /yang dag don gyi snying po ni/ /gang nas btsal kyang mi snyed na/ /rarja rig sgrib med darge pa yang ②zhes rgyu 'brase kyi theg pa kun la sbyangase te 'bras bu'i don du gnyer yange /ma nor ba'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa ni/ bdag nyid kyi phyir gzhan nas mi 'byung ste/ gang zhig tshol ba ni ri dwags mi yul so mtshams ①'das pa lta bu'o//de'i’ phyir thob bya med pa las nor pa'i zhen pa dag pa tsam la rnyed ces btags kyi dngango bo nyid ni dag pa bzhi gsum du ye nas gnas pa nyid do/ /de bas na 'di nyid thun mong ma yin pa'i lam ma nor bar bstan pa'i phyir/ deka rla rtarge 'grus goms pa ni/ /bsnyede pa'i dam pa de nyid yin zhes pa/ snyerges pa la dang gzhire ston pa ni rgyu 'byes gnyis su med pa'i tshig dang don to/ /rang gzhan du ma lus par nges pa mthong ba mthar phyin nas/ rtag pa dang 'grub pa tshul gnyis goms par byed pa ni/ grangs kyisnyenapadus mtshan ma las khyad par du gyur pas/ dngosaṃ po la ma dag pa sbyangs pa dudang / ma thob pa thob par byar med pa ni phyin pa med par phyin pa'i don rngorme gzhi gang durjang mi zin pa la go phangs ⑤chen po ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ deke ni ma nor lam yin par akha 'is bod de rab tu bsdus/ ces gsungs so/ /byange chub lta ba 44—91

bstan pa'i lngamatshan nyid gang snyam pa la/ gtanatshigs su'ang deka bzhibe+e nyid kyi ye shes ni—/ /gciṣ+pe ciso 'di zhes brjod du med/ /gnyise med dbyings kyi ngang du med//gsum du sna tshogs 'byung zhing 'phro/ /zhes pa de ltar lhun debazhin nyid gyis grub pa'i don rtogapasam bslad rkyenagyis ma bcos pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyu'i mtshan nyid ni—/ cigamatha'i rnams ma spangs bral la ma bsdus rdzogs pa'i sems nyid bye brag gi chos su rang snang bas rnam pa gcig brjod du med pa de'i phyir ngo bo 'dinye bar brjod du 'ang mi btub po/ /des na du ma'i chos su 'ang med de cir snang yang rang rig mu mtha' dang bral ba mnyam pa'i dbyings khona'o/ /stum ①bu'o na yon tan ci'ang mi snang ba zhig go zhe na/ mtha' 'i spros pa rang bral ba'i sems nyid mnyam pa'i dbyings sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor rang snang ba'i tshad rtog ge'i blos dpag pa las 'das pa'i phyir/ byen rlabs ya mtshan mtha' yas mchog zhes gsungs so/ /'bras bu de bsdu na dur 'dus snyam pa la/ doṣ+pe bsdus gsung rab bzhi bcu gnyis zhes pa/ phudze+e po la sogs pa ril gdod nas ye shes kyi phyag rgya bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du sangs rgyas pa ni bsgrub bya dang shes bya dam pa kho na nges pa'i lung rang bzhin gyi rgyud do/ /deg las gzhan pags par smra bas 'di mi thong ba'i phyir/ de lase lhargo pa'i don smra ba/ /de ni rnam dag lam yin te/ /rang blo bsam pas 'khrul pa yin zhes pa/ bshadargyud sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /mi zardo 'khor lo rang snang don/ /ma 3thong rbongs pa'i 'khrul pa rnams/ /44—92

byin rlabs lha dang yon tan lhar/ /snang 'dod res 'jog sems 'dod sogs//gzhan las 'phags 'dod nor pa'i lam/ /mdongs pas nam mkha' brnyebs pa bzhin/ /nor pas ma nor rnyed mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i byedas bu'ingo bo nyid gang snyam pa la/ thamasaṃ cad joji rig byarja churbe sems/ /de ni lung gi tshad mar bshad/ /tsharde bzhi phab pa'i donata yin te/ /zhes pa snange ba dang / lam pa'i snang ba byedal snang rang bzhin gyis ①zhen pa bzhis bsdus pa ril zhen pa gcig sneched du byas pa'i zhen pa rarja gi mtshan nyid rig pa dang gsal ba de nyid mtha4 ma spangs bral ba la rizla lhun gyis grub par gsal ba la mi g.yo ba'i don ni sgo skur dang ngang gis bral bar bden pa kho na'o/ /denya ni dbral du gtan tshigs kyis bsgrub par bya ba dang bral te/ phyi mo nas lung dang rigs ①pa dang mngon gsum dang rjes dpag byen mong ma yin pa dag gi grub mtha' grub zin pas ma nor ma bslad pa'i shes bya'o/ /lhag ma ni skabs kyis bsgom lam dag dang 'byel par 'chad pa'o—/ /rbesgormi lam gang zhe na/ darge yi rnam gsum tshul sgom zhing / /zhes pa/snodaka bcud rgyud dag par rtagapadri lta bas bshad pa'i don gsum gyis rtogs par bya ba'i don du na rjolta ba yang dbye thag bcad de/ dang po dang dri bzhis drang dekha nyid ji lta bar rig pa rang gsal la mi g.yo bar bya ba'o/ /zhingabyedag par 'byel ba'i sgra ni/dper nyi mas 'od mi 'tshol ba ltar tha snyad du mnyam par 'jog par byed pa skad zer yang dngos po bdag nyid pas blo rjes su 'brengs pa med pa'i phyir/ bya' ba dang po ltar byas pa med med la spyodapatung bya med bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdashaṃ nyid 44—93

ci'i phyir rang bzhin gsung du yin snyam pa bstanal/ 'bye jer 'byes pa'i thabase chen te/'gropa ba skun la range bzhin gnas zhes pa/ chos so cog 'jes bu lngar rme 'gags par rang snang ba'i phyir/ riṣ+pes drug rilakha rten dang rten can med par lam dang 'bras bu lnga'i bdag nyid du yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan du na bshad rgyud sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/ dag pa rnam gsum rtsa dzocud shes pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /thabatsu kyis yab yum ye shes gsal bdestong/ /deka nyilda byedalngar rten can rten lnga lngar/ /rang gnas thabs kyi bdag nyid du/ /nyonanya mongs sa bon kun kyang gnas ye shes su—/ /de phyir gzhan la rag ma lus/ /ces gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor dang po'i don to/ /lngosabu bstan deg nyid dang longs spyod bdagadu bstan pa gang snyam pa la—/ zadzo 4'i dus med yidi bzhin mdzod/ /burme pa bzang dang yid bzhin mdzod—/ /za ma tog dang rin chen rkyal/ /gzhan nas yod 'ongs ma yin te//rarja sems bsod nams brtan pa yin zhes pa/ mika zad rgyan byi 'khor lo'i/'brarme bu'i longs spyod ni 'phel 'grib dang bral ba dgos 'dod skong ba'i nor bu lta bu'o/ /de hūṃ rkyen gzhan las ma rag pa ni/ dper rangalas sprul 'dodalha dang mi'i rgyal po 'khoralobasgyur ba dang dang / rtse klu'i bum pa bzang po dang / nor bu'i bang mdzod dang / rin po che za ma tog dang / rkyal bu 'ang logs nas ma byung ste bsodanya nams mthun can du gyur pa'i rig pa rang snang ba lta bu'o/ /de bas na mchog chen po'i dngos grub ni zag pa can las khyad par du gyur pa'i phyir na/ snya srin la sogs yod pa'i nor 'dra rin chen ma yin tekha zhes gsungs 44byed94

te—/ ngog bo 'dzinapadang gzungaba'iyul gyi zag pa gnyis ga bral bar gsungs so/ /lhargo rme ni khyad par can gyi ngo bo thunamong min pa ston pa'o/ /de rngos gang zhe 2/bo de dkor ni rin po chen/ /hūṃ gsung mi bzad par ldan pa'i/ /rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor bsam mi khyab zhes pa/ byarja chub kyi dkor ni bo de dkor nas rin po che bdun kho nar 'dus par 'chad par 'gyur te/ dpel+la ni dgos 'dod skong ba dang 'phel 'grib med pa dang / rtog pa bral ba'i chos bzhis sbyar to/ /①de'i 'brasabumatshaṣ+pe nyid dang tshad ni gcig du ma las grol bas gcig la 'ang ril lhun kyis rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor smra brjod bsam pa las 'das pas thams cad mabyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /ltaba'iyon tan de dag gi don rtogs pa'i yon tan bstan pa'i phyir/ dngoso grub mchog gi snyinge po ni/ /dnge po don rtogs mje' mi gtong / /chu srin phyag rgya ji bzhin du/ /spyod yul kun tu tshad dpag med/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhes 4 grub pa'i mchog du gyur pa 'an+d+ras bu'i bcud ni gang zhe na/ gzhithog ma ni rnal 'byor nyid deg de ④ji lta bar tshul tshad bzhi'i rtogs pa bzhis rang rig pa'i mngon gsum du byas pa ni/ dang por dbugs phyin pa yin pa'i phyir/ dngapo dang po mtha' grangs kyi sngon ④te byedas bu'i dang po gnyis su 'ang 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo spyan gyi mchog yod na'ang 'khor bar mi ldog pa'o / /de'i chos mthun pa'idapeni chu srin gre bar rin chen chud pa lta bu ste/shes pa dang spyodayul yongs su dag pa la ldog pa'i las sbyangs phyir sa ngang gis med pa'i phyir ro/ /lta bsam gtong ba 'on kyang 'jug pa'i phyir lam mi dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /44byed95

mtshan nyid dor ba ma yin no/ /blamanas sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ zhes pa bzhi'i ①rgyud kyi mtshan nyid ste/ blamanas sgyu 'phrul dbang gi rgyud las/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba bzhi las de kho na nyid du bshad pa'o stong zhing dben pa'i sems nyid ni/ /rigs dang kha dog dbyibs med de/ /ci 'ang med las cir yang snang / /mi 'gyur sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho 'byung / /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs kyang / /sems kyi sgyu 'phrul chen po yin/ /yang phyiltarabashad pa'o/ /kun 'byung dkyil 'khor sgyu 'phrul che/ /mang la 'byel pas dra ba'i don/ /zhes pa dang / phyogs gzhan du dang sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/ gsang bshad shes rab thabs rol sgyu ma las/ /rang bzhin sgyu 'phrul chen po 'char/ /thabs dang thabs byung 'brel pa nyid/ /thams cad kun gyi gzhir gnas pa'o/ /zhes pa dang / rgyamatshode nyid kyi nang nas yang bstan pa'i/ nangaltar bshad pa'o gnas gzhi gar thabs sgyu ma las/ /nam mkha'i ye shes cir yang gsal/ /cir snang bdag nyid rig par 'drel/ /dra ba'i don du nga 'is bshad zhes gsungs te/ 'dir 'dogs su gnas pa'i bya byed kyipa'i tshul gyes rgyud nyid de bstan pa las/ 'dir le'u'i mtshan ni gang zhe na/'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi ces pa phyogase bcu dus bzhi snod bcud bdag las 'dus pa dang / zad pa'i dus med ces pa de dkor ni rin po che ces pa longs spyod hūṃ gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i le'u zhes pa yi ge'i go rims bzhin du le'u'i don ha ha ha gsum po dum bu gsum du sbyar ro/ /gos dang 'dra ba'i phyir skabs kyi don tshoms su bstan pa ni/ lung gis gcod de che long rnam par bzhag pa'o// //le'u dang po'i spyan rnam par 'grel pa'o// //44—96

gsum gyi dang po dam bca' ba rnal 'byor mi stsol ba gzhidanga'abras bu gnyis dang bar ma'i lam gnyis bstan par bya ba'i ched du/ le'u gnyis pa mthong bar byed pa'i thabs la 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas gnyis pa sdud pa'i tshigs su deke bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba bstan pa las/ chos thams cad nam mkha'i mkha' dang / yudze+e gyi dbyings su 'dus par bstan nas/ ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /zhes pa denasaskabs kyi tshig ni rgyud dkrugs pas ming thob kyi rjes thogs su sbyor ba tshigarjesasu ni ma yin no/ /rgyurde dang de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las ston pa thun mong du bstan pa'i gzhi las/ gnarme skabs nam mkha' kyi don dpe'i sgo nas chos so cog nange gi rtsargyudal bya nam mkha' dang gtsung ba'i bde stong la gcig nam mkhar dbyer med pa'i don grolabara'akhor gnyis kyi ched du bstaṣ+pe de ①par dgongs nas bka' stsal to/ /zhes pa'i tha tshig go/ /gsumapa bzhi don gyis nam mkha' gnyis kyang thun mong du bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ yange dasga donakha gyi gsangag mchog ni/ /bde ba (1gas kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /ngeso ṭ+wā'i don chen bzhi bcu gnyis/ /yide bzhin rin chen gsarla bar thirmi/ /oṃ zhes pa ma nor mi slu bas lhagi pa'i don dam du 'gyur bas deg stsong rka ba ni bstan ji lta bar gnas zhes khrun/ dngose po gnyis spyod la mi 'dzin pa'i longs spyod khyadade bzhin mnga' bas ming bzhi dngayerang ④pa'i ye shes lhunalhun gyis grub pa nyid do/ /lhunade'i tshul ni kun rdzob du mnyam par rdzogs pas ngesapa'iphung sogs ye shes bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su sangs rgyas pa la yangaspang bya med pas nges pa'i don to/ /deg bas na 44—97

kun—/ /sems mtha' gyen la zlog pas gnas su thim/ /yige'akhor lo'ibadzu gsum sangs rgyas bdag 'gyur ba/ /ngo bo gzhan nas thob pa med/ /ces gsungs so| /yum gyi gsang ba ni kha rnarla 'byor bzhidang po de'i mtshan nyid gang snyam pa la/'og du rgos byadzo chub sems kyi thig pa ni/ /kun la khyab cing mi gnas pas/ /kha dog gnas dang dbyibs ma yin zhes pa/ 'khora'adas gnyis sems nyid ma gsal byangadag la ma bsdus sa rdzogasapar semasagasal bas thigalegadon nas drang por byung ba ni/ kun la khyab ril gyi ngo bo badzu saganasamatshan nyid mi rnyed pa'i phyir bas/gzugs khadogabral gzugs kyang rdzogs pa'o/ /de'ike 'bras bu'i bcud du gyur pa gang zag gang gi yul yin padangamin pa'i bye brag dbye ba'i phyir/ yonaka tan mchog gi snying po ni/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rtorge ge'i spyod yul shes pagasum ni yod ma yin/ /zhes pa/ soso'isnyebo mu— pa'i shes pa dang / mustegasalog sred can gyi shes pa dang / nyanarangabyisapa'isherme pa dang / semasatsam phyogs sum̐ rig pa'i shes pa dang / dbusamatha' dbus med pa'i shes pa dang / yange dag sngags la phyi nang las phyi pa phyi pa'i shes pa pa dag ni/ lha— cig skyes pa'i dri ma dang / cherde du byas pa'i dri mas bsgribs pa'i phyir/ don 'di mi rig ste/ brgyud pa dang de rnams kyis kyang brgyud pa dang log pa byas nas phyis thob pa srid do mos pa'i yul spangs pa ni ma yin pa'o / /'o na gang gi yul yin snyam pa la/ zabaṃ cing bye che b.re sbyangs pa'i/ /gsal ldan bstan pa'i spyode yul te/ /zhes pa/ gange dag shes rab rgya mtsho lta bu dang / narme mkha' lta bu dang / glorge lta bu dang / ngur mo lta bu'i dang /44byed99

ri bo lta bu yod pas/ bslab pa'i mtha' gnyis lha mi ces dang/ thun mongs theg pa drug las sngon du brtsal bas/ shes rab kyi rab rib med cing rnal 'byor bying rgod dang bral ba'i skal ba can gyi mngon gsum pa'i yul lo/ /de bas na tshe 'di la mi thob zer nas kho thag bcad nas ring du skalabarartsol ba dag ni mdongs pa nam mkha' snyeb pa kho na'o/ /telhag ma'i don ni/ bdag nyid lasa'abyungabar du 'chad do / /⑫salam du byed ston lamag dang 'bras bu rag gzhan du ma lus pa'i yul du mi byed pa'i phyir des kyang / gzhaṣ+pe nas brtsal zhing brtag tu med do/ /ces gsum̐ngs so/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang ces par le/'i don dang po'i mtshan don dang po'i don dam du gzhi rnal 'byor rmi dbang du bstan pa'i phyir/ thamase cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /hūṃ tshogs 'jig rten khams g.yo ①dang / /rgyarla ba mngon byung thams cad kun/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su ma gyur par/ /dus bzhi phyogs bcu gang na 'ang med/ /zhes pa/ 'chadaka pa'i dngos po gnyis po ril du—/ ngo bo ma grub pa dang / ngang gis mtha' bral ba dang / mu mtha' med pa dang / go ma 'gags pa dang / rgyu rkyen bral ba dang / lhun kyis rdzogs pa dang / rgyud du mi skye mi 'jig pa dang / bdun kyis mthun pa nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /dekha nyid khas blangs pa'i dngos po 'khor ba dang / bye ngan las 'das par bsnyad pa tha dad pa nyid kyi ngo bo de lta bas/ 'khor ba dong sprugs su grur pa'i phyir/ log rtog las nor pa tsam las mi snyed pas/ duse bzhi dang phyogasabacuragang nas brtsal yang mi snyed pa'i tha tshig ste/ phyi mo'i rigs don 44byed100
