rnal 'byor chen po'i don bstan pa/ /thabs dang shes rab zung 'byel pasaske/ /nyon mongs ye shes rtsal du snang / /dam rdzas lnga yang spyod pa'i rtsal/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi sgor zhugs nas/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu thag gcad nas/ /ting 'dzin lnga yi sgor zhugs nas/ /rigs 'dzin lnga yi lam brgyud te/ /cho ga lnga yis don mtshon nas/ /sngags kyi yan lag lngar ldan pas/ /yo byad lnga yis ①thabs chen pos/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gis/ /ting 'dzin lnga gsum brten ④byas nas/ /gtan tshig ①bzhi yis gtan la phab/ /thabs dang shes rab sa thob ste/ /sku gsum lhun grub rdo rje thob/ /chags sdang lnga yis 'gro ba 'dren/ /thugs kyi sgo lcags las/ rnal 'byor chen po'i gzhung bkrol ba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //skye med rnal 'byor don bshad pa/ /ye shes dbyings dang sras kyi tshul/ /skye med dbyengs nyid ye shes te/ /ye shes rig pa dbyings nyid tshul/ /gnyis med rol pa bde ba che/ /rim par 'jug pa ma yin te/ /snang srid phyag rgya thams cad la/ /chu la nya ldang ji bzhin du/ /thug phrad snang srid phyag rgya ste/ /rig pa sras su rtogs gyur na/ /snang srid lha ru ma gsal kyang / /'bras bu rang la rdzogs pa yin/ /rtogs par byed pa'i tshad ma yang / /rig pa rtsal gyi tshad ma yin/ /yer kyis rtogs na phebs pa yin/ /med pa phyal ba rang bzhin dang / /gcig tu lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /spyod pa tshogs kyi khyad par yang / /snang srid bkra gsal tshogs kyi mchog /rim par bkod cing sgrub mi dgos / /ye shes bla ma'i sa la gnas/ /sku gcig kun tu khyab pa yis /44—361

chu zla'i tshul du 'gro don byed/ /thugs kyi sgo lcags las/ chos nyid rnal 'byor gyi don bkrol ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //shin tu rnal 'byor don bshad pa/ /ji bzhin nam mkha' rdo rje dang / /rtogs bya theg pa'i yang rtse'o/ /rtogs bya theg pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /snang srid rig pa'i lhun grub la/ /thegs ①pa'i rtsol bas sgrub mi byed/ /cir snang chos la 'gegs ④mi byed/ /skye 'gag med par cir mi dgongs/ /skye 'gag kun gyi zhing du gnas/ /dgu yi dngos char dgur mi gnas/ /rgya mtshor nam mkha'i chos snang bzhin/ /dgag sgrub med par sems la rdzogs/ /spyir na theg pa'i bye brag rnams/ /snang ba'i chos 'du chos 'byung bzhin/ /kun 'byung kun 'du kun kyi gzhi/ /theg pa mtho dman mthong stangs dang / /skabs kyi gdang ngam ri rgyal dang / /ri phran rnams kyis mthong gsal 'dra/ /khyad par che chung cir snang yang / /mthong stangs dngos po gcig las med/ /snang ba tsan dra'i gzugs brnyan la/ /mi yis mthong bskor mthong ba bzhin/ /bsgrub pa'i tshad ma'i rtogs byed ni/ /gcig la gsum gyi gtos byas dbab/ /snang srid mtho dman thams cad dang / /'byung ba lnga pos bsdus pa kun/ /mthong stangs gsum du mthong ba ste/ /dkar dag spros bral dngos po'i don/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa spyod las 'das/ /de ni rnam dag lam chen no/ /stobs can ma bskyod rang dgar gzhag /snang ba sris snem thim pa bzhin/ /phyogs char ma bzung 'bras bu'i mchog /sku gsum 'dod pa'i tha snyad bral/ /gdul bya gdul byed ma grub pas/ /gdul bya'i don gyi tha snyad bral/ /'khor 44—362

'das bzhi la rdzogs pa de/ /snang srid rig pa'i bdag nyid pas/ /che ba'i chen por bdag nyid gnas/ /stobs can glong la grod pa bzhin/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang nyid 'di/ /rtags na lhun grub nyid du snang / /lhun grub klong na ngang gnas na/ /mi rtog bsam gtan bsam gtan med/ /rtog pa blo yi spang blang can/ /khyud snud nyan pa'i byis pa dag /sgrib spangs snang ba 'dod pa 'dra/ /ma spang lhun grub 'bras bu'i mchog /'gro don gzhan du sgrub mi dgos—/ /dngos po ma nges snang ba'i don/ /gzhi gcig kun tu snang ba ste/ /ma nges kha dog sna tshogs la/ /ji ltar gnas pas de bzhin snang / /theg pa mtho dman thams cad dang / /mtho ris ngan song bye brag kun/ /ma nges phyir na sna tshogs snang / /bsam gtan don dang ma nges phyir/ /shes pa ma bcos rang dgar skye/ /rig pa ma yengs 'dzem bag med/ /de ni bsam gtan rgyal po yin/ /chu srin rgyus pa'i zas bzhin no/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes ma nges te/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang rtsi shing sogs/ /gdul bya'i ngo la cir yang snang / /rdo'i snying po'i dpe bzhin te/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i gnas lugs ni/ /theg pa dgu'i bye brag dang / /snang srid dngos po'i mos rnams kun/ /rang gnas rang 'char rang grub pas/ /kun 'khol kun spyod kun tu gnas/ /mtho dman med pas rtse 'byam ste/ /snang ba'i mtho dman 'gog mi byed/ /blta rgyu med pa'i lta ba can/ /rdzogs pa'i theg pa'i gzhung gsum mo/ /'dod bzhin gnas pa ma yin te/ /'char ba mi 'gog gsum mi gnas/ /gcig tu 'dus pas ngos gzung med/ /bsgom yang rang bsgom bsgom mi byed/ /byung tshor gzung ba'i rten mi bya/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i tshad ma ste/ /bcal ba med 44—363

par ye phebs pa'o/ /rang shar grol tu med pa ste/ /mdog ma bsgyur ba bsgyur ba'i mchog /mtshams med mi dge'i tshogs rnams kun/ /ma bzlog ma spangs rang yan na/ /de nyid rdzogs pa'i ye shes yin/ /de ltar rtogs na rnal 'byor pa'o/ /bshad du mang ba'i chos 'di la/ /bshad pa 'di yi rang bzhin 'byung / /rgyal ba'i ye shes gti mug mchog /gso rgyu med pa'i rtogs pa can/ /bstan cing brtags pas rtogs mi 'gyur/ /mun pa snang ba'i 'khrigs pa can/ /rtag pa rgyun tu khre ru 'byung / /ci skyes rang byung rang yin teske/ /spang blang ma byas kun gyi rje/ /ma bsgrubs che ba'i chen por gnas/ /nam mkha' che thugs kyi sgo lcags las/ shin tu rnal 'byor gyi don bkrol ba'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //slob dpon chen po shrī sirnya yis thugs kyi sgo lcags dbye ba'i don bkrol ba'o—/ rdzogs so// //dpal gyi seng ge dgongs pa'i bcud/ /drug pa kun bzang thugs kyi gter—/ /mtshon byed sgo lcags dbye 'grol 'dis/ /ma lus grol nas blo la snang // //44—364

༄ga /bsre ba'i tho byang bzhugs so//①༄7/ /dad dang ldan pa gzhug pa 'ang / /mchod pa bshams la brda phyag bya/ /dri dang mna' dang mtshams shags ④dbab/ /mchod pa rlabs te zhi khro mchod/ /gnan dang sgras ①gzhug zhu ba dang / /yon dbul bgegs bskrad phyag 'tshal gzhug /tshe sba bgegs bskrad sgrib pa bral/ /bu rlab bdag bsgom zhu ba dang / /dor dang mig dbye lha dbog dang / /dam chu blud cing bsgrags pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dam sgrags pa/ /bsred dang brtan bya ming dbang bskur/ /nus dbang bskur zhing lha bshad dang / /bka' bsrung ba dang sum cu gnyis/ /bsre ba'i cho ga'i tho gang rjoyin/ /slob dpon bi ma las mdzad pa rdzogs sto// //44byed366
bsdur mchan/366 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rtor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bshad/ ②〈〈pe 〉gaskug rjo〈〈pe 〉〉rgyang /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2562)44wa 367

༄ga /mtshan nyid sgon ma bzhugs so//①༄4/ /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang dang zhen pa'i tha snyad gnyis/ /dang ba'i chu zla gza' skar bzhin/ /yul bral ma 'dres gsal mkhyen la/ /rang bzhin rtogs dang grub phyag 'tshal/ /dngos gnyis long thugs bzhin 'bres②/ /ma mthong 'khyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /nang gi ling tog gsal phyir tshig gi thur mas dbye ba yang / /dngos gnyis shes pa'i mtshon chas rang bcings thag pa gcad byas te/ /lam gnyis sgo nas thar pa mngon thob gzhan don brtsam phyir bshad/ /don 'di lung nyid gzhir bzhag ste//rjes 'gro rig pas thag gcod pa/ /nye ba'i dpe yis mtshon byas te/ /thabs chen theg par mngon 'jug pa/ /mdzub mos ri bong can bzhin du/ /shes bya yid ches yan lag gis/ /bsgrub bya tha snyad mngon chud ste/ /yang nas yang du goms bya'o/ /rgyud mchog sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /bde ldan gsung gi don 44byed368

'byung ba'i/ /skabs kyis tshig mdo lus bzhag na/ /chos dang yid ches yan lag dang / /don ngos rnyed pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /'gal skyon yon tan mtshan nyid do/ /chos kyi don nyid thog ma ste/ /rnam par dkar dang mtshan nyid 'dzin/ /mtshan gcig ngo bos gnyis 'gyur ba/ /rnam par dkar ba lam rnams te/ /de yang thun mong khyad par gnyis/ /mtshan nyid spyi dang rang gis phye/ /spyi mtshan nges tshig ngo bo dang / /gzhi dang nyes pa gang gis yul/ /rnam grangs nyes pa gang la sgrib/ /dus dang spang lugs mthun pa'i dpe/ /log pa'i dus kyi lus bzhag pa'o/ /de nyid bshad pa'i yan lag ni/ /spyi ni sgra dang don gyis te/ /brjod pa tsam dang dngos por gsal/ /de nyid mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /ngo bo rgyu ni mtshungs dang grogs byed dang / /lhan cig ma rig rtog 'du 'phrod/ /sgra don spyi yul yid kyis shes/ /gzhi dang gnas skabs dang por ro/ /shes bzhin ngo bo grangs 'jug ste/ /mtshan nyid chad dang rnam grangs dang / /ltos pa'i kun brtags rnam pa ni/ /zhen pa snang ba'i yid rnam shes/ /sgra don kun gyi spyir snang ba'o/ /rang snang bdag nyid chen po la/ /gud du be+em rdzas bdag snang ba/ /de dag nyid du de 'dod to/ /zhen pa rang snang skad cig kyang / /snga phyi rgyu 'bras tshul gyis skye/ /dbang po'i yul rten nang rnams kyi/ /'phrul pa'i rgyu bzhis cir yang snang / /log rtog gsum dang yang dag pa'i/ /lam gnas so so'i zhen mtha'o/ /bdag dang chos kyi lam bral myong / /log dang yang dag so so ste/ /gzhi dang gnas skabs dang por ro/ /thog ma tha ma med dus nas/ /rnam smin lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /nyi mun gser 'gyur ji bzhin du/ /ma spangs 44—369

dngos 'gyur tha snyad ming / /thags sbrul dmigs rgyu ji lta bar/ /med bzhin sems kyis log rtags ①pas/ /phyogs tsam dpe zhes tha snyad 'dogs/ /med bzhin sems kyis log brtags phyir/ /gzhi'o med pa nyid du 'dod/ /ldog ②pa'i dus ni bskyed mthong ste/ /ji snyed skad cig ye shes phyir/ /ma spangs bral ba ldog zhes dogs/ /rang mtshan don dang sgra nyid ni/ /rgyas par lus bzhag bcu dang bzhi/ /bzhi ①mtshan grangs dang gang snang dang / /tshul dus rkyen nyes rgyu ldog dang / /gang yul gang la sgrib po'o/ /thog ma bzhi po bshad bzhin te/ /'dra gzhi med snang rmi lam tshul/ /mtshan nyid rang ni sra gsher sogs—/ /ngo bos de bzhin nyid dbang brjod/ /grangs gnyis yang dag mchog snang ba'o/ /grags pa'i dbang du drug dang len/ /khyad par skabs su shes bzhin gnyis/ /bdag gzhan shes sogs rdul sogs snang / /skad cig snga phyi dngos sbyar ba'i/ /dang po rdzogs zhen phyi la snang / /dus ni rjes bzhin phyis thog med/ /rgyu bdag dmigs dang de ma thag /byung tshor skye phyir sdug bsngal myong / /bdag thob lta ngan gyis lam bral/ /rgyu ni lhan cig smos pa dang / /rtog pa bslu 'gyur zhen nyid do/ /ldog pa bden mthong tha snyad te/ /ngo bos snang ba bsal bum yin/ /rtsang byas rnam gnyis su yang 'gyur/ /spyir ni rtsa ba'i shes yul de/ /khyad par tshogs drug yul snang ngo / /yang dag snang ba yid kyi'o/ /shes pa drug sogs snang ba'o/ /kun gzhi yid sogs drug snang ba'o—/ /bdag snang nyon mongs cha yin te/ /rdul dang sna tshogs yid snang ba'o—/ /de yang bdag dang gzhan las 'phrul/ /tho yor dang / zhugs rdzas/rkyen dang ma rgyan chas 'phrul snang / /mi rtsang rus sgom thag ⑤sbrul dang / /44—370

dmigs rgyu la sogs phyogs gnyis kyis/ /mtshan nyid rnam gnyis mtshon par brjod| /med bzhin snang rtog sems skyes nas/ /'jug dus las tshod rnams la sgrib/ /mtshan nyid yan lag yid ches rgyus/ /mngon byed bzhi dang don bsgrubs ①pa/ /lung dang rigs dpe gtan tshigs dang / /don tshig tshod phyir don bsgrub pa'o/ /rang bzhin chos nyid rigs rtsod lo/ /don des spyo dang rang mtshan nyid/ /dbyer med gnyis grol mtshan ldan rnams/ /mdon nyid med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /skabs min snang grangs ①'dres shes brjod—/ /'dres dus rnam grangs shes bya ba/ /log dus nam mthong skabs su shes/ /brtag yul snang ba ma rig pas/ /spyi la rang gi mtshan du mthong / /rang spyi ngo bo byed med pa'o/ /gral gsum 'dres dang snga phyi dang / /rigs mthun bsre bar brjod pa nyid/ /'dres pa brjod zin snga phyi ni/ /rigs mthun rtogs ④pas bslus pa ste/ /snga ma yul la phyis mthun rtog /rigs mthun bsre ba 'di lta ste/ /mi gang dngos po phung khams rnams/ /du ma gcig tu rtogs pa'o/ /'gal ba dpe lugs rang gi tshig /mtshon bya mtshon byed rgyu 'bras te/ /lung na yod bzhin med smra ba/ /bka' dang 'gal de'i duskyon du brjod/ /dpe dang ma mthun dpe yis 'gal/ /don la mtshon pa ma yin no/ /rang gi tshig la snga phyi dang / /dngos su 'gal ba 'byung ba dang / /mtshon bya mtha' bral tshig mtha' bral/ /smre byed mtshon du mi rung ngo / /rgyu la gnyis smra 'bras bu gcig /rgyu dang 'bras bu mi mthun te/ /gnyis pa'i tha snyad ril bzlog pa/ /rkyen bzlog yon tan nyid du snang / /mtshan nyid skabs las 'phros pa'i don/ /dngos gnyis gcig dang tha dad pa'i/ /rgyu 'bras 44—371

gcig dang tha dad pa'i/ /sgra don gcig dang tha dad pa'i/ /de bzhin rigs dang gcig tha dad/ /ngo bo gcig dang ldog pas phye/ /rtogs pas tha dad sogs dbang gis/ /mtshan nyid rjes su 'ang skabs kyis sbyar/ /dngos po zung dang bcas rnams la/ /ltos nas 'dogs pa zla las te/ /'di ni kun la'ang 'gro ba yin/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /rang dang spyi ru bstan pa'i skabs/ /brjod rang spyi'i don brtags te/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyid/ /mngon thob ①thugs rje 'byel pa'i rgyus/ /bzhi snang ba yi don byed shog /gting nas bstan pa mi 'dzin na/ /phyi rol sgra goms don mos chung / /ser sna pho dregs rang phyogs can/ /phyogs cha mya ngan zla sems la/ /nam du yang ming ②btang yang khong rtsang / /skar khung nam mkha' mtsho mig ltar/ /tshig bsdu don rgyas blo mchog don/ /bstan pa shes rab mi snyed pa'i/ /rgya che lam grol 'dod la phyin/ /rmong sbyar byed grags dbang song bas/ /bstan na be+e'u g.yang song ltar/ /gnyis ka rdo rje dmyal bar skye/ /mtshan nyid sgon ma rdzogs so// //①44—372

༄ga /sgyu 'phrul sde bo'i dbang bskur ba dkyil 'khor rdo rje las kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/①༄/sgyu 'phrul dra ba khro bo'i dbang bskur ba dkyil 'khor rdo rje las kyi rim pa zhes bya ba yod/༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a rnyi ṣiñca mā yā dzā la badz+ra kro dha maṇ+ḍa ④la/karma pā la na maḥ/ bod skad du/ sgyu 'phrul khro bo'i dbang bskur ba dkyil 'khor rdo rje las kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ bdag nyid ngang gi khro mdzad cing / /khro bas longs spyod rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'du 'phro khros gyur dpal/ /gnyis med rig pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba lung gi spyi/ /gsang ba snying po'i rgyud dag las/ /dur khrod dkyil 'khor thob bya ba/ /tshad ma gnyis 'byel goms pa yis/ /bdag gzhan sa mthar phyin bya'i phyir/ /gnyis 'bral bsdus te nges pa 'di/ /rnal 'byor bla med 'bras bu'i mchog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs gshegs shul/ /theg pa'i yang rtse kun lam 'bras/ /gsang ba snying po'i rgyud kyi don/ /de snyed bcu yi gzhi nyid las/ /skabs kyi 44—374

dgongs pa dkyil 'khor dbang / /nyams la rmongs pa'i don phyir du/ /ston pa rdo rje'i bla mar bzhugs/ /chu bo 'dus pa'i ded dpon la/ /srog lus longs spyod rnam gsum gyis/ /gsang ba'i rgyud rnams las gsungs bzhin/ /mnyes byed bzhi ldan shiglu'i mchog /skabs dgos thog ma maṇ+ḍa la/ /rgyud las gsum gnyis gcig gsungs pa/ /skabs kyi rang bzhin lhag pa gnyis/ /gdug pa gnyis dang gzhir ①gsungs so/ /de dag dgos ched rnam grangs dang //nges tshig bya thabs sdom tshig go/ /dang po rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /gnyis po byin rlabs ldan pa la/ /de mtshon de nyid mngon bya'i phyir/ /nyon mongs sgo nas bzhi mthar phyin/ /bzhi yi dang po bzhi mthar phyin/ /phyi ma khro bo gtso bo lnga/ /rtsa ba yin te gzhi de las/ /dbang bsgrub las dang mchod dkyil 'khor—/ /lhag ma gnyis dang rjes 'jug ste/ /rtsa ba lnga dang rnam bzhi po/ /rigs dang mtshan mas 'bras bu dbye/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs//gsum rgyud las ni 'di skad du/ /dbyengs su bsdus pa dkyil yin te/ /'phro 'du mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /yang na 'das pa dkyil yin te/ /'jig rten sna tshogs 'khor yin no/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /rigs bzhi'i lha dang lha mo dang / /'khor gyi khro bo khro mo nyid/ /lhag gnyis rang bzhin gcig gshos so/ /snying po thams cad dus gsum dkyil/ /gang yin yan lag gsum 'khor ro/ /thog mar bya thabs rag lus med/ /rang bzhin 'be+ebs pa'i yan lag go/ /rang rig lhag pa'i rim sgyur dang / /rdzogs min blo bur smin pa bzhin/ /skyed pas rdzogs shing don byed pa'ang / /chos dbyings ye shes cho 'phrul lo/ /lhag pa rdzas gzugs snyan ma mnga'/ /gang 44—375

yang sa gnan byin rlob ①phyir/ /sdom pa dam tshig sta gon dang / /tshon gyi bri dang dbye snyen pa/ /rab gnas bya zhing rgyas par bsreg /'jug pa gnyis dang yon tan bshad/ /bzhi gnyis dang po gang zhe na/ /spyan gyi cho ga sdom pa'i tshig /brtag slad tshad sbyang dbang bsrung brlab/ /yongs su bzung bas rdzogs pa yin/ /dang po bar snang sa nam mkha'/ /nam mkha' phyag rgya lnga dbyibs la/ /bar snang mdog dang dbyibs su shes/ /sa gzhi lo rgyus rnam gnyis phyir/ /bkra shis rnam gnyis ldan mi ldan/ /dbyibs bzlog phyogs mtshams brgyad brtag bya/ /'og gzhi steng du bskos brtag pas/ /shis pa min na spro 'am sbyang / /skyon dag spangs te dur khrod du/ /dngos grub khro bo bsgrub par bya'o/ /de yis bdag la de slad phyir/ /khru gang maṇ+ḍal ba byung lnga/ /byugs te dkar dmar gyis byugs bya/ /mchod rdzas rnam gnyis tshang bar dgod//rnal 'byor dbang po lnga gos dang / /dam tshig ma dang ldan byas te/ /las kyi khro bo rnal 'byor gyis/ /phyi nang rdzas mchog byin gyis brlabs①/ /gsang ba'i byin brlabs gzhan yin te/ /bdud rtsi ba lo ①mchod pa lnga/ /srog dang ldan pas byin brlab bo/ /gzhan dag sngags dang phyag rgya drug /'jig rten dbang dang bdag zhugs nas/ /khro bo ji snyed 'khor dang bcas/ /lhag ma'i khro mo kun gsal bas/ /rmad byung mchod pa lugs su mchod/ /de nas spyan gyi sa bon las/ /lha mo gser mdog phag ser ma/ /rin chen bum pa mchog sbyin brgya/ /g.yas g.yon rim pa de bzhin pas/ /byin brlabs gsum ldan dbu brgyan brgyal/ /srog la ye shes de bzhin blta/ /ye shes lha mo sbran btang ste/ /dpang gsol rjes su brjod pa'i tshig /hūṃ bskyab pa sangs rgyas 44—376

thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par ni/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa'i lam—/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /mthe chung mthe bong gnan gsum dz+reng //lan gsum sa la gnyis kas btug /oṃ pri sbyi bh+ya hoḥ/ lte ba man chad lha mo'i 'thon—/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs lha mo bstan ma che/ /mchod yon bzhes nas 'di nyid du/ /mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /phyag dang zhal bsel gsol bar bya/ /mchod pa lnga yis mnyes byas nas/ /sa yi lha mo bstan ma 'og phyogs skyong / /sku gser phyag na gser gyi bum pa bsnams//'ja' tshon 'od ldan phag chen khri la bzhugs/ /de la phyag 'tshal bstod cing mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ pra sdi bh+ya swa hāḥ/ brgya rtsa brgyad du grangs rdzogs nas/ /gtor ma gser skye sa byin ldan pa/ /lha mo sngos la las bcol bya/ /sa bdag byin po spyan drangs bsngo/ /hūṃ ri rab chen po'i gling bzhi 'bar/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jing 'dzin gtsug na nor bu 'bar/ /kun dga'i bdag po dbang chen 'bar—/ /kun tu sa'i lha mo bstan ma 'bar/ /sa bdag mthu chen 'khor gyi gnas rnams su/ /mchod sbyin dam pa gtor ma 'di bsngo bas①/ /so sor 'khor gyi re ba bskongs gyur nas/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod—/ /bden pas bskul la bsgo bar bya/ /rgyal ba'i byin brlabs hūṃ bzhis sdus/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rdo rje gom pas srogs ④ldan bya—/ /sum bha'i gsang sngags yung kar spro/ /zhabs thugs hūṃ las rgya gram gyuraske/ /re gyis phyogs mtshams me dpung gyur/ /brjid bag 'gying bas gnas 'dug ste/ /thal sbyar lha mo mdun 'dug la/ /ji ltar che mchog he ru kas—/ /ru tra bdud sde btul ba ltar/ /chos kyi rgyal srid dpung btsugs pa//44—377

de bzhin du ni bdag gis kyang / /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor zi/ /sa yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ rata na byu mi ṅgadhi ku ru hūṃ sa ma ya ste/ gong gi phyag rgyas lan gsum mnan/ /lha mo 'dzum byas yongs gyur nas/ /sa gzhir thim pas rin chen sa/ /thugs kyi ye shes rang bzhin du/ /brten ①byas pa yi dngos grub 'gyur/ /stegs bu khru gang lus gang dang / /lus gsum bcu drug khru ldan pa/ /nyi shu 'am nyi shu rtsa lngar byed/ /dpag tshad rgyang grags rim pa bzhin—/ /'jigs byed lha grangs rnam pa bzhi/ /tan tra nyid las gang gsungs pa/ /slob bu'i mos pa dang sbyar nas/ /legs rtsig ngos 'jam snyoms par bya/ /sor bzhi 'am mdzub gang tshad gsungs pa/ /gsang ba zab mo'i skabs su sbyar/ /de dag bdag gir bya ba'i phyir/ /zangs dang shing dmar zla gam rtse/ /thugs kha'i hūṃ las dbang khro rgyal/ /mdog dmar sku smad zla gam dpal/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis/ /pad+ma zhags pa tha ma na//dbang gi phur 'dril 'od dpung dmar/ /sdang mig byin brlabs ldan thogs la//hūṃ pad+ma chags pa khro bo dbang gi sku/ /ma lus dbang du bsdud ④pa'i las mdzad pa—/ /'dzam gling ye shes pa 'di dag /bdag gi ①byang chub grogs su 'gyur bar mdzod/ /oṃ pad+ma ki la ya pa shaṃ ma ye hūṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hāḥ/ khro bo'i 'od kyi kun khyab parjo/ /bdag gi dbang gyur sa bkra shis/ /de lta bur 'gyur sbyangs byas nas/ /sdom ni las dang sbyin bsreg dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin/ /zhi bas dri ma dag par bya/ /dang po rgya dpangs khru gang bsko//chus bkang gom pa brgyar phyin blta/ /lto 'phye'i dus tshod bzhi shes brkorjo/ /ro lnga'i mtshan nyid bzang ngan shes/ /ngan na spro 'am zhi ba'i mes bzang 44—378

na kham bu gsar pa'i snod/ /nyi shu bcu yi grangs 'bru lnga/ /spos lnga rin chen snying po lnga/ /sman dang bdud rtsi lnga lnga po/ /cha mnyam gter chen bum par gzhug /stegs bu byug pa'i las chen bya/ /'jigs byed phyag gnyis nyi 'bru lnga—/ /rdo rje rtse lnga hūṃ bsgoms la/ /sa gzhi dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /oṃ dang badz+ra ha na gnyis/ /kro dha hūṃ phaṭa gsang sngags brjod/ /lan gsum sa la bskul 'od sbyang ①/ /rig phyir rnam dag stong chen no/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi mthar zhen pa/ /ming tsam dri ma rang rig phyir/ /phyogs lta med par mi rtog pa'o—/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha ba ata ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod spyod yul rnam dag bsam/ /skad cig ting 'dzin rig pa'i dngos/ /sngon po hūṃ nyid rig pa las/ /rdo rje rtse lnga thugs yig ldan/ /'byung ba'i sa bon de las gdon—/ /spro bsdus don gnyis bsgrub byas te/ /zhe sdang rigs te dur khrod med④—/ /dkyil du smug nag r+ghaṃ spros te/ /re shig ngam nas slar 'dus nas/ /'jigs byed dkyil 'khor gang yin pa/ /dur khrod gdan ni brgyan par bsam//gnas der bde ba'i gdan bting la/ /bla ma rgyas pa'i chos zhugs la/ /rdo rje 'gros byas ①shar ltas 'dug /rtsa bas thabs shes sbyar bskyed la/ /'khor rnams tshang bar bde skyed bya/ /lnga bcu brgyad dang rgyal ba kun/ /rig ma'i mkha' la gang bar sbyar/ /phyi nang gsang ba cung zad dbul/ /rigs mthun thig le phyogs mthun bzhag /rdo rje khro tshogs rgyal mo bzhi/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis byin brlabs te/ /so sor dbang drang bstem brtan la/ /badz+ra karmas cung zad mchod/ /thal sbyar legs 'dug byin brlabs bskul/ /phyogs bzhir re mos brjod pa ni/ /zhi ba'i ye shes rang snang ba'i/ /rgyan 44—379

rnams kun gyis rab mdzes pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor chen po gsung du gsol/ /yon tan rin chen dgyes pa'i gtso/ /ma lus kun gyi re bskong paṃ/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan mchog /dkyil 'khor chen po gsung du gsol/ /rang rig dag pa gos med pas/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa bsnyes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor chen po gsung du gsol/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pas/ /thams cad bsgol ba'i ded dpon mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mchog /dkyil 'khor chen po gsung du gsol/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs pa'i//rang rig mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil/ /ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol/ /hūṃ bzhis byin brlabs bsdus byas te/ /zhe sdang rdo rjes gdan byas la/ /hūṃ nga ni sangs rgyas kun byi bdag /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /dbang mchog bsgrub pa'i las byed kyis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gzhan du dengs/ /sum bha ni yi gsang sngags 'gros//byas te phyogs mtshams kun tu bsam/ /de nas dbus 'dug bsrung 'khor gyis//bsam gtan mchog tu brtag par bya'o/ /phur bu srad bu grog mo rgyal/ /mdzes pa'i yid 'ongs bdag nyid rnams/ /so sor rab gnas ldan byas te/ /thig gdab cho ga phun sum tshogs/ /mkhas ldan chen pos sgrim byas la/ /ba su ta 'am rgyus chen la/ /dam tshig ye shes sku gsum lnga/ /'jigs byed stegs bu tshad ldan la/ /dam rdzas bshams nas oṃ dang saṃ/ /sarba kro dhi shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ grangs gsum ldan pas ma nor gdab/ /grangs lnga de stengs oṃ rdo rje//gsang sngags su tra sa ma ye/ /ma ti kra ma hūṃ phaṭaḥ yang na oṃ rgyu ban dha dang / /44—380

ma ti snga ma ji bzhin gdab/ /dam tshig thig la rab gnas bya/ /legs par go rims gzhung bzhin no/ /sta gon dam tshig yo byad lha/ /slob bus bsog pa'i yo byad ni/ /dbang dang sgrub pa chog rdzas dang / /'khor lo rgyan dang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba nyis rdzogs brlab/ /steng phyogs bteg la pañca ka /byang shar mtshams nas bri bar bya/ /de bkab mchod sbyin la sogs bya/ /rtsa ba'i 'khor lo las rnams kun/ /gzhung bzhin rdzogs nas tsan+dan kun/ /sbyar bas gu khya badz+ra yi/ /rtsa sngags rjes su ma ṇi dang / /pad+me swa hā brjod rjes la/ /brtan pa'i sngags brjod gnas thig le/ /zin nas gang yin gtso bor bsgom/ /thugs kha 'am sbyor ba'i 'od zer las/ /rgyu las gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ /gdan ldan nang du dkyil 'khor lha/ /skad cig 'od du 'bar bar bya/ /shes rab dbyings kyi de bzhin nyid/ /thabs kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /phyi nang med par rig par gsal/ /'dus byas sgyu ma'i rig ma yin/ /lnga gsum dbang byin ldan pa la/ /dbab drang mchod brjes ①mthun par sbyar/ /rdor dril ldan pas gsol btab la/ /oṃ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byam na/ /rgyal ba gang bzhugs 'khor dang bcas/ /mgon po dam can ji snyed pa/ /thams cad kun nas dgongs su gsol/ /sras bcas thabs cig gshegs nas kyang / /sa gzhi yongs su gzung bar mdzod//thugs kyi dam tshig sems dpa' yi/ /gsang sngags brjod pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /gzugs brnyan lha rnams rol mdzad nas/ /spyan la thim nas rig pa gsal/ /bral ba med pas bzung ba med/ /bdag dang bdag gi med mnyam pa/ /tan tras sa gzhi bzung bar gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor spyan drangs cung zad mchod/ /44—381

slob bu khrus byas gral bkod de/ /sta gon gnas pa'i rim pa ni/ /slob bu'i rab tu gnas par shes/ /kha dog nyi shu rtsa lnga 'am/ /lnga yi tshor gyis bri bar bya//kha dog lnga yi dam tshig ni/ /ma mthong smongs la bstan phyir tshon/ /rab gnas skabs bzhin byin brlabs te/ /thig gdab dbang ldan phyogs dag nas//dur khrod tshon ni ldan pa yi/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ /gru bzhi sgo khyud bzhi dang ldan/ /'bar ba'i bar khyam ①gnyis kyis mdzes/ /thod sgrul sna tshogs nyi zlas stibarjid/ /yang na tshad med rtsibs stengs la/ /'khor lo bar khyams sgo ldan pa'i/ /pho brang lnga la bri ba ni/ /'dus pa'i tshom bu lnga yi rigs/ /kha dog so sor bri bar bya/ /dbang phyug gis bskyed gzhan pa rnams—/ /mi skyod sor mo nyi ldan 'bru/ /khu tshur gyis bri ①rin chen blang / /'bru ldan thal mos ma yengs bri/ /dur khrod rtsig pa rlon sngo skom/ /pañca ye shes lnga rim tshul/ /sgo bzhi rkang pa zhing smug thod/ /so so'i gdung bzhis nges bteg ste/ /bam rim khog skam yan lag ni/ /ring thung dbang po'i phreng ba dang / /dkyil 'khor gtugs bcas zhing phran dang / /ba dan rgyal mtshan gdugs sogs bri/ /dra ba thod skam dra byed thod tshal lo/ /dra ba dra phyed gzugs sogs dang / /pha gu thod pa rgyu zhags bcas/ /dpag bsam ljon shing lha chen brgyad/ /rdo rje ra ba me rir bcas/ /zin nas nam mkha'i thig phab ste/ /sgu gsung thugs ldan gzugs kyang dgod/ /yang na rigs kyi rnam dbye ba/ /sku dang gsung thugs yon tan las/ /gtso bor so sor 'gyur ba yin—/ /mchod sbyin la sogs las rdzogs pa/ /dgos pa'i yon tan ldan byas nas/ /tshon rnams gnod sbyin phyogs bkod de/ /las kyis yan lag 44—382

rdzogs pa yis①/ /kha sbyar ban dha'i bum chu dang / /thams cad las kyi bum pa yis/ /bsangs te gsum lnga bdun sogs bsnan/ /yan lag dkyil 'khor slob bu gsum/ /snga ma'i thig gnyis bzhi 'gyur tshad/ /gtsang ma'i snod du legs bzhag la/ /de bzhin tshon lnga go rim bzhin/ /'jigs byed dbang du bdag bzhugs nas/ /las kyi bum pas ①bgegs bskrad nas/ /stong nyid sngags kyis lan bdun sbyang / /rigs dang ldan pa'i bdun gsum lngar//de bzhin gsung lnga'i yi ge dgod/ /cho ga rigs gsum rigs lngar bskyed/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs drang bstem bstan/ /kun bzang bsel dang rnam lnga dbul—/ /yab yum sngags kyis gtor ma rag /ting nge 'dzin stan gzhan byis mnyes mchod/ /tshon lnga 'ang ye shes sku rjes mthun/ /thig dang tshon brlab rdor gsor cing / /hūṃ mi gnas ye shes che bdag nyid/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ thams cad gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /bdag rdo rje che ge zhes bya bas/ /'jigs ①byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor mtshan/ /che ge bzhengs par 'tshal bas na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /bdag la mthu stobs byin brlabs mdzod/ /bdag la rdo rje ye shes kyis/ /thig mtshon dngos grub pa du gsol/ /tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha gu khya dz+nyā na dza dzaḥzhes brjod pas—/ nam mkha' bde gshegs thugs kha nas/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od drangs nas//tshon thig rig ④gsum lngar thim dupas/ /de dag sbyor bas yongs gyur pa/ /de de de la thim gyur pas/ /ye shes srad bu sku gsung thugs/ /mi spyod bu'abru bcu ldan pa'o/ /oṃ sarba pañca rad na sa ma ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ nges brjod spung ⑦zhing bsnun pa ltar/ /byas pas ye shes rigs chen lnga/ /rin chen las byas 44—383

bum pa de/ /lto mgrin bzhugs ldan zhom grum spangs/ /sna tshogs mdog ldan ras kyi dkri/ /gdan gsum dbus su rgya gram lngang / /bskrad gdug khro bo'i gzhal yas khang / /snying po bcud dang ldan pa la/ /bdud rtsi khro bor ①rab gnas ldan/ /thams cad las las bkra shis 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bum mtshan kā pā la/ /dkar po lcang lo ldan pa la/ /sngon byi las byas khang du bskyedaske/ /bdud rtsi la sogs bcud ldan pa/ /'jigs byed khang du lha rnams bskyed/ /mthing dmar dar gyi bcing bar bya/ /rang bzhin drangs ①stem brtan mchod de/ /so so'i bzlas pa grangs tshad nas/ /yongs su khya ba ro ldan pas/ /dbang gi rdzas su nges par shis/ /bzung ①ba'i las rdzogs rjes dag tu/ /snod ldan bu rnams dur khrod khrus/ /gos bzang rang gnas thal sbyar te/ /sems skyed las dang mchod pa bya/ /dkyil 'khor yon tan stan brod bskyed/ /rdo rjes drangs la 'od kyis sbyangs/ /'jigs byed gtso bor rab tu gnas/ /dgur ldan go bgo lus bsrung bya/ /rdo rje gsum du dbu byen brlabs/ /bsrung skud srog ldan g.yas g.yon bcing / /so shing ku sha byin mtshan rtag /gnas sogs nges pa thob phyir bya/ /gang dag mtshan nyid ngan na ni/ /mche ba'i phyag rgya g.yas g.yon du/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ/ gdug sogs gang gi tshad mi 'gyur/ /shikhyu kun dang de bzhin ngan//drag po me yi ④bsreg par bya/ /gzugs brnyan lhag pa'i rab gnas dag /sdom ni sngon du lta ba'i bya ba dang / /ting 'dzin lha skyed rang bzhin dbab/ /dbang po'i skyon gsal mnga' gsol dang / /khrus gsol bkra shis ras kyis phyis//mchod pa phyi nang gsang gsum dbul/ /bden pa'i byin brlabs dmigs 44—384

brten bzhugs/ /yon bdag bskor phyag smon lam gdab/ /bum pa sngon ①bzhin bsnyen rdzogs dang / /yon bdag sbyin bsreg rgyas par bya/ /gzhung gi yo byad tshang ba dang / /chas lnga rgyas sdemadog mchod rdzas lnga/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhung zin nas/ /me long byug phyis bya ba dang / /sprul pas drag tu mtshalas bcad de/ /khong stong rgya ldan stong nyid sngags/ /grangs ④rjes mthun par brjod pa yis/ /brtan gyur rnam pa'i mchog ldan brlab/ /thugs kyi hūṃ las 'byung yig lngas/ /phyi yi srid pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /smug nag r+ghaṃ las 'jigs byed khang / /gdan stengs mtshan gsum ye shes gsal/ /sbyor ba'i mtshalas nas 'bru bton stem/ /cho ga'i rim pas sku skyed de/ /bu dang sems can thams cad phyir/ /bum pa gnyis por dbang bskur nas/ /byin brlabs dbang gis mdzad pa lasabu/ /smon lam gtor gsum ye shes lnga/ /rang bzhin gnas nas drangs stems brtan/ /de la de gnas de tshig ldan/ /gser gyi thur ma snyan bzhar dang / /rma tsher ljags bzhar tshems shing dang / /dung gi so mangs la sogs pa/ /spyan nyan shangs dang ljags tshems skra/ /las sbyor mngon shes thabs ma 'dres/ /smon lam bdag bzhin thob par sbyar/ /yi ge hūṃ sogs 'bru lnga yis/ /'phro 'du drag po'i mchog lnga gsal/ /de dag gsang ba'i yon tan dag /smon lam dgos byed mthun par sbyar/ /'bru gsum dbu gsum 'bru drug phyag /bskyed de khams gsum 'gro drug don/ /rnam thar ye shes grangs mthun smon/ /de bzhin zhabs dang a k+ṣa yi/ /'phro 'du ljags dang mche bar ldan/ /ma dang dza ru de bzhin las/ /spyan 'bar ral pa smin ma 'khyug /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas ma bkrod phyir/ /bdud bzhi zil 44—385

byis gnon pa dang ①/ /sgra yi yan lag chos ston dang / /skye shi rtsa ba gcod byed dang / /khyab pa thugs dbang mthar ma lhung / /thabs chen mkhas sogs don byed pa/ /bdag dang bu dang 'gro ba'i phyir/ /de dag thob par smon lam bya/ /ka las dmar ser sprul pa spro/ /hūṃ drangs phyag mtshan so so'i 'bras//hūṃ rol pa nyi shu'i grangs thugs khar/ /'phro 'du mche ba pa yis brjod/ /sha rngam du e cho 'phrul/ /nyi shu nyi shu'i smon de bzhin/ /dpal gyi chas brgyad bshog sogs pa'i/ /dur khrod chas brgyad mnga' gsol bas/ /rgyan gyis snethams cad 'dul smon thob/ /thod pa'i dbu rgyan ye shes lnga/ /shun kyi cod pan shes thogs med/ /rus 'phreng thugs rjes mi rjed bzung / /sgrul chun zhe sdang ye shes che/ /g.yang gzhi khyab pa'i thugs rje che/ /glang chen ko bas stobs bcu non/ /stag lngags mi 'jigs bzhi yis dpa'/ /nyi gdan thugs rjes las nyon bsreg /zhing gdan khams gsum dregs pa gnon/ /rjes mthun smon lam de dag yin/ /chu gtsang 'bru dang 'dag chal sgos/ /'bru dang sman chab rin chen dang / /dkyil 'khor gzugs brnyan la sbyor ba/ /nyon mongs shes bya sku lngar smin/ /bkra shis dag pa'i ras kyi phyis/ /spyod lam rnam pa ④dag pa thob/ /kun bzang bsil dang mchod pa dang / /spos dang me tog mar me dang / /bdud rtsi gtor ma sbyor sgol dang / /'dod yon rak+ta rol mo dang / /gzhung las byung bzhin gzugs brnyan lha/ /mchod de rdzas mthun smon lam bya/ /'khor gsum dag la bu pho mo/ /chung ma bran khol rkang 'gro dbul/ /zhing dang sprul pa gsang longs spyod/ /'khor smon dbang sgyur de bzhin no/ /gling bzhi rin chen spras pa dbul/ /skor mun smon lam 44—386

kun phyir ro/ /lhab lhub bla re spos gdugs dang / /thugs rjes rgya bral kun khyab cig /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba sel/ /shes bya thogs med mi thub rjod/ /rol mos bstod pa sgra sgrogs shing / /tshogs mchod tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs so/ /mchod pa'i rgyan dang longs spyod kun/ /sems phyir yod med mi dmigs par/ /bde ba mchog nyid bsod nams te/ /mchod sbyin ma chags ye shes yin/ /ma spangs pa la mi gnas pa'o/ /bden pa'i byin brlabs brjod bya zhing / /brtan pa'i gsang sngags brjod de brtan/ /bden skul yon bdag skor ba bya/ /me tog dor te phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs phyir bya ba de dag ni/ /don du 'gyur ba bzhir ldan dbab/ /kun byas dbang phyug rig pas 'jug /de nas slob ma bzhug ①par bya/ /'jigs byed lha rnams mngon byas te/ /dbang gi chas lnga rab ldan pas/ /shar sgor gus 'dug dur khrod kyis/ /me tog snyim pas thal sbyar te/ /oṃ dang rdo rje khro bo'i sngags—/ /dam tshig dus bab bgegs sngags kyi/ /rig pa'i me tog dor byas te/ /khro la khros pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /brjod bskul thugs dam rjes dran pas/ /spro 'od thim gzi ldan bya/ /dur khrod lha dang dbyer med pas/ /dgyes nas gnang ba thob par bsams/ /de nas shirgyu'i cho ga yang / /sdom ni dur khrod gdong g.yogs dang / /dri dang lan dang gral rims dang / /tshe sba bgegs bskrad sgrib pa sbyang / /lha bskyed go bskon byin brlabs bsrung / /dam dbog chu mnon dam tshig sgrag /dor dang mig dbye lha dbog stem/ /gu gu ma yis dag byas te/ /ras dar dmar pos gdong g.yogs la/ /rdo rje 'chang bas gral bkod de/ /gu rus brjod pa 'di skad du/ /rigs kyi bu 44—387

khyod ci la dga'/ /lan gsum lan du smra bar bya/ /bskal pa bzang la bdag dga'o/ /rdo rje rtse mo byen bya rung / /dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /byang chub rdo rje'i lam du drangs nas ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang dngos grub rnams/ /dang ba'i yid kyi rab tu blang bar bya'o/ /rim drangs dkyil 'khor lam du gzung / /hūṃ mdzad mi g.yo ting 'dzin dag /dung khang r+ghaṃ las gzhal yas khang / /hūṃ gnyis mthing skya ljang nag gis/ /'phro 'dus bcud bsdus ①be+er thim zhu/ /de las khro bor bzhengs pa ni/ /zla khams ②dbus kyi sgo khyud la'o/ /de nyid yongs gyur lus thim pas/ /skal pa rdo rje'i tshe thub bo/ /bi shwa badz+ra gsang sngags kyis/ /sprul pas g.yo rur tshems shig gtor/ /rim sprul 'jig rten sprul pas g.yengs/ /bskrad 'dus rdo rje khro bor gyur/ /lha gsal phyag sor nyi zla'i gdan/ /steng du yab yum 'bru bcu bsam/ /thal sbyar rigs sngags rim brjod nas/ /bden pas bskul te spro bar bya/ /ban dha trata kyi gsang sngags kyis/ /srog dang ldan pas sgrib bral te/ /rang sems ring po hūṃ las lhar/ /rdzogs tshul bskyed de phyag chen por/ /'bru gsum 'phro 'dus gnas gsum brlab/ /spyi bo'i haṃ las rgya khram go/ /mdzub gnyis hūṃ khros bsrung bar bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku dang ldan/ /ding dag sangs rgyas sku 'dzin pa'i//byin gyis brlabs pa'i las mdzod cig /gsung dang thugs kyang de bzhin bya/ /bdud rtsi 'bru gsum gsal ba nyid/ /rdo rje lce bzhag 'phros 'dus pas/ /rdo rje gsum byin sdu byas te/ /nga rgyal skyed pa'i gsang sngags kyi/ /rdo rje gsum stsal dam gsum sbyin/ /mi ldog rigs nges brtan bya'i phyir/ /thar lam 44—388

'dren pa'i bla ma dang / /byang chub 'gro ba'i spun rnams la/ /sgo gsum zol med bkur ba dang / /gsang ba yid kyi bsrung bya zhing / /he ru dpal du rtag gnas pas/ /mtha' yas sems can bu bzhin skyongs/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rdo rje sa la mi gnas pas/ /lha rnams dang ni mi rnams dang / /sgrub pa po dang rnal 'byor rnams/ /de kun khros pas khrag chen po/ /nyams pa'i snying nas khrag chen 'thung / /i dan te na ra kan sngags kyis hūṃ/ /lce la bzhag la ra chu stem/ /badz+ra yak+ṣar rab gnas bya/ /yon tan brjod pa'i chu nan bya/ /de nas go bar dam bsgrags pa/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de 'dir dngos grub mchog tu gsungs/ /dam tshig che ba'i chen po mchog /bye brag med par ring nas spyod/ /dge dang mi dge'i chos rnams la/ /lhag par rten par mi bya ste/ /mnyam nyid rig pa'i klong zhugs nas/ /ci la 'ang thogs pa med par spyod/ /hūṃ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /dur khrod rdzas kyi me tog dor nas kyang / /bla med sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams/ /skal ldan bdag cag rnams la pa du gsol/ /oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho zhes dor ro/ / tshud bu spyi gtug ①lha dbab bya/ /slob bu lha'i gzi ldan pa/ /legs par lha dbog sgom thabs sbyin//rigs dang sbyar la gsang mtshan gdags/ /de ring dad pa'i shugs kyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni lta bar bgyis/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /spyod kyi dam tshig 'di lta bu/ /gsang ba bstan pa'i snod du rung / /dam pa mchog tu 'gyur bar byed/ /dngos grub thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha phaṭaḥ'od zer gyi thur mas dbye/ 'khor lo mthong ba'i nga rgyal bya'o//44—389

'khor lo gtso nas bran mtha' yas/ /lha ngo mi bzhin bstan byas la/ /dkyil 'khor dbyibs nan rgyan sogs don/ /rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin du bshad—/ /zhugs dang ma zhugs yon tan skyon/ /bsgoms dang ma sgoms yon skyon rnams/ /'jigs byed stangs dpyal gnyis sam lnga/ /gdu ste dang ldan rab zhugs na/ /'dod pa yid 'ongs snyam par 'gyur/ /gang dag dad med mi 'jug pa/ /byang chub chen pos dbul bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid lha dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /yon tan chung yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /lha spangs dge spyad don med 'gyur/ /de don rgyas par don 'byal lo/ /de nas zab par dbang bskur ba/ /sdom ni rgyu rkyen dgos ched dang / /gegs dang ngo bo rnams ①grangs dang / /bskur thabs yon tan skyon dang 'bras/ /rang gi bden pa gnyis med pa'i/ /thig le chen po'i bum pa ni/ /las kyi rnam rtog dri ma sbyong / /rtogs tshogs rigs snang phyag rgya yi/ /re re'ang lnga snang dbu rgyan dang / /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /phrin las lnga yi snying po lnga/ /snang stong shes rab thabs cod paṇa/ /kun khyab stong chen go char ldan/ /yon tan rgyud shar phreng ba dang / /rang byung mi nus brtog ①chen po/ /spyod yul bral bas gdungs sangs brgyal/ /'dod lnga rigs snang bza' btung ngo / /phyag rgya dbu rgyan snying po dang / /cod pan go cha rus pa'i 'phreng / /gzi mdangs rgyal mtshan zhing gi gdugs/ /longs spyod rang bzhin bza' btung dang / /rgyan chas dbang dang sgrub rdzas kyis/ /mtshon cha'i don kun rang gi sems—/ /nyan sgom 'chad las rab 'byam lnga/ /rang sems gtan tshigs kun tu gsal/ /rang bzhin mi g.yo gsal bar 'drel/ /spros bral gnyis 44—390

rdzogs yul med bcom/ /bya ba kun tu rig par shar/ /las rnams thams cad thogs med pa'o/ /dbang mchog rang la med gyur na/ /bskur ①bas thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /gegs brgyad dri ma yongs sbyangs la/ /dri sbyangs ras rnams mtshon chen bzhin/ /dbang phyug khungs thob slab rdzogs pa'i/ /byen brlabs ldan pas mnga' bdag skyen/ /gzhung gi yon gyi mnyes bya'o/ /dad brtson brtul zhugs ldan pa'i bus/ /ser sna spangs dang sngon bzhin rgyu/ /thob bya go dbye dmigs de dag /thob bya skyon spangs yon job sbyin/ /'jig rten sgyu 'phrul thob bya ba/ /rnyogs pa'i chu la gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /dam med snod gsum med yid dang / /ma dang 'bral ba'i gang zag dang / /bskur kyang snang bar ga la 'gyur/ /bdag po rdzas dkyil tshogs pa yi/ /rgyu rkyen ldan pa'i byin brlabs grangs/ /thob par bya ba ngo bo ste/ /rnam grangs rjes su 'jug pa ni/ /lha dbang phyag mtshan rgyan cha dang / /nus dbang lnga dang gdan byi dbang / /sgrub rdzas gsang ba rnam gsum mo/ /dbang bskur thabs ni snod rim dang / /sbyar te sbyin par gsungs pa la/ /sdom ni yon dang khrims sogs stsal/ /dgongs su gsol ba rnam ④sbyin pa'o/ /rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus/ /bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad dbul/ /rang rgyud gtags pa'i phung po 'di/ /rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyor ba'i phyir/ /lus srog rdzas kyi mchod pa 'di/ /bla med sman pa'i mchog la 'bul/ /gnyis med tshul du dgongs nas su/ /blang dor med pa'i tshul du bzhes / /a la la ho zhes drug /badz+ra be+e ga a kra ma yi/ brjod de mkha' la dkyil 'khor bteg /dbus su rdo rje khro bo rgyal/ /bla mas 'bru brgyad 'phro 44—391

bskor la/ /gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /slob bu'i re ba bskang ba dang //sems can don phyir bdag rtsom na/ /bzod pa mdzad de dgongs su gsol/ /sa ma dzas bsdus gsol ba btab/ /'jigs byed dgongs gsal mthu stobs gsol—/ /thod pa'i rgyan sogs hūṃ lnga yis/ /sbyor ba'i byang sems rigs lngar gsal/ /shu n+ya tā sogs nga rgyal bya/ /dbang byin pa yi mthu ldan bsam/ /de nas sbyin pa'i rim pa ni/ /slob bu he ru kar bsams la/ /rdzas rnams lha'i rab gnas can/ /gnas gtad rtog tshogs lhar gsal thim/ /e ma nga ni rang byung ba'i/ /dpal chen khro rgyal nyid kyi sku/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i rdo rje 'di—/ /nga yis khyod kyi lag tu sbyin/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ badz+ra shrī te ru ka /badz+ra kro dhī shwa ri ste/ a bi ①ṣañca hūṃ a a a/ dam pas 'gro drangs rang rig gi/ /gsang sngags 'jug la dbang gi sngags/ /phyi ma kun la'ang rab sbyar te/ /rtog sbyangs lhar gsal gnas thim mthun/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung nyid kyi sku/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ /nga yis khyod kyi snelag tu sbyin/ /'khor lo 'di ni khyod kyis long / /dpal chen khrag 'thung nyid kyi sku/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i rin chen 'di/ /tshig gsum snga ma'i rjes su brjod/ /dpal chen khro rgyal nyid kyi sku/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i pad+ma 'di/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i ral gri 'di/ /khrag 'thung kun gyi zhing yug dbang / /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /srid gsum yul la 'joms pa'i phyir//rdo rje zhing dbyug khyod kyi long / /ye shes khrag 'thung mda' gzhu'i dbang / /chags med thugs rje'i don mdzad phyir/ /rdo rje mda' gzhu spyod kyi long / /khrag 'thung kun gyi rgyal mtshan dbang / /khams gsum kun las rgyal ba yis/ /44—392

—rdo rje rgyal mtshan khyod kyis long / /khrag 'thung kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /rnam rtog rdul du rlog pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje rdo rje khyod kyis long ①/ /khrag 'thung kun gyi rgyu zhags dbang / /bde chen dbyings su drang ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje rgyu zhags khyod kyis long / /khrag 'thung kun gyi dung dmar dbang / /de ring / snod bcud ma lus gsol mdzad phyir/ /rdo rje dung khrag /khrag snying 'dren dbang /de ring / 'gro ba ma lus sgrol mdzad phyir/ /rdo rje byis snying khyod kyis long / /khrag mgo lus dbang / de ring / sems can lnga phung gzhom pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i mgo lus khyod kyis long / /stag gdong wa gdong spyang gdong dbang / /de ring / rtsal gyis thams cad gnan pa'i phyir/ /dpa' brtul dbyings su bza' ba'i phyir/ /sgrib byed thams cad bza' ba'i phyir/ /thams cad ma lus za ba'i/ /rdo rje gdong bzhi khyod kyis long / /khrag 'thung kun bya rgod dbang / /kai ka kā ka u lu'i dbang / /'dod pa thams cad snyog pa'i phyir/ /srid gsum ma lus bsdus pa'i ①phyir/ /rnam rtog rdul du brlag pa'i phyir/ /ye shes sgon ma gsal ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje bya bzhi khyod kyis long / /khrag 'thung kun gyi lcags kyu'i dbang / /mche zhags lcags sgog dril bu'i dbang / /thugs rje thams cad drang ba'i phyir/ /thugs rjes thams cad bcing ba'i phyir/ /thugs rjes ④thams cad bsdom pa'i phyir/ /thugs rjes rdul du brlag pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje brgya bzhi khyod kyis long / /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /nyi shu brgyad kyi dbang mchog rnams/ /las bzhi 'am so so'i dbang bskur ba/ /dur khrod chen po'i gzhung bzhin rtsam/ /e ma ho/ nga ni rang 'byung byung ba yis—/ /khro rgyal khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i sku/ /dri za drang srong grul bum sogs//44—393

phyogs skyong phyogs na bgegs byung ba/ /rnam par rgyal ba nyid kyi bsrungs/ /de bzhin khro dgu mthun/ bi dza ya a bhi/ ni la daṇa ḍa sogs/ rdo rje dung chen gang ba dang / /khor yug ral gri dgra sta shol/ /thugs mtshan rang brtags ①'bar ba yis/ /phyag rgya drug gis dbang bskur ro/ /badz+ra lo ga pā la a rnyi/ rgyan cha rtags kyi dbang bskur ro/ /dbu rgyan thod pa'i phreng ba lnga/ /dbu skra khams ②nag ral pa can/ /stong chen mi 'byed dbang du bsdud④/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dbu rgyan 'di/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dbang bskur ro//ka pā la mu ku ṭa a bhi/ khams gsum dbang bsdud srid gsum gnon/ /'khor ba phyag rgyas 'debs par 0na/ /bdud rtsi bum chu rab gnas ldan/ /sgrib sogs dag par dbang bskur ba/ /chu rgyun phab la rjodakyil 'khor gsal/ /rtsa sngags dal rmi a bhi/ shun shun gyi cod pan rab gnas ldan/ /bu mchog 'di la sbyin par bya/ /rus pa'i phreng ba rab gnas ldan/ /gzungs dang nying 'dzin yon tan 'phel/ /ka pā la ma be+e/ go cha rgyal mtshan gdugs bza' btung / /nyan sgom 'chad la rab 'byam lnga/ /sna snying lce la yan lag lnga/ /r+ghaṃ las gzhal yas he ru lnga/ /slar thim slar skyed dbang lnga sbyin/ /gsang dbang shes rab ye shes dbang / /bde chen dbang dang zab mo gsum/ /bla ma'i gdams pas bskur bar bya/ /glang chen ko rlon theg mchog dang / /bsdud byed zhing gi g.yang gzhi dang / /dpa' brtul stag gi sham thabs dang / /don dam bcud kyi zo ris dang / /gdul bya thal ba'i thig le dang / /thugs rjes chags pa'i rak+ta dang / /sku gsum rdzogs byed thod tshar gsum/ /gnyen lcug 'khril ba'i sbrul chun dang / /dur khrod chas brgyad dbang bskur ro/ /ga 44—394

dza na ra byā gh+ra tsarma me la rak+ta bhasma/ nā ga ka pā la mā la a nyi/ dbang po rnam lnga ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /nga rgyal ma spangs thod rlon se ral kha/ /ka pā la mā la a rnyi/ rgyal bas grogs gzigs rigs 'dzin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor lha ltar rab tu gzigs/ /dam can gyis ni rje dpon gzigs/ /rang rtags 'bar ba'i ye shes me/ /dbang mchog dam pa sbyin par bya/ /dz+nyā nā dza ①la ram̐ a rnyi—/ /'di rnams rkang pa brgyad chad 'dug /khyu mchog ma he gzig dang stag /gtum pa dom dang nyi ma'i gdan/ /zhabs bzhi bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i rtags/ /dregs pa'i gdan gyis dbang bskur ro/ /ru tra tsa tur mā ra tsan+t+ra srur+ya a bhi/byang chub sems kyi rdzas mchog dang / /dri chen tshe yis rigs 'dzin rdzas/ /khams gsum sgral ba'i sha chen rdzas/ /chags chen pad+ma rak+ta'i rdzas/ /las rnams grub pa'i dri chu'i rdzas/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi dbang bskur ro/ /pañca a mṛ ta a rnyi/ /sha chen dag gi dam tshig gi/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i mchog tu 'gyur//glang po sha yi dam tshig gis/ /mngon shes lnga ldan thob par 'gyur/ /rta sha dag gi dam tshig gis/ /mi snang ba yi bdag por 'gyur/ /ba glang dag gi dam tshig gis/ /rdo rje tshe yi mchog tu 'gyur/ /khye sha dag gi dam tshig gis/ /rdo rje dbugs kyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /sha lnga dag gi dbang bskur ro/ /ma hā rmi sa a rnyi/ ban dha snod yangs bcud ldan ni/ /gdug pa ru ṭa'i khrag mtsho gsol—/ /zhal du dug gsum zad par mdzad/ /chags grol thod khrag dbang bskur ro/ /ka pā la rak+ta a bhi/ tshul khrims zhing gi rgyal mtshan ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan brjid pa'i tog /lcug phran so phran rna char ldan/ tsarma d+mā dza a bhi—/ byang chub sems kyi g.yang gzhi'i gdugs/ /ye shes lnga ldan tog chen 44—395

snying / /lcug phran sor bsham brjid bag can/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la sbyin//badz+ra tsā tra a bhi/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog tī la ya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang ba yis—/ /phyi nang bgegs rnams tshar gcod shog /oṃ badz+ra tī la ya a bhi/skye shi med pa rdo rje dbang gi che/ /ā yu a nyi/ gzhan yang rnga dang yungs kar dang / /bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'o/ /rang rang gsang ba'i longs spyod rgyan/ /longs spyod chen po'i dbang thob shog /yang dag bla med dkyil 'khor du/ /mtshan grangs rdo rje'i ming btags pa/ /sngags 'chang ming gi dbang bsgur ro/ /badz+ra na ma a bhi/ hūṃ gi nam mkha'i lha phab la/ /thim pas gzi brjid ldan par bya/ /zhabs la spyi bos btugs byas te/ /'byor pa'i longs spyod tang rag btang / /slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing / /dbang rnams thob par ma byas par/ /nyan pa la sogs rtsom pa rnams/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /gang yang theg chen dbang bskur ba'i/ /dus 'di phan chad rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngan song thams cad med pa dang / /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /rigs dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /mthu chen bgegs nad mi 'byung zhing / /lha mi'i mtshan ma sdug bsngal sel/ /sangs rgyas 'byung dang mi skol zhing / /theg chen lam la spyod pa dang / /mthar ni skye med rdo rje nyid/ /gzhan yang gsang ba gsang chen gyis/ /bskur thabs zab mo yang dag ste/ /gsang ba shes rab thabs gnyis te/ /dbang gsum sbyin pa'ang dgos ched dang / /ngo bo nges tshig rnam grangs dang / /thabs dang yon tan skyon rnams sdom/ /gsang bdag gsang chen thabs 'byel tshul—/ /mngon byed rdzogs rims thob pa dang / /las kyi sgrib pa sdom nyams 44—396

sbyong / /de phyir 'di la nan tan bya/ /'od gsal gnyis med ye shes ro/ /dpa' bo de phyir bdag ldan pa/ /thob bya gang yin des bde ba'i/ /ngo bo gnyis su shes par bya/ /sems can kun gyi 'dod sbyor ro/ /ye shes ngo bo rang gnas dang / /zhen pas sgribs pas ma stsong ba/ /bla ma rnam gnyis btar ba yi/ /byin brlabs bcud rgyud myong thob phyir/ /gsang ba thob par nges brjod do/ /de don mngon du bya ba ni/ /sor bzhi 'am mdzub gang rab gnas ldan/ /bcu gsum ldan pa'i dam tshig ma/ /khrus bya rgyan dang skyed sogs bya/ /shikhyo rin chen snying ①gang 'dug /las kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs sbyar la/ /phyag rgya'i dbang rnams sbyin par bya/ /rgyal sras dor byas mig phye bas—/ /de la gu gya dbul bar bya/ /de nas byin brlabs gsum nyid bya/ /mkha' gnyis gang yin dkyil 'khor gyi/ /las rdzogs nye ring ran par bzhag /shes rab thabs kyis phyag rgya las/ /bde ba'i 'bru tshogs gsal ba'i rgyun⑤/ /rdo rje'i lam nas pad+mor 'khyil/ /rtse nas stem zhing dkyil 'khor bsgyur/ /bsgrub pa nyi zla'i snying po de/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje lce yis blang / /sgrib sbyang gsum rgyud he ru ka /gnas la dbang bskur dbugs phyung te/ /gsang gter gtad pa'i ①cho ga bya/ /las rdzogs bla ma gnyis mnyes bya/ /dgos pa'i yon tan rnam gsum dang / /snod rung ming burtog don thob pa'o de las bzlog pa skyon lnga'o/ /gang la yod pa 1nga ba'i rgyu/ /gsang chen bzhi pa'i dbang nyid de/ /bzhi par grags pa chos kyi rgya⑤/ /lo grangs mtshan ma gzhung ldan bya/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa thob par bya/ /sngon bzhin chags pas chags gzhom zhing / /lnga pa'i go 'byed pa'i rgyu'o/ /don dam ye shes mngon 44—397

bya'i phyir/ /rang rig 'od gsal ngo bo'o/ /rang rig rang gsal kun mkhyen pa—/ /thabs kyi sngon byas khang du gyur/ /rang rig 'od gsal mthun mongs grags—/ /phyogs mchod dbu ma bya ba dang / /yo gar grags pas bla ma 'dir//thun mong min par thob bya'o/ /kar ma mu tra brnyed pa dang / /'byor pa'i yo byad kun tshang bas/ /gnas der 'dod pa'i mchod pas mnyes/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i las rdzogs nas/ /chos bshad phyi nang gsang ba byin/ /khrus sogs sngon bzhin byin pa dang / /gsang ba'i sa thig zi sogs bya/ /bco brgyad phrag gnyis so sor dgod/ /byin brlabs gsum ldan mkha' dbyings las①/ /ye shes gnas su so sor gsal/ /shikhyu'i lag tu btad byas te/ /dbab bzung bzlog pa'i man ngag sbyin/ /de dag sngon du gzhung bzhin goms/ /thabs la dbang ba'i blo can gyis/ /'khyud dang 'dzum pa sos 'debs gzhib/ /reg pa sen 'debs bdebs shing rtse/ /rang gnas gnyis kyis mkha' rgyas nas/ /dza hūṃ baṃ ho gsang ba bzhis/ /'dzin dang 'khyud dang sdom pa dang / /skyod pas dgyes pa'i sgra snyan pas/ /ri bong ldan pa rnam pa gnyis/ /phab nas rtse mo rnam gnyis las/ /brag brdung lta bur gnyis sbyor ba/ /khams gsum lus ngag gnas ngan spong / /de tshe gsang ba'i lha mo brgyad/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pas rang nyams dag /tshogs sbyar sa bcu'i rim pa bzhin/ /bde rtags nges pa bdeng du bya/ /rdo rje snying po mkha' la bcud/ /'dod dang bsam gtan bde 'byung phyir/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i ro/ /gzhan du gol dang ma gol rtag /'byung bas bteg cing gsum pa'i las/ /bskyod dal las kyi bde myong ba/ /zla ba la 44—398

rten rten can de/ /de bral de yod de med pas/ /shing tog dran pa'i ngo bo bzhin—/ /de goms bzlog thabs rnam gnyis kyi/ /bzlog ste rten dang sa rims so/ /rin chen rdzing nas sprul pa'i bar/ /rjes su mthun par rtag par lta—/ /thabs med rang dgar spyod pa dag /mngal gyi grong khyer yi dwags 'gro//rdo stengs sa bon ji lta bar/ /bskal par 'bras bu ga la 'byung / /thabs dang shes rab gang yod pas/ /spyod pa bla ma rnams gnyis dang / /rang gi bsod nams dus thabs kyis/ /rang byung ye shes nyid du 'char/ /'di ltar snang ba thams cad kun/ /rdos pa can gyi chos min te/ /rtog med rang rig 'od gsal ba/ /ye shes 'ba' zhig kho na nas/ /gcig dang du ma bral bas na—/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs te/ /rang byung ye shes gnas med snang / /skad cig yod med las grol ba'i/ /bden rdzogs chos sku dmigs med pa'o/ /gsang chen lnga la rim pa bzhin/ /don dam shes pa sbyong phyir dang / /dug nad dug gis spyad pa'i phyir—/ /lnga pa 'di ni rab tu sgrags/ /'dod chags bden pa gnyis med dor—/ /ye nas rang la gang gnas pa/ /thob par bya ba de nyid de/ /rgyu rkyen 'dzom dhipa'i mthu yang yod/ /gnyis med ye shes skye 'jig med/ /gzung 'dzin ma spangs rang grol bde/ /brtan dang bde chen ma thob pas/ /gang la snang ba thob ces bsgrags/ /de ni thabs kyi thob byas nas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i phyag rgya bca'/ /phyi nang bkru brgyan ④dang skyed bya/ /bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba der①/ /bzhi pa thob pa'i bu dang yum/ /gsang ba'i sa thig 'azi sogs bya/ /mchod rdzogs brjod pa'i las grub nas/ /bu la phyag 44—399

rgya che gtad de/ /de dang rab gnas phyag rgya bzhi/ /sngon bzhin sna rtser nyi zla shar—/ /nyi ma dbang byas shar ba'i dus/ /sa'i dus su snyoms 'jug pas/ /ba spu bgreng dang sgra 'byung dang / /bzhin mdog 'gyur zhing mdog bde ba/ /chu zil rang lus mchog las byung / /rim pa 'byung ba sngon bzhin pas/ /dkrung dang rnal 'byor dbang thob pas/ /rak+ta byang chub dus gcig 'bar/ /gnyis med zung du 'byel ba ①las/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis sogs 'byung / /phun sum tshogs pa'i lhun grub rnams/ /gsang dbang mchog gi 'byin par byed/ /gsang ba pad+mor ldan gyur nas/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis so/ /pha rol tu ①phyin bcus rgyu 'bras rdzogs/ /sa bcu rims kyis bgrod byed rdzogs/ /kun tu 'od dang pad spyan rdzogs/ /thabs shes bla med sa yang rdzogs/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyang rdzogs/ /'di ni rten ma la rten yin/ /drod snyed sa thob dus gcig tu/ /rig pa ye shes phyag rgya las/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor du/ /rim bzhin rol pa'i thabs dag ni/ /ting 'dzin rang bzhin thabs kyis 'grub/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul rmad kyi chos/ /gzhan nas yod 'ongs ma yin te/ /thabs la rten pa'i shes rab nyid/ /de lta bu'i ngang du snang / /las gnyis spyod pas mi 'gyur zhing / /bsgom dang sgrub pas mi 'byung ba/ /dag cing 'dun yod ①thob par 'gyur/ /de las bzlog pa cig shos yin/ /lus dang longs spyod gtong la sbyin/ /snod ldan ngang tshul bzang la bstan/ /shin tu sbyangs la shes spyan yod/ /bud med 'gugs pas gtso la dbul/ /'dod rten rang dgar mi spyad pa/ /nges pa can la shin tu brtad/ /de dag las bzlog skyon can dag /bud med 'dod 44byed400

pa'i 'phyal ba dag /rmongs la 'phyar bas gal te byin/ /dus min srog zad byugs bsregs brtsang / /chags pas rang dgar spyod 'grus dang / /tshul sdom rtog pas bcings pa dang / /nying khu med par sgra brten spyod/ /e ma ho/snying rjes sems 'phrogs nas/ thabs lam mchog 'di rab bgyis pas/ /chags pas mi balhung bde thob shog /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khro bo'i dkyil 'khor dbang rab gnas kyi bsgrubs thabs/ khro bo rdo rje las rim/ budha ①bhu khyas mdzad pa 'di yongs su rdzogs so// //brtsar mchan/374 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉7sa/375 ①〈〈pe 〉thazhir/376 ①〈〈pe 〉〉 sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉tharlab/ ①〈〈pe 〉ṭham/377 ①〈〈pe 〉ra sngos pas/ sne〈〈pe 〉shesag378 ①〈〈pe 〉thastan/ sne〈〈pe 〉misdus/ sne〈〈pe 〉gro sa/ du〈〈pe 〉thas ⑤〈〈pe 〉thasko/379 ①〈〈pe 〉mkhas/ sde〈〈pe 〉ṭha ①〈〈pe 〉7/381 ①〈〈pe 〉'as/382 ①〈〈pe 〉skalas/ ②〈〈pe 〉thazlas/ ①〈〈pe 〉tsā/383 ①〈〈pe 〉༅/ sde〈〈pe 〉d+kus/ ①〈〈pe 〉thajig ༷〈〈pe 〉〉rigs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉thims du〈〈pe 〉sta /⑦〈〈pe 〉wān/384 ①〈〈pe 〉ya/ ②〈〈pe 〉rang / ①〈〈pe 〉razung / du〈〈pe 〉thas/385 ①〈〈pe 〉mdza/ khru〈〈pe 〉thargyas/ ①〈〈pe 〉sngang / rjo〈〈pe 〉glodzes pa la/386 ①〈〈pe 〉7dang / ②〈〈pe 〉skom sne〈〈pe 〉mir/387 ①〈〈pe 〉mizhugs/388 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sdus/ ②〈〈pe 〉khim/389 ①〈〈pe 〉za' bu spyi gtugs/44—401

29 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rnam/ ②〈〈pe 〉skadub rtog291 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skur/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rnams/392 4)〈〈pe 〉sta)/ ②〈〈pe 〉ste)sa/193 ①〈〈pe 〉〉wakhyod kyis long / ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsdu ba'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉rje/394 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brtag ②〈〈pe 〉skabam/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsdus/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉pa/395 ①〈〈pe 〉〉zhu/397 ①〈〈pe 〉4)ma/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉spyo/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉btang ba'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉me'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉76la/398 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa/399 ①〈〈pe 〉toradzoms/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉spyan/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉do/4 ①〈〈pe 〉skoragrel pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wa/smo ③〈〈pe 〉〉tren/4༷1 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagad dha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2564)44wa 402

༄ga /sgyu 'phrul dbang gi gal po'i don 'grel/①༄4/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun sems su bcom pas ye nas ldan/ /tshig gi mtha' las 'das kyang yon tan dpal du shar/ /kun tu sgrib g.yogs bral bas spong len ngang gis med/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i klong de rtogs pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sgor zhugs te/ dad pas mos pa dang brtson 'grus kyis bdag dang gzhan gyi don byed nus pa'i slob bus/ dang por gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor chen por phan pa'i dbang bcu dang / nus pa'i dbang lnga thob par bya ste/ de nas rang rig pa'i brtul zhugs dang ldan pa'i slob bu khri'i nang nas gcig tsam 'byung srid pa'i don du/ gsang ba'i dbang dang / ye shes rang gnas kyi dbang bskur ba'i gal po don mdor bsdus te dgrol bar bya'o/ /de la phyag btsal ba dang / dkyus tshig lnga'i 'bru lngar bcom zin to/ /44—403

sor bzhi zhes pa rgyud las smos pa ste/ gser ram shing tsan dan las byas pa'i maṇ+ḍal sor bzhi 'am/ mdzub gang la legs par byas ①te/ sman lnga dang /'bru lnga dang / rin chen lnga dang / snying po lnga dang / bdud rtsi lnga/ byang chub kyi sems lde gur byas te/ snyoms par byugs la/ der rig pas sa bcad de byang chub sems kyi sprin las byas pa'i tshon rtsis/ sran tsa na ka klebs pa tsam gyi pad+ma la/ sen rlum tsam gyi nyi zla'i steng du lha so so'i phyag rgya til 'bru glebs pa tsam du bri'o/ /gal te de ltar ma gyur na yum gyi mkha' la sbyor ba'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor tshad gong ma bzhin du rig pas bslab bo/ /blo dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /de ni sngon nas btsal ba gang zhe na/ khrus mkhan zhes bya ste/ rtog pa chung ba lo grangs bcu gnyis sam/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis sam rtsa lnga lon pa ste/ de la bla 'og du ma gsungs so/ /lus kyi yon tan gsum ni/blta na mdzes pa/ lus mnyen pa/ 'gro ba'i stabs sdug pa'o/ /ngag gi yon tan gsum la/ smra ba nyung zhing brdzun spangs pa dang / ngag 'jam pa dang / skad ngang pa gzhon nu ltar snyan pa'o/ /sems kyi yon tan gsum ni/dad pa che ba blo rno ba shes rab gsal ba'o/ /spyod lam gyi yon tan gsum ni/'phral du dal ba dang / blta na brtag thub pa dang / 'grogs na dang ba che ba'o—/ /gsang ba'i yon tan ni bka' blo bde ba ste/ ji ltar yang sbyar du btub pa'o/ /de lta bu'i yum sems ma'i cha byad can de ni/ mig ②gis med du mi rung ste/ 'di med par dngos grub 'byung du re ba ni/ dper na sa gzhi med par 'bras bu bskyed par 'dod pa dang 'dra'o/ /de nas yi ge bzhin khrus dag par byas la/ de nas yi ge las 'byung ba'i spos dang / til mar 44—404

du bsres te lus la byug pa dang / yi ge'i spos phye ma dang / sbrang rtsi'i lu rgya shug gi 'bras bu tsam byas la/ 'di ni kha'i ngad bskyed pa'i thabs dam pa'o/ /de nas rna cha dang gdu bu la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs dang / ras sam dar la sogs pa'i chas kyis mdzes par bya'o/ /de nas stan la bzhag la mchod pa yang bshams te/ yum de rtog pa gsal ba la/ ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa zhig na/ rang gi gtso bo dang mnyam du byin gyis brlab po/ /de ltar mi ldan na gtso bos byin gyis brlabs pa ji ltar bya zhe na/ bdag gi yum du legs par babyed la/ de'i lag pa g.yas pa la/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ g.yon la ro langs ma/ kha la khro gnyer ma/ phyi'i pad+ma la ral gcig ma dgod/ de'i spyi bor oṃ las kun tu bzang mo/ lce la saṃ las gos dkar mo/ snying kar hūṃ las sangs rgyas spyan/ lte bar swa las mā ma ki①/ nang gi pad+ma las dam tshig sgol ma/ de rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams kyang legs par gsal bar bya'o//de nas rgyal ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang / spyan drang ba dang / rang gi mchod pa kun gyis kyang mchod de/ de nas mkha' las rigs so so'i yul dang 'jo sgeg dang chas pa'i sems ma rnams/byang chub sems las spros te/ bsam pa dang chas nas mchod do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan thob par 'dod pa'i slob bus/ khrus byas la mig bkab la gser dang be+e ḍūr+ya la sogs pa'i rin po che phangs pa med pa thogs nas/ser sna'i sems spangs te/ pang gi dkyil 'khor la sems gtad la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'dod par gsol ba btab ste/ yi ge'i 'bru ni ma bcom mo/ /de nas pang gi dkyil 'khor la gtor/ de nas slob dpon gyis 44—405

chos brgyad kyi phyogs gnyis spangs pa'i sems kyis/ slob bu'i lag pa g.yon pa nas mtheb srin gyis bzung la/ bu 'dir shog cig zhes bya ba'i gnang ba'i tshig gis ①drangs te/ g.yas su bzhag la/ rang gi lhar bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs te/ nye ba dang ring ba spangs par bzhag go/ /de nas bdud rtsi btab pa'i yol bas bcad la/ slob dpon gyis bdag nyid lhar gsal ba las—/ yum dang mthun pa'i gnas su rigs lnga dang khro bo bzhi yang bsgoms la/dper na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis stong gsum gyi stong thams cad nyungs 'bru gcig tu chud par mdzad pa ltar/ mkha'i rdo rje dbyings phyug ma'i rtsa la bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis tshang bar bkod pa der dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ril spyan drangs la bstem mo/ /de nas thig le nyid ma skyes pas phung po dang khams su ma grub par shes nas/ sems can lta bu'i 'dod pa'i dngos po su la ldang ste mi ldan pa'i sems kyis rol par bya'o/ /de'i tshe rig pas mkha'i sangs rgyas kun kyang bzhugs bzhin du ma skyes par shes pa'i yi ge hūṃ dang phaṭa gnyis 'du 'bral med pas rgyal ba thams cad mnyes pa'i ye shes skye ba dang /'og nas 'byung ba'i bkug pa byas te/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo la bzlog nas/gnas der rgya mtsho tsam bskyil zhing bzhag pas/ de kho na rgyal ba thams cad mnyes pa'i mchod pa chen po yin pas/ rgyud las kyang / 'khril pa'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor bas/ /bdag nyid mnyes pas mnyes par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sgo 'byed ces pas hūṃ gis sgo phye bas/ bde ba nyams su myong nas kyang bkug cing slar bskyil la/ tha mar zad pa med pa'i rgya mtsho las/gzhal yas khang gi phyi 'khyams su budha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang / thabs gcig 44—406

tu bzhugs pa las/ slob dpon sku bskyod de phaṭa phyung bas sgo phye ba de/g.yas pa'i rdo rjes sgo bcad la/ slob bu brdas bos te/ hūṃ nga ni rgyal ba kun gyi bla zhes bsgo ba byas nas mtheb srin gyis rta babs la bkug pa de lha kun kyang / rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa de/ ljags rdo rje rtse lnga pa las blangs te slob bu'i lce la stem mo/ /de tsam nas ①dus gsum byi chos thams cad dang /khams gsum gyi sems can kun dang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyang bde ba chen po byang chub sems su gsal bas/ rgyal thabs spyi blugs su gsungs so/ /de la rdo rje rgyal po bsam pas ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' la 'tsher ba nyung 'bru tsam grangs med pa babs pas/ 'od kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi bag chags thams cad bsregs nas/ lus chos nyid la sems ye shes su gsal ba dang / snying chos kyi 'khor lo'i nang na rtsa brgyad yod de / gsum chos nyid kyi rtsa gcig ye shes kyi rtsa/ gsum rang rgyud kyi rtsa/gcig yon tan rmi rtsa'o/ /de la chos nyid kyi rtsa la ni 'od ser po cig yod pa las su dang tri gnas la/ de la kun gzhi gnas so/ /ye shes kyi rtsa la 'od mthing ka'i nang na a dang dri yod pa de la yid gnas so/ /rang rgyud kyi rtsa la 'od dmar po'i nang na pre dang du gnyis yod de de la nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas so/ /yon tan rmi rtsa la 'od dmar nag gi nang na gnyis gnas so/ /de la a dri gnyis dbugs kyi snyigs ma la rgyu'o/ /su tri gnyis rtsa'i snyigs ma la rgyu'o—/ /pre du gnyis khrag gi snyigs ma la rgyu/ rtsa de dag gi mdo ni ye shes rang gnas kyi rtsa dar dkar gyi skud pa 'am/ ba dag brkyang ba 'dra ba rta lnga ②bcur bshags pa tsam gcig gis bzung nas gnas so/ /de'i nang na khrag gi 44—407

dngas ma mtshal cog la ma 'dra ba la/ dbugs kyi dngas ma gser sa 'og na gnas pa'i rlangs pa tsam zhig la/ 'od kha dog sna tshogs pa'i dkyil na byang chub sems spros pa med pa'i thig le tshogs brgyad gang yang ma yin pa ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs so/ /de la rdo rje rgyal po'i bsam pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i 'od kyi yi ge drug bsregs pas/ shes pa gsum gnyid dang bcas pa ye shes kyi 'od du gyur pa de/ ma hā su kha la 'dus pas de nyid cir yang ma grub ste/gdags bskyed thams cad dang bral bas ye shes glu pa'i ①sa non par bsam mo/ /de nyid hūṃ dkar la 'tsher ba zhig tu gyur pa las hūṃ thams cad bde ba chen po'i dbyengs—/ zhes bya ba'i yig 'bru ma bcos te/ sngags dang bcas pa brjod pas/slob bu che mchog tu bskyed pa ni gsang ba ste/ bskyed pa'i rdzogs pa'o/ /de la lung sum rgyud khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyang rdzogs par bsgom/thig le dbul te slob bu'i thig le khrus dang mjes par brgyan la dbul la/ de slob dpon gyis kyang rang gi yum bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te/ sngon bzhin sbyor ba'i rdo rje rtse nas zla ba la phaṭa yod pa rdo rje dbyings phyug rtsa la reg ste ma bskyil bar spros la/ snang ba thob pa dang don dam pa'i lte bar/ zla tshes gnyis kyi dbus su thig le cig gsang ba'i rtsa sbubs su bsams la/ ye shes kyi spyi ste sa bon la phog par spro'o/ /lhag ma gzhal yas khang gi khyams la yod pa mtheb srin gyis thig le nyid dbang bskur te/ slob bu bkug la slob bu'i thabs kyi gung mo dang thig le'i shes rab kyi gung mo lto sbyar ba rin po ches bcings pa'i mdo slob dpon gyi mtheb srin gyis bzung la/ bde ba chen po chos kyi sku zhes brjod de gtad la/ tshig de'i don bshad pa dang / de shes 44—408

nas slob bu yis snying khar rdo rje dril bu bshigs ①te bzung la/ oṃ mi 'gyur ba'i zhes bden pa'i tshig brjod/de nas rdzogs pa'i rdzogs pa bshad de/ sbyor ba ni ye shes rang gnas zhes bya ste/ 'di nyams su mi len pa la ye shes kyi dbang thob cing yod par ma gsungs so/ /de nas rgyud las/ de nas rigs kyi bu mchog des/ rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus/ /bu dang chung ma nor byi dbyig /rab tu gces dang yid 'thar dbul/ /zhes 'byung bas/ de'i don dkrol la yon dbul lo//de lta bu'i slob bus las su bya ba'i man ngag bstan pa ni/ spyir gzugs can byi sems can thams cad la rang 'byung gi 'khor lo chen po drug rang chas su gnas teske/ de'i bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo chos kyi sku'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gang zhe na/ mgo bo'i rtsa nyid pad+ma 'dab ma ldan pa g.yas nas bcu drug gi mdo g.yas pa'i ka'i khru'aphar rtsar 'dus/ de thur du bcas pa/ la la nā ste rdo rje dri'i ①chu'i rtsa'o/ /g.yon nas bcu drug gi mdo g.yon pa'i 'phar rtsa thur du bcas par sa nā ste rak+ta'i rtsa'o/ /dbus thig le chen po chos nyid kyi sku zla ba rgyas pa lta bu las/ tshangs pa'i rtsa rtog pa'i gags dang bcas pa'i thur du byung ba ni/ a ba dhu ti ka ste/ bde ba chen po'i lam de sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kyi gter yin par gsungs so/ /de man bcad 'khor lo dang po lam dang bcas par bstan to/ /gnyis pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo ni/ mgrin pa na yod/de'i pad+ma ni ldan pa phyogs gcig gi cha ste/ bcu drug go/ /de dag las skyes pa ni/ rang bzhin gyi dumakha' 'gro ma rngam pa zhes bya ste/ ci yang gnas pa 44—409

med par longs spyod thams cad la rol pa ni lce ste phyi nang kun brda phrad par byed pas khyab ma zhes kyang gsungs so/ /gsum pa chos kyi 'khor lo ni snying la gnas te/ snying kar ①ba ni zla ba ste thabs dmar ba ni nyi ma ste shes rab/ snying la gshir nyid 'dab ma brgyad do/ /de brgyad kyang rtsa bzhir 'dus te chos nyid kyi rtsa dang / ye shes kyi rtsa dang /rang rgyud kyi rtsa dang / yon tan gyi rtsa'o/ /de dag 'di bzhin ni ser po dang /mthing ka dang / dmar po dang / bya'i sgog zhol ltar dmar nag go/ /sa bon ni yi ge drug go/ /de la gnas pa ni 'od ser po la kun gzhi skad cig ma gnas so/ /mthing ka la ni yid gnas so/ /dmar po la nyon mongs pa'i yid gnas so/ /dmar nag la gnyid ②gnas so/ /rtsa de rnams kyi mdo ni ye shes snying po'i mkha' zhes bya ste/ ba thag brkyang ①'dra ba de ni yum gye mkha' ste lhun kyis rdzogs pa'i ye shes so/ /de'i nang na khrag gi dngas ma mtshal spyog la ma 'dra ba ni mi 'gyur ba'i sku ste me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de la dbugs kyi dngas ma gser sa 'og na yod pa'i rlangs pa tsam zhig yod pa de ni/ ma bsgrubs pa'i sa te/ ye shes so/ /de la 'od kha dog sna tshogs yod pa ni ma btsal ba'i don te ci yang sa le mkhyen pa'i ye shes so/ /de'i nang na byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po spros pa med pa'i thig le/ tshogs brgyad gang yang ma yin pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku bzhugs pa ni/ dper na gser gye sbu gur rin po che'i se'u bcug pa 'dra bar phyi nang med par gsal ba de ni/ rang byung gi ye shes zhes kyang bya/ mi gnas pa'i ye shes chen po zhes kyang bya ste/ de ni rdzogs pa'i rdzogs pa bya ba brtsal dang bral ba'o/ /gtan tshigs de'i phyir snying la chos 44—410

kyi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa sprul pa skye ba'i 'khor lo ni/ sems can gang yang rung ste/yan lag lnga la dur khrod lnga/ /mtshan ma dur khrod gcig /nang khrol la dur khrod gcig /lus snying bcas pa la dur khrod gcig /brgyad po de kun bsdus pa'i rtsa du zhe na/ bcu phrag drug zhig dang / gyen thur gyi rtsa che ba bzhi ste drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de dag lte ba nas spros la 'dus kyang der 'dus te/ de lus gzugs khams/ ngag 'dod khams/ sems gzugs med pa'i khams dang gsum la khyab pas sprul pa ste/ de dag gi mdo ni len pa med pa'i rtsa zhes bya ste/stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi dbugs kyang der rgyu'o/ /de bas na len pa med pa'i dbugs la mi g.yo ba'i mkha' 'gro ma zhes bud med kyi rgyud las bshad do/ /lnga pa me'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sprul pa nas mar thabs kyi phyag rgya gsum dang / gcig bor ba man chad de/ yul yangs dog gi phyag rgya bzhi'o/ /de na rdo rje dbyings phyug ma'i sna rtse dang mnyam por gnas pas sgor ma zhes bya'o/ /gru gsum logs gsum ste drug /dbus kyi cha gnyis te brgyad/ de ni spor ma brgyad do/ /drag po ni gru gsum gyi brda'o/ /drug pa rlung gi 'khor lo ni/ thabs kyi rlung bcu bshad na 'dir gnyis shig bzung ngo / /de la stod kyi rlung ni bsdam pa'o/ /smad kyi rlung ni g.yo ba ste/de'i dbyebs ni za hor gyi gzhu 'od ma bkug pa 'dra ba'o/ /mgo bo sbrul lta bu la sna la ba dan sbrul lce lta bu yod pa'i chad pa'i dkyil gyi bu kha na yi ge yo dmar skya rang bzhin gyis yod pa'o/ /rlung 'di las ni gom pa 'dor ba dang / pho mo'i sa bon 'byin pa dang kun rdzob kyi rlung dang / bshang gci 'byung ba'i las 44—411

byed de/ /gal te rlung 'di med na las de kun 'gog /yul ni phyag rgya brgyad do/ /rgyu ba ni lte ba nas rkang mthil yan chad du rgyu'o/ /de las las dang po pas/ yo gis bskyed de spar nas 'khor dang dur khrod kun ma hā su kha la 'dzud pa'i dus na/ gtum mo zhes bud med kyi rgyud las bshad do/ /'di nas mar ye shes dbab cing dgug pa'i thabs mdo tsam zhig bstan te/ don dam pa'i sa ①phyag rgya gcig la zla ba tshes pa gnyis gyen thur du kha sbyar ba'i bar du/kun rdzob kyi byang chub kyi sems nyid chos sku dang tha mi dad pa nyungs dkar che tshad bsgom pa ni dbab pa gcig go/ /rkyang pa zhes pa don dam pa'i phyag rgya phyed la sems sngon lta bu 'od ④yang mi gnas pas bsgom pa ni/ zla ba drug gis snang ba 'thob ste/ de ltar sprul pa'i 'khor lo la thabs gsum mo/ /chos kyi 'khor lo la mkha' 'gro ma med pa'i pad+ma can dang mkha' 'gro mar ldan pa dang /rtsa brgyad kyi mdo ye shes snying po'i rtsa la/ ma hā su kha nyi ma ltar dmigs pa ni khams gsum kun kyang dag pa'i snang bas 'gags pa ste/ thabs gsum mo/ /de nyid las thig le bskul ba ni myur ba'i thabs te bzhi'o/ /de la sogs pa ye shes dgugs ①pa thabs mtha' yas pa kun ni snang ba thob kyang dngos grub chen po shin tu bul ba ste/ log pa'i lam dulhung ba yang mang ngo / /de dag ni rdzogs pa'i bskyed rims te bud med kyi rgyud las ni thabs dam par bzhag go/ /da ni sgogs pa'i rdzogs pa ston te/ rang bzhin ngo bo nyid kyi yum ste/yon tan gyi mtshan nyid bcu gsum rdzogs pas mthong ba tsam gyi snang ba thob pa'i yid g.yo ba/ yi ge med pa ni/ ā ste chos nyid du rtogs pa ni nyin mo yang ma yin mtshan mo yang ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin ldang ba ste/ 'di ma shes par 44—412

dngos grub thob par re ba ni/ nam mkha' khu tshur gyis sod par re ba dang 'dra'o—/ /rdo rje ma'i sna bskul ba ni/ hūṃ phaṭa las ltos pa ma yin temakhyud pa'i gar gsum gyis snang ba dang po thob tsam na/ 'khor lo la bzlog pa ni rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i dang po pa ste tha ma'o/ /rnal 'byor pa thabs dang shes rab gang yin yang / sku stag phru gu rgyug pa ltar bya ste/ bkug la stod kyi rlung 'phro 'du gang gi dus su phyin kyang rung ste bcu drug gi 'khor lo la byed mar bcad de/ de kho na nyid gsang sgo thub tshad du bsdam/ yi dam par bzhag pa ni rdzogs pa'i 'bring gi 'bring ngo / /de nyid las dbu'i 'khor lo byed ni ci yang ma yin pas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis ka dang 'bral ba ste—/ yi ge yo brtson 'grus kyis sdom pa ni/ gsang sgo sdom pa ste/ des dga' ba thob pa ni sa dang po rab tu dga' ba thob pa yang yin la/ sa gsum gyi dang po kun tu 'od kyi sa yang yin pas/ thob par nus zhes bya'o/ /de'i rdzogs pa'i rdzogs pa ni/ yi ge dang phra mo dang sku gang la yang mi rtog pas—/ thabs chen po bya ba rtsal dang bral zhes bya'o/ /de phan cad sangs rgyas kyi yon tan kun brtsal mi dgos pas rdzogs pa chen po zhes smos so/ /de'i phyir rgyu 'bras ①kyi chos kun rdzogs par dkyus las smras ②so/ /de nas mar gyi yi ge 'bru ma bkrol lo/ /dbang gi gal po'i don 'grel rdzogs so// //khri dang 'bum la gcig 'ga' 'byung ba la/ /man ngag rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur bya phyir bkrol/ /gsum las mangs na rdo rje dmyal bar byed/ /'das na rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyang 'tshig /gter du bcang ngo // //①rtsa 'grel gnyis ka sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa gnyags dz+nyā na'i 'gyur 44—413

ro—/ / //bsdur mchan/4༷2 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉〉ltar bkod/4༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gra/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ming /4༷5 ①〈〈pe 〉nya)/4༷6 ①〈〈pe 〉stago/4༷7 ①〈〈pe 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rnga/4༷/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉bla ma'i/4༷smyo ①〈〈pe 〉〉bshibs/ ②〈〈pe 〉stana'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉dri/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/41༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉dkur/ ②〈〈pe 〉stananyis/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉ba/412 ①〈〈pe 〉〉was ②〈〈pe〉〉nel/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dgug du〈〈pe 〉〉〉du/413 ①〈〈pe 〉〉 'bras/ ②〈〈pe 〉skusgos/ ②〈〈pe 〉ska /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2565)44wa 414

༄ga /sgyu 'phrul dra ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//①ra ga /bcom ldan 'das ye shes rang gnas rtog pa mi mnga' ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud chen rgya mtsho las/ /dug gis dug gsal lta bu'i don gyi phyir/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i snang ba 'di brtsams pas—/ /'gro ba ma lus 'dod chags kyis grol bya/ /dad brtson brtul shugs ldan pa la/ /phan pa'i dbang sbyin nus pa'i dbang / /rim pa bzhin du thob byas nas/ /shin tu dben pa'i gnas nyid du/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen pa/ /bsgrub pa dang ni bsgrub chen po/ /yum gyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /dang po brtsal ba bshad bya ba/ /lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /dbye 'am yang na mi dbye bar/ /lus 'bul byed na kun snyoms bya/ /spu gu ring zhing mdzes pa dang / /pad+ma gong ma ut+pal ldang / /si la che chung ran pa dang / /smad zheng che la ba ga rab/ /pad+ma rak+ta cung zad 44byed415

mang / /se la ga bur yod pa dang / /zhal ni shin tu mdzes pa dang / /si la yon tan bcu gcig ldan/ /se la gsum ste oṃ la gsum/ /hūṃ la'ang gsum ste tram̐ la gsum/ /ji ltar sbyar tu btub pa ste/ /de ni skyed byed zhing dang 'dra//zhing med sa bon 'debs pa ni/ /sa bon gtan du rlags ①par 'gyur/ /gnyis pa bshad par bya ba ni/ /brlabs dang rgyan dang stan chos cha/ /rnam pa gsum du bshad pa yin/ /dang po yum dang pad+ma dang / /gsang ba yin te rnam gsum 'dod/ /bdag nyid gang yin yum bsams la/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon kha dang ni/ /phyi'i pad+ma'i bar khyams la/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ro langs dang / /khro gnyer ma dang ral gcig dgod/ /spyi bo lce snying lte ba dang / /nang gi pad+ma de dag tu/ /oṃ dang i hūṃ swā hā las/ /kun bzang gos dkar sangs rgyas spyan/ /ma ma ki dang sgol mar rlab/ /pad+ma brgyad dkyil ge sar e//ra las rtsa dang bcas par rlab/ /hūṃ las gsang ba sbu gur phaṭa/ /de ltar rim pa bzhin du rlab/ /shin tu sgeg pa'i gzi brjid 'bar/ /yid bzhin rin chen phreng ba 'bar/ /dbyangs snyan yid 'phrog gzi ldan 'bar/ /gzugs mdzes bskyod pas phyogs bcur g.yo/ /kun tu tshim byed dri gsung thim//la mdzes rin chen phung po 'bar/ /'od gsal 'phro bas kun tu 'bar/ /bdud rtsi bsel dri 'jam pa tri/ /dgug dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa/ /rgyud las gsungs pas don mi 'gal/ /stegs bu dris byugs sil bkram par/ /bshung phud khrus byas lnga dris byug /tsan dan lde gus de bzhin te/ /rgyan dang lha'i tsa ka li/ /rgyan sogs rim pa de bzhin te/ /bde ba bskyed phyir sun mi byed—/ /lde gu pad+mar bcug bzhin bya/ /chags pa bskyed phyir 'di lta ste/ /44byed416

sbu gu 'dzum zhing dbye ba dang / /spu gu nyid la tsum pa'i bya/ /pad+mar tsum pa'i gnyis la'o/ /rā ga rā ga ngag gi yin/ /dris byug srin po lag pa yi/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma 'dab rgyas bya/ /dung gi phur pas dgeg stod gdab/ /nying lag gsum gnyis 'bur ba brtse/ /mnyam dang brtul zhugs skyil krung ngam/ /yang na pad+ma nyid kyis so/ /'da' 'da' 'og mas mchu gzung bya/ /de la sogs pa gtsug lag las/ /gsungs pa ji bzhin mkhas tha'o/ /gsum pa ji bzhin ril 'thad pa/ /rgyu dang thabs dang yon tan no/ /rgyu ni gnyis gnyis dang po la/ /bcu gsum gnyis la yi ge ste/ /bde chen gur khum zla rgyas gnas—/ /gnyis pa bcu gsum gnyis pa dang / /bzhi gnyis lam phyir der 'byung ste/ /tha ma bde ba bskyed ces bshad/ /g.yas nas chu dang g.yon nas niske/ /nyi ma dbus nas ga bur yin/ /yum yang de bzhin kho na 'dra/ /de yis bskyed pas rgyu yin no/ /se la bshung phud dri/ chu skyes dag byas rgyas pa'i nang / /bsrub thabs khams bzhi yum bzhis kyang / /bde ba bskyed ces bya ba ste/ /dgug dang 'dzin dang de bzhin te/ /'khyud dang bsdams dang bskyod pa yis/ /bde chen ga phur spyan drangs la/ /mi drag mi dal mi 'bral bar—/ /ho bas 'bras bu bskyed par byed/ /de phyir lha mo 'khor gyis bskor//g.yo dang bskyod dang 'jug pa dang / /'bras bu dag gi don yin no/ /dbang po rdo rje pad+mar ldan/ /gnyis med byang chub sems 'phro na/ /mi dmigs bde dang longs spyod 'phro/ /bco brgyad 'byung ba'i gnas yin te/ /byang chub grub pa'i zhing yang yin/ /bde ba sbyin pa'i rgyu yin te/ /gsang ba'i mtshan nyid brjod pa ni/ /dbang po rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyal/ /yum gyi 44—417

pad+ma bde mchog dbyings/ /sems ni byang chub 'byung ba'i gter/ /dbang po yul sems ldan gyur na/ /gsang ba mchog gi 'phrul chen po/ /dkyil 'khor rdul snyed grangs med dang / /phun sum tshogs pa lhun grub rnams/ /gsang ba mchog gis 'byen par byed/ /de phyir nges par dang du blang / /tha ma rten dang rten can dang / /skyon yon dag ste gsum du bshad/ /rten kyang 'di ltar shes par bya/ /'byung bzhi'i rim pa'i bde zhu nas/ /'og nas 'og tu 'phro bar 'gyur/ /reg 'kham dbang 'khyud sbyor ba yis/ /hom khung phur bus bskyod pas ni/ /ram̐ gyis khong du sbar ba yis/ /tsakra bye gsal kha bye bas//de zhu a ni tsakra las/ /u da 'dzag pas baṃ thig 'dra/ /de nas sprul pa'i tsakrar ni/ /gnyis 'dus gnyis las ga phur dang / /rā ga 'dzag par byed pa yin/ /mngal byi dbus na brten ①gnas pa/ /theg pa'i dbyibs su rgyud las bshad/ /dga' ba bskyed pa'i rtags bshad pa/ /'dar dang rdul dang ba spu langs/ /skad 'gag pa dang mdog gsal dang / /kha dog 'gyur zhing mchi ma stsos/ /dga' dang mchog dang chad pa dang / /rang bzhin dag tu gsungs pa yin/ /gang tshe nor bu sems gang ba/ /de ni dga' bar brjod pa ste/ /de nas 'bru gsum mchog tu dga'/ /gsum gyi gsum su chad pa 'byung / /de nas gsum ni rang bzhin no/ /rang bzhin de las g.yos pa ste/ /bde chen g.yos nas smin phrag sleb/ /de ni dga' bar bshad ces gsungs/ /gsum phrag gnyis nas bcu gsum gnyis/ /de ni mchog gi dga' ba yin/ /de na dharmāḥtsakra ru/ /chad pa yin no lte ba nas/ /de ni dga' zhes rgyal bas bshad—/ /de nas nor bu thu ga ru/ /mchog gi dag zhes bshad pa yin/ /14—418
