de nas kha ru byin pa ni/ /chad pa zhes bya rang bzhin ni/ /babs la ma rag bshad pa yin/ /ye shes bcu drug bshad bya na/ /'dod dang 'dar dang 'gro ba dang / /dga' ba bzhi ni dga' ba yin/ /rgyas dang 'dud dang 'byung ba dang / /mchog tu skye ba mchog dga' yin/ /'bar dang thig le myos pa dang //chad pa zhes byar bshad pa yin/ /u tang ni tshul dang gnyid/ /rang bzhin dga' bar brjod pa ste/ /de ni mtshan mar brjod pa yin/ /de ltar mtshan ma med pa la/ /sbom po dbang mos cung zad myong / /bsrub dang bsrub pa las byung ba/ /bskug cing hūṃ ring las byung ba/ /gcig dang du mar bral ba yi—/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs te/ /rang byung ye shes gnas med snang / /dngos rnams nyid na dngos med par/ /rtog pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /de yis dngos med rtogs par 'gyur/ /yang dag gshegs dang log rtog dang / /gzhan yang sprul pa bsam yas kyis/ /de la gsad cing gzung du med/ /kha dog dbyibs dang gnas rigs med/ /rtog med rang rig 'od gsal ba/ /byang chub sems zhes brjod pa ni/ /gang nas ma 'ongs gar mi 'gro/ /rtog med 'od gsal thams cad mkhyen/ /thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sems nyid las ni gzhan ma yin/ /sems dang chos su dbyer med pas/ /byang chub lam de ring ba min/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /sna tshogs ji snyed brjod pa yang / /so so'i mtshan nyid ma gtogs pa/ /ba spu'i cha tsam brjod pa med/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /rang bzhin ye nas dag pa yi/ /sus kyang ma byas ngang 44—419

gis gsal/ /ma chags pad+ma 'dra ba yi/ /ye shes can gyi spyod yul te/ /kun dang thun mong de ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul te/ /skyes bu blo rtsal rab kyis gtogs/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi thams cad kyang / /rtog pa'i mtshan ma so sor snang / /snang ba nyid na dbyer med de/ /mtha' dbus med de bzlum po'i tshul/ /de bzhin rang gi rig pa yang / /mtha' dang dbus med du ma men/ /gang du mi 'gro kun tu khyab/ /kun la de bzhin mi gnas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /gsang ba'i don mchog 'di dag kun/ /lta ba dman la bshad byas nas/ /dus min bar ni srog zad nas/ /mgo 'gas snying yang 'tshig par 'gyur/ /khab len gyis ni lcags bsdud ltar/ /mi 'dod bzhin du dbang med par/ /ngan song mi khom skal bar bathong / /de bas shin tu gsang bar bya/ /gang na gsang chen 'di yod par/ /me ma mur kyi dong 'bigs shing / /sru gri nags tshal gtams pa la/ /'dzegs nas bu dag 'gro bar byos/ /chags pas chags pa grol ba ni/ /dug kyang sman du 'gyur ba bzhin/ /'dod chags ye shes chen po 'dis/ /sku lnga lhun grub thob par 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho me long la sogs rgyud chen las/ /mthun pas mthun pa dgrol ba khye gu tshul kyis 'dod chags kyis/ /mos pa'i gang zag lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kun gyis thob par shog /sgyu 'phrul dra ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //sgeg pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ban dhe dz+nyā na ku ma ras bsgyur ba'o// //44—420
bsdur mchan/415 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉sngasnar 〉ltar bkod/416 ①〈〈pe 〉mudug418 ①〈〈pe 〉ga)na/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2566)44wa 421

༄ga /gsang ba'i man ngag 'jam pa'i zags pa zhes bya ba/①to bi ma la'i sgyu 'phrul 'jam thigs bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/'gu ya ba ta sha mu ka bā bin du na ma/ bod skad du/ gsang ba'i man ngag 'jam pa'i thigs pa zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la yi ge kun 'dus pa/ /gsung gi 'khor lo bde ba'i yon tan te/ /yi ge bzhi gnyis rtsa ba'i 'khor lo can/ /ngag gi dbang phyug de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig 'gro ba bla med pa'i/ /rig pa'i dong rtse gser gyi sgo/ /'phrag thag gser gyi ②yu ba can/ /yon tan rig pa'i sdong bu can/ /gsung gi thigs pa'i 'khor lo bca'/ /'gro ba'i ded dpon bla ma des/ /rang la rdzogs pa'i yon tan dang / /chos kun bsdu ba'i gnas drug dang / /rgyu dang bral ba'i 'bras bu dang / /rig pa gsung gi 'khor lo dang / /'bar ba'i sgon me'i 'od zer lnga/ /de dag de la de gnas shing / /de yis de dag de rdzogs pa'o/ /44—422

rkang gsum 'khor lo yan lag can/ /bde ba'i me tog rig pa yi①/ /gsung gi 'khor lo ngag gi rgyan/ /'gro ba'i dbang po lnga rdzogs pa/ /rgyal ba'i dgos don gsal ba'i ngang / /mngon shes drug gi ye shes te/ /gcig kyang mngon shes lnga lnga ste/ /gsum gyi rtsa ba gsum rmi bdag /mngon shes lnga phrag drug la sogs/ /de dag ma nor thig le ste/ /rgyu ba gsal ba'i mngon sum pa//gsal bas mngon sum rgyu bas shes/ /rgyu ba'i rtog pa ma lus pa/ /mngon du gsal bas ye shes mchog /bdag nyid mtshan ma'i rgyu ba la/ /snga phyi med pa mngon sum ste/ /'khor lo gsum ldan thig le can/ /rgyu ba med par ye shes gsal—/ /de yi don ni snying po mchog /rtsa gsum 'khor lo 'dus pa'i bdag /lus kyi 'khor lo bcud du 'dril/ /rtsa mdud dbu ma'i 'khor lo can/ /rgyu ba med par gsal ba'i rten/ /rtog dang ye shes kun bdag nyid/ /gzhi'i rang bzhin gsum gyis ①dngos/ /dang po ye shes chu 'khor lo/ /de yis gso zhing de'i rten/ /sku yi 'khor lo lus kyi gzhi/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo kun gyi bdag /gsung gi 'khor lo rten dang yul/ /mngon shes yon tan 'phrul gyi ming / /bde ba'i rgyal mtshan sgon me'i lam/ /lnga 'dus drug 'dus gcig gi dngos—/ /rin chen phung po snang ba'i lam/ /rtsa bar 'byel pa stong pa ste/ /rtse mor 'byel pa me tog yin/ /ma lus 'dus pa kun gyi bcud/ /rtsa ko la yi 'bras bu bzhin/ /rkyen dang 'phrad pas 'bras bu rnams/ /smin pa'i mtshan nyid so sor snang / /dper na 'o mas skoms pa las/ /zho shing drang srong zho ru 'gyur—/ /zho las khrag gis bsgos gyur na/ /tsa ko la yi mi rung 'gyur/ /ser gyi dus su rlung zhugs na/ /sbugs stong shig gi wa ru 'gyur/ /sa las 44—423

sbyar ba dus kyis sprad/ /de nyid tsa ko la ru 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa'i bye brag rkyen—/ /sbyar bas smin pa sna tshogs 'byung / /de bzhin tsakra 'bar ba'i dbus—/ /lte ba dgu pa'i thig le gcig /snying po lus rtsa bcud kyi srog /lnga bdag brgya rtsa bcu gnyis snying / /gsum gnyis pho brang kyi ga ta/ /'di'i byed pa'i rim pa ste/ /thabs bral rnams la rgyas btab yin/ /me dang rlung yang de bzhin te/ /drug dang gsum gyi rang bzhin bdag /'dzin dang gnyeg dang byed dang bskul/ /las byed rgyu dang mtshan ma can/ /'di ni g.yo ba rlung gi las/ /ta pa li dang tsa to ta/ /sing tog ta'i rgyas byed de/ /me yi 'khor lo gsum dang drug /de dag bzhin du rlung rnams te/ /'og gzhi rlung dang me 'khor lo/ /ye shes chu dang dus kyi khams/ /sbyor ba'i rim pa rgyu yis sprad/ /sku gcig 'khor lo thugs 'khor lo/ /gsung gi 'khor lo de bzhin gsum/ /smin pa 'khor lo gsum rnams 'byung / /rgyu yi bye brag bcu gsum drug /ba ba ta ga sa li la'i/ /mngon pa'i shes pa bzhi gnyis 'byung / /rnam pa'i mngon pa ma lus pa'i/ /skabs kyi dus kyang gcig tu mngon/ /rig pa gsal ba'i phyag rgya 'ang 'grub/ /mi g.yo rtsa ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /'gyur ba med pa'i tshe yang 'grub/ /'di ni sbyor ba'i dam tshig mchog /'di bzhi ①dag la dam gnas pa'i/ /gang la de yod de rnams ni/ /de rgyu de yi gnas su che/ /de 'dzin de yi yul la 'jug /de yod de dag de las 'byung //gang la yod pa de ni de yi rgyu/ /gang lus brjod pa de ni de yi gzhi/ /yod pa gang rnams de las med par smin/ /gang dang gang gi rtsa ba gang rnams dang / /drug gnyis lnga bzhi'i thig ler gcig /de bzhin brgyad gnyis bcu drug phyed/ /44—424

yi ge rtsa ba bzhi gnyis ldan/ /thung ngu hūṃ gi rgyu ba can/ /steng nas 'bar zhing thig ler thim/ /kun tu 'phro zhing gsal bar 'bar/ /rnam pa thig le nyis skor 'char/ /rgyu ba gcig la thim pa brgyad/ /'bar ba'ang de bzhin gcig tu thim/ /tshangs pa bde ba'i skar khung ①nas/ /shar ba rdo rje hūṃ gi bdag /de bzhin lnga dang bcu'i bdag /bu ga brgyad nas de bzhin 'char/ /ye shes bcu yi 'khor lo ni/ /thams cad zla ba'i lus can mkha'/ /ma hā su ka ka ya bha—/ /'di ni yan lag med pa'i lus/ /bcu drug 'dul ba'i srog rtse gong / /bzhi 'dus 'dab ma'i dbus na'o/ /de bzhin bzhi 'dus srog rtse'i 'og /gnyis 'dus bzhin gsum nu ma can/ /gnyis kyi bcud 'dus bde ba'i dngos//'di ni mgo dang ldan pa'i lus/ /'dus pa'i thig le tshul du gnas/ /de bzhin dbus ni mi g.yo ba'i/ /yon tan kun gyi yi ge gnas/ /zla ba gang ba'i tshul du gnas/ /de bzhin rims kyi yan lag rdzogs/ /snying gi dbus na mi shigs pa/ /pa ko ra yi 'bras bu ltar/ /ye shes bdag tu bcas pa'i sku/ /bdag med ro ltar ma yin te/ /dngos gsum thig le rdzogs pa'i lus/ /thung ngu ma yin ring pa ①men/ /thig le mi shigs yi ge dang / /thung ngu'i lus las bskyed pa yin/ /khro bo'i 'od zer brgyad cu gnyis/ /'dus pas rgyo ba'ang de bzhin te/ /sgo dang dbang po de dgang 'byel/ /thabs la rlung gi sgo nas gzhug /de bzhin de las de 'byung bas/ /bde ba'i sprul pa'ang rgyal po che/ /bdun 'bum nyi khri yan lag ni/ /rims kyis bzhi 'dus gcig gi dngos/ /gsang ba'i thig le 'dres pa'i bcud/ /ye shes yul dang 'dres pa yin/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu thig ler rdzogs/ /rgyan gyi 'khor lo rang las shar/ /sa ha 44—425

sta'i lam nas shar/ /kha yi thig le sbubs su zhugs/ /g.yas g.yon thig le phyed phyed 'dres/ /dbus nas 'bu ku ta'i rtsa/ /rgyas pa gnyis kyi phyed nas byung / /nu ma gnyis gnyis rgyus pa gnyis/ /pa ko la yi 'bras bu bzhin/ /steng na gnas shing 'og tu rgyas/ /de nyid hūṃ nyid ring po ste/ /thig le rgyus pa'i tshul du gnas/ /yan lag rkog ma mkha' yis bsdus/ /sog me bcud 'jib bung ba 'dra/ /rgyu ba nam mkha'i lam nas byung / /hūṃ gsum me yi 'khor lo gsum/ /de bzhin rlung gi 'khor lo drug /chu yi 'khor lo 'dab ma gnyis—/ /de ni in tra ni la ta/ /pad+ma ra ga'i rang bzhin te/ /phye bas bcu drug gsum dang gnyis/ /'di dag rgyan gyi yan lag yin/ /rgyu ni 'bar ba tsi ta brgyad/ /rgyu rkyen yan lag sbyor ba yis/ /rtsa ba gsum dang yan lag rnams—/ /ma lus de dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ni phyogs bzhi sbyor ba ste/ /'di ni lus la sbyor ba ni/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /dmigs pa gsum byis bsdu byas la/ /mi dmigs gsum gyis lus la bsdu/ /khams gsum bdag nyid gcig pu la/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lus la bsdu/ /bdag nyid nam mkha'i lus su bya/ /rnam pa 'dod pa'i las dang sbyar/ /mtshan nyid chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /khyab pa dngos med yi ge bdag /a li ka li g.yas g.yon na/ /thig le kha zeg gyen du rgyu/ /'bab pa za ba rlung sbubs can—/ /'bab pa them pa'i steng 'og sgra/ /rjes su mthun pa'i don ston sgra/ /bsdu bas thig le rlung can yin/ /dbus kyi rgyu ba thig le sgra/ /gong gi phreng ba de bzhin thim/ /gcig dang gnyis su rims kyis rgyu/ /kun gyi rgyu ba rgyun zhugs nas/ /sgra bstan pa yi don kun rnams/ /rtag tu ye shes chos kyi 44—426

gsung / /'bab pa ku ra yi chu ①la/ /'gyogs pa'i chu yang gzar po gnyis/ /thabs kyis 'bab pa gcig byas na/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i gzugs 'byung ste/ /sku gsung mtshon pa'i gsung yang 'byung / /mngon shes rig pa'i gsung yang 'byung / /khams gsum bsdu ba'i gsung yang 'byung / /'khor lo ma lus yi ge'i bdag /kun kyang rdzogs pa'i gsung dang ldan/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo thig le brgyad/ /lo ma yi ge brgyad dang ldan/ /a ka tsha ⑧dang de'i gtso bo ste//'di yang 'khor lo kun gyi bdag /khyad par 'byung dang rtog pa'i gzhi/ /gso ba 'jog pa'i yi ge bzhi/ /bsdu ba spro ba'i yi ge bzhi/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i yi ge gsum/ /rgyu ba gsal ba'i yi ge lnga/ /mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i yi ge drug /de la sogs pa de bzhin shes/ /rtsa ba'i thig le brgyad dang ldan/ /'phen pa rlung gis sbyor ba brgyad/ /dbang po sgo dang 'byel bar byed/ /de la thabs kyi sbyor ba bya'o/ /nye bar sbyor ba'ang 'di yin te/ /snying ni mya ngan bral ba'i khams/ /sprul pa gzugs khams sdug bsngal yin/ /mgrin pa 'dod pa'i khams yin te/ /bde ba chen po gzugs med khams/ /rang lus khams gsum bdag nyid de/ /snying po mya ngan bral ba'i khams/ /mi shigs jig le'i nga rgyal nyid/ /mos dang 'tsham pa'i rnam pa nyid/ /rang gi thig ler bsgom par bya'o/ /kun gyi ④rang bzhin bdag nyid can/ /nga rgyal med pa'i lus su bsgom/ /'di dmigs pa yi rim pa ni/ /'dod pa can la bde ba'i lus/ /gti mug can la gzugs nyid do/ /nga rgyal can la sgra nyid de/ /zhe sdang can la po tos bya/ /rgyu ba med la rig pas bya/ /dman pa'i blo la goms pas bya/ /de ni rgyu ba'i rim pa ste/ /rtog pa rlung dang dngas gnyis 44—427

dbye—/ /bdag nyid myu gu sems dpa'i sku/ /'dod pa'i lus la brtan pa bsdu—/ /sku yi rnam pa yan lag rgyan/ /snying gi nang du maṇ+ḍa la/ /yan lag tshad dpag med pa sgom①/ /de nas khams gsum 'khor lo'i bdag /de nyid gsal bar bsgom bya zhing / /rkyen gyis gsal ba nyid du bya/ /gnas pa srog dang rgyu ba rlung / /dran pa'i sems kyis brtag byas te/ /ye shes sbubs su bzhug par bya/ /'phen pa'i yu ba 'di yis bzung ②/ /rgya long gzhu yis bkang byas te/ /'gengs pa dang la gcig gnyis srid/ /des na yang thig kha yi rtse/ /de bzhin nu ma gnyis par sa/ /'dab ma sa gnyis sbyor ba'i lam/ /rgyu ba gcig nas thig le'i sgo/ /de nas 'khyil zhing pad+ma'i nang / /gnas chen rgyud pa'i gnas su'ang 'byung / /de ltar byer ba'i rim par bya tha mar thig le 'khyel zhing g.yo/ /de rjes g.yo ba med par gnas/ /rtsa ba'i ting 'dzin bde ba'i lam/ /khams kyis gzung bar rgyas gdab bo/ /de yang snang ba'i rim pa ste/ /thung ngu ma yin ring po min/ /thugs kyi hūṃ gis 'tshams sbyar te/ /rtsa ba bsgye zhing lo ma rgu/ /'dab ma'i me tog gyen du sbyin//dbugs kyi 'phen pas bde ba gzhug /sim pa'i rnal 'byor de nyid 'thob/ /ye shes rlung gis chu yis dkru/ /ye shes dgugs pa'i las byas nas/ /bde ba'i gnas su bde ba gzhug /thung ngu hūṃ gis mtshams sbyar te/ /gsung gis bud pa sbubs nas 'byung ①/ /bde ba'i sgo rnams dbye zhing gsal/ /rdo rje nu ma gdab cing gzhib/ /lus kyi ro dang bde ba'i sgo/ /de yi rnam pa de las myong / /lus las 'phros pa'i 'od zer nyid/ /khams gsum ma lus hūṃ bsdus te—/ /lus can sa bon thig ler babs/ /brjod pa'i thig le mtshams sbyar 44—428

nas—/ /de yis rdo rje gsung du brjod/ /de nyid lus dang mtshams sbyar te/ /bde ba'i 'khor lo rgya yis gdab/ /hūṃ gis lus pa'i 'od zer nyid/ /khams gsum ma lus dbugs bsdus te/ /thung ngu hūṃ gis 'tshams sbyar te/ /bde ba'i ye shes 'od zer te/ /ma bcos rig pa'i dbang phyug sku/ /rnam pa 'ja'i 'od dang 'dra/ /rang bzhin khyab pa chu zla bzhin/ /rnam dag g.yo ba med pa'i rlung / /mdzad pa'i las kyang de bzhin rdzogs/ /hūṃ nyid ring pos 'tshalas sbyar te/ /dbugs kyi rgyu ba lnga gnyis gcig /la dub ma yin rangs pa min/ /mgyogs pa ma yin bul ba min/ /'jam pa ma yin drag po min/ /'di ni spyor ba bde ba'i dus/ /hūṃ nyid ring pos ①zhes bya'o/ /'byung bzhi dkyil 'khor la gnas nas/ /brgyu ba snying po 'khor lor rgyu①/ /gang la 'dis ni de nyid bya/ /de la yod de de rdzogs 'byung / /gzhan du drag po hūṃ rims ①nyid/ /bde ba chen po gnas su brgyu/ /lus la dran pa'i 'khor lo bca'—/ /bcu phrag bcu dang de bzhin dgu/ /'dus pa yan lag rgyu byed pa//de ni drag po sbyor zhes bya/ /gsum nyid de bzhin lnga yi bar/ /bde ba'i 'khor lo 'tshams sbyar bas/ /de ni 'jam pa'i hūṃ rings te/ /de dag rgyu ba'i rim par bya'o/ /de nas 'tshams kyi rims shes te/ /gang las byung ba'i rnam byung ba/ /rnam par rgyu ba'i yon tan 'byung / /sbyang dang dgug pa'i dus kyis bya/ /bde ba snying gis 'khor lo las/ /dbang phyug chen po'i 'dod 'byung ste/ /ma hā de ba'i nor bu bzhin/ /spras nas ring po hūṃ grangs te/ /rjes su mthun pa'i brgyu bas thim/ /'od zer sna lnga'i ye shes 'bar/ /'phros nas khams gsum ma lus pa'i/ /sa bon bsdus nas rang gi bshang lam nas/ /44—429

'jug pa lte ba'i gnas su drang / /lte ba 'od kyi phyir bsdus te/ /so so'i sa bon gnas su bsdu/ /thig le gsal ba'i 'od du brgyu/ /ye shes rdo rje'i 'od du 'khyil/ /lbubs kyi sa bon 'khor lor 'bar/ /sku yi bcud bsdus 'od kyi lamaspyo/ /bzhi 'dus lnga bzhi drug gcig 'gyur/ /rgyud pa rims ①pas drug lam bzhi/ /'du ba nyid ni 'bar ba ste/ /sa gsum rim pa'i sgo la bzhugs/ /dbang phyug rgyal po rgyan gyis brgyan/ /de ni ngag gi dbang phyug yin/ /gnyis bsdus hūṃ gis mtshams sbyar bas/ /a gsum 'dus pa'i thig le gcig /'di na sbyor ba gsum 'dus pa'i/ /yi ge kun 'dus gang gis ④lam/ /chad pa'i gsung gis ①thigs pa yin/ /mun pa mar mes sel ba bzhin/ /gnyis bsdus thig le gcig gi ngang / /'di ni ngag gi rdo rje yin/ /de nas ngag gi dbang phyug des/ /sems kyi yon tan rdzogs byas te/ /phyi nang bral ba'i mngon shes te/ /bdag gi gsung gi 'khor lo can/ /gcig dang gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi/ /de bzhin gsum nyid gsum dang ldan/ /gcig ni lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /phen rjopa gsum gyis de dag 'phen/ /chos nyid mi yo'i rtsa nyid la/ /yi ge a yi thig le gnas/ /kun gzhi mi g.yo rig pa nyid/ /rtog pa gnyis dang lhan cig la/ /yi ge a yi 'od kyis bsdu/ /rang bzhin 'dus pa'i yan lag la/ /mi gtsang sdig pa'i lus thams cad/ /ma lus 'dus nas a la thim/ /rtog pa gnyis dang lhan cig pa/ /a nyid mar me'i gzugs su 'bar—/ /ma lus rang gis rjogazugs su 'bar/ /lus kyi rdzu 'phrul chen po 'thobaske/ /jig le sgra dbyangs ma lus pa/ /'od kyi dudrangs la e la thim/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i sgra/ /ma lus thig le rang 'bar gzugs/ /44—430

'dzin pa'i rtog pa ma lus pa/ /sa bon gsum sogs dngos gzhi can/ /ma lus ye shes rang 'bar gzugs/ /'di dag sku gsum ①'khor lo can/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ltar mnyam gnas pa'i/ /mngon shes rigs ④pa'i rgyal po che/ /rdo rje rig pa 'dzin pa'i rtsa/ /thig le mi g.yo dbus dmig can/ /yi ge a yi rang bzhin can/ /ya dal 'bub pa'i rtsa drug bsdu/ /rjes su mthun pa'i thig ler gzhug /dbang po mos pa'i rjes su rgyu'o/ /ye shes rgyu yi bye brag rnams/ /rnam grangs shes pa'i mngon shes yin/ /bi ga sa ri'i rtsa nyid la/ /nyon mongs rnam shes rtogs ④pa'i bdag /sa bon yi ge sha nyid de/ /bsdu sbyor rim pa'i yan lag rnams/ /snga ma bzhin te de 'byel pa'i/ /dga' byed dag dang lum pa'i rtsa/ /de dag kun kyang rim pas bsdu/ /rigs gsum 'dus pa'i sgo nas 'jug /rjes su dran pa'i sngon rjes 'jug /de bzhin rtsa bar rang rgyud las/ /'phros pa rtsa byed rtsa can dang / /rus pa'i khu ba can dag dang / /sug grel sbubs 'dra rus stobs can/ /lnga ni rgyu yi yul can te/ /sa bon lnga yang de bzhin du/ /ka tsa ta dang ta pa de/ /mig dang rna ba sna dang lce—/ /lus dang de bzhin rim pa yin/ /de bzhin ya lad pa yi rtsa/ /drug nas 'bab pa yul ma yin/ /kha dog ldan pa'i dbyings mig can/ /lus ni mig gi dbang por 'brel/ /sgra dbyangs ngo bo nya bzhug rjoganyis/ /bcu drug gnyis 'dus thig le can/ /sgra sbyor thig le rim gsum bo/ /me long brtsegs pa'i tshul du gnas/ /de ni rna ba'i dbang por 'byel/ /snang ba dra yi 'od 'dus pa/ /khab mig can gyi sna nas drang / /ra ga ba ste kha mi'i mgo/ /de bzhin sna yi dbang por 'byel/ /de bzhi ga ma ru yi rtsa/ /skan dang gsum du 44—431

'dus pa yin/ /ro drug 'dus pa'i thig le che/ /zla ba tshes pa'i gzugs can te/ /de bzhin lce yi dbang por 'byel/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ya bag can—/ /'khor lo gsum nas 'dus pa yi/ /'byor ldan 'dus pa'i lte ba can—/ /de ni khyab pa gsum gyi sgo na gnas/ /'di ni nyi ma'i 'od bzhin no/ /kun kyang 'du ba'i yod pa'i gling / /ba ga yangs pa'i mkha' dang ldan/ /'di dag rim pa snga ma bzhin/ /dri ma sbyangs nas 'od bsdus te/ /thig le yi ge rgyu ba can/ /thim nas ye shes rang 'bar skyes/ /kun kyang bde ba'i lam nas bcug /so sor gsal nas rgyu ba bsdus/ /rim pa gzhan dang ldan pa yis—/ /gcig kyang kun gyi mngon shes ldan/ /bde ba'i rlung gis bsdus bzung ①ba/ /'jug pa'i las dang rgyu ba'i rim/ /dus dang gnas su shes pa ni—/ /ye shes chen po'i mngon shes yin/ /de bzhin bde ba'i ye shes rlung / /ye shes rang 'bar nyid du thim/ /so so'i sgo nas 'od du 'bar/ /rim dang rim gyis phyir zhing brlab/ /snang ba sgod bcud gcig tu bsdu/ /tshad gsum dgal ba'i gro byung na/ /phyi nang bral ba'i ye shes yin/ /'di ni yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i ye shes yin/ /gang zhig gang la de med pa'i/ /de nyid de ldan de rgyu can/ /de la rin chen sbyin mi bya/ /de la de sbyin de ru 'gyur/ /'di ni skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /rin chen gter ldan rgya mtsho'i nor/ /lam tshol rgyu yi don grub pa/ /rgya mtsho'i khri la 'dug nas kyang / /'khor lo lag par thogs nas ni/ /bdud rtsi khong du 'thungs ②nas dug gi zil pa nyab/ /khams gsum dbang du bsdus nas lab pa yul du byed/ /rang lus mig gis gang nas mig gcig bya ra gtong / /'di ni skye dgu'i 44—432

bdag po ste/ /'di la rin chen yu ba btang ①/ /bdag gis rin chen brnyen nas mthung / /mchod dang sbyor ba'i rim pa yis/ /spyi bos len dang snying la dgod/ /gos ldan lus kyi shes rab mig /skal ldan rnams dang 'phrad gyur cig /sgyu 'phrul 'jam pa'i thigs pa/ slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/422 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ④〈〈pe 〉s+dzas/423 ①〈〈pe 〉stanas ①〈〈pe 〉7)/424 ①〈〈pe 〉ra zhi/425 ①〈〈pe 〉ngosangs/ ②〈〈pe 〉ge /427 ①〈〈pe 〉mas/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tsa/ ①〈〈pe 〉5)sa/428 ①〈〈pe 〉thasgom/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngazung / ④〈〈pe 〉jang /429 ①〈〈pe 〉༅/ ②〈〈pe 〉mirgyu/ ①〈〈pe 〉'angs/43༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉rim/ ④①〈〈pe 〉5)/ ④〈〈pe 〉skaraphen/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉5)/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉kyis/431 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagasung / ②〈〈pe 〉(rig ①〈〈pe 〉sta1ga du〈〈pe 〉thazhugs/432 ①〈〈pe 〉'izung / ②〈〈pe 〉thathungs/433 ①〈〈pe 〉stanatad/44—433
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/(2567)

༄na gsang thig gi 'grel pa bzhugs pa lags so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/gu ya be+en du u pa te sha 'bri te/ bod skad du/ gsang ba'i thigs pa'i man ngag gi 'grel pa/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang na yod pa'i rnam pa brgyad du shes/ /gang la ci 'dra de nyid sres pa bzhin/ /rnam bzhi'i bye brag drug las brgyad dkyil nas/ /don dam snying po de la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /zhes bya ba gang dang de gnyis rtag tu 'byel te/ gang nang yod na snying gi dkyil na yod/ du yod na rtsa'i dngas ma brgyad yod pa/ de'i dkyil na dngas ma chen po gsum yod/ de'i dkyil na lnga yod pa de'i dkyil na thig le byang chub kyi sems bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang na yod na snying khong stong gi dkyil na rtsa'i dngas ma rtsa bran rgyus pa blad pa 'dra ba brgyad yod pa la/gsum chos nyid kyi rtsa/ gcig ye shes kyi rtsa/ gsum rang rgyud kyi rtsa/44—435

gcig yon tan gyi rtsa/ de ltar brgyad du shes par bya'o/ /gang la ci 'dra de nyid bsres pa bzhin/ /zhes bya ba chos nyid kyi rtsa la 'od ser po gcig gnas/ci 'dra na dbyibs zlum po/ tshul dngul chu zhun ma la bzhon mar gyis zol song ba dang 'dra'o/ /snying po ni oṃ/ sa bon ni su dang tri'o/ /de gsum kha dog za 'og gur phub pa dang 'dra'o/ /ye shes kyi rtsa la 'od mthing ka gcig gnas so//ci 'dra na dbyibs gru bzhi zhags pa bsdogs pa'am zla gam dmar po/ tshul le brgan lce la shel sgong rgyus pa 'dra ba/ snying po ni hūṃ/ sa bon ni a dang zi'o//rang rgyud kyi rtsa la 'od dmar po gcig gnas so/ /ci 'dra na dbyibs zla gam dmar po/ tshul sos ka'i chu la smigs rgyu ba 'am rtsi skya'i kha la zil pa chags pa 'dra—/ kha dog zangs ma bzhu ba la ra gan gyi rtsi song ba dang 'dra'o/ /snying po ni a/ sa bon ni pre dang du'o/ /de yang ma rtogs pa'i dus na 'khor ba'i rgyu ste/ /a dz+re la sogs pa'o/ /rtogs pa'i dus na ye shes te/ oṃ la sogs pa'o—/ /de gnyis 'dres te/ byang chub kyi sems la gnas pa'i tshul gong ma dang 'dra bas bsres pa/ zhes bya'o/ /rnam bzhi'i ①bye brag drug las brgyad dkyil na/ /zhes bya ba chos nyid dang ye shes dang rang rgyud dang yon tan gyi rtsa dang bzhi la bya'o/ /bye brag ni 'od ser po la kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas so/ /'od mthing ka la yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas so/ /'od dmar po la nyon mongs pa'i yid gnas so/ /'od ser po la rtsa'i dngas ma la rgyu'o—/ /'od mthing ka dbus kyi dngas ma la rgyu'o/ /'od dmar po khrag gi dngas ma la rgyu'o/ /'od dmar nag sgo lnga'i rtsa'i dngas ma la rgyu'o/ /'od ser po'i 'gab na oṃ dang su tri gnyis gnas so/ /'od mthing ka'i 'gab na a 44—436

dz+re gnyis gnas so/ /'od dmar po'i 'gab na a dang pre du gnyis gnas so/ /'od dmar nag de rnams kyi skyon dang yon tan no/ /de la a dri gnyis dbugs kyi snyigs ma la rgyu'o/ /su tri gnyis rtsi'i snyigs ma la rgyu'o/ /pre du gnyis khrag gi snyigs ma la rgyu'o/ /de yang lha dang mi gnyis su skyes pa'i ①kha zin yid kyis rnam par shes pas byas nas sa bon a dang dri la stsog go/ /yi dwags dang lha ma yin du skye ba'i kha zin kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pas byas nas sa bon su dang tre las stsog go/ /byol song dang dmyal bar skye ba'i kha zin sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa dang nyon mongs pa ban gyis byas nas/ sa bon pre dang du la stsog go/ /de ltar gnas pa de ni 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la rang rgyud du gnas so/ /de la rnam bzhi'i bye brag drug las zhes bya'o/ /brgyad dkyil zhes bya ba de ltar rtsa dngas ma rtsa bran rgyus pa sha mnad dang 'dra ba brgyad yod pa la bya'o—/ /de la dbyibs ba thag gug pa bzhin du 'dug pa la bya'o/ /de ltar brgyad kyi mdo dngas ma'i rtsa dar dkar gyi skud pa 'dra ba la dbyibs ba thag zhugs pa 'dra ba gcig yod la/ de'i phra sbom ni rta rnga bcu tshal tsam gyis bzung la/ de la khrag gi dngas ma mtshal cog la ma bcag pa gcig rgyu'o/ /de la dbugs kyi dngas ma gser la ②sa le sbram sa 'og tu brnags pa'i rlangs pa tsam rgyu'o/ /de kho na la 'od kha dog sna tshogs pa gcig gnas so/ /'od de'i nang la dkyil zhes bya'o/ /na zhes pa bzhugs pa'i don te/ de'i dkyil na thig le chen bo byang chub sems bzhugs so/ /de'i dpe ni ci 'dra na/ gser zhun ma'i sbu gu'i nang nor bu rin po che ze'u ga btsugs pa 'dra ba 'am/ rin po che ke ke ru gang la btags pa 'dra la/ kha dog nyi ma shar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra bar 44—437

bzhugs—/ de ni chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po don dam kun gyi rgyu yin pas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya'o/ /gang la snyoms zhugs de la yod pa la/ /de la de nyid yod de de la lta bar bya/ /gang las byung ba de las byung ba yin/ /de las de byung de kho na'o/ /zhes bya ba ni gang la snyoms par 'jug par yod na thigs pa'i rang bzhin la yod ji ltar yod na dngas ma dar dkar gyi skud pa 'dra ba ni gdod ma med pa nas phung po'i rten byed pas 'byung ba'i dngas ma ste/ sa ltar snang ste yum sangs rgyas spyan du gsal lo/ /de ni stong pa chen po'i ye shes te—/ thams cad dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i rten byed pas so/ /dar dkar byi skud pa 'dra ba de la khrag gi dngas ma mtshal cog la ma'i dngas ma dang 'dra bar gnas pa ni gdod ma nas phung po'i long 'dogs pas—/ 'byung ba'i dngas ma ste chu ltar snang ste yum ma ma ki'o/ /de ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes te/ thams cad bkol pa med par dbyings gcig tu sdud pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de la dbugs kyi dngas ma gser sa 'og na gnas pa'i rlangs pa tsam gnas pa'i ni gdod ma nas phung po yang zhing g.yo ba'i rten byed pas 'byung ba'i dngas ma ste/ rlung ltar ste yum dam tshig sgrol ma'o/ /de ni bya ba'i ye shes te/ thams cad bde ba chen po'i dbyengs su spyod ①pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de la drod kyis ①dngas ma me long nyi ma la bzhag pa'i dngas ma tsam zhig gnas pa ni gdod ma nas phung po smin par byed pa'i rang bzhin pas/'byung ba'i dngas ma ste me ltar snang ste 'od kha dog lnga'o/ /yum gos dkar mo'o//de ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes te/ thams cad bde ba chen po'i dbyings su rtogs pa'i sgon ma yi/ 'od de'i dkyil na thig le chen po byang chub kyi sems 44—438

bzhugs pa ni dngas ma chen po ste/ gdod ma nas phung po gsal bar byed pa'i 'byung ba'i dngas ma ste/ rtsa nam mkha' ltar gnas so/ /de ni khyab pa'i chen po'i ye shes te/ yum kun tu bzang mor snang ste/ thams cad yang dag dag pa'i dbyings su gsal ba'i go skabs 'byed pa'o/ /de ltar theg pa gser zhun mar ①'dra ba ni shes rab ste/ kun tu bzang mo la sogs pa yum rnams kyi ngo bo'o—/ /de la rin po che ze'u gtsugs ②pa 'dra ba ni thabs kyi rgyal po kun tu bzang po la sogs pa yab yum rnams kyi ngo bo'o/ /de yang rin po ④ke ke ru gdang la btags pa 'dra ba ni/ me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /des byang chub kyi sems thigs pa de la bltas na mthong ba med pa'i tshul du mthong ste/ yab gang yin pa yum/ yum gang yin pa yab ste/ tha dad pa ma yin pa 'od can du mthong ngo / /de gang la yod na thig le la yod ces bya'o/ /de la de nyid yod de de la blta' bar bya/ thig le de gang la yod thabs dang shes rab snyoms par yod ces bya/ de la khams gsum thams cad yod/ de la blta bar bya zhes bya ba byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin de la rgyun tu blta zhing dgug par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms na ci 'ong zhe na/ gang las byung ba de las byung ba yin zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'ong ste/ nam mkha'i gzugs su skye ba 'ong ngo / /rnal 'byor chen po la khams gsum pa thams cad la tha dad pa ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /gang las byung ba theg pa chen po de la bsgoms pa/ rgyun mi 'chad pa las 'byung ngo / /de ci 'byung ci 'ong / de las de byung de kho na'o/ /zhes bya ba ngo bo 'ong ste/ thig le byang chub kyi sems las su rung bar 'od can du gyur tsam na/oṃ gyi gong 'og na su dang tri/ hūṃ gi gong 'og na a dang dri/ oṃ gi gong 'og 44—439

na pre ①dang du gnas pa 'od du gnas pa 'bar bas/ thigs pa rang bzhin med par 'gro/ thigs pa la rang bzhin med pas dar dkar gyi skud pa 'dra ba/rta rnga bcu tshal tsam la khrag gi dngas ma mtshal cog la ma'i dngas ma tsam zhig gnas pa ni bde ba chen po chags par byed pa yin te/ de 'od du 'bar te/'od du 'bar bas de la dbugs kyi dngas ma gser sa 'og na gnas pa'i rlangs pa tsam zhig gnas pa ni/ bde ba chen po g.yo bar byed pa ste/ de 'od du 'bar te/ de 'od du 'bar bas de drod kyi dngas ma la me long nyi ma la bzhag pa'i dngas ma tsam zhig gnas pa ni bde ba chen po sbyin par byed pa ste/ de 'od du 'bar te 'od du 'bar bas dngas ma chen po nyid kyi rang bzhin med par 'gro ste/ nam mkha'i gzugs su skyes tsam na/ khams gsum thams cad so sor ma yin pa'i ye shes lhun gyis grub pa nam mkha'i gzugs su byung ba las de las de byung zhes bya'o/ /de ltar nam mkha'i gzugs su skyes pa de nyid thig le byang chub kyi sems yin te/ de la de nyid kho na'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /gsang ba'i shes rab thig le dbyings/ /bcu drug bzhi'i dkyil na gnas/ /shes rab thabs kyi snyoms 'jug la/ /kun tu rgyas btab dkyil 'khor yin/ /bdag nyid chen po lngas lta zhing / /thur du 'phro zhing gyen du 'bar/ /bde ba chen po mchod pa yis/ /go ge snying po bskul bar byed/ /zhes bya ba gsang ba'i shes rab ni/ kun tu bzang po'i ②rang bzhin thig le la bya/ de chos kyi dbyings yin/ gang na gnas lte ba na gnas/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil na nyi ma la gnas so/ /rang bzhin ji lta bu yin zhe na/ shes rab dang thabs te thig le las byung ba thams cad mtshan nyid 'dzin pa ni thabs te yab rnams so/ /44—440

thig le rang bzhin med de chos kyi dbyings yin pa ni shes rab yum rnams so/ /de ltar thabs dang shes rab ste yum rnams so/ /de ltar thabs dang shes rab dbyer med par thig ler bzhugs la/ thig le de las gzugs dang khams su thams cad 'byung ba yin te/ byung ba thams cad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du ma gyur pa med de/ dkyil 'khor du gyur pa de thams cad chos kyi dbyings yin pas/ kun tu rgyas btab dkyil 'khor yang zhes bya'o/ /de la ye shes lhun gyis grub ste/ gnas pa la bdag nyid chen po lngas lta zhing zhes bya'o//go ge dngas ma chen po la thim pas gyen du 'bar zhes bya'o/ /de dngas ma chen po gser la ①sa le sbram sa 'og na gnas pa'i rlangs pa tsam gnas pa 'od 'bar nasaske/ thigs pa 'od can du gyur pas dbugs kyi gzhi med de de je zhi je zhi las rgyu ba med na/ de med na de'i 'bras bu bde ba chen po la gnas pa la/bde ba chen po mchod pa zhes bya'o/ /bde ba chen po drod de gong gi thig le la thim pas 'od du 'bar ba la/ bskul bar byed ces bya'o/ /de'i 'od thig le mnyam sbyor bas/ /lnga gnyis drug gi dkyil na'o/ /bde ba chen po'i ro yis ni//dgyes pa chen po stobs par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni dngas ma chen po 'od des mgrin pa'i thig le la thim pa la mnyam sbyor zhes bya'o/ /de gang la bzhugs rtsa sdedrug gi dkyil na pad+ma'i ge sar la bzhugs pa la lnga gnyis drug gi dkyil na'o/ /de la 'og gi drod kyis bskul nas 'od du 'bar te/ bde ba chen po la gnas pa la bde ba chen po'i zhes bya'o/ /des bde ba chen po lhun kyis grub ste/ de las phyir mi g.yo ba las dgyes pa chen po stobs par bya zhes bya'o/ /shes bya byung zad bsod nams kyis/ /de nyid sgyu mar rang snang ba/ /gzigs mo'i 44—441

bde ba mtha' yas kyis/ /bde ba chen po'i 'ben la phog /zhes bya ba ni/shes bya ba ni yul yin la/ byung ba ni rnam par rtogs pa yin la/ zad pa ni thig le 'od can yin la/ 'on kyang zig le 'od can rnam par rtogs pa zad pa'i ye shes zhes bya'o/ /zig le de la thig le nyid rang bzhin med de bde ba chen po nyid rang bzhin snang ba ste/ bde ba'i 'od la rol mo zhes bya'o/ /rol mo la gzigs so zhes bya'o/ /des bde ba chen po'i gnas na thig le bzhugs pa la phog pas/ bcu gsum gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor na/ /de yi thig le mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /kun gye dngos yin kun gyi gtso/ /bcu dang bzhir ni mngon rdzogs so/ /gsum dang gnyis su yang dag gnas/ /kun gyi dngos por bdag 'gyur bas/ /zhes bya ba rtsa sum cu gnyis kyis ①dkyil na nam mkhar so pa'i dkyil na zla ba'i thig le de ni byang chub kyi sems so/ /thig le de ni sangs rgyas kun gyis ②dngos po yang de yin pa de na chos kyi ste/ gtso bo'o/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du rdzogs pa yang thig le de nyid yin/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyang de nyid yin/ 'on kyang mgrin pa'i zig le'i 'od des bde ba chen po'i thig le 'od du zhu nas spyi blugs su gyur pas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur te/ khams gsum thams cad so sor ma yin par gyur pas ye shes nam mkha'i shugs su skye ste/ chos kyi skur gyur pa la/ kun gyi dngos por bdag gyur pas zhes bya'o/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pa chos kyi skur gyur te/ khams gsum thams cad yongs/ de la dbang bskur dam pa yin/ /nyid la gnas pa gnas nyid la/ /de la gnyis rdzogs lhun gyis grub/ /thams cad de'i rgyan du che/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rnal 'byor gong ma ltar las su rung 44—442

phan chad tshe la dbang ba la sogs pa gang la ①de la dbang sgyur bas so/ /de ltar grub pa de yang gzhan ma yin/ bdag nyid ye nas dkyil 'khor du gnas pa de la lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gong ma lta bus dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'o/ /de la tshogs rnam pa gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lhun gyis grub pa des/ thams cad dkyil 'khor du gyur pas de'i longs spyod du ma gyur pa 'am/ rgyan du ma gyur pa med pa la rgyan du che zhes bya'o/ /gnyis rdzogs thig le mnyam spyor bas/ /snying rje chen po yongs kyis 'char/ /bcu bzhi'i sems can 'dul ba la/ /sgyu ma'i sems can sgol ba yi/ /rnal 'byor chen po 'od ldan spyod/ /zhes bya ba thig le las su rung na chos kyi skur gyur pa de tshogs rnam pa gnyis rdzogs pa las 'byung ba'o/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa de snying rje chen pos/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sems can rnams la rmi lam 'am sgyu ma'i tshul du byed do bsgol ②bar byed/de lta bu'i bya byed pa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa rnal 'byor chen po 'od ldan 'ong /'di yod na 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba rga ba spyod pa la spang bar bya'o/ /'di la rtag tu gang 'dug pa/ /sangs rgyas sras dang 'khor bcas kyis/ /thugs rje nyi ma shugs kyang 'byung / /de la bde byed bde ba sten/ /zhes bya ba thig le 'di la gang 'dug pa'o/ /rnal 'byor de las ④sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / mkha' 'gro ma kun gyis 'jig rten gyis dubade ba dang / bde ba chen po chos kyi sku'i dngos grub ster/ skal pa rdul snyed grangs med du/ /thos bsam sgom la rab sbyangs pas/ /'byung ba bde ba chen po yin/ /slob dpon mnyes byed kye 'di lta/ /zhes bya ba bskal pa grangs med par sbyangs pa'i mthu las byung ba 'di yin te/ slob dpon la bsnyen bkur byed na 'di sbyin no//44—443

gang la gang med gang la 'ang / /de la de med de la 'ang / /dmyal bar bsregs dang sdug bsngal che/ /de bas gzhan du bstan pa min/ /gang la sbyangs pa'i 'phro med pa de la dad pa med/ dad pa med pa de la skal ba med pas de la bstan na/ skur pa 'debs pas dmyal bar skyes pas ①mi bstan no//gsang ba'i man ngag thig le 'di/ /thig le chen po 'od snang bas/ /sems can kun gyi rang bzhin la/ /bde ba chen po snang bar shog /gsang ba'i thigs pa'i man ngag rdzogs sto // //sdeslob dpon chen po bi ma las mdzad pa/ lots+tsha ba gnya' na ku ma ras bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/425 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/436 ①〈〈pe 〉thazhi/437 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skye ba'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉7la/438 ①〈〈pe 〉thaskyod/ sde〈〈pe 〉sko)/439 ①〈〈pe 〉zo/ ②〈〈pe 〉thatsugs/ ①〈〈pe 〉skoche/44 ①〈〈pe 〉tha ②〈〈pe 〉zaba'i/441 ①〈〈pe〉ril/ ②〈〈pe〉7bcu/442 ①〈〈pe 〉ma gnyis kyi/ ②〈〈be+e 〉ra)/442 ①〈〈pe〉7dga'ab/ ②〈〈pe 〉thasgol/ ①〈〈pe〉phro/ rjo〈〈pe 〉ra)/444 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skyebs/ ②〈〈pe 〉na /44byed444

2642༄ga /dbang cig car 'jug pa'i man ngag①༄/ dbang gcig car du 'jug pa bzhugs so// ༄4/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal①/ /skal ldan mchog gi don phyir du/ /thabs rgyud dbang gi las rims ④gnyis/ /mtshan sbyang la sogs rim bcu gcig /bye brag bzhi bcu bzhir bshad bya/ /sa'i mtshan nyid rab brtags te/ /las sogs sbyang ba byas nas ni/ /thig gdab dkyil 'khor gang yin bri/ /rab gnas rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod pas rgyas par mnyes byas la/ /gsol btab bu yang legs zhugs nas/ /dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid bstan par bya—/ /de ru lnga gsum dbang thob nas/ /lus dngos dkar dag nus ldan pas—/ /dus 'di phyin chad rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngan song thams cad med pa dang / /nus pa'i las la thogs med pas/ /mtho ris thar pa'i bdag por 'gyur—/ /dbugs phyung las bsgrub thogs med pas/ /spros pa'i dkyil 44—446

'khor rgyas 'bring sogs/ /bsgrubs brtan mtshan ma thob pa dang / /phyag rgya bzhi sogs dkyil 'khor ram/ /lnga bzhi las sogs sa de ni/ /chos dang lam rnam rgyas bshad pa/ /mchu zheng 'bring mnyen skabs phyed cing / /pad+ma ut+pal dkar nag phyed/ /lus dang chu rlung ①ga bur dri/ /phra 'jam tshigs zlum ④phyag rgyar ldan/ /'khor lo dang skad 'gros ldan zhing / /spyod lam chos dang 'thun brtags te/ /'khrus ④byas gos brje dam tshig sbyin/ /rtog med rang gi ting 'dzin shes/ /lus tshad med bzhi yi 'khor lo la/ /dbus ni byed po yab yum sa/ /g.yas sogs rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rang bzhin yid kyi thig btab ༷ste/ /stong nyid sngags kyi ye shes las/ /ting 'dzin chu las nya ldang tshul/ /de ltar phyir ⑤la 'ang sbyar bar bubyas te/ /de ltar drangs bstem gsal mchod mchog /'dod pa lnga yi ⑦mnyes byas la/ /he/ rang bzhin 'du 'bral med pa'i lha/ /phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs mchog tu/ /bdag dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i phyir/ /byin brlob rab tu bzhugs ④par gsol/ /khrus byas rnam snang yan lag rdzogs/ /g.yon grangs pad+ma steng 'og brtug /dkyil 'khor chen por yid la bya/ /ji ltar bkod dang bdud rtsi yis6 rang bzhin mtshan nyid bstan par bya/ /nyi zla pa hūṃ pad rdo rje/ /dbus su hūṃ dang yig lngas mdzes/ /'ung nas yung 'brus gang ba dang / /drangs bstems yud mchod gsol bar bya/ /'ung nas lugs su sbyar ba'i sems/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'am bum sogs nas/ /brtan pa'i yid kyis blangs sbyin bya/ /yang na gnyis su med pa yi/ /ye shes yig lnga'i gnas bzung ste/ /myur du brdas bos pad rtser sbyin/ /rdo rje phra mo gnas sbyangs te/ /yig sogs ngag gi dri ma dag /44—447

snying por 'dus pa'i bde ba ①chen pos/ /khams gsum kun kyang der shes pa'i//bde dang mtshan ma mthong ba na/ /hūṃ las rin chen pad+ma'i bu/ /rdzogs pa'i chos gos sna bzung la/ /bu khyod mtshan ma'i rtog bral zhing / /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /kun la spyod par dbang thob nas/ /slob bu bde la bkod byed pa'i/ /dbang phyug chen por deng gyur ro/ /dbugs phyung bzhi bcu gnyis sogs te/ /thig le yi ge sgra 'khor lo/ /bye brag 'ju 'dul rim pa kun / /bstan te shes te dang du blangs/ /thun mong 'jig rten bde bde gsum—/ /rim shes rim pa'i ro pyong nas/ /'dod lngas bde chen gsol ba gdab / /bcu drug mi 'da' dam tshig rgya'o/ /zla 'od nyi mas ma sgribs shing / /phyi rol mtshungs las khyad gyur pa/ /bcu phrag gsum bzhi lhag ma gnyis/ /gnas las ma 'das dbyibs mdog ldan/ /thob nas sbyangs pa bshad bzhin las—/ /rlung dang byed thabs drod dus shes/ /spyi pad snying lte mtshan 'thil bar—/ /rigs kyi pho brang thig btab ②la/ /kha dog lnga yi rdul tshon bgye/ /gcig dang bye ba'i dkyil 'khor bri/ /chos dang sprul bde bde chen dkyil 'khor//thig phran rim bskor 'od bskul nas/ /bde ba'i mdongs kyis rgyas byas te/ /gnyis ka las byung ye shes mchog /'ung gnas khrus rtsi skyu ru ra/ /'o ma gur kum khrus dag nas/ /nyed brdeb sprod 'o brtse 'khyud 'jib/ /rab gnas sna tshogs bcu drug gis/ /dkyil 'khor lha mnyes mchod pa'i mchog /bde ba 'dod pa lhar byas nas/ /de ltar rang ldan thal sbyar te/ /kye kye bde mdzad phyag rgya che/ /bdag la thugs brtse phan par dgongs/ /mdzad dang sgra yis bde ba gsol/ /'ung nas lan gyis bskul byas pas/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa 44—448

zla rlabs ①can/ /thabs chen theg pa 'di las gsal/ /rang zas mchog snga sdeza ba dang / /bha gar 'o 'jib bde blang zhing / /rlung bsub 'chi ba'i spyod pa rnams—/ /khyod kyis bya bar nus sam smos/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rdo rje'i tshig / bde ba chen po'i ye shes phyir/ /rmad byung thabs kyi spyod pa la/ /bdag gis mi nub ci yang med/ /rdzas sbyin spyod pa'i brtul shugs brtag /spyi bos zhabs blang gzhal yas dbye/ /'og min ngo bor mngon byas te/ /pad+ma'i rol mos mnyes par bya/ /mkha' ltar gdug ④pa'i dbus dbyibs la/ /sum cu bzhi bcu gnyis kyi lha/ /thugs dam bskul ngo shes par brtanarjo/ /ri mo 'am yang na dngos dag las/ /rang gnas sa rlung rims shes te/ /zla ba bcu gsum drug bsgoms nas/ /bshad bzhin dbang po byin rlabs ⑤pas rig pa'i brtul shugs la 'dug pa'i/ /thoms med snyoms zhugs nyams bzung ste/ /sa rims rjore rer bskug rlung gzung dze+e/ /bshal thag rnying pad la gnas bya/ /ye shes bcu gcig nyams bzung nas/ /ri rtser zla ba skar chen shar/ /'od 'dres bsel la gsal ba ni/ /mi dmigs shes rab ye shes mchog /yig lnga'i gnas su bsten byas na/ /brgyad po dkar dag dgu pa'i dngos/ /ye shes rang rig 'od gsal ba'i/ /bcu gcig sa brtags rgya tshogs snang / /rim 'di rtags dang gang ldan pa/ /sems dpa' sangs rgyas dbugs phyung ste/ /de ring phan chod bu spyod ni/ /rang rig bde la gnas pas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ste/ /yum dang 'jo ma thams cad la/ /'dod bzhin spyod pa'i dbang phyug 'gyur/ /rigs su gyur rnams thabs 'dis zung / /mthun 'jug 'tsham par 'gro 'dul ba'i/ /dbang bsgyur rgyal po nyid du nges/ /44—449

'ung nas sa la sngar sbyangs dang / /steng 'og rlung gi las nyams dang / /shes rab thabs pa'i bzlog pa gnyis/ /phan sems ma yis ①las nyams dang / /pad gnas rims ①gsum gnas bshad de/ /nyams su lon na nyams kyis bsgrub—/ /mkha' 'gro bde ba gsal 'bar zhing / /mnyam du mi snang rig gsal khyab/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang thob 'gyur/ /'ung gnas dbang phyugs rgyar ④skor te/ /nus pas yan lag brdab gsol bya/ /bcu gsum sa la nyi shar ba/ /sbyang thig bri gnas bshad bzhin shes/ /'dod pa rdo rje yan lag rdzogs/ /bza' btung mchog gis mnyes byas la/ /tri ka ril bu'i me tog kyang / /dkyil 'khor gong ma'i lter chud bya/ /blo skums dgas sogs byed bstan nas/ /nang par nyi ma shar dus dri/ /kye ma mkha' klong rnam dag ma—/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mtha' gsal zhing / /mtshan mo'i mun pa gsal bar mdzod/ /nyi zla shar thabs de nyams kyis/ /bsam yas lhun grub dkyil 'khor snang / /de de'i mdon nyid bstan par bya/ /gnyis ka rkyang phyag dbu nub pas/ /nyi ma shar bar 'ong ba yod/ /sangs rgyas kun dang dbang phyug la/ /mthu btang rjob yi gsol btab ⑤la/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi dkyil mor 'dug /bsdol dang mthil sbyar rtse sprad dang / /rting sprad rgya khram rigs dulnga'i tshul/ /rkang pa mnyar btegs mkha' 'gro'i dkyil/ /rtse mor krung bsgoms khrag 'phram mo/ /gal te nyams thabs med ⑦bzlog ste/ /gzhal yas lha khang reg pas tshor/ /de nyams zin pas bde bar bya/ /zla ba dbang po'i rnam shes la/ /nyi yid rnam shes gsal byas pas/ /bcu gsum drug 'dus gsang thig le/ /sems shes mngon par shes pa yis bsod 44—450

nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te/ /rlung stobs 'gyed pas e la spro/ /rgyu 'bras bzlog pa'i bde mchog ni/ /yig lnga sa las gsum mthong lam/ /thig le skye gnas 'pho 'jig mthong / /rang rig lha mig rnam par dag /skye sogs sems lnga ye shes lngar/ /rim shar sa bcu dus gcig 'byor/ /gsang ba'i thig le ar 'dus pas/ /ma skyes kun gsal pad+ma spyan/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon par shes pa'i sa/ /zag par 'dzin med bsod nams tshogs/ /rol mo'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas mchog /sngon byi gnas dran shes pa yis/ /ye shes dgyes la mchod pa 'bul/ /lnga phung yan lag dngos ming can/ /sgo gsum gyis bsdus dngos kun gyi/ /thig le dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu lnga/ /skad sbug gnyis ①la rang snang 'gyur/ /phun sum tshogs lnga lhun grub pas/ /rig gsung rang bzhin rgyud chen thos/ /yi ge bdes gang rdor gsung las/ /rang bzhin rgyud sgra nges 'byung ba/ /rna ba'i mchog gis thos shes bya/ /thams cad ⑤ma 'dres bdag snang phyir/ /ro mnyam gsal la 'du shes stong / /zag pa zad pa'i bsod nams tshogs/ /mtshan dpe la sogs dpag med rnams/ /rang byung gnas med lhun grub snang / /de tshe las bun ma zos las/ /bdag sems ngal tshi ma chad do/ /sku dang gsung thugs yon tan las/ /'phrin las lnga lnga lhun grub pas/ /khams gsum las mtha'i bar rnams la/ /brag cha'i sgra bzhin snang bar 'gyur/ /skal mchog rdzogs pa'i rim bshad pa/ /lnga gnyis gsum drug ldan zhing la/ /sa sbyang gnyis dang gsum par shes/ /dbang rdzas phyag rgya legs shes bya/ /dkyil 'khor thig bri gnyis pa las/ /spyi dpung mtshan rgyab mgrin 'thil 'khor/ /mthu chen khro bo yab yum gsal/ /drang 44—451

bstem mchod gsol rab gnas bzhugs/ /rin chen gser dngul ldan pa yis//las dkyil bum gnyis byin rlabs bzung / /mchod gsum rdo rje dam sngags sogs / /yid kyis dbang phyug legs par 'jug /las kyi bum sbyang chus gsang ①bya—/ /khrus g.yog dri gsol lhar rdzogs rlabs/ /dam tshig chu sbyin nan ①bsgrags bya/ /dbab dor mi dbye dkyil 'khor bstan/ /de bzhin rang la'ang shes par bya'o/ /dbang gnyis mtshungs rgyu gsal bskyed pa/ /bum sogs rdzas sam phyag rgya'i rgyas/ /ting 'dzin tshig bshad ldan pas bskur/ /rgyu la mthing gsal nus mthur ldan/ /rang bzhin rjes su bum sogs kun/ /lhag pa'i phyag rgyas mos byas la/ /dbugs phyung sngar bstan dkyil 'khor lha/ /sprad de rdzogs pa'i bsam gtan bya/ /'ung nas dbang phyug dkyil 'khor lha/ /'dod yon lngas mchod gsol ba gdab/ /bcu gnyis bum pa phyag rgya che/ /sbyang sogs cho ga sngon rdzogs pas/ /ji ltar bshad bzhin dbang bskur te/ /dbugs phyung chos dang der shes bya/ /bum pa nyi zla'i snying po de/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor sngar bsal ①ba/ /rang 'byung rdo rje lce yi rjoblang / /ye shes snying po 'ang ma skyes pas/ /bdag med gzhan med der shes med/ /'du shes thams cad bral gsal ba/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin rim shes bya'o/ /mkha' 'gros ⑤gsal 'bar tshe la sogs/ /yid bzhin sprin byis ④bdag por 'gyur/ /yi ge thig le 'ju 'dul rnams/ /gang rung sprad de bsam gtan bya/ /bde ldan rim pa'i rgyu zhes bshad/ /bum pa bcu drug dam tshig rgya/ /sbyang sogs cho ga sngar shes te/ /rang gnas la sbyar bshad bzhin bya/ /dbugs sogs chos rnams bshad bzhin shes/ /rang rig thams cad mkhyen snang ba'i/ /nyi 44—452

zla'i phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams kun/ /phyi nang bar na mi gnas pa/ /sgyu ma lta bur rtag tu shes/ /dkyil 'khor bum pa phyag rgya che/ /bde chen bzhi ①pa la sbyar bya/ /sgo gsum rtsal gyis mnyes byas la/ /dbang phyug bum pa bskor gsol bya/ /gsang sngags gsang ba de kho na/ /dngos po kun gyis ②de nyid de//de ltar de bzhin de yi phyir/ /de la de bstan de shes 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho rting gi pha bong ltar/ /gsang mi nyams pa'i dam bca' bya/ /sa sogs gang yang 'tshalas bcad ①de/ /pang ru'i rna g.yas sbubs chus sbyar/ /dngos kun sems phyir spang blang bral/ /skye mched mi 'gog cang mi bsam/ /gang min pa de chen pos cis ma sgribs/ /gsang ba nges par zhen pa na/ /tshig dor rim mi sgos bshad pa/ /yul mthar 'gro ba'i sa brtags bzhin/ /nam zhig don la reg gyur na/ /som nyis spang phyir nges shes bya/ /'chad pa bzhin du las byas la/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam byas te/ /phyung 'byung hūṃ tha la sogs bcu—/ /dkyil 'khor chos khams rang gnas pa/ /g.yas dang g.yon gye rim pa bsam/ /mthong tshor myong thos rim bzlog pa/ /snying po gnyis sogs brgyad bsam bya/ /dbang po dus su 'byor pa rnams/ /g.yon dang shes rab g.yas yin par/ /'gro 'dzin 'dug sogs brgyad du bsgom/ /g.yas g.yon dpung gsang lte dbus su/ /rdo rje phyag rgya tshogs rims bcas/ /dngas ma'i rta'i gar thabs rtser/ /bya byed phyag rgya gnas par brtags⑦/ /sa bon yig bde rdo rje gsum/ /kun nas kun tu rang bzhin gnas/ /'jig rten sa bon chos gnas pa/ /byin brlabs skyes bus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /skabs kyi spyod bas bsgrubs ⑤mi dgos/ /gar thabs rol mor mi snang min/ /'khor lo 44—453

thig le bsam gtan bzhis/ /kun kyang bder 'gyur stong pa nyid/ /ma ①rtog ye shes bcu gsum drug /dngos kun rang rig nyid du snang / /thams cad yi ger 'dus snang zhing / /rdor 'dzin yab yum skur gsal ba/ /phra mor sbyor bas bzhi ru 'dod/ /phung po khams la sogs pa'i lhas/ /khams gsum ma lus ril bsdus te/ /rtog pa'i dngos po'i ②rim de gnas/ /phyag rgya bco brgyad gnyis su gsal/ /ting 'dzin snang ba phyed pa'o/ /shes rab nyid dang thabs ldan phyir/ /rang mtshungs yab yum sprod par bya/ /bdag rigs de bzhin gshegs dkyil 'khor/ /sngags kyi yan lag lnga rdzogs nas/ /drangs bstem mchod pa gsum mnyes te/ /'bru gsum bsnol bzlas phreng ba yis//thams cad kun kyang bde bar 'gyur/ /gzugs su snang ba kun gzhu nas/ /nyi zla bco brgyad phrag gnyis po/ /gsang ba'i zig ler gyur pa ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag snang ba/ /kun gyi sras su bdag gyur pa'i/ /de ltar sbyor ba goms pa ces①/ /'ung nas goms par sla ba rjoni/ /steng sgo 'byung bzhi yum dbyengs dang / /kha dog reg tshad dbye zhes bya/ /'og sgo kha dog de bzhin te//yig lngar gnas mtshungs las kyis drang / /sna tshogs bcu drug las byas nas/ /nyi ma bzang mo'i gdan khri dang / /rgyab yol sku rten chos gos bcing / /lcags kyus gnyis rgyas gsal bar 'gyur/ /dkyil mo gnyis kyis snyoms zhugs te—/ /khrag 'phrog dkyil mos blang bar bya/ /snyoms zhugs le shes bde ba'i rgyun—/ /rdul dang rdul phran zil pa ni/ /brgya dang bcu gnyis sum cur 'gyur / /thig phran bzhi dang bcu drug la/ /thig le zig chen ye shes dngos//nyi zla ngos mnyams ⑤gsang thig le/ /'bru tshogs hūṃ ming ye shes te/ /bco 44—454

brgyad phrag gnyis hūṃ 'dus pa/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor thig le che/ /yi ge lnga mthar zug rngu bral/ /chags bral bde chen nga yi rgyal/ /gnyis bsdus mtha' yas zhe sdang che/ /blu 'dus rang rig rang gsal ba/ /rmongs byed ye shes rdo rjer bshad/ /ye shes rdo rje ma 'dres rdzogs/ /tha snyad mi shong 'phrang dog mchog /rang rig mngon sum rtog med pa/ /ser sna chen po'i 'phrin las rdzogs—/ /rig pa'i skyes bu rdo rje drug /rgyu ①drug 'khor ba'i gnas drug tu/ /byin brlabs ④shugs kyis snang bar bshad/ /shes rab thabs 'byel gsang thig le/ /yig gsum gnas su mthong ba yang / /gsang sngags gsang ba'i de nyid ni/ /sa bcu ro mnyam 'byor ces bya/ /yi ge mchog gnas dngos po kun//ma 'dres bdag las gzhan mi dmigs/ /snang yang gos med pad mi dmigs/ /bcu drug bzhi bcu phrag gnyis sogs/ /thig ler gnas kyi yi ger snang / /mtshan dpe las 'phro bcu gsum pa/ /rtsa gnas bstem zhing dkyil 'khor sgyur①/ /rol mo'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa/ /rang bzhin ma nges bsam bzhin snang / /nyid la dbang bsgyur nyid spyod la/ /rgyan du dkyil 'khor ma lus thogasadhi/ /mnyam rdzogs chen po lhun gyis grub/ /'ung nas spun bdag gdam pa'i don/ /rdor lnga'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin/ /de don slob ma'i nges tshig can/ /shes rab thabs 'byel bdag yab yum/ /bskul dang gdam pa'i bka' gcogs pasarjo—/ /srid gsum srog 'phrog sum char men/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rje za ma tog /dug spyos pa'ang de bzhin no/ /rngub 'dug 'byung ba sngags rgyal gsum//lus can kun la rang bzhin gnas/ /ha dang sder byas thabs kyis sngags/ /dkyil mo'i phyag rgya rgyun bcas dunas/ /rdo rje med pa'i nor mkhan bzhin/ /44—455

'dod pa nam yang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje lce ni sgo gser ltar/ /rig byed mi 'da' 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /ming gsum bdag nyid 'gal mi bya/ /nor bu 'tshig par mi gos na/ /brtan na 'bral yang nyes pa med/ /shes byed bzhi dang shes bya'i dngos/ /las mtha'i tshul 'dra ma rtogs pa/ /gzhan du brjod na nges par 'jig /rdul snyed bskal par 'gyang bar 'gyur/ /spang dor mi bya bcu gnyis ni/ /de la rtag tu ldan par 'gyur/ / skal pa ①zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /shin tu sbyangs la rab gnas la/ /rin chen gter gyis sderim bzhag pa/ /las don gzhung gis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /dbang cig car 'jug pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/446 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉rabang gcig car du 'jug pa bzhugs so// ④〈〈pe 〉〉 lo ①〈〈pe 〉〉rem/447 ①〈〈pe 〉ra nga / ①〈〈pe 〉tharlum/ ①〈〈pe 〉41sa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉radab/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉phyi/ rjo〈〈pe〉7bar/dze+e〈〈pe 〉stanas/ ④〈〈pe 〉ra zhug ⑨〈〈pe 〉sten/448 ①〈〈pe 〉7ba/ ④〈〈pe 〉rdzadab/449 ①〈〈pe 〉mirlabs/ ①〈〈pe 〉snga/ ①〈〈pe 〉skaradug rjo〈〈pe 〉thastan/ rjo〈〈pe 〉tharlabs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉rim—/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉thazung /45 1〈〈pe 〉tha ①〈〈pe 〉'am/ ①〈〈pe 〉ras dbang phyug brgyar/ rjo〈〈pe 〉ratang / bu〈〈pe 〉sngagatab/du〈〈pe 〉〉sdeg ⑦〈〈pe 〉༅da thabs/451 ①〈〈pe 〉h+phad/ ④〈〈pe 〉ṅkacad/452 ①〈〈pe 〉ra sang / 1〈〈pe 〉stanam/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉sngar gsal/ 0〈〈pe 〉(6sa/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉5)/453 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagazhi/ ②〈〈pe 〉7)/ ①〈〈pe 〉zagacad/ du〈〈pe 〉thartag du〈〈pe 〉7)sa rtsol bas bam /44byed456

454 ①〈〈pe 〉〉mi ②〈〈pe 〉〉po/ ①〈〈pe 〉sngagaces/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉spob pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉mnyam/455 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rgyud/ ②〈〈pe 〉chosabs/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsgyur/ du〈〈pe 〉〉thog du〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉bcad/456 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bskal pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉7)/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2569)44wa 457

2643༄ga /baje ba chen po phyag rgya'i man ngag jes bya ba/①kho bde ba chen po phyag rgya'i man ngag zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā su ka mu tra pa pre sha na ma/ bod skad du/ bde ba chen po phyag rgya'i man ngag zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po ye shes rol pa'i klong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu 'phrul thabs chen gsang rgyud las/ /dug gis dug nad grol byed ltar/ /'dod chags bde bar rgyas byed phyir/ /bde chen rol pa'i man ngag bstan/ /gzhan lus shes rab tsakra'i don/ /brtag dgug byin brlab bde bskyed dang / /rol thabs rtags skyon yon tan 'bras/ /yan lag rgyas pa'i bzhi khruru bzhag /dang po nas brtsams mthar phyin par/ /las dang rigs pa byin rlabs ①dang / /ye shes rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /dngos dang ting 'dzin bde thob pas/ /pad+ma gsum la rim par sbyar/ /mthar thug bde chen sgrub bya'i phyir/ /ye shes sangs rgyas btsun mo brtenadu/ /44—458

zag med bde ba rgyas bya'i phyir/ /rig pa'i bu mo brten ①par bya/ /lus sems nus bde brtan bya'i phyir/ /mi'i bu mo brten par bya/ /de yang nus pa'i bye brag gis/ /lha klu gnod sbyin bu mo 'am/ /mi'i bu mo sngon brtag ste/ /spyir na rigs brtag lo grangs brtag /lus chos brtag ste bzang ngan dbye/ /khyad par bha ga'i dbyibs brtag dang / /rtsa brtag bzang ngan khyad par can/ /rol thabs skabs su shes par bya'o/ /thabs dang man ngag ldan pa'i sa/ /rgyal rigs rjes khrurigs bram ze'i rigs/ /rang bzhin rin ①bzang yum du btsal—/ /mtshan dang mi ldan spang bar bya/ /dmangs rigs tshos ④ma gar mkhan ma/ /gdol ma nyo tshong ma nyid dang / /chung ma sgyug mo bu sring mo/ /mthar sgyeg lus 'tshong ma la sogs/ /rang bzhin rigs ni ngan gyur kyang / /mtshan dang ldan na dngos grub zhing / /rang bzhin ngan dang ma sbyangs dang / /dka' thub can dang dam med dang / /zhen chags can dang phrag dog can/ /log sred can dang le lo can/ /log pa'i gang zag dbang song ba/ /lus mtshan yod kyang shin tu spang / /rigs rtag ④de sogs rab tu gces/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug dang / /bco brgyad bcud ldan rab yin te/ /nyi shu la sogs 'bring du bshad/ /rtsa lnga tha ma'i tshad yin te/ /gzhan la dngos grub med par gsungs/ /mtshan ldan ma la na so med/ /mtshan dang bcud gnyis mi ldan na/ /lo grangs tshad bzung dudagos pa med/ /yid 'ong lus mdzes kha dog legs/ /gzugs dang lang tsho ldan pa dang / /btsun zhing na so dar la bab/ /lus ran sha mdangs dkar dmar phyed/ /skad snyan dran pas yid 'phrog pa/ /nus dang chags pa che ba dang / /dka' ⑦blo bde zhing 44—459

yid mi 'khrugs/ /dul zhing blo gros ldan pa dang / /rol pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang / /pad+ma ni dang ha ta ni/ /sha ka ni dang tsa ta ni/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i lus/ /bzang mo dngos grub skye ba'i brten①/ /de la sogs pa yum brtag pa/ /rgyas par gsang rgyud kun las bshad/ /gang du gzhan gyis dbang byas dang / /dka' thub can dang ngo tsha dang / /rtsang sme can dang rang bzhin ngan/ /g.yengs pa dang ni 'grams pa dang / /snang dang gnyid dang brnyings ①pa dang / nus pa med pa spang bar ①bya'o/ /ting 'dzin sngags rdzas thabs rdzogs pas/ /dgon pa bar chad med gnas su/ /snga dro phyed dang skur sman ④dang / /dgongs ka'i dus su dgug par bya'o/ /khrus bya chos bshad 'du shes bsgyur/ /zas dang gos tshogs rjes bsrungs la/ /dam tshig sdom phog dbang bskur na/ /phun tshogs lha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /thabs dang shes rab byin brlabs la/ /mkha' gsang rdo rje pad+mar bsgom/ /mchod bstod bzlas pa mthar phyin nas/ /tha mal zhen pa rang grol bya'o/ /bde ba bskyed cing chags 'dod na/ /chags pa'i glu dang gar dag dang / /bza' btung glu dang chags pa'i gtam⑤/ /ji legs pa yis spyad par bya/ /'jam dang tsub dang snyan mi snyan/ /dal dang drag dang sbom 'phra dang / /ring thung myur bul glu rnams blang / /yab yum gnyis kyi bya ba ni/ /gar thabs brgyad dang bubacu gcig gi/ /nyi shu'i thabs kyis bde ba bskyed/ /mdzes shing chags pas lta ba ltar/ /bzung ba dang ni 'khyud pa dang / /sbyor ba dang ni mnye ba dang / /'bud dang ngang pa'i sgra 'byin dang / /rtog dang 'be+ebs dang rdeg dang bskyod/ /'o dang 'jib dang 'cha' ba dang / /gtse dang 'bab 44—460

dang zhon pa dang / /gtsugs dang 'byung dang 'jug pa dang / /rol pa sna tshogs spyad pa'o/ /yab yum gar thabs drug cu 'am/ /'dod pa'i yan lag sum brgya 'am/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pas/ /bde ba yongs su bskyed bya'o//mdor na bya ba'i las dag ni/ /steng 'og 'khyud pas ①gnyis yin te/ /lta dang 'dzin dang gtse dang gnye'/ /reg pa de bzhin shes par gyis/ /thabs dang shes rab tshul gyis so/ /yum gyis rol thabs bcu drug gis/ /rol pa'i gar ni bcu gsum ste/ /dga' dang lta dang 'khyud pa dang / /'o dang 'gor dang 'bud dang 'jo'/ /zhal sbyor gtse dang mnye ba dang / /'jib dang ba ga dkar ①'dzin ston/ /thabs chen yab kyis bya ba'i las/ /nu ma de bzhin mig gnyis dang / /sna dang 'gram pa chu ①so dang / /brla dang lte ba ba ga dang / /dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'o bya'o/ /mchu dang nu ma'i mgor gnyis dang / /mchan khung 'bur gnyis 'khur tshos la/ /bud med dga' ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mi drag par ni ngos gdab po/ /mchu gnyis bar du mchu gnyis dag /lta bzhin yun ring bzhib par bya/ /nu ma gnyis dang 'bur gnyis dang / /brla dang nu ma skyed pa ru/ /gtse dang chags pa bskyed sdepa'i phyir/ /sen thabs bcas pas reg par bya/ /gsang ba stod kyi gnas gsum dang / /skyed pa'i gnas gsum nu gnyis dang / /mchan khung rtsibs logs rgyu zhabs su/ /tha mal tshul gyis brud par bya/ /srin lag thabs kyis bskyod par bya/ /reg dang 'phro bas yid phan ⑤pa/ /de tshe rtags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lus ni bcud kyis 'tsho bar bya/ /sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga/ /bcud dang sbyar ram dngos kyang rung //bza' btung mur ba la sogs brtenadhi/ /phan tshun dga' ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /44—461

chos dang 'byel pa'i tshig rnams kyis/ /chags pa'i gtam ni gsang thub par/ /skabs sam dus su smra bar bya/ /'gro nyal 'dug sdod longs spyod dus/ /dal ba'i tshud rmis dben pa ru/ /ting 'dzin ma sbyongs bar dag tu/ /longs spyod lnga dang ldan par bya'o/ /khas blangs mkha' dang rtsa brtag pa/ /bzang ngan dbye ba gnyis gnyis/ /gang du bde bskyed rten gyi dbyibs/ /yo ba dang ni blang ba dang / /rtsa na 'phel ka che ba dang / /rtsub dang rlum mthong 'dzag pa dang / /'gyur dang mi legs dmas pa dag /de rnams spang bar shes par bya /sra ba dang ni 'phangs mtho dang / /rtsa ldan drod che ska ba dang / /mi 'gyur ba dang bzlum pa dang / /ting ring 'jam zhing cung zad dam/ /pad+ma'i snying po bzhin du bzlum/ /shun bu chung la spu nyung ba/ /bzang po'i rigs dang mtshan du bshad/ /rtsa med pa dang shas pa dang / /rtsa ngan pa dang yo ba dang / /kha dma' ba dang thung ba dang / /'phra dang nus pa med pa dang / /spang bar bya bar rab tu bshad/ /rgyas pa'i rigs dang sbom pa dang / /rang bzhin bzang dang nus pa che/ /bcos su med pa bzang por bshad/ /khyad par gdung can btsal ba'i thabs/ /rdo rje lce dang srin lag dang / /srin lag bcos ma la sogs pa'i/ /gsang ba'i pho brang rgyas par bya/ /thabs dang zas dang spyod lam gyis/ /'khor ba zil non rtsa snyed nas/ /bdag po gdung can rnam par sbyar—/ /thabs chen lam la mkhas pa yis/ /ye shes snang ba mched par byed//blta ba dang ni brtags ①pa dang / /thos dang reg dang 'grogs pa yis/ /zhen pa log cing bde bskyed de/ /ran pas sdug bsngal sel bar byed/ /yab yum rol pa'i thabs dngos ni/ /dbab dang gzung dang gnas cing ②zhing / /44—462

rang rang gnas su slar son thabs/ /shes rab thabs kyis g.yas bzung ste/ /stod smad dgug pa kyo ka ta/ /dbang po'i yul sdus ①'khyud pa ni/ /gsang ba chen po'i zhags pa'o/ /stod smad shin tu bsdams byas te/ /ma skyes mi gtong sgog gi las/ /bskyed pa ha sa'i bde sgra'i sgogs/ /kun tu drag cing bde spong ho/ /dbang po gnyis ni srubs pa las/ /bdag po gdung can phrad ②pa'i tshe/ /nyi zla dus gcig shar ba'i tshe/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /spyod yul nus pa kun bzlog nas/ /mthong lam rang gi mtshan nyid skye/ /gnas nas ldang zhing bde g.yo ba/ /rang gi lam 'jug rtog 'gag cing / /rang gi 'pho bas sa gnas tshe/ /phyi ma'i bde ba skye bar 'dod/ /goms pa'i rlung mthus slar bskyed de/ /mthar phyin thabs kyi byang chub sems/ /dga' dang rjes su dga' ba dang / /kun rdzob lugs las 'byung ba dang / /don dam lugs las bzlog pa gnyis/ /yan lag nying lag rgyas 'gyur te/ / rims na rims ④pa bcu drug ro/ /dang po bzhi tshogs bcu gnyis lam/ /gsum bzhi mthong lam bzhi bsgoms dhipas/ /tha mar thim brjod rim bzlog pas—/ /rim pa bzhin du gsal bsgoms pas/ /thig le phra rags snang ba kun—/ /'bab zhon sdol ma'i thabs nyid kyis/ /thig le gong 'og steng 'og gnyis⑤ / /thig le gong ma nyid 'og tu/ /'og ma gnyis duni steng du 'bar/ /gcig gnyis lus kun khyab par mthong / /sems kyi thig le thog mtha' med/ /lus kyi thig le sno la rkyang / /'dres pa la ni gang goms pa/ /zlog ⑦pa 'dren pa hūṃ gis shes/ /'dren pa dang ni 'dzin pa dang / /rtse dang skyed pa rtsa ba dang / /lte ba snyipa mgrin skra 'tshalas su/ /thig le 'pho ba'i tshul gyis bya/ /44—463

'og nas bskul zhing steng gis mnan/ /dngas snyigs bsre ba'i thabs la 'jugathig les lus kun khyab par bya'o/ /bde ba'i rtags ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /lus dang brtsar bcas mgul ①ba dang / /ldeg cing 'bar ba'i bde bas gang //bde bas dbang bsgyur tshim pa'i sgra/ /ma lus khyab par sgrogs par byed/ /'dar dang rlung dang ba spu ldang / /sgra dang lus bde brgyug pa dang / /rgod dang brgyal sogs gang byung yang / /brtan dang sbyang ba'i cho ga bya/ /mi mthun log pa'i rtags snang na/ /thabs kyis ④rim pa'i cho ga bya/ /theg pa mchog la mi chags shing / /'dod lnga chags pa spong ba dang / /'khor ba'i khams su brtsang bar 'gyur/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa dang / /lam gyis ①yon tan thams cad rdzogs/ /'bras bu'i ngo bo lhun gyis rdzogs/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ tshogs drug ye shes lnga cha gcig /thabs las bzlog pas sngon gnas shes/ /'gro 'ong rdzu 'phrul nges lung gsal/ /brjod 'drar thos shing sa gsum mthong / /phung khams yul gyis buzag pa med/ /a li ka li'i bde ba nyid/ /phan tshun 'dres cig par shes/ /bcu drug ngos gnyis mtshan dang ldan—/ /phyogs gcig ye shes lnga ldan pas/ /brgya bcu zod ⑤sogs rgyu la 'phags—/ /kun tu 'od dang pad+ma spyan/ /'khor lo sa mchog mngon sum la/ /de sogs brjod pa grangs las 'das/ /steng 'og lam la goms byas shing / /me rlung sems la gsal bstan na/ /rnam smin snyigs mar bcas pa 'di/ /rdo rje lus 'gyur the tshom med/ /de nas sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /thugs rje rol pas gzhan don rdzogs/ /man ngag 'di'i snod bstan pa/ /bzang ngan gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig dang / /shes rab snying rje 44—464

phun sum tshogs/ /brtson 'grus btong 'phod ①che ba ni/ /dam pa'i rigs su shes par bya/ /bud med chags pa che ba dang / /de bzhin skyes bu dar la bab—/ /lang tsho bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /gsang ba thabs kyi snod mchog yin—/ /'dod pa bral dang rme ning dang / /ma smin pa dang dka' thub dang / /log par 'ag zhing mi 'jug pa/ /bde mchog sbyin pa'i snod ma yin/ /'on kyang dad pas sgor 'jug na/ /bla ma'i gdams pas kun dor min/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i don chen po/ /yang gsang thugs kyi snying po yi/ /man ngag thabs kyis bde sgrub kunaske/ /tshe 'dis sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /bde chen phyag rgya'i man ngagagazhan lus shes rab kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/458 ①mtshan byang 'de chos 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ①〈〈pe 〉razhi/ sne〈〈pe 〉'ag pa byin brlabs/ ༷〈〈pe 〉snyen/459 ①〈〈pe 〉snyen/ ①〈〈pe 〉tsā/ ①〈〈pe 〉'gas/ du〈〈pe 〉〉'a/ du〈〈pe 〉thartag rjo〈〈pe 〉razung /⑦〈〈pe 〉snga ka'/46༷ ①〈〈pe 〉snyen/ ④〈〈pe 〉d+kungs/ ①〈〈pe 〉7ngas par/ rjo〈〈pe 〉raman/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉'itan/du〈〈pe 〉ram/461 ①〈〈pe 〉mi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉rar/ sne〈〈pe 〉zochu/ rjo〈〈pe 〉thaskyong/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉ra pham/ du〈〈pe 〉lken/4462 ①〈〈pe 〉thartag ②〈〈pe 〉thacing /463 ①〈〈pe 〉thasdus/ ①〈〈pe 〉skoraphrad/ ①〈〈pe 〉'am nas rim/ du〈〈pe 〉thasgom/ ⑤du〈〈pe 〉lked/⑦〈〈pe 〉thazog464 ①〈〈pe 〉ma ra bcas 'gul/ ④〈〈pe 〉7)/ ④dhi〈〈pe 〉5)/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉thazod/465 ①〈〈pe 〉'itong phod/44byed465
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2570)

bshags bsngonags so//①༄ ga /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo nges pa'i gsang sgor zhugs pa'i mi/ /thar pa sgrub par khas 'ches pa'i/ /rnal 'byor stobs med le los nyams/ /rgyun gzhi med pas lhung phyir bshad/ /de la rgyun du bya ba ni/ /dge ba'i srog la bar gcod pa'i/ /nyon mongs thibs po gzhom par bya/ /le lo thugs thub ra chod dregs/ /myos dang dpa' med sgo mo bsdam/ /rdo rje gsang tshig ma rtogs pa/ /mtshan ma bying ngam zur mi brjod//gshed ma'i lag nas 'gros brtson ltar/ /le lo dgra bcom brtson pas 'bad/ /rtag tu dgra bzhi bcom byas te/ /rdo rje brnag pa bsam 'phel bas ngag nyams kha na ma thos 'phog /lta dman spyod rtsing 'chol gzhung bor/ /log spyod nar bas bar chad dgra/ /rtsa gsum yan lag 'chal bar shor/ /ljon shing rul bzhin bka' chad 'byung / /brtsams pa'i la ②la sbyor ba'i tshe/ /44—467

brtson med le los 'bras bu 'phrog /de bzhin rnal 'byor nges spyod la/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud lnga 'byung / /rnam rtog 'phrog pa'i bdud nyid dang / /de bzhin btang snyoms le lo'i bdud/ /longs spyod 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i bdud//tshig rtsub mtshon cha rnon po'i bdud/ /khro brtum ngang thung byedag pa'i bdud/ /zhi ba'i ngang du ma bzlog na/ /thar pa don po'i gegs su che/ /bzhi bral bzhi bcom lngas bslus pa'i/ /rnal 'byor 'khor spangs dgon rten yang / /de la rnal 'byor ming ci yod/ /de bas gzhung bzhin 'bad par bya/ /nyams pa lnga dbang mi gtong ba'i/ /rnal 'byor rnam gsum la gnas pas/ /las kyi dus kyi rgyun bya ba/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /bla ma snying por bzhugs byas la/ /phyag skyabs mchod dang bstod bshags dang / /yid rang sems bskyed lus dbul dang / /byang chub chen por bsngo bsgom bskul/ /bsam gtan gnas sbyang rjes bsab pa/ /yid kyi ting 'dzin la gnas te/ /ye shes 'byung gsum ting 'dzin gyis/ /chos nyid ngang du sbyang byas te/ /bskul tshig gsang sngags bcas brjod pas/ /nyams pa'i chad pa mi 'byung bar//lhag pa'i chos sku the byed med/ /de phyir de la de yis brtson/ /nang nub dus su bya ba na/ /sngon bzhin sngon du bsdus byas te/ /phyag 'byed mchod pas dgyes byas la/ /mchod pa rim bzhin dbul byas te/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i nyes byas bshags/ /nyin mtshan dus bzhir bsngo byas te/ /nongs 'gal mchis pa ming gis bshags/ /sngon nas bsags pa'i dge bsdoms te/ /de ring phan chad spyad pa dag /bdag gzhan chos phyir byang chub bsngo/ /phyin chad mi nyams dam ①bca'o/ /dpa' bo yongs par sgrib pa sbyang ②/ /blo ldan 44—468

tshul du 'chos byed cing / /bzhi ②spang lam kun don ched du/ /rgyun gyi tshogs khrus sgeg pasa'adi bsdus pas/ /mtha' yas byang chub chen por shog/ //brtsar mchan/467 nyumatshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉rtor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉pos/468 ①〈〈pe 〉rang /469 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sbyangs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stanazhi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2571)44wa 469

bcu dgu pa bzhugs so//①rag /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhi khro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad aposalung bstan pa'i dus gcig na/ zhi khro thams cad ngo bo bcom ldan 'das steng gi phyogs 'og min na/ tshe 'das sems can thams cad byang chub tu sgol ba'i ting nge ②la snyoms par bzhugs te/ dkyil 'khor drug gshinapom 'ongs pa'i don du phyi ma dang bdun/ kunapothugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas phyung ste/gdul bya'i zhing gshin po mtha' dag ma lus par thig le la byin gyes dbye ba med pa la sogs pa byu ta gsum brlab par mdzad do/ /deladon rnam pa khrubadun tshigs su bcad pa bcu dgu pa'adisa'agrel to/ /sngonadu bya ba dngapo sgodabartags pa'am brtags pa'i gnas ched du/ /sngon du gson gyi rim gro'i yo byad dang sngags mkhan gshin po la dgos pa'i yo byad du dgos pa kun bsog byab bar 'os pa dang bya rgyu kun byas te/ /khro sa: 'bar ba mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor mang po be+ekram nas ni las kyi dkyil 'khor/ /bgegs rnams rdul du klog cing 'byer/ /dkyil 47khor 44byed470

brgyad pa bga'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor la jibs brgyad yod pas baṃ gre tshe brgyad yod pas de'i las ga nga bsrang tshul bzhin bzhag /byim pa byin brlabs kun tu bzang mo'i dkyil 'khor bum pa gzugs dri ma bca' ldeng bu dgram/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor te rigs lnga'i bsnyen pa bya kum pa 'dzab khang bye la 'phro 'du bya/ ma ha yo ga'i sa la gzud pa bzang mos brgyan/ /dzo nor lha ni bsnyen byas te/ /chi: med chasngon gyi ces dri ma 'dzin pas gsol ba btab la me tog dor gsang mtshan gdags yi dam lha dbog sangs rgyas kun 'a (1/ /byisna/ phab yo byad kun bsag pa dang gson gyi cho ga zhi khro gzhung bsrang ba ni gson po la byin phab pa'o gsal bar rdzogs nas ni/ /lasabacol ba phyogs skyong lan chags btang bar bsod nams gtor sbyin gyi dkyil 'khor la 'jug ste cha gsum gyi gzhung du ma gdal bya mchod pa bshams mtshan byang gzugs bum pa bca' las gzhung bsrang shes pa dgug bum pa'i 'dzab bya gtor ma dang po bskyil bar pa dang tha ma btang mtshan byang bkru ba yan chad la chos dgu'o bya/ /tram̐d lnga'i sgol ba'i rdal lamanas nub tha ma drag pos sgral ①can tu 'od la/ /gsal ba'i thugs rje sems la 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa la gzu gzud de bstem/ /tsita 'am mtshan byang lag pas blangs la dal gyi dbus su bzhag la ni lhan ṣ+pe por gsal ba/ /thabs rigs yab yum gyi sbyor mtshalas nas 'od 'phros pas rnam shes hūṃ du gnas pa de 'od kyi dra bar bcug de bana'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dbus kyi le tse gru gsum la nyi zla'i gdan la bzhagadang shes rab sbyor ba las ①ma g.yos pas/ /gru gsum por ni bsgral bar bya/ /lung a nu yo ga'i theg pa la gzud pa bcas te sngags dang phyag rgya yis yi ge 'khor lo dang ye shes bla ma'i sa la/ /yab yum gnas sumada' gzhu lag tu blangs te snying ngam mtshan byang la brteg med rtse la blangs te zhi ba'i dpe chung gi steng du me long gi steng du byang bu bzhag pa ni rdzogs pa chen po'i sa'o phaṭa kyis 'phang / /bo de tsi tas dbang bskur nas phyir mi sdog pa'i sa la bkod pa'o/ /lhag ma dang lta ba'i klong bshags bya gnas lung mar me'i smonalam gdab bcol bskang / /slob dpon tha ma la'i tshigs rkangasu bcad pa bcu dgu ni lots+tsha ba bsnyegs gnya' nas kha bskangs pa'o/ /bi ma la yis tha/nga du bstan nas brnyegs kyis kha 44byed471

bskangs/ /rdzogs so de yang chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba kun gzhi byang chub sems yenas rnam par dag cing sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin ye nas de ltar yin pa'i don ji lta bar shes pa'i ye shes rang gi rang bzhin rang gis rtogs par byas nas der gnas bcas pa las gzhan logs gcig tu gnas bcar med pas rang gnas thams cad kun gyi gzhi'i rang bzhin du dbyer med pas chen po'o/ /slob dpon shi len na len tra'i paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya'i mchog tu gyur pa mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa bi ma la'o/ /zla/da chags pa sbyong ba khro bo rgyu mdzad chen po'i rgyud kyi ma hā rak+ta bstan 'gan gyi le'u las bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi lung gi rgyud de'i don bsdus pa tshig bcad bcu dgu pa'o/ /lung skenur rtogs pa'o/ /:glob/ba/ don las btags te ye shes rang gnas chen po zhes bya ca/'a6da khams gsum 'khor ba las grol zhing thar pa'i dus med pa rnams 'khor ba las bsgral nas bla med byang chub tu drangs pa'i phyiradon ched bsdus pa'i don dkyil 'khor drug ma 'ongs pa'i don du phyi ma dang bdun// //bsdur mchan/47 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉thār bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉ṅka'adzin/ ①〈〈pe 〉bopa/471 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsgral/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wazospyor ba las/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2572)44wa 472

cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/①༄ rab gnas kyi cho ga rnam par bsres pa gsum dang sbyar ba bzhugs so/ /༄ ga /rgya gar skad kyangadon gsum du/ mā ya dzā la su pra tiṣ+ṭha bi dhi kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa sku lnga'i bdag /'bras bu lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /rigs 'dzin rdo rje 'dzin pa la//gnyis med rig pa'i bde bas 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sku gsung thugs kyis ji ltar 'dul ba'i gang zag la/ /de yi cho ga shes bya'i phyir/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rab tu gnas pa'i mdor bsdus bshad/ /gzhung don la gnyis man ngag gi dgos pa sgyu 'phrul dra bar legs zhugs te/ /slob dpon mnyes par byas pa dang //dbang rnams rim par thob pa dang / /don gnyis mngon 'dod rnal 'byor pas//dkyil 'khor la sogs thams cad la/ /byin brlabs dbang bskur bya ba'i phyir//44—473

ji ltar rigs pa de la 'jug / sagang gi ①gnasagang la gang dag dus/ /tshul ji ltar byas pa'i yon tan dang / /skyon du rim par bdun gyi shes par bya/ /dbang lnga rim par thob pa dang / /dbang dang rab gnas kyi lung ldan las la lhag chad med—/ /teng nge 'dzin ye shes rkyen thub kun mkhas g.yo sgyu med/ /stonapa'irtags thob ting 'dzin drod ldan pas/ /ji ltar 'os pa bsdu bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor glegs bam rdo rje dril/ /bris sku byas sogs gang yang rung / /bum pa mchod rten la sogs pa/ /de lta de ltar spyad par bya/ /gnas ni ri rdo rjenam mkha' 'khor lo dang / /sagazhipad+ma lta bu'i bdag nyid can/ /dgrabagegs kyi bar chad med cing dga' ba ru/ /ji ltar dga' ba der bya'o/ /nya dang brgyad dang stong la sogs/ /ra ba bzhi dang rgyal sogs dang / /yo byad 'byor par gyur pa dang / /bsnyen pas rtags thob dus su'o/ /ji ltar bya ba'i thabs nyid ni/ /srun bya lardzas dang sbyang ba dang / /rlab dang dbang bskur rdzas mchod dbul/ /brtan byas bzhugs pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /sngonadu bya ba dang po rnal 'byor de nyid kyis—/ /dalabasdus rgyas 'bring sogs de nyid bskyedapa kyis/ /mchod bzlas ting 'dzin rtags thob pas/ /mdogang du 'thad rgyasapa'i gnas nyid du/ /dalagyis snyam la sogs sachog rgyas par bya/ /de nas dal dang bum pa gnyis pa sta gon bya/ /rdo rje 'gros kyis dal nam mkha' la bteg la de nas rdo rje gom ldan pas/ /gang de mi 'gom steng du bzhag /de nas gzungs ldan las byed pas/ /thig gi las la rab tu sbyar—/ /de nas kha dog thigaskud ra lnga ldan pas/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mtshan nyid las//byin brlabs gang ltar rigs par bya/ /rgyan 'phreng bza' btung ras 'phan sogs—/ /rgyan mchog legs par dgram par bya/ /de nas mtshams bcad pa phyi 44byed474

nang gsang ba yi/ /bar chad bgegs bsal lhar bdud rtsi 'asgol pa zhe sdang rdo rje gsal bas| /thun mong spyi'i bshags pa dam bca' byin dbab sogs lasabyas pas/ /ting nge gsum sku gsum sa la bslab par bya/ /sprul pas mdagapa sbyang zhing rim babyedakhyanabar+ṣade//gdan bkod de stengs rgyas sbyar la/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor phab ste bcing / /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ /bstems te mchod pa bzlas pa bya/ /srog ldan thun bzhi la sogs pa bzlas pa tshul gsum gyis/ /yan lag lnga ldan bar chad med—/ /ma yengs ngag gis rtag tu 'bad/ /de tshe rgyardzasal bod 'bar 'dzum zhal sgra la sogs/ /gal te dbang rab gnas kyi gcig par lung ston gnang thob nas/ /mchod sbyar dngos grub blang bar bya/ /de nas ci rigs las la sbyar/ /bzhi pa rdzas dang rab gnas dang / /mchod pa gsum du shes par bya/ /sku dang mchod rten phyag mtshan dang / /glegs bam rdo rje dril bu dang / /dkyil 'khor dbu rgyan phur bu ste/ /gzhan rnams rjes su mthun par brjod/ /bum pa chu dang zho mar dang / /lji ba shing shun yungs kar nyid/ /rin chen 'phreng ba dbu rgyan dang / /gdu bu do shal sku rags dang / /cod pan zhabs gdan de bzhin te/ /thur ma snyan bzhar sma tsher dang / /chan pa chems shing me tog phreng / /ras dang bdug pa mar me dang / /dri chab dam rdzas gtor ma dang / /sta na ga na 'dod yon lnga/ /bla re rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs/ /na bza' khang bu bzhugs khri dang / /gling bzhi'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin no/ /mchod rdzas rgyan 'phreng btung ba dang / /bza' dang bca' dang bgo ba dang / /rta dang ba lang rin chen bdun/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i yo byad dang / /gzungs ma rig pa las byung ba/ /mchod pa'i rdzas su yang dag bshad/ /sbyang ba ting 44—475

'dzin rdzas dang ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar shes par bya/ /ting 'dzin chos dbyings ye shes su/ /stong pa ra po'i rab gnas zer stong nyid dran pas sbyangs pa yin/ /rdzas ni bum pa'i chu nyid kyis/ /bdud rtsi 'khrul pa'i chu yis bkru/ /zho mar 'o ma lji bar sbyar/ /'bru mar byug cing bsku bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor glegs bam bris gzugs nyid/ /dngos min gzugs brnyan las shes bya/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya bi shwa ta ni swā hā/ de nas sgrum gyis byug par bya/ /hūṃ tram̐ hri khaṃ ①zhes brjod do/ /tsan dan dkar dmar u dum bar/ /na kro ta dang par pi nyi/ /shing shun lnga yis btab byas la/ /de nas ras kyis legs par phyi/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bi she ka sa ma yo hūṃ/ de nas yungs kar rgyal po yis/ /bar chad ma lus skrad par bya/ /stong chen thal mo khong stong phyagargya sngags ga bha wa ldan pasaske/ /stongapa ra po dag pa bzhin du dag par sbyang / /sku ni longs spyod byin gyis brlabs sprul pa 'am/ /gang dag de dag nyid du rlob/ /mchod rten rgyu 'bras lhun rdzogs la/ /lhag pa'i lha 'am ②na du ḍado shisa'aphrin las pa'o/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma ral gri phyag mtshan gong gi mthun par rlob/ /glegs bam rgyal ba chos sku a tu bzang podrug pa'i④/ /sprul pa'i sgon mar yumapha rol ma ma rlob par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu mi bskyod pa/ /yab yum 'byel par byin gyis brlabs/ /dkyil 'khor de dag nyid du ste/ /dbu rgyan rgyal ba yab yum bcu/ /phur pa khro bor brlab pa ste—/ /rdo rje pad+mar byin rlab pa/ /gang yin thugasaka nas phyung pa de la bstem/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bstem byas la/ /dkyil 'khor nyid kyang wos bu mthar phyin thim par bya/ /phyag rgya bzhi ldan bstan pa la/ /skugasung thugs kyi nges par gsal ldan nyid du brlab/ /de nas sgo gsum 'bru gsum gyis/ /sku gsung thugs 44byed476

ldan par byin gyis bam sa nyid du bya/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi spyan drangs la/ /phyag rgya bzhi ldan dri med sumapa'i chu/ /ye shes lnga ldan de'i gnas lngar thim/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs nyid du bya/ /de la phyi nang mnga'adabul kun jisnyed pa'i/ /ye shes lnga'i dbang bskuradabang rdzas rnams kyis dbang bskur la/ /skugasung thugs rang rang las gang byed pa yi/ /de dang de'i nus pa can/ /re re sku gsung thugs ldan pas/ /'gro ba'i don byed nus dbangakadusasubaskur/ /dbang rgyas sbyin sreg rgyas par bya /sprul pa thubadrugam yin gzhan dag la/ /yab yum dburgyan 'byel pa nyid du bshad/ /thun mong dbang sogs thun mongs ma yin pa'i mnga' dbul ba mtha' yas la/ /rdzogs par bskur bar bshad pa yin/ /bdag gzhan dri ma dag bya'i phyir/ /rin chen bdun gyi bum pas bkru/ /bdag gzhan don du thunamongs ma yin pa'i dbang yang bskur| /maṇ+ḍamig sman byugs pas spyan gsal dang / /snyan gsal shangs tog ljags dri gsal/ /sprul pa nyid la shes par bya/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku la rin chen 'phreng ba dang / /gong du bshad pa'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa rdzas rnams kun/ /de'i yon tan rdzogs byas nas/ /bdag kyang de 'dra bya ba'i phyir/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya sngags nyid dang / /rdzas kyi de lta nyid du bya/ /bdug pa dri chab mar me dang / /dam rdzas sbyor sgol 'dod yon lnga/ /de nyid yon tan rdzogs pa dang / /bdag gi tshogs gnyis rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /rim pa nyid du dbul bar bya/ /de bzhin gos dang dar dang 'phan/ /de yang rim pa bzhin du dbul—/ /phyag bsil bdud rtsi rnam lnga dang / /sbyor sgol gtor ma rol mo'i sgrarka/ /'dod yon lhab lhub bla re gdugs/ /rin chen khang bu mdzes pa dang / /gling bzhi maṇ+ḍal rta babs brgyan zhing gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa byin gyis brlabs la dbul/ /44—477

yul khang rta glang bran khol nor/ /bu dang bu mo rang lus dbul/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor legs par brtag① /de nas rdo rje slob dpon byis/ /mchod gnas nyid du legs par gtad/ /chosaskyongabasrungs la bstems la rang rang dang mthun pa mchod byas la/ /slob dpon grogs dang gzungs ma yis/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rol mo bstod pa kun byas la/ /dkyil 'khor de la bskor bar bya/ /de nas dngos sam grib ma 'ang rung / /'goms na rgyal ba bsad dang mtshungs/ /de nas rang gi sngags ldan pas/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan byas la/ /ji srid dgongs pa'i bar du ni/ /de dag brtan par byas pa'am/ /yang na rdzas de ma brlab ④par—/ /de srid brtan par byas pa'am/ /yang na 'khor ba gnas bar du/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis brtan par bzhugs/ /gal te zhig par gyur pa'i rdul/ /de srid rgyal ba'i gzugs skur nges/ /de re sprul pa bsams ①yas pa/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis bsam mi khyab/ /sku yi phyag rgya chen po ni/ /yang dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /'gro ba ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mthun byas sku ni sna tshogs ston/ /de bzhin nyid las g.yos pa med/ /dper na me long chu zla bzhin/ /de ltar kun tu snang byas nas/ /bdag gzhan don du 'grub par shog /ka ya wa ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ de ltar gnas par gyur nas kyang / /'khor ba ji srid bar du ni/ /rgyal ba'i gzugs sku bsam yas pas/ /bstan pa chos kyi 'khor lo yis/ /'gro don kun tu gnas par shog /rgyal ba chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ltar gnas par brtag pa bya/ /de nas lhag ma byin byas la/ /bsdu dang go bgo lus bsrung la/ /rgyun gyi ting 'dzin ldan byas la/ /brtan par gnas pa'i ma— nyid sems can ma lus thams cad la/ /ye shes lnga yis kun 44—478
