khyab kyang / /rang gi rnam rtog sgrib byas nas/ /ye shes lnga yi don ma mthong / /'on kyang 'phel 'grib bral ba'i phyir/ /'khor ba srid dang mya ngan 'das/ /de srid bar du rtag par gnas/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yang / /thugs rje rgyun du gnas gyur nas/ /las dang thugs rje 'phrad pa yis/ /skal bar gnas pa smos ci dgos/ /ji ltar nam mkha' dag pa lasti/ /gzugs sku nyi ma 'bum brdal bzhin/ /de bzhin chos sku dag pa la/ /gzugs sku skye ba bsam mi khyab/ /mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad ldan/ /gdul bya'i bya ba chis bar du/ /'pho 'gyur med par de ltar gnas/ /sa la sogs la phyag rgyar byas/ /rnam grol rim pa thob gyur na/ /dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum ye shes kyis sbyangs pas/ /smos ci dgos te de nyid yin/ /ye shes dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rnal 'byor ting 'dzin mthu byin dang / /rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i nus mthu yis/ /sgrib pa dag cing tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /gang 'chad de yi dngos grub thob/ /sgrub pa myur zhing tshe la dbang / /mthar ni skye med rdo rje'i sa—/ /'grub 'gyur the tshom med ces bshad/ /theg pa dman par mi skye zhing / /rgyal ba kun gyis dbang bskur 'gyur/ /rgyas pa ma byas pa'i rma dkyil 'khor gzugs sku la sogs pa/ /rab gnas mthu byin mi gnas par/ /bstod dang bskor ba ma byas pa/ /bsogs dang zi ba'i nus mthu med/ /de nyid ngal ba don med de| /rnal 'byor ting 'dzin ldan pa yis/ /sku gzugs rab gnas kyi byin brlabs med pa la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pas brlag par 'gyur/ /de phyir 'bad ①de rab gnas bya/ /gang dag dkyil 'khor la sogs rdzas la brten④/ /de yis 'brasabusgrub par 'dod pa de don du/ /lung dngarig padang man ngag 44—479

tshad ma gsum ldan pas/ /sgyu 'phrul rab gnas cho ga legs bsdus pas/ /de don nus mthu ldan nas 'gro ba kun/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen 'grub par shog /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rab gnas kyi cho ga rnam par bsreg ①pa gsum dang sbyar ba/ lorgyusami gsung slob dpon rgyal ba bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/472 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/474 ①〈〈pe 〉stanas/476 ①〈〈pe 〉skabams/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉lha'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa 'am/478 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brtags/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉brlag ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉bsam/479 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pas/ ②〈〈pe 〉torachad/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsten/48 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsres/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2573)44wa 480

༄ga /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag gnas/ /skyed pa yi ni rim pa dang / /rdzogs pa yi ni rim pa'o a yig ring po las byung ba/ /bsrung dang lha rnams bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /yi ge e dbyibs bzang po la/ /dbus su paṃ yig brgyan pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis nga rgyal gyis/ /dngos por gnas pa spros pa med/ /de nyid chos dbyings ye shes so/ /de nas sems can don mdzad gzugs/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ /ka li tha ma las byung bas/ /kun tu bzang po nyid kyi sku/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /dang po a yig thung las byung / /rang bzhin med de rang bzhin gzugs/ /kun tu bzang mo nyid kyi sku/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /de yi a gzugs bzang po ste/ /bde bar gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i gnas| /gnas der so sor 'bad pa yis/ /sems de phra mo so sor gsal//44—481

so sor rtogs pa las byung bas/ /so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /de la gzugs su rdzogs byas te/ /rnam pa du ma'i skur gyur pa/ /sum cu drug gam sum cu brgyad/ /bzhi bcu gnyis sam bzhi bcu bzhi/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes te/ /de ltar lha rnams bskyed pa ni/ /bskyed pa'i rim par gsungs pa'o/ /ting 'dzin de la legs gnas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod pa yis/ /skad cig nyid la lha rnams gsal/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i bskyed rims te/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rdzogs pa'o/ /ting 'dzin de la legs gnas nas/ /yang ni rnam rtog de mi sgom/ /rtog med kyang ni sgom mi bya/ /rtog dang mi rtog gnyis med de/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal te/ /dngos po mtshan mar dmigs pa med/ /dmigs su med pa'i ngang gnas pa/ /rnam par rtog pa skye ba med/ /skye ba med na 'gag pa med/ /skye 'gag gnyis su mi dgos pa/ /de nyid gnyis su med pa ste/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med/ /de ltar gnas nas mngon gyur pa/ /tshe 'di nyid las sangs rgyas te/ /'bras bu chos kyi sgu zhes bshad/ /dpal gsang ba'i snying po'i rim pa gnyis kyi don/ rgyal po in tra bhu dhis mdzad pa rdzogs so—/ / //44—482
bsdur mchan/481 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉rtor bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2574)44wa 483

༄ga /zhi ba'i lha rgyud ches bya ba/①kho zhi ba'i lha rgyud ces bya ba bzhugs snyokhru// ༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ de ba shān ti nā ma tan tra/ bod skad du/ zhi ba'i lha rgyud zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyes bu dam pa gang dag gis ni nges dgongs pa/ /gang la dgongs pa gang gis nges par 'grel pa ni—/ /skye med chos las skye ba'i cho 'phrul mang snang zhing / /thugs rjes zhing 'dul cho 'phrul bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye ba med las thams cad skyes shing skyes nyid skye med dang / /bdag gzhan kun rtog dbang gi 'khor la snying rje mchog gi sems/ /skyed par gsungs pa'i lung la bsten te nges don snying po la//dgongs shing gsungs mdzad lha rgyud don 'grel bdag gzhan rtog pa 'dul bar bshad—/ /phung po la sogs chos rnams byang chub sems su gcig /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs zhi gnas lhag mthong rnam pa gnyis/ /don dam nye bar brtags 44byed484

pas bde rol phan mdzad pa/ /lha rgyud dag gi ①kun smin kun gzhir gyur pas mos| /de yang gdul bya'i dbang gis mdo dang rgyas snang ba/ /gnyis gsum gnyis gnyis gsum gsum bcu bdun gcig la sogs/ /rtog 'dul mtshan ma spyi dang khyad par mtshan nyid dang / /rab 'bring tha ma'i blo yis ma 'ongs ②dus su dpyad/ /de 'ang sku mdog phyag mtshan dang / /bzhugs thabs gdan khri rgyan chas kyi/ /ma nor de nyid nges par gzung / /de nyid rnam pa lngar shes bya/ /de la dang po gnyis yin te/ /rang bzhin kyis ni sku mdog dang / /rigs kyi kha dog bstan pa yin/ /rang bzhin sku mdog bzhi ste dung dang ni/ /ku mu ta dang zla nyi ma'o/ /rigs ni lnga ste be+e drur+ya dang ni/ /kang ka ri dang le brgan lta bu dang / /gser sbyangs pa dang sna tshogs lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa la'ang gsum ste phyag mtshan dang / /phyag rgya'i rnam pa gsum ste rnam par dbye/ /phyag ni gnyis sam drug ste gzung 'dzin dang / /ye shes rnam pa drug la dgongs pa'o/ /phyag mtshan rjes mthun thabs dang shes rab dang / /dbyings dang ye shes pha rol phyin pa drug /phyag rgya bzhi ste ma bcos mi 'da' dang / /ma nges pa dang 'drel snepa las kyi rgya'o/ /ma bcos gnyis te ma skyes ma 'gags pa'o/ /ma 'gags pa yang rnam bzhir shes bya ste/ /kha dog yul dang mtshon pa'i gzugs dang ni/ /mtshan rtags nye bar brtags pa'i phyag rgya'o//mi 'da' gsum ste zin mdzad mi bskyod pa'o/ /ma nges grangs ni tha dad gcig tha yas/ /'grel pa gnyis las las dang dam tshig go/ /gsum pa gsum ste thabs gnas tshul nyid do/ /thabs ni rang bzhin khyad par rnam pa gnyis/ /gnas ni phyi nang mtha' dbus med pa ste/ /yon tan bsam yas rjod 'da' khyo44—485

gcig gnyis su/ /tshul 'di gsum gsum yang na bcu gnyis gsum/ /bzhengs dang gshegs pa dang ni gzigs pa dang / /gnyen lcug 'khril ba'i tshul dang ldem pa dang / /gzhon nu gsal mtsher tshul dang lhun sdug dang / /gzi byin 'bar ba'i tshul dang 'khrug pa'i tshul/ /dgongs dang bsten dang brten ①dang 'byongs pa'i tshul/ /'dud pa cam me ma ④le lhan ṣ+pe dang / /sal le'i tshul du spyi dang khyad par gyi/ /bye brag ci rigs par ni rnam par dpyad//gzhi la gsum ste dharmā tsakra dang / /sa yi khyad par yon tan che ba'o/ /lnga pa gnyis te rgyan chas gdan dang ldan/ /gzhan yang rnam par mang por brjod pa ste—/ /dbu rgyan snyan cha do shal 'gur chu dang/ /phreng ba se mo phyag gdub rgyan te bdun/ /chas ni sku dang gsung thugs yon tan las kyis bsgyings/ /de phyir chos gos smad dkris ze'u ldir dang / /smad g.yogs gsang dgos rnam lngas brjid par snang / /gzhan yang mtshan dpe 'phags pa'i lam la sogs/ /rdzogs par mnga' phyir sras kyi tshogs rnams kyang / /bkra shis brgyad kyis yongs su 'khyil ba'o/ /de las sogs pa dpag med brjod las 'das/ /de dag spyir snang khyad par rab snang 'di'o/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad ye shes lngar gyur pa/ /dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /rdo rje sku dang gsung dang thugs ldan pas/ /dug gsum 'jom mdzad bcom ldan rdo rje sems//kun gzhi gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes thugs/ /bde ba chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /sku yi longs spyod mtha' 'das brda mjal gsung / /dug lnga zhi mdzad bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad/ /nyon mongs yid gyur mnyam nyid ye shes thugs/ /bsam 'das brjod med dmigs med chos kyi sku/ /gzhan byi 44byed486

mi brjod rig pa'i ye shes gsung / /yon tan rgyas mdzad bcom ldan rin chen 'byung / /yid gyur so sor rtog pa'i ye shes thugs/ /mtshan rdzogs mngon par byang chub brnyes ①pa'i sku/ /ljags kyi mi brjod yi ge med pa'i gsung / /gdul bya dbang mdzad bcom ldan snang mtha' yas/ /sgo lnga gnas gyur nan tan ye shes thugs/ /thugs rje chen po cir yang sprul pa'i sku/ /ljags kyi stong gsum kun tu grags pa'i gsung / /bdag gzhan don mdzad bcom ldan don yod grub/ /ye shes thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam thar sgo gsum gnas su 'dren mdzad kyang / /thugs kyi longs spyod thams cad mi dmigs pa/ /kun 'byung yum chen nam mkha' kun tu bzang / /ye shes thugs rjes 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'god/ /re dogs med par ye shes spyan gzigs kyang / /sku'i longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs pa/ /kun skyed yum chen sa gyur sangs rgyas spyan/ /ye shes thugs rjes 'gro la ma lta bur/ /dgos 'dod re ba yid bzhin bskongs gyur kyang / /yon tan longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs pa/ /kun bsdud yum chen chu gyur mā ma ki/ /ye shes thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang / /tshul khrims gos la dri mas ma gos shing //gsung gi longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs pa/ /kun smin yum chen me 'gyur ②gos dkar mo/ /ye shes thugs rje chen po'i thugs dam gyis/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam las sgol mdzad ma/ /phrin las longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs pa/ /kun grol yum chen rlung gyur dam tshig sgrol/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes khyad par las/ /rnam par snang mdzad thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /dang po sems bskyed rin chen myu gu bsnams/ /sems las 'od 'byung thugs mchog 44—487

sa'i snying / /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes khyad par las/ /rin chen 'byung ldan thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /nyon mongs sgribs gcod shes rab ral gri bsnams/ /yon tan mthar phyin thugs mchog nam mkha'i snying / /so sor rtogs ①pa'i ye shes khyad par las/ /snang ba mtha' yas thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /shes bya'i sgrib sbyong pad ma dkar po bsnams/ /gsung dbyangs rnam dag thugs mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes khyad par las/ /don yod grub pa thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /mkhyen lnga lhun grub rdo rje rtse lnga rnams/ /phrin las mthar phyin thugs mchog rdo rje can/ /chos kyi dbyengs kyi ye shes khyad par las//rnam par snang mdzad sku yi sprul pa ni/ /dang po sems bskyed dga' bas 'gying ba'i tshul/ /sku yi 'gro 'dul badz+ra la phye ma/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes khyad par las/ /rin chen 'byung ldan sku'i sprul pa ni/ /bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rin chen phreng ba bsnams/ /yon tan 'gro ba 'dul mdzad mā bye ma/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes khyad par las/ /snang ba mtha' yas sku yi sprul pa ni/ /sku lnga lhun grub cir yang 'gyur ba'i lha/ /'phrin las 'gro 'dul badz+ra nirnyi ma/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes khyad par las/ /rnam par snang mdzad gsung gi sprul pa ni/ /gti mug las kyi chos 'chad klu shing bsnams/ /chos dbyings ye shes thugs rje byams pa'i gsung / /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes khyad par las/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gsung gi sprul pa ni/ /nga rgyal lam sbyong chos 'chad po ti bsnams—/ /mnyam nyid ye shes sgrib pa sel ba'i gsung / /so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes khyad par las/ /snang ba mtha' yas gsung gi sprul pa ni/ /'dod chags lam sbyong chos 'chad rin chen snye/ /rtogs ②pa'i ye shes kun tu 44—488

bzang po'i gsung / /bya ba nan tan ye shes khyad par las/ /don yod grub pa gsung gi sprul pa ni/ /phrag dog lam sbyong chos 'chad uta pal bsnams/ /nan tan ye shes 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i gsung / /chos dbyings ye shes rnam par snang mdzad dang / /phyogs dus 'phags pa mchod pa'i phrin las ni/ /snang ba gzugs mdzes mchod pas mnyes mdzad pa/ /spyan mnyes mdzad pa'i gzugs mchog me tog ma/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen 'byung ldan dang / /phyogs dus rgyal ba mchod pa'i 'phrin las ni/ /dri 'byung ye shes mchod pas mnyes mdzad pa/ /shangs mnyes mdzad phyir dri mchog bdug pa ma/ /rtog pa'i ye shes snang ba mtha' yas dang / /phyogs dus rgyal ba mchod pa'i 'phrin las ni/ /sgra gsang sgra snyan mchod pas mnyes byed de/ /sgras mnyes mdzad pa rdo rje sgol ma'i sku/ /nan tan ye shes don yod grub pa dang / /phyogs dus rgyal ba mchod pa'i 'phrin las ni/ /rol pas reg bya'i mchod pas mnyes mdzad pa/ /sku mnyes mdzad phyir reg bya'i dri chab ma/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /shar phyogs lha'i 'jig rten 'joms mdzad pa/ /lta ngan lam sbyong chos 'chad pi wang bsnams/ /brdung ba zhi mdzad lha dbang brgya byin sku/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /shar phyogs lha min 'jig rten don mdzad pa/ /nga rgyal lam sbyong chos 'chad go cha bsnams//'thab rtsod zhi mdzad lha min thags bzangs rigs/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /shar phyogs mi yi 'jig rten don mdzad pa/ /phrag dog lam sbyong chos 'chad sreg spar bsnams/ /'gyur ba zhi mdzad mi dbang shākya thub/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /shar phyogs 44—489

byol song 'jig rten don mdzad pa/ /gti mug lam spyong chos 'chad po ti bsnams| /glen lkugs zhi mdzad seng ge rab brtan mgon/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /shar phyogs yi dwags 'jig rten don mdzad pa/ /'dod chags lam sbyong chos 'chad rin chen sgrom/ /bgres skom sdug bsngal zhi mdzad kha 'bar ma/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyis—/ /shar phyogs dmyal ba'i 'jig rten don mdzad pa/ /zhe sdang lam sbyong chos 'chad me chu bsnams/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal/ /ye shes bzhi la rigs bzhi phrin las kyis/ /drug gi 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya ru//sprul pa bye ba phrag brgyas 'gro drug gis/ /don rnams ji ltar 'dul mdzad thub pa drug /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes khyad par las/ /rnam par snang mdzad drag po'i 'phrin las ni/ /sku yi dngos po 'joms pas thod dbyug bsnams/ /de phyir shar sgo bsrung ba'i gshin rje'i gshed/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes khyad par las/ /rin chen 'byung ldan 'phrin las drag pos ni/ /thugs kyi dngos po 'joms pas rdo rjes gnon/ /de phyir lho sgo bsrung ba'i rnam par rgyal/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes byin brlabs las/ /snang ba mtha' yas 'phrin las drag pos ni/ /gsung gi dngos po 'joms mdzad thod sbrul gnon/ /de phyir nub phyogs bsrung ba'i rta mgrin dpal/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes khyad par las//don yod grub pa'i 'phrin las drag po ni/ /'phrin las dngos po 'joms mdzad rgya gram gnon/ /de phyir byang sgo bsrung ba'i bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes khyad par las/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'phrin las drag pos ni—/ /brtag pa lta ba 'joms bsdud lcags kyu bsnams/ /log 'dren snying 44—490

'dren rta gdong lcags kyu ma/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes khyad par las/ /rin chen 'byung ldan 'phrin las drag pos ni/ /chad par lta ba 'joms bsdud zhags pa bsnams/ /log lta zhi mdzad phag gdong zhags pa ma/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes khyad par las/ /snang ba mtha' yas 'phrin las drag pos ni/ /mtshan ma lta ba dbang bsdud lcags sgrog bsnams/ /log lta dbang bsdud nyi zla lcags sgrog ma/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes khyad par las/ /don yod grub pa'i phrin las drag pos ni/ /bdag tu lta ba 'joms mdzad dril bu bsnams/ /log lta brlag byed thal byed dril bu ma/ /stong pa nyid kyis ye shes khyad par las//'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'i rnam rtog rnams/ /bde chen mnyam pa'i ngang la 'god mdzad pas/ /phyag zhabs mnyam bzhag yid gyur kun tu bzang / /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes khyad par las/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kun—/ /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i dbyings gyur pas/ /gsang gsal phyag rgya chos gyur kun bzang mo/ /kun 'byung kun gzhi chos nyid dbyings/ /ma skyes mi 'gag kun tu snang / /smra bsam brjod med yul las 'das/ /mtha' yas mtha' yas bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /mi rtog ngang las rtog nyid du/ /brtags pas stong pa gang byung ba/ /de nyid rtags pa chen po ste/ /gang mi rtogs pa rtog pa'i rgyu/ /stong nyid mi g.yo nam mkha' la/ /mi bskyod bde bar gshegs mdzad pa'i/ /mi dmigs mi rtog de bzhin nyid/ /rtog pa sna tshogs bskyed par mdzod/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi snying po las rang bzhin kun tu snang ba'i dngos/ /yong la khyab pa'i snying rje'i yum/ /mtha' yas rgyal sras bskyed par mdzod/ /tha dad rnam par snang mdzad nas/ /44—491

gsung gi phyag rgya'i ye shes las/ /rgyal ba rnams ni yi ger snang / /yi ge ye shes bskyed par mdzod/ /ye shes pha rol phyin rdzogs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor rig pa'i sgo mtshon pa/ /thugs kyi rtag snang snang bar mdzod/ /rnam grol ye shes snang bar mdzod/ /stong nyid mi rtog ye shes las/ /ma skyes mi 'gag gzugs snang ba/ /mkha' la 'ja' snang ji bzhin du/ /dbyings las phyag rgya bzhes su gsol—/ /de nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin te/ /rang byung yi ge sum̐ du gsal/ /thams cad yi ge'i rang bzhin te/ /ma skyes gsal ba'i yi ge aḥ/ /sems nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin te/ /sna tshogs yi ge hūṃ du gsal/ /dug gis nad sel ji bzhin du/ /rtog pas rtog pa zhi bar mdzod/ /dang po'i las can nges par 'byung ba'i gdul bya dag /rab 'byung tha mas mtshan ma med dang mtshan ma yi/ /rnal 'byor rim pas 'bad de nyams su blangs bya'o/ /dam pa'i dgongs pa dman pas dpag par mi 'os kyang / /bsam pas da ltar ma 'ongs dus kyi ①bdag gzhan la/ /phan phyir lung la ston pa'i bka' sgros rjed byang 'di/ /tshig don 'gal 'khrul 'phags dang mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /de ltar mos pa dag dang mos pa'i dga' ba gang dang gang / /bsam dpyod dge bskul shes rab 'phel 'gyur gcig pa yi/ /dge ba ci mchis ma 'ongs don du bsngos pa yis/ /'di la mos pa mtha' dag grol zhing smin gyur cig /slob dpon bi ma la mi tras/ zhang dz+nyā na la gnang / rgyud thams cad kyi 'grel pa/ lung dam pa'i bcud/ man ngag mtha' dag gi snying po/ rnal 'byor gyi lam dam pa/ log pa'i rtog pa zhi bar byed pa/ zhi ba rtog pa'i lha rgyud do/ /gang dag dam pa 'di la mos pa med/ /snod min 44—492

rnams dang nam du'ang ma 'phrad cig /gal te 'phrad na'ang mos pa skye ba dang //mos shing 'phrad nas smin zhing grol bar shog /rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/484 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉'tho/485 ①〈〈pe 〉stagos/ ②〈〈pe 〉skorong / ③〈〈pe 〉skaragrel/ du〈〈pe 〉toradas/486 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brtan/ ②〈〈pe 〉stabal/487 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brnyed/ ②〈〈pe 〉ngomar/488 ①②〈〈pe 〉mnyag492 ①〈〈pe 〉4)sa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2575)44wa 493

kyi sgrub pa bzhugs so//①ragyi/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye ba rnam dag 'di nyid kyis/ /dbang bsgyur de tshe thob bya'i phyir/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen pa/ /bsgrub pa dang ni bsgrub chen po/ /dkyil 'khor bdun pa la brten te/ /dus tshogs bsgrub pa'i mchog nyid 'di/ /dang po 'jigs byed rol pa yi/ /dbang thob brtags pa'i rgyal sras la/ /rgyud ①pa'i chu bo bstem byas te/ /blo la nges pa'i lung du bstan/ /gzhan du nams kyang mi bstan cing / /bzhon dang spyad dang 'tshong la sogs/ /longs spyod rnam pa 'byor pa dang / /rdzas kyi nor phyir ma yin no/ /rmongs la 'phyar dang brtson 'grus zhan/ /nams kyang sbyin par ma gsungs te/ /smad pa bam kyi gter bzhin du/ /sus kyang phyin par ma gsungs la/ /srog chags kha'i gtam bzhin du/ /rnams kyang smra bar mi bya'o//gnas dang longs spyod ci bde dang / /ma nyams blo ni rab ldan pas/ /dang 44byed494

por dam mnos bzhin du bya/ /yan lag ma nyams yo byad ldan/ /cho ga rdzogs par shes pa yi/ /rnal 'byor tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /nges par legs pa'i dgongs pa 'grub/ /le lo bsgyid snyom ①med pa'i sa/ /the tshom med par bsgrub byas na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /phun sum tshogs pa lngar ldan pas/ /mi 'chang glu gar phyag rgya dang / /shes rab thabs su shes pa dang / /byang chub sems kyi mchod pa dang / /brda' la sogs pa'i yon tan ldan/ /mdor na tshab dkar phyag rgya dang / /ging dang bya rog spyan pa dang / /rdul phyags la sogs yon tan ldan/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo'/ /longs spyod lnga gnyis ldan pa yis/ /mdor na tshogs rnams mngon du bsgrub/ /dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chen/ /rdo rje dung chen dmar rtsis gang / /dung dang srog shing gsar rnying dang / /rgyal mtshan gsang ba'i rtog ldan pa/ /rgyan btags bco brgyad 'bar ba dang / /rol mo'i bye brag tshang ba dang / /sman dang sman par bcas pa dang / /rgyal po 'bru dang dung chen rgyu/ /gangs chu badz+ra ki la ya/ /tshogs kyi mchog tu dmigs pas bzhag /lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /dbye 'am yang na mi dbye bar—/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen pa/ /bsgrub pa dang ni bsgrub chen po/ /yum gyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus la/ /dge ④mnyam mchog gi sbyin pas bstem/ /bsgrub pa nyi zla'i snying po de/ /'gro drug dus gnas de dag snang / /mchod pa chen po mnyam sbyor zhing / /dkyil 'khor rdo rje lce yis blang / /mkha' 'gro gsal 'bar tshe la sogs/ /yid bzhin sprin gyi bdag por 'gyur/ /zhing 44—495

gyur mchog dang mchog phran rnams/ /nyi zla'i steng du mkhas pas bzhag /gag gcad bsgal ba'i rim pa bzhin/ /e la ma btang ji bzhin pas/ /nga rgyal lag gi 'du byed bsgom/ /hūṃ du gyur pas rnam pa ①dag /dbyings su thim nas phyag rgyar 'bar/ /skur gyur 'od zer 'phro bas brjid/ /gtsug tu rnam par rgyal ba bsgom/ /smon lam byang chub lam du bzhug /smon lam gnas su the tshom med/ /glu bros sbyangs te char phab na②/ /dngos kyang bsngo ba dag par bya/ /ngo mtshar ngan 'gro thar pa'i thabs/ /ye nas skye med de bzhin nyid/ /sgyu mar snang ba mig yor tshul/ /gnyi gar rnam bzhi dag pas na//sbyor bsgrol bya ba kun byas kyang / /rdul cha tsam kyang byas pa med/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /drug cu rtsa dgu bcu rtsa drug la sogs/ /'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /'jigs byed tshogs la bdag lus 'bul//de nyid dkyil 'khor nyid du brtag /rdzas dang sa gzhi brtags nas ni/ /so sor byin brlabs tshul bzhin bya/ /gtsug tor bsgyur ba'i snying po dang / /gsum dang 'tshogs pas gdab pa dang / /yon tan snying pos bya ba dang / /'dza gad ka pā la de bzhin/ /rgyan dang bsgrub po tshul bzhin bya/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /brdeng dang bcas pa'i bsam pa yis re ba med par rab sgrub phyir/ /dang por mchod sbyin dam pas mchod/ /sa gzhi rab tu mnyams pa der/ /rgyang grags dpag tshad la sogs pa/ /lus gang lus do gsum gyi tshad/ /nyi shu rtsa lngas rab mnyams pa 'am/ /dur khrod chag chag ldan pa der/ /thig gdab rgyal pos byin brlabs gzhi/ /ldan pas ba su thig gis drangs/ /srog dang ldan pa'i kha dog lngas/ /phyag rgya gzungs dang snying po 44—496

lnga rnams/ /lnga'i tshon gyis srog ldan zi/ /gsang ba'i don byi las byos shig /phyogs mabyedas bar chad gdul ba'i phyir/ /thams cad rdo rje brag stengs su/ /khro bo mang po bkram nas ni/ /me ri dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar/ /phyi rol dam sri chos rgyal las/ /rdzogs byas bdud rtsi gsang sngags ldan/ /srog dang ldan brjod klog bzhin dbyer/ /gzugs dang lugs chen dung mchog sogs/ /ci 'dod snang bar bdag gis bgod/ /gnas dang zla dang rdzas rnams ni/ /bar gsang ldan pas mchog tu bzhag /mig gi rten yang legs par bri/ /gsol ba'i sdod mchog byed bzhin bzhag /gdan gral byed pas mnga' gsol te—/ /sngon gyi byin dang ldan pas kyang / /bdag don gnyis pa thob par bya/ /dur khrod bdag po bsdus mnan te/ /shes pa byang chub bsrung ba'i lha/ /khog par rang bzhin dur khrod gnas/ /bzhi phyir zhugs te rten du bya/ /sdom pa nyi shu ldan pa yis/ /lhag par mtshan nas rdzas rdul med/ /nye bar bsnyen pa'i dbang thob nas/ /rtag pa rnam gsum lung dang sbyar/ /'bras bu'i sa lnga goms byas te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /chos dbyings rnam dag dkyil 'khor la/ /gsang sngags spyi'i dkyil 'khor las/ /shes 'jug yum byi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /rang gi rig pas ci nus par/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /'jigs byed dbang du bdag zhugs nas//khro mo ji snyed 'khor du bya/ /rgyan dang cha lugs la sogs pa/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs ni ji bzhin par/ /tsha rngam chen po'i cha lugs bsgom/ /spyi 'am yang na re rer ni/ /byed bu gang gi lha rnams bsgom/ /gsang ba'i snying po nyid bshams te/ /'das pa dag tu mnyam sbyar zhing / /byin brlabs dbang gis 44—497

mdzes par bya/ /thugs kyi sngags kyis spyan drangs nas/ /dor bskul mchod bstod tshul bzhin bya/ /bdag gi lus la zhugs tshul du/ /de'i gzugs bzung mchog tu bstem/ /bstan nas gnad ①la phab byas te/ /dam tshig bstan zhing zil gnan bsdu/ /phyag 'tshal dam tshig mchod pa bya④/ /ting 'dzin rdzas rnams mnyes byas te/ /'dod don gsol ba tshul bzhin bya/ /glu drug 'phrin las sngon bzhin du/ /dbyangs drug blangs pas don drug gsal/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bsnyen pa ni/ /rnal 'byor 'phra mo sbyangs pas bya/ /yum gyi mkha' la dngos grub blang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'phro 'du ni/ /rnam gsum tshul du srog dang ldan/ /'bru brgyad don ni kha las shes/ /bar chad ting 'dzin mchog gis bzlog /spyod lam gdan sogs bsrung ba bya/ /gos rgyan bza' btung glu dang tshig /hūṃ du shes pas spyad par bya/ /'jigs byed chen po'i ting 'dzin dang / /nyams pa med pa'i sems kyis spyad/ /bro gar skabs su bzhi phyir bya/ /bar chad med par sngon bzhin bsgrub/ /zhag grangs tshang zhing rtags byung na/ /dkyil 'khor 'thun pa nyid du sbyar/ /gzugs sgra dri 'od du ba dang / /'dzum g.yo ston dang 'od zer 'phro/ /'phar 'khor 'bar dang mtshan ma rnams/ /nyam ④kyi phyag rgya rang don sad/ /phyed pas bzlog dang spogs par bya/ /in tra sgo ti buku ku ri pa bzhin/ /dngos grub mchog shes blang bar bya/ /brgyan pa bgegs pa pho nya dang / /tshangs pa dbang po 'dod dbang dang / mdor na bcu gnyis gling gi bdag /drag shul mthu yi dregs pa can/ /dngas ④shing brgyal te blo stor nas/ /bum pa bzang po 'bul bar 'gyur/ /lha mo klu mo brgyan pa dang / /rta dang glang po 44byed498

bzhon pa dang / /gnas dang ster dang bgo ba dang / /gtsug na nor bu yod pa dang / /ci 'dod yid la bsams pa 'bul/ /de la bran bzhin byed par 'gyur—/ /de yi dgos pa thams cad ni/ /ma lus kun rdzogs 'grub par 'gyur//de 'dra'i mtshan ma mthong gyur na/ /rdo rje bla ma'i ngag bzhin bya/ /dngos su phan gnod bzlog blang bya/ /lha dang rdzas dang yo byad lnga'i/ /grub pa tshul bzhin bsdu bya ste/ /mthing nag 'bar ba'i yig 'bru ni/ /khyung chen ldings tsam mtsho ser bzhin/ /bstems sogs ting 'dzin ldan par bya/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du thib①/ /rigs 'dzin dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus 'bar bar 'gyur/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal sel bar byed//rdo rje rigs su skye ba'i gnas/ /mi gnas nam mkha'i mtha' babe+es par/ /goms par 'dod pas 'gro ba dang / /chu la sa bzhin 'gro ba dang / /bsreg bya 'bar ba'i dbus gnas dang / /tsha ba rlung gis bteg nas kyang / /phyogs bcu kun tu phyin par 'gyur/ /lus dang phung por bcas pa yis tshe la dbang ba'i rigs ②'dzin 'grub/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshe nyid kyis/ /bla med kun tu bzang por 'gyur/ /lus ma spangs par rigs 'dzin sa/ /yun rings chos kyi bde spyad nas/ /bla med rdo rje sems dpa'i sa/ /dpe byad mtshan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /mngon shes drug ldan thams cad mdon/ /tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par rosde/ /sangs rgyas zhing la dbang bsgyur zhing //spyod yul kun tu ma 'da' la/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /rnal 'byor las su rung rnams kyis/ /'bras bu mngon du ma byung yang / /lus ngag yid la dbang thob nas/ /sangs rgyas 'byung dang bskal mnyam 'gyur/ /44—499

khyung dang seng phrug ji lta bar/ /rnam smin rigs su the tshom med/ /kun kyang 'gro ba'i don du bsngo/ /sgyu 'phrul tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ thugs kyi sgrub pa rdzogs sto// //bsdur mchan/494 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉thargyud/495 ①〈〈pe 〉〉stoms/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dges/496 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgar/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanas/498 ①〈〈pe 〉stananas/ ②〈〈pe 〉thams/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉nyams/ ④〈〈pe 〉sngag tri/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉dngangs/499 ①〈〈pe 〉〉thim/ ②〈〈pe 〉stareg ①〈〈pe 〉stadzal/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2576)44wa 500

'od kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba/①ga rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'od kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra satwa ma ya dz+wa la pra ba mu dra na ma/bod skad du/ rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'od kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba/dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos po ji bzhin par son pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /gzhi gcig dngos mjal don son pa'i/ /rnam gsum tshul du phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyud mchog sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /rnal 'byor phyi ma'i don phyed du/ /tshom bu gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor byi/ /bsgrub thabs rim pa 'di brtsams so/ /dang po pa yi rnal 'byor pas/ /shis par mthad pa'i sa phyogs su/ /sa'i bya ba kun byas nas/ /bar chad rnam gsum gsal ba'i phyir/ /yo byad rnam gsum tshang bar bsog /stegs bu khru bzhi tshad du brtsig /ba yu rkyang nyul byas nas kyang/ /bar chad bgegs rnams 44—501

bsal bar bya/ /thig dang tshon gyi rab gnas sogs/ /shin tu rgyas par bya ba yin/ /de dag bri ba'i cho ga ni/ /rtsibs bzhi gru chad sgo ru bcas/ /yi ge gdan dang snying po sogs/ /rgyan dang bcas par bri ba yin/ /rgyan dang mtshams dang dam rdzas brlab/ /rim pa bzhin du bya bar gsungs/ /bsgrub pa'i las dag bya ba yang / /rgyu'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang / /'bras bu'i 'khor lo bstem pa dang / /mnyes pa'i yan lag bya ba dang / /rgyun byi ting 'dzin nyid du bshad/ /dngos rnams nyid na dngos med pas/ /rtog pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /de phyir dngos po dngos med do/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ata ma ko haṃ/ lus ngag sems dang chos thams cad/ /gang na'ang mi gnas mi dmigs pa/ /mig yor tshul du sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bsgom/ /rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun gye rtsa ba yin/ /sems nyid yi ge'i ngo bo ste/ /yi ge yid bzhin rin chen sprin/ /yi ge'i mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /aḥ shin tu brtan gyur a dkar las/ /yongs su phra ba'i a 'phros pas/ /phyogs kun gang zhing gsal gyur nas/ /bsdus kyang 'phel 'grib med par brtan/ /thams cad yi ger gsal byas nas/ /spros pas kun gang la la thim/ /snang srid ming tsam nyid du gyur/ /de nyid nam mkhar gsal ba las/ /de las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /e yo baṃ lo re/mthing dang dud kha dkar ser dang / /dmar la dang bas brtan par bya/ /de steng dkyil du bye 'phros pas/ /yongs gyur gzhal yas khang du gyur/ /ye shes rin chen dbyibs gru bzhi/ /mu khyud palca glo 'bur bcas/ /lam gyis 44—502

bsgrod phyir rta babs brgyad/ /de'i 'bras bu brgyad rdzogs phyir/ /sna 'phyong rin chen za ra tshags/ /chu skyes rta rkang sgom bu dang / /sgril 'chang shar spu khyung mgo sogs/ /dbyibs dang kha dog mdzes par ldan/ /tha snyad rang rig sems snang phyir/ /rtse mo rma bya'i mdongs lta bus/ /ji ltar bltas pa ①de ltar snang / /kun tu snyoms phyir byar 'dabs ldan/ /seng mgo kha nas mu tig 'phro//pha gu dra ba dra phyed dang / /gzugs kyi lha mo rnam par spras/ /gzhan yang rgyan mchog rim par ldan/ /pho brang rtsibs bzhi dbus dang ldan/ /de las sgo bas rnam par brgyan/ /khri rkang brgyad ldan de bar du/ /seng ge brgyad kyis rnam par spras/ /de steng rin chen pad+ma dang / /nyi zla gnyis te lnga yis brgyan/ /sgo ru nyi rkang rnam par bsam/ /dbus su hūṃ dang k+shi las ni/ /rdo rje dril bur gyur pa las/ /mi skyod yab yum rnam bsgom ste/ /mthing kha rdo rje dril 'dzin pa—/ /yum dang yab du 'dra ba las/ /g.yas pas yab khyud ⑧g.yon dril bu/ /sku ru bstan pa rnam par bsam/ /hūṃ dang dza dang ho du las/ /rtsibs bzhi rim bzhin sems dpa' bzhi/ /sems dpa' la sogs bzhi po dag /cho ga gsum gyis rdzogs par bskyed/ /sgo bzhir sgo ba yab yum brgyad/ /bco brgyad rnam par bsam pa ni/ /rgyu'i 'khor lo bskyed par gsungs/ /'bras bu la yang rnam pa gnyis/ /ting 'dzin 'khor lo bskyed pa dang / /ye shes 'khor lo bstem par bshad/ /ting 'dzin 'khor lo bskyed pa ni/ /gtso bo'i thugs las bdag phye nas/ /'jig rten mas ①po sras kyi cha/ /bzung la gsol ba gdab par bya/ /sems nyid theg par rab nges pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /tshom bu gcig pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /sku gsung 44—503

thugs su bdag sbyor cig /bskul bas 'od 'phros gnas gsum sbyangs/ /sgrib pa med pa'i yi ge gsum/ /zla rlung sbyor bas bteg nas ni/ /bskor ba byas te thugs khar thim/ /rdo rje'i lam byung chos yum mkha'/ /byang chub sems su thim par bsam/ /sgra byung kun rol 'od du gyur/ /de las hūṃ k+shi gnyis su gyur/ /de las rdo rje dril bu ste/ /de las yongs su rdzogs par bskyedaske/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yi/ /mthing kha yab yum yang dag bsgom/ /byen brlab dbang bskur mkha' gsang brlab/ /sku gsung thugs kyi nga rgyal bya/ /brda' bskul gnyis med sbyar ba las/ /yum gyi mkha' la dkyil 'khor bgod/ /thig le yi ge phyag mtshan dang / /rdzogs par bskyed la hūṃ mdzad bton/ /rang gi gnas su bgod pa yin/ /de'i sngags ni 'di dag go/ /hūṃ badz+ra dh+rika /k+shi jo tī shwa ri/ oṃ badz+ra satwa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra la se oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rā dzā saṃ/oṃ badz+ra dhu pe e/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a gu sha dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra sa du a/oṃ badz+ra de shwa ra ti oṃ/ hūṃ bigha nan ta krid phaṭa/ badz+ra a gu sha dza①ཿ/ hūṃ ya man ta krid phaṭa/ badz+ra pa sha hūṃ/ hūṃ pad mān ta krid phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho ṭa baṃ—/ hūṃ pradz+nyān ta krid phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gasne hoḥ/ de ltar sngags kyis gsal byas nas/ /de la dbang bskur byen brlab pa/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas pa ji bzhin sbyar/ /rin chen smug po dziṣ+ṭha ru/ /mtshon gang 'od can bsgom pa'o/ /de rnams sku'i mtshan nyid dang / /dgu dang ldan par bsgom mo zhes/ /dus gsum rgyal bas gsungs pas na/ /mkhas pa de'i rjes su 'brang / /'di ni ting 'dzin 'khor lo'o/ /ye shes 'khor lo bstem sdepa ni/ /phyogs bsdus dzas bskul rdo rjer bzhengs/ /phyogs bsdus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che/ /44—504

mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo //rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam spyor bas//phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa'i/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ /nye bar gyur pa'i dam tshig mchog /kye kye bcom ldan 'das kyis dgug /dza hūṃ baṃ hos gnyis med bya/ /de la me tog dor bar bya/ /ye shes rgyal po la sogs pa—/ /gzhung rgyas tshig gis 'jigs phyir dang / /gzhan las snang bas bri ma byasaske/ /'di ni ye shes dkyil 'khor rnams/ /bstem pa yin zhes rnam par bstan—/ /mnyes pa'i yan lag bya ba ni/ /①sngags brjod dngos po gnas bzhin bca'/ / dang po phyag rgya'i rim pa ni/ /④gung mo sprad pa gtso bo'i min—/ /mthe bong mdzub mo rdo rje 'dzin/ /mthe bong gung mo rgyal ba 'dzin/ /srin lag mthe bong chags pa che/ /mthe'u chung mthe bong legs pa mchog /sgo bzhi khro bo'i phyag rgya ni/ /rim par bca' zhes yin par gsungs/ /dam rdzas lhag pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /glu dang rol mo ye shes dang / /spyor sgol tshogs kyi mchod pa dang / /dbang po yul 'dus rig pa kun/ /gnyis med rgyan kyi mchod pa ste/ /bsam dang brjod dang sprul byas te/ /lha la lha thim tshul gyis ni—/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bzang po mchod/ /bsod nams tshogs chen thob phyir ro/ /'di ni mnyes pa'i yan lag ces/ /chos brtags phyag rgya bzhi po dang / /'di mi 'gal ba yin pa yis/ /gzhung du rnam par bkod pa yin/ /zhor 'byung bsgom rim lam bshad pa/ /dang po stong pa chen pos ste/ /cir yang mi dmigs rnam pa bsgom/ /sna tshogs dmigs pa chen po 'di/ /mi spang de la rnam par rol/ /de la sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad ldan/ /kun la rnam par 44—505

bsam par bya/ /de la hūṃ du 'dris pa 'am/ /gang yang rung bar bsgoms pa dang / /de las dmigs pa brtan pa dang / /spros bsdus rdo rje 'bar dril bcas—/ /de las phyag mtshan bsnams pa yi/ /lha'i dkyil 'khor nyid du bsgom—/ /de las sna tshogs dkyil 'khor la/ /lha ni bla ma'i rim pa bzhin/ /bkod de gsal bar gyur pa dang / /gong ma de las ma nyams par/ /de nyid yan lag spros bdag ste/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs yan lag lha/ /yab yum gnyis la de bzhin du/ /lhag ma la ①yang de bzhin sbyar/ /yang na dpag tshad rgyang grags sam/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni bsam yas par/ /sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /de ltar goms pa'i rim mchog des/ /ji ltar bsam pa bzhin du 'grub/ /tshe ni bcu dang drug pa yis/ /brgya brgya dag tu bsnur zhing gnas/ /lus ma bor bar sangs rgyas pa/ /mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'das/ /'di ni lhun grub rigs ④'dzin pa'o/ /rgyun gyi thig le dbyings su'o/ /de las lha'i sku bskyed la/ /rtog tshogs lha'i dkyil 'khor du//gsal byas rtse gcig ting 'dzin gyis/ /bzlas dang bsgom pa rgyun tu bya/ /'gro nyal 'dug sdod spyod lam bzhir/ /mi 'bral bsam pa rgyun du bya/ /'di ni rgyun gyi ting 'dzin no/ /sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa'i rgyud chen las/ /lung dang man ngag gter dag gis/ /bco brgyad grub pa'i man ngag 'dis/ /gar khyab bla med byang chub shog /slob dpon bi ma la'i slob ma/ rgyal ba bzang po dpal sbas pas/ yul ma ga dhar gshegs pa'i dus su mdzad pa/ 'od kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i sgyu 'phrul rdzogs sto// //'phan yul gyi brag khyang du bi ma la mi tras/ tshwa na ku ma ra la bka' stsal 44—506

te/ bsdus pa la mos pa'i don du bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/501 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/5༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉pas/ ②〈〈pe 〉stagargyud/ ②〈〈pe 〉stabs/5༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dz+ra/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bstems/505 ①〈〈pe 〉ṅkadang po phyag rgya'i rim pa ni// ②〈〈pe 〉ridang po phyag rgya'i rim pa ni//ga 6 ①〈〈pe 〉〉lha/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rigabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2577)44wa 507

༄ga /sde bo las kyi 'phreng ba bsdus pa bzhugs so//①༄tsho/ /skal par gsang sngags skyen mdzad pa'i/ /khro bo'i tshul can sa 'dzin dregs/ /btul bas de 'dra'i sgo bgag phyir/ /sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa'i sku/ /rdo rje srin po te ru ka /ma lus bdag la gnyis med 'dud—/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud dag las/ /spros la mos thob don phyir du/ /he ru ka dpal 'phrin las mchog /las kyi phreng ba cung zad bsdu/ /nga yi thugs kyi snying po 'di/ /spyod dang bsgom dang bzlas pa dang / /sdom pa kun la ④mkhas pa yi/ /bsgom pa sran dang chos phyogs dang / /bstan pa 'dzin par nus pa yi/ /mi 'khrug blo zab rkyen thub cing / /zla dang bcas pa dam tshig ste/ /sbyor ba gnyis ga mkhas pa dang / /lung dang tshad du ldan thub dang / /gzhan la brnyad par mi byed cing / /bstan pa mchod pa byed pa dang / /nye ba'i bsnyen pa dam tshig la/ /bsgrub pa bsnyen pa nye bsnyen pa/ /ci nus par 44byed508

ni shin tu brtson/ /sems can ngang tshul kun bor nas/ /gang gi yid kyang mi 'khrug cing / /mchod pa stob la tshogs la rub/ /bud med dgug la gtso la 'bul/ /zungs thub gsang la mkhas pa yi/ /nges pa can la shin tu gtad//dam tshig mi ldan spyod pa brtsing / /gting nas bstan par mi 'dzin la/ /'dod chags spel bar mi byed cing / /rigs ngan pho mo 'dod spyod dang / /spro thung 'dod chags rab tu che/ /blo zhan phrag dog sgo bkur can/ /gnyid che chang dad brtson 'grus chung / /slob la mi gus nan tan med/ /slob dpon mi dran yun sems chung / /gal te dam la gnas na yang / /nga yi gsang ba 'dzin pa la/ /mngon du dga' bar mi nus te/ /lta zhan bka' las 'das pa dang / /grol bar dka' zhing nus mthu zhan/ /mun dang sgog dang skye bo la/ /gar dbe+en 'phrad par 'dod spyod cing / /'dod chags dga' lam de dag la/ /tshig rnams gsang ba smra byed pa/ /dngos kyi don dang mthun pa las/ /skal pa 'jig rten bar du yang / /thugs kyi bde ba mi spro zhing / /nam yang bstan par mi bya'o/ /gal te rmongs pas byin pa na/ /rims dang nad kyis srog gcad de/ /rtsa ba yan lag yangs pa yin/ /bsrad ①dang sbrebs par yun ring gnas/ /dus brtags tshogs skos ting 'dzin drod/ /ti ra gnas 'phrog dur khrod nyul/ /mchod pa'i phud dang phud kha 'dzin/ /gza' skar dus mangs 'tshogs ma 'tshogs④/ /nyams dang ma nyams bsgom mi bsgom—/ /ging dkar gnas stobs ma stobs dang / /phyi bgegs thul dang ma thul dang / /mchod pa che chung khyed ma khyed/ /nyung phyir shin tu nan tur bya//de bas gzhung don yid 'ong gnas/ /rnyed nas bya ba kun rdzogs bya/ /shin 44—509

tu skar ma rgyal rnams la/ /brgyad dang nyi shu la sogs dus/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i zhag ①grangs dag /gang ltar rigs pa'i nan tan bya/ /skal ldan 'byor ldan dga' ldan tshogs/ /dang po bsgribs te gsal ba ni/ /sdom la gnas pa'i dka' thub can/ /zas dang longs spyod mi mthun dang / /lta spyod mthun yang nang mi mthun/ /phyi nang can dang gnod byed can/ /'dod pas myos dang zas la skam/ /dad med bsgom bsgrub mi nus pa/ /'di dag gsal bar gsungs pa'o/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje 'a ga byed cing / /dza gad byin rmis ma brlobs la/ /gsang ba bsgrub pa mang po la/ /yin dang ma yin drod du bsten/ /rnal 'byor che btsan khyad par kyis/ /spyod lam mi rigs mi gsal zhing / /lta spyod dman pas las mi 'grub/ /sbyor dang bsgol ba'i sgo 'gegs shing / /rnal 'byor 'di ni zhags pas bcings/ /slob ma 'di ni gti mug 'phangs/ /ye shes chen po'i phan don gyis②/ /grub pa pho mo kun nas kyang / /dam rdzas med na las mi 'grub/ /'di ni sangs rgyas lung dang 'gal—/ /dad pas rkyen dang bsdo phod na/ /blo rna thos pa 'dzin pa dang / /brtson 'grus me sbrul bzhin 'bad dang / /brtul zhugs thogs pa med pa dang //yid rings sgrub pa mi gtong dang / /phyi nang rgyud gzhung mkhas pa dang / /brda dang lan gyi phyag rgya mkhas/ /las su bya ba zhum med bsdu/ /slob dpon gzungs 'khor tshab dkar ging / /rdul phyag gnas dang rdzas brtag bslab/ /mkhas slob mi rtogs ④nyams pa'i bdud/ /kar ma bab col las kyi bdud/ /'ga' na spyan shos lha bu'i bdud/ /sta na me bral srin bu'i bdud/ /cho ga lnga ni rdzogs byas shing / /yo byad lnga ni rdzogs par ldan/ /sngags kyi yan lag lnga 44—510

rdzogs pas/ /ma nyams 'jug la rab brtson na/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam—/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang bsgyur rigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ /bdag phyir bcu drug tshun chad kyis/ /sku lnga lhun rdzogs the tshom med—/ /cig shos phyir na skal pa yi/ /grangs med gnas kyang gzhon pa'i tshul—/ /ji ltar 'os shing rig pa dang / /rang gis 'byor pa rjes 'thun pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs thar pa'i mchog /ro la sogs pa dpa' bo gcig /zlas rgyas la sogs yang dag ldan/ /tshe ni mchog tu mdzes pa'o/ /snying po'i tshim byed mchog yin te/ /dri zhim dmar po nyid du 'dod/ /'jam pa gos su yang dag bshad/ /dbyangs ni snyan par bya ba dang / /gzi brjid dri zhim nyid du 'dod/ /thar pa chen po shin tu mdzes/ /btsun mo la sogs reg phyung ba/ /gtor ma 'di ni nang gir bshad/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs sems can lnga/ /bsgrub pa'i rdzas su gsungs pa yang / /grub byed nyen dang bral ba yi①—/ /sdig med sha khrag mchod ston bya/ /nya sha chang dang bu ram chang / /bza' dang sran ma'i khur ba dang / /dri dang me tog la sogs ldan/ /gtor ma 'di ni phyi ru bshad/ /phyi nang yo byad lnga rnams la/ /mchog dang mchog phran dung chen rnams/ /mtshan dang brtag pa rnam brgyad bya/ /byen brlabs so so'ang dag par bya/ /yan lag phrin las sbyang ④dang gnas/ /gnyis gnyis rdzogs bya bskrad bsrungs mas/ /rim pa bzhin du rdzogs pa dang / /rten dang ldan pas byin gyis brlab/ /dngos rnams nyid na dngos med pas/ /rtog pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /de phyir dngos po dngos med do/ /lus dang ngag sems chos thams cad/ /gang 44—511

na'ang mi gnas mi dmigs pa'i/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mig yor tshul du sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bsgom/ /phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad la/ /rang byung chen pos kun tu khyab/ /rang byung de nyid dngos med par/ /kun gyi phyag rgya'i rgyu yin no/ /sngon po hūṃ nyid te ru'i dngos—/ /ye shes mkha' la shar ba dang / /e yi ra ke re zhes brjod/ /dur khrod 'byung po'i sa gzhir gyur/ /cir yang 'gyur ba'i yig 'bru las/ /'phros 'dus rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas khang / /rgyu bi shwa bi shud de/ ban dha tsakra dz+nyā na da na ni/ srur+ya maṇ+ḍa ①la/ de ba tiṣ+ṭha nan/ ti ra baṃ/ 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ /gru chad bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /gru bzhi sgo khyud bzhi dang ldan/ /'bar ba'i bar khyams gnyis kyis mdzes/ /thod sbrul sna tshogs nyi mas brjid/ /'bar ba'i phro ba mang pos 'khrug /khyu mchog ma te gzig dang stag /gtum pa dom gyi yar bas ni/ /dbang phyug lha chen la sogs bzung / /rgyu 'bras he ru gdan bzhugs pa'i/ /sku yi dbyings nas yum phyung ste/ /ti nyi dges pa'i gzi mdangs kyis/ /rin chen pad+ma rgyas mdzad nas/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa ②la/ phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūṃ/brjod pas khro bo 'chol pa yis/ /g.yos 'ur shig gtor gtor ba'ang / /rim pa gsum gyur bdud btul te/ /ye shes phyogs 'dus yongs gyur pas/ /bde gshegs sku lnga yum dang bcas/ /byang chub sems sprin mkha' dbyengs las//nyi shu 'khor spros bsdus gdan bzhugs/ /tshon gang srin po'i tshul bzung ba/ /shar sgor thugs dam bskul ba'i tshig /ho sems nyid theg pa rab nges pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis sdogs/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje he ru ka'i/ /tshom 44—512

bu'i dkyil 'khor bsam yas kyis/ /sku gsung thugs su bdag sbyor cig /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya hoḥ.oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya snye/ ces brjod rol pas yongs gyur nas/ /'bru gsum gyur pa hūṃ dngos te/ /zla rlung las kyis mkha' la phebs—/ /rol pas kun kyang ma 'dres 'od/ /thugs yig mthing nag zung du 'bar/ /cho ga rim pa phyag rgya rdzogs/ /mkha' gnyis byin gyis brlab par bya—/ /rol pas mkha' la dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /sngags kyis bltam ste rang sar bgod/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ka /ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra da ra ma hā kro dhi shwa ri dz+wa li ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ta thā ga ta ma hā shrī he ru ka /ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ①sarba duṣ+ṭan/ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ta thā ga ta ma hā kro dhi shwa ri sarba duṣ+ṭan hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ma hā shrī he ru ka /ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ②sarba duṣ+ṭan/ ta ka ha da da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ srur+ya rat+na da ra ma hā kro dhi shwa ri baṃ da ma hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ma hā shrī te ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan/ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hriḥshad ta pad+ma ba mu ka ma hā kro dhi shwa ri kha hi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ karma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ④sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a mo gha ma hā kro dhi shwa ri bi sha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kau ri ha/ badz+ra tso ri ha/ badz+ra pra mo ha/ badz+ra be+e ta li ha—/ badz+ra puk+ka si ha/ badz+ra ghasma ri ha/ badz+ra sma sha ni ha/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa rjoli ha—/ badz+ra seng ha mu kha he/ badz+ra bya kri mu kha he/ badz+ra sring ga la mu kha he/badz+ra shwa na mu kha he/ badz+ra sti ḍa myu kha he/ badz+ra kang ka mu kha he/ badz+ra kha kha mu kha he/ badz+ra u lu mu kha nye/ badz+ra ar+ya te dza te nga dzaḥ/ badz+ra a mo gha hūṃ/badz+ra la ga baṃ/ badz+ra basmi bha la ya ba to hoḥ/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo 44—513

bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ 'jigs byed chos bu bsams yas pa/ /gcig gsum lnga la sogs pa yang / /'khor lo bar khyams sgo rnams su/ /'jigs byed rdo rje rigs kyi gtso/ /btsun mo 'dzin ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ /khro mo'i tshogs dang ldan par bsgom/ /'khor lo bar khyams sgo rnams su/ /'jigs byed 'khor lo rigs kyi gtso/ /btsun mo 'dzin ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ /khro mo'i tshogs dang ldan par bsgom/ /'khor lo bar khyams sgo rnams su/ /'jigs byed rat+na ①rigs kyi gtso/ /btsun mo 'dzin ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ /khro mo'i tshogs dang ldan par sgom⑧/ /'khor lo bar khyams sgo rnams su/ /'jigs byed pad+ma rigs kyi gtso/ /btsun mo 'dzin ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ khro mo'i tshogs dang ldan par bsgom/ /'khor lo bar khyams sgo rnams su/ /'jigs byed las kyi rigs kyi gtso/ /btsun mo 'dzin ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ /khro mo'i tshogs dang ldan par bsgom/ /'jigs byed lnga rdzogs dkyil 'khor ni/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las rdzogs par bsgom/ /sngo nag sgrug nag ser nag dang / /dmar nag ljang nag 'jigs pa'i sku/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir dgrad—/ /ko rlon gos ni sna tshogs gon/ /rngam pa'i sgra chen 'jigs par sgrogs—/ /sbrul dang thod phreng nyi zlas brjid/ /dbus kyi te ru'i phyag rgya ni/ /ti ra chen po'i dbyug pa dang / /rdo rje chen po rab tu 'bar/ /mi mgo dmar gyis bskang ba gsol/ /shar gyi he ru'i phyag rgya ni/ /ti ra'i dbyug tho chen po dang / /'khor lo chen po rab tu 'bar/ /dung chen dmar kyis bkang ba ni/ /rdo rjes 'khrug cing rab tu gsol/ /lho yi khro bo phyag rgya ni/ /ti ra chen po'i 44—514

dbyug pa dang / /yid bzhin nor bu'i rin chen dang / /yid bzhin nor bu gzhal yas su/ /dmar rmi arga rab tu gsol/ /nub kyi khro bo'i phyag rgya ni/ /ti ra chen po'i dbyug pa dang / /pad+ma chags med rab tu 'bar/ /dung chen dmar gyis bkang ba gsol/ /byang gi khro bo'i phyag rgya ni/ /ti ra chen po'i dbyug pa dang / /rdo rje rgya gram rab tu 'bar/ /dung chen dmar gyis bkang ba gsol/ /khro mo rnams kyang khro dang mthun/ /gnas dang yul byi phyag rgya sgo/ /rgyud gzhan dag dang mthun par bshad/ /ma mo rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ /'jig rten 'das mdo che las bshad/ /lhag pa'i lha dgu bsgom byas te/ /che ba'i nga rgyal ldan par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya wāka ①ṭīt+ta badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ①/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta a ta ri sha /sa man+ta pra ta be+e sha /a nu ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ①/ hūṃ rdo rje snying po srid gsum mgon/ /tshogs rje tshogs bdag dpal dang ldan/ /'jigs byed 'dul ba 'jigs pa'i gtso—/ /rdo rje khrag mthung gshegs su gsol/ /thod rus 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang longs spyod cing / /gdugs rjopa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /tshogs kyi slob dpon gshegs su gsol/ /thugs rje chen po thabs mkhas pa/ /gdug pyapa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes rtog pa'i khyad par las/ /sprul pa mang po'i tshogs dang gshegs/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ e ha nyi a na ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥre/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya phaṭa/ oṃ khro la khros pas zhi mdzad pa/ /thugs rje khro dpal rngam pa'i tshogs/ /'bar ba'i byen rlabs rmad po che/ /da lta nyid du bdag la sprul/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya :zhe/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya ho/ oṃ 44—515

badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya phaṭa/ a li u li/ ta li/ ta pa li/ daṣ+ṭi kau na ro tri/kha re yo ki ni/ kha nyi ho/ rdo rje bstem glu drug bstod bya/ hūṃ ha te phaṭa bh+yo ram̐/ka ya bāka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ oṃ shri te ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan sa ma ya rdaṣ+ṭi a ba ste ①pa ya ka hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra n+d+ra te tri sha sa ma ya ste/ oṃ badz+ra sgra te tri sha sa ma ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra n+d+ra te tri sha sa ma ya phaṭa/ oṃ shrī te ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭa sdes ma ya mu tra ma ram̐ pra ban tsakra/ bag sha ya bag sha ya/ bi twa sa ya bi to sa ya/khya bha ga bān/ 'bu dha ga she tri pra ti ste pa ya ka hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag med phyogs bral don dam thugs chud cing / /byams dang snying rje dgra zin mi mnga' yang / /gdugs ①pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ /'jigs byed te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro mo dbang phyug sku la gnyer gnas shing / /thabs dang shes rab 'byel ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mkha' 'gro mi zad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba'i/ /gdug dupa 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing ⑤/ /'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs can rdzu 'phrul can/ /ma sring byams ma'i tshul gyis grogs mdzad ma/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu ho/ pra ti pu ho/ mnyam pa'i grub rdzas chen po dag /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la dbul/ /oṃ e hūṃ su ra to/ ka ma la/ ma hā su ka /ma le/ ma nu sa ma na/ dza li ni da na—/ a pa yo kha hi/ a la la ho/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca shri he ru ka man+d+ra dz+wa la ma hā maṇ+ḍa la/ ka ya bā ka cisto/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ swe sri swe/i saṃ e/ haṃ haṃ haṃ/ badz+ra ma hā ka pa la/ khar ka da na da na dz+wa la sirtserjo/ma hā shri he ru ka a me du me sid ton bha ste/ saṃ ha ra na hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ma hā yo ga 44—516

ata tā ma hā sa ma ya/ ru lu ru lu a la la ho/ thog mar bdag nyid rtogs bsgom bsgral/ /de nas gnyis med blo yis ni/ /blo ngan 'jig rten snying re rje//gnyis su med par bsgral bar bya/ /'khril pa'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /bdag nyid mnyes pas mnyes par bya/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo//longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor thim/ /chos nyid la ni chos nyid rol/ /te ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen khrag mthung spyan drangs te/ /dur khrod mchog gi gnas chen 'dir/ /zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas/ /dmar gyi arga rgya mtshor bskyil/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnabs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra/a be+e sha ya/ a be sha ya/ pra be+e sha ya pra be sha ya/ pra ti dzaḥ/ shri ban kha kha kha hi kha hi/ nga ni khrag mthung chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i dra ba chags pa dang //dmar chen po yi rgya mtsho la/ /'khor rmi mkha' 'gro rnams dang rol/ /ma rungs 'dod la ma chags shing / /dam tshig la sdang dgra chen rnams/ /thugs rje byang sems ldan pa yis/ /ngo mthon stobs kyis bsgral bar bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ—/ shri te ru ka ma hā badz+ra/ sarba duṣ+ṭan sa ma mu tra/ ma rang hri pa se kha hi kha hi/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ /khams gsum ma lus bsgral ①ba dang / /gdug pa ma lus gdul ba'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya'o/ /oṃ shri he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya/ ma hā mang sa/ ma hā rak+ta①/ ma hā ba su ta/ma hā tsit+ta/ ma hā go ro tsa na/ shi ri ban khā khā khā/ le le le/ hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo/ ko tak+ṣa/ ko ta ba/ ko ta ko ta bas lca/ ka ti ra ka /ko la k+ṣa/44—517

ko la ba/ ko la ko la bas lca/ ko la ta thā/ bsgom dbyangs yi ge 'bru brgyad bstan/ /dbyangs drug blangs pas don drug 'grub/ /gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa yis/ /rnam gsum tshul gyis bzlas pa bya/ /a ki du na dz+wa la na/maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā shi he ru ka badz+ra kro dhi shwa ri sarba duṣ+ṭan hūṃ phaṭa/ru lu ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ a ta thā ga ta ma hā shri te ru ka /ma hā kro dhi shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ ru lu ru lu sa ma ya hūṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na ma hā shri he ru ka /rat+na ma hā kro dhi shwa ri bi da ma hūṃ phaṭa/ ru lu ru lu ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ oṃ triḥ/ pad+ma ma hā shrī te ru ka /pad+ma ma hā kro dhi shwa ri kha hi hūṃ phaṭa/ ru lu ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/oṃ karma ma hā shrī he ru ka /sarba a mo gha ma hā kro dhi shwa ri bi sha ru pe hūṃ phaṭa/ru lu ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ oṃ ma hā sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na pad+ma a mo ka ma hā badz+ra shrī he ru ka /ma hā sa ma ya ha he hūṃ phaṭa/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ e 'o ya mtshan 'phrul chen kyi/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje rang bzhin dpal—/ /dug dang bdud rtsi khyad med par/ /dag pa'i rang bzhin rnal 'byor thugs/ /kun tu bzang po rdo rje'i sku/ /ye shes lnga yi khro rgyal gtso/ /khrag 'thung 'jigs byed te ru ka /sangs rgyas mtha' yas 'gro ba rgya mtsho 'dul//thugs rje bsam yas khro rgyal kun gyi gtso/ /khrag 'thung kun la ches 'phags yid bzhin mdzad/ /ser nag mthing nag dmar nag dang / /sngo nag ri rab lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ /skal par bcas pa'i me ri'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /ro tshogs mang po'i dkyil na zhal rngam pa'i/ /bsod nams lus 'dus rdo rje mi zad pa'i/ /skar tshogs mang po nyi zla'i 'od bzhin tu/ /che btsan dregs pas 44—518

'jigs pa'i tshogs kun 'joms/ /mtshungs med cho 'phrul khyad par ston pa yi//'dod pa'i dbang phyug gar gyi tshul bzhin bzhugs/ /za byed rngam pas thugs sku gsung gi zhal/ /khrag mtsho mtha' med bskems shing skal tshogs 'joms /khro gnyer snying 'dren 'jigs byed klog ltar 'gyur/ /dur khrod 'bum gyi dbu smug 'jigs par brjid/ /'khor ba'i rtog pa 'jig mdzad thod rlon phreng bas bsgeg /rol phyir rtse mor snang bas a a ha las bzhad/ /rang nyid che bas dbang rdzogs dbu la brgyan/ /smin ris khro gnyer klog bzhin rab 'gyu bas/ /phyogs dang 'thun pa'i khrag 'thung 'gyed cing bsdud/ /sprul pa de lta bus ni zil gnon pa/ /'jigs pa'i mun pa'i tshogs chen rab bshams kyang / /sdang mig spyan ni nyi zla rgyas 'bar bas/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs phung sdug bsngal gtan nas sbyong / /khros pas zhal gdangs so chen brtsigs 'bar bas/ /srid pa'i rtse nas dmyal khams bsnyeg pa ltar/ /'jig rten dus gcig mid mdzad lam drug gtan nas gcod/ /ye shes phyag bsnams phyag mtshan 'bar ba yis—/ /srid gsum ma lus rdul phran stongs par mdzad/ /rkan sgras rol pas 'gro la pheg brdebs bzhin/ /khams gsum kun la chos ston rgyas par mdzad—/ /zas su khrag 'thung rdo rje che mchog gsol/ /'jigs tshogs bsad pa'i ko rlon g.yang gzhir bsnams/ /klu 'dul yon tan sbrul nag stong gis klubs—/ /'jigs bcas klu yi tshogs kyang zhabs kyis mnan/ /'dod chags 'dul bas 'dod chags kun gyi gtso/ /'dod chags chen po 'dod chags nyid kyi sku/ /mang po 'khor bcas 'jigs pa 'khor du byas/ /zhe sdang 'dul ba zhe sdang kun gyi gtso/ /zhe sdang gdug pa zhe sdang kun gyi sku/ /44—519

'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams 'od kyis kun bzhu ①ba/ /rab tu 'jigs pa'i 'jigs pas 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gti mug 'dul ba gti mug nyid kyis ②gtso—/ /gti mug blo sel gti mug chen po'i sku/ /mi phyed khrag 'thung sren ②chen ri rab bstanabu/ /nga rgyal 'dul ba nga rgyal kun gyi gtso/ /'jigs tshogs bsad nas ro tshogs mang gi gnas/ /zhal bgrad mche gcigs chog pa'i dus mtha' med/ /'jigs pas phebs par dka' zhing rab tu bsngags/ /phrag rjodog 'dul bas 'phrag rjodog kun gyi gtso/ /phrag dog che mchog kha ⑦dog chen po'i sku/ /bud med kun bsdus dkyil 'khor dbus gnas shing / /lam nor gdug par bcas par phar gyis gsod/ /zhing gi sham thabs gdug pa 'dul bar mnabs/ /sku 'dra 'jigs gzugs kyis sku la brgyan/ /zhabs dang phyag tu gyur pa bsam thag chad/ /zhabs chen g.yon pa brkyang bas lha gnon bdud la khyab/ /zhabs g.yas thabs chen mang pos dbang bsdus ⑧'dor zhing bskum/ /rdo rje se gol phyar bsdabs gnyid chen rab sel mdzad/ /'od chen dbus nas klog chen rab 'gyur ba/ /'jigs par klong na med pa'i dpa' bo byed/ /zas ngan bdud rtsir sbyar ba'i sman chen bdag /'jigs byed byed lta bu ni rab tu bkon⑨/ /bskal par bkrus kyang slar skye dri ma la/ /ye shes nyi zer 'od kyis byen brlabs dang / /thugs rje dag pa'i char gyi cho 'phrul gyis/ /brda tsam yul la rmongs 'khrud las sbyong zhing / /shi ba'i lam 'gog shes rab dkyil 'khor du/ /skye ba btan ⑩nas sbyong ba thugs rje 'char/ /byams sdang mi mnga' bka' drin chen po'i gter/ /khrag 'thung sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsnyen pa'i dngos grub drin la du/ /glu drug bstod pas 44—520

sngon yang bya/ /gos rgyan bza' btung glu tshig dang / /bro gar a le ka le dag /srog dang ldan pas bsdus byas te/ /tshogs phyir hūṃ gis mchod cing rol—/ /bdag nyid 'dul ba'i dbang phyug du/ /rtag tu mnyam bzhag khro bo'i tshul/ /'khor byi khro bo de bzhin te/ /mdog dang phyag rgya thams cad dang / /sngags mchog dam pa ma lus gdon/ /lhag ma g.yon pas reg byas te//lan gsum brjod de byin brlabs pa'ang / /oṃ saṃ hūṃ u tsi ti sta badz+ra ma ti ti sta swa oṃ/ de nas phra men 'khor bsdus nas/ /so so las dang mthun byas te/ /so so'i gnas su bzhag par bya/ /dbang du bsdus ①dang bsgo ba'i thabs/ /thams cad ma lus byos shig pa/ /lhag ma byin nas dbang yang bskur/ /rang gi dam tshig rab bsgrags pas/ /gang 'dod las de byed par bsgo/ /sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas/ /shin tu gdugs ②cing gtum bag can/ /thams cad ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /dbang dang byin rlabs rmad po che/ /lha chen la sogs dbang bsdus nas/ /'khor rnams rang gi slas su byas/ /so so'i las rnams bskos pa de/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i/ /ma rtogs myur du mngon par phyung / /dam bcas bzhin du ma byas na/ /ji ltar rang gi mna' bor ba'i/ /bsdom bcas de las 'da' ma byed/ /dam tshig de las 'das gyur na/ /mgo lus snying yang tshal pa bdun/ /yag sha khro bos gtub par 'gyur/ /de bas rnal 'byor sngags 'chang gis/ /ji ltar bcol ba bzhin du byos/ /las de mngon du ma byas nas④/ /rang gis mna' bor khas blangs pa'i/ /rul myags tshig nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /rnal 'byor dam la gnas gyur pa'i/ /las rnams yongs su bya ba dang / /'khor rnams bu gcig 44—521

bzhin du skyongs/ /phra men ma yang dngos grub thob/ /bcol ba'i las rnams mngon du byos/ /zhes bsgo'o/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba thams cad la/ /'dod yon lnga yis sbyin pa btang / /de nas las rnams rdzogs byas nas/ /dbang phyug chen por gnas brtan nas/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga la sogs/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /bdag la thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /spyod lam rnam bzhir ma nyams bya/ /de ltar bsgrub pa'i ngang 'chang ba/ /ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs byas nas/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas/ /theg dman spyod par yongs ①mi 'gyur/ /mi khom gnas su skye mi 'gyur/ /skye shi med pa'i g.yung drung thob/ /sangs rgyas zhing yang sbyong bar byed/ /ngan song gnas rnams stongs par byed/ /yang dag mchog gi snying po 'grub/ /las kyi phreng ba bsdus pa yis/ /kun kyang tshogs chen sa thob shog/ //

༄ga /khro bo yang dag sgon ma bzhugs/①༄4/ /ye nas spros med lhun gyis grub/ /ye shes mkhyen ldan sku gsung rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /tshad med yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs mnga' ba'i/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal te/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal po rgyal ba kun gyi thugs//don gyi snying po ma bcos byang chub sems/ /bla med mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i—/ /nges pa'i bsnyen bsgrub rim pa 'di brtsams so/ /gnas dang shes pa yo byad 'khor rnams dang / /dbang dang dam tshig phun sum tshogs pa yis/ /rgyud lngar skyes pa'i 'gro ba sdug bsngal/ /byang chub chen po'i snying rjes sems bskyed do/ /chos rnams thams cad ye nas sems nyid de/ /sems nyid rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pas/ /bsgom par bya dang byed med ye nas stong / /ci la'ang mi rtogs ①mi dmigs bsam dang bral/ /mtha' dang dbus med nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /yongs la snyoms pas snying rje 'byung ba'i yum/ /bde ba 44—524

chen po'i ngang du dgod do zhes/ /yang nas yang du dam tshig rnam par bca'/ /mkha' mnyam rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings nyid la/ /bde gshegs thugs kyi ye shes snying po ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin yi ge hūṃ du snang / /thams cad 'byung gnas ye shes chen po'i hūṃ/ /de las ye shes 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs mnyes 'gro ba'i rgyud sbyangs te/ /dur khrod chen po'i yon tan kun bsdus nas/ /re zhig ngang nas 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor bkod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta burta gar ba lang / oṃ pad+ma dharma a be sha ya a a/ dur khrod chen po rab 'jigs par/ /rlung nag rdo rje gtams pa'i steng / /khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i dkyil/ /keng rus chen po ri rab brtsegs/ /yo karma rag sha haṃ/ ra ma hā ra ka ta dz+wa la sa mun da hūṃ/ ṣ+pe ni ri ti dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ phaṭa/zla kham ①dbang chen maṇ+ḍa la/ /dur khrod yon tan tshogs kyis brgyan/ /phyi dang nang med kun tu nang / /ye shes gzhal yas nam mkha'i rgya/ /rgyu bi shwa bi shud dhe/ 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ /gru chad bzhi yis rnam par brgyan—/ /gru bzhi sgo khyud bzhi dang ldan/ /'bar ba'i bar khyams gnyis kyis mdzes/ /thod sbrul sna tshogs nyi zla brjid/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba mang po 'khrug /dz+nyā na ban dha tsakra maṇ+ḍal dha na hūṃ phaṭa/ dregs pa lha chen khyab 'jug dang / /tshangs pa brgya byin khyo shug steng / /khyu mchog ma he gzig dang stag /gtum pa don gyi brdzis pa'o/ /de steng hūṃ chen 'phro 'du las/ /ye shes sku mchog he ru ka /'jigs byed 'bar ba'i cha lugs dang / /lha chen gdan la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā shri te ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan khrag 'thung badz+ra he ru ka /dbu 44—525

gsum mthing nag dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug kha ṭī rdo rje rnge chung g.yas—/ /ti ra dbyug pa ban dmar rgyu zhags g.yon/ /zhabs bzhi thabs dang shes rab brkyang bskum thabs/ /byin dgu nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor sdang mig bgrad—/ /dung chen khong seng kun tu gsan pa'i snyan/ /shangs nas hūṃ dang zhal nas phaṭa sgogs shing / /rno dpal mche ba skye shi rtsad gcod brtsigs/ /dbu skra kham nag ral pa gyen du 'khyel/ /smin mtshams khro gnyer klog stong 'gyu ba bzhin/ /thod 'phreng sbrul nag nyi zla phreng bas brgyan/ /glang chen ko rlon zhing lpags g.yang gzhi gsol/ /gcan zan rgyal bo stag gi shams thabs can/ /ba su thal chen raka ta zhag gis brgyan/ /bskal pa'i me dpung nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi—/ /khyu mchog lha chen khyo shug gdan la bzhugs/ /bcom ldan 'jigs byed shugs kyi dpal be+e'u ni/ /ye shes sku mchog tshon gang rin po che/ /zur brgyad dkyil nas 'bru brgyad 'od 'phro zhing / /bde chen byang chub sems ni 'phro zhing 'du/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /khro rgyal ye nas yin pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon rdzogs shing / /sku gsung ye shes rang dbang bskur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bka' badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta cisto badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sar+ṣa ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū tsa badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā a dar sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ/oṃ ma hā pra ta be sha dz+nyā na badz+ra ata ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā sa marnya dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ/ oṃ ma hā shu kri ta a nu sta na dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa ata ma ko haṃ/44—526

khro rgyal gzungs dang mnyam sbyor phyir/ /spros med de bzhin nyid dbyengs nas/ /yum chen kro dhi mngon phyung ste/ /cha lugs 'dzin pa sgu la 'khril/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra dha ra ma hā kro dhi shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa dza/ oṃ dze+e ①hūṃ/ mkha' dbyings rdo rje pad+mar ①byen rlabs te/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor hūṃ las rtse lnga oṃ/ /sa las ma chags pad+ma'i gzhal yas su/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chos skur saṃ dang ldan/ /bde mchog sgyu ma'i brdas mtshon te/ /pad+ma rin chen ldan byas nas/ /dbyings kyi bde chen 'byung ba de/ /rang rig ye shes de la 'od/ /oṃ pad+ma sa ma yo gi ni pra we sha ya phaṭa/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ hi hi dges pa'i gzi mdangs kyis—/ /rin chen pad+ma rgyas mdzad de/ /yum gyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus la /dges mnyam mchog gi sbyin pas bstem/ /oṃ hūṃ a/ ji bzhin mkha' la gsal dag pa/ /dri med nyi ma'i 'od pas mtsher/ /byang chub sems sprin 'phros pa las/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sprin phung spro/ /hūṃ ha te phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la/ stong gsum phyogs bcu rdul phran snyed/ /de snyed khro bo'i dkyil 'khor 'thon/ /de dag sangs rgyas mdzad pa yis/ /phyogs bcu'i dregs pa ma lus bsgral/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra a ta ha sa ha sa/ ha ha hūṃ ta a ti/ de nas dur khrod bdag po dag /phyag rgya che dang ldan pas ni/ /bsgrub pa'i gnas su byin rlabs nas/ /ci rigs su ni las rnams bya/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan lapra ban tsakra ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ stong gsum gang ba'i khrag 'thung rnams/ /dbyings su 'dus na zhal gsum pa/ /phyag drug 'bar ba'i cha lugs dang / /rigs lnga khrag 'thung 44—527

rang gi phyogs su dgod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shrī te ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ①ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kro dhi shwa ri sarba duṣ+ṭan hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ma hā shrī te ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ srur+ya rat+na ma hā kro dhi shwa ri ②bi da ma hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ pad+ma ma hā shri te ru ka sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hriḥshad pad+ma ba da ma mu ka ma hā kro dhi shwa ri kha nyi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ karma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a mo ka ma hā kro dhi shwa ri bi shi ①hūṃ phaṭa/ rigs lnga'i khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas/ /gsang ba'i kha nas gsol bton te/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung rngam stabs dang / /'bar chen klong gi 'khor lo'i phyogs bzhir gnas/ /bcom ldan khrag 'thung budha te ru ka /dbu gsum smug nag mthing kha dmar ba'i zhal/ /ti ra'i dbyug pa rdo rje khyung chen g.yas/ /rgyu zhags ban dmar ti ra ba su g.yon/ /bcom ldan khrag 'thung rat+na he ru ka /dbu gsum ser nag mthing kha dmar ba'i zhal//phyag drug byes dbyug rdo rje dgra sta g.yas/ /stong gi 'jig rten ban dmar rgyu zhags g.yon/ /bcom ldan khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru ka /dbu gsum dmar nag mthing kha dkar ba'i zhal/ /rdo rje be con rdo rje dgra sta g.yas/ /stong gi 'jig rten ban dmar gshol ni g.yon/ /bcom ldan khrag 'thung karma he ru ka/dbu gsum ljang nag dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug ral gri rdo rje dgra sta g.yas/ /stong gi 'jig rten ban dmar gshol ni g.yon/ /de nas dges te ha brjod pas/ /byang chub sems kyi sprin dag las/ /dkar mo'i tshogs dang rkun mo dang / /rmongs mo dang ni ro langs dang / /lbos mo dang ni gtum 44—528

mo dang / /smre sha can dang ma tshogs ma'i/ /tshogs rnams rang gi lag cha dang //ngo mtshar chas nas rngam 'thon te/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i shar mtshan nas/ /'khor bar rngam pa'i mdangs kyis 'khod/ /oṃ badz+ra kau rī hā/ oṃ badz+ra tso rī hā/oṃ badz+ra pra mo hā/ oṃ badz+ra brte lī hā/ oṃ badz+ra puk+ka sī hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī hā/oṃ badz+ra sma sha rī hā/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī hā/ kau ri ban dmar byis dbyug sngo/ /tso ri mda' gzhu 'gengs ma ser/ /pra mo chu srin rgyal mtshan dmar/ /be+erta byis za rdor 'phyar gnag /pu ka dmar ser byes rgyu 'dren/ /ghasma dung dmar khrag 'thung ljang / /sme sha sngo nag byis snying za/ /tsaṇ+ḍa ser skya byis lus mgo| /de nas dges te te brjod pas/ /seng gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang ni—/ /stag dang wa dang khyi dang bzhad①/ /dur bya ka ka 'ug gdong che'i/ /tshogs rnams rang gi lag cha dang / /ngo mtshar dag tu chas 'thon nas/ /'bar ba chen po'i bar khyams kyi/ /phyi rol shar gyi phyogs dag nas/ /'khor bar rngam pa'i mdangs kyis 'khod/ oṃ badz+ra sing ha mu khā he/ oṃ badz+ra byesbyi mu khā te/ /oṃ badz+ra sring gā mu khā te/ oṃ badz+ra shā na mu khā te/ oṃ badz+ra byu dh+ra mu khā he| oṃ badz+ra shaṃ ka mu khā te/ oṃ badz+ra kā ka mu khā he/ oṃ badz+ra khru phru ka mu khā he—/ sing ha kha ro snol ser seng / /byek+shi gnas blta bsnol mar stag /sring gā byis ldag nag mo wa/ /shwa na bral blta mthing kha khyi/ /1 dh+ra mgrin dmar rgyud mgo rgod/ /rka ka zhing 'phrag snar mgo rings/ /ka ka kha rog bam gri nag /u phru lcags kyu mthing tshogs 'ug /khros pa'i sprin las hūṃ brjod pas/ /dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i phyogs bcu na/ /rnam rgyal gshin rje rta mgrin rgyal/ /bdud rtsi dbyug sngon mi g.yo mgon/ /'dod pa'i rgyal dang 44—529

stobs po che/ /hūṃ mdzad pad+ma 'khyil pa rnams/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bdud 'dul zhing / /rngam pa'i stabs ①kyis brjid par gnas/ /oṃ pradz+nyān ta krid a pa ra tsit+ta badz+ra ma hā kro dhe hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya man ta krid ya man ta badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad man ta krid ha ya byu ba badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ big nan ta krid a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa ④li badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rī la daṇ+ḍa ①badz+ra ma hā kro dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ar+ya a tsa la ma hā badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭa ki rā dza badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba la badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ hūṃ ka ra badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma kuṇ+ḍa rjoli badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje ban dmar dkar/ /gshin rje'i gshed po thod dbyug mthing nag zhal/ /rta mgrin dmar po rdo rje dbyug tho lu gu rgyud/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil dhiljang nag rgya khram dril bu bsnol/ /dbyug sngon rin chen dbyug tho sdigs mdzub khro/ /mi g.yo ljang sngon ral gri sdigs pa bdud/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar skya rdo rje sbrul gye zhags/ /stobs chen dud kha rdo rje rnga yab bsnams//hūṃ chen mthing kha rdo rje dril bu hūṃ gi rgya/ /pad+ma dud kha 'khor lo ṣ+pe le gter/ /de nas dges te phaṭa brjod pas/ /rdo rje sring 'gro ma tshogs dang / /gdong mo 'jig rten ro langs ma'i/ /tshogs rnams rang gi lag cha dang / /ngo mtshar chas nas 'jigs 'thon te/ /dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir rngam gzugs gnas—/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ya te dza te nga dzaḥhūṃ/ badz+ra a mo gha hūṃ/ badz+ra lo kā bi badz+ra bha smi pa la ya ba te hoḥ/ rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin/ /phag gdong nag mo mche zhags thogs/ /nyi zla dmar mo lcags sgog sdom/ /thal byed sna tshogs dril 'khrol dges/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /bcu 44—530

gnyis dang ni brgyad kyis mdzes/ /rang gi gdan dang lag cha dang / /ci bgyi zhes ni chas te gnas/ /ma nu rag sha sī/ brah+ma nī/ ro ṭī/ be+eṣ+ṭa ①be+e/ku mā rī/ in+d+ra ṇi/ badz+ra siṅga lo a mri tai/ sau mya/ daṇ+ḍa rda/ raka sha rnying/bhak+ṣa sī/ ra ti badz+ra/ ru dhi re maṭ+wā/ e ka tsa re/ ma no ha ram̐/ sid dhi ke—/ bā ya be/ ma hā ma ra ṇa badz+ra/ aldi/ bā ra hi/ tsa muṇ+ḍi/ pu ta rna/ ba ru ṇi/ badz+ra ma hā kā la/ tsa kā la/ kum+bha k+karna④/ lasbo da ra/bh+yo mi sring dmar ser tri shul zhing chen g.yag /tshangs ma dmar skya rtse lnga ban dmar sbrul/ /khro mo ser nag dbyug tho spu gri gzigasarjo/ /khyab 'jug dmar nag rgyu zhags dung dmar zer/ /gzhon nu ser nag pha wang 'khor lo dril/ /dbang mo dmar ser ba ⑤dbyug khog chen dred/ /bh+yo dbang mo dmar mo rgyu zhags zhing chen dom/ /bdud rtsi sngo nag chu srin rin chen bum/ /zhi ba sngo skya glo snying bum pa sdig /be+e con nag mo bam chen gris 'debs khra/ /srin mo ser nag rgyu 'dren rnge chung wa/ /za byed mthing nag bam chen snying 'byin stag /bh+yo dga' byed dmar nag lcags kyu bgegs 'dren rgod/ /khrag 'thung dmar mo rtse lnga dung dmar rta/ /gcig pu dkar dmar rdo rje ban dmar lding / /yid 'phrog dmar nag tir chung dung dmar byi/ /grub pa dkar dmar pad zhags pu shud mgo/ /rlung mo ljang ser ro za sha pho'i mgo/ /bh+yo gsod byed dmar nag rnge chung ral gri la ti spyang / /me mo ljang nag rgyu 'dren kha dang kyin/ /phag mo ljang ser rtse lnga zhing sa phag /rgan byad dmar mo dung dmar rgyu 'dren skeg /sna chen ljang nag zangs gri zhags pa yod/ /klu mo sngo skya bya rog dung dmar gri/ /bh+yo nag mo lcags kyu pu tra khya byug mgo/ /ra ni sngon mo rgyu zhags 44—531

'dren pa'i ra/ /bum sna dmar mo lcags sgog kun sdom spre'u/ /gsus 'dzin ser nag dril chen dung dmar spyang / /khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas kun—/ /dang por bskul dang bskyod pa dang / /rdzogs dang mthar phyin bya ba'i phyir/ /so so'i snying po lan bzhi brjod/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi sras su bya ba'i phyir/ /bskul tshigs ①dbyangs kyis gsol btab pas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rin chen dbyeg /thim pas lhun byas gcig pa'i 'od/ /snying po byang chub sems su gnas/ /de las snying po spro bsdu yis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gsal 'thon te/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i phyogs bcu nas/ /kun kyang khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /ye nas ma bcos lhun byis rdzogs/ /lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung rdo rje'i thugs/ /phung po lnga nyid rnam grol ho ru ka /'byung ba lnga nyid khro mo dbang phyug yum/ /rnam shes dbang po yul dus la sogs pa—/ /ma mo phra men ci bgyi pho nya'i tshogs/ /lus kyi yan lag ta krid khro rgyal bcu—/ /don dam spros med byang chub snying po ni/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /rang byung ye shes brtsol bral gnas med pa/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid de ltar snang / /dbang po rang nyams phyal bar mi btang zhing / /spyod lam kun tu rang gi ting 'dzin bsgom/ /shes par bya bar ②bsrung dang bsgrub pa dang / /mi spang ba dang mchod pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /bka' bzhin bsrung zhing klung du goms par bya/ /dam tshig 'di las mi 'da' rnal 'byor pa/ /kun tu bzang dang mnyam pa'i spyod yul te/ /'di las 'das par byed na bsreg par 'gyur/ /spyan drangs mchod pa rdzogs pa dang / /44—532

bsgom ①dbyangs yi ge 'bru brgyad dag /le lo med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /bar chad med pa'i 'phro 'du bya/ /rtags dang mtshan ma byung ba na/ /bsgrub pa chen po'i dngos grub blang / /dngos grub de dag srud pa gang ②/ /dang po bde gshegs dkyil 'khor la/ /gnyis pa rigs 'dzin grub pa la/ /gsum pa gtso bo mchog la dbul/ /bzhi pa bsgrub pa bdag nyid blang / /lnga pa grogs mchog rnams la sbyin/ /de dag las kyang ci rigs par/ /'dzin chags med par bgo bar bya/ /las kyi lhag chad bskang ba'i phyir/ /gzhung bzhin bshams nas rton lam gdab/ /snying po dran par lhar bskyed la/ /bar chad bgegs las bsrung ba'i phyir/ /tshig 'di sngags dang bcas par brjod / /cis kyang mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i/ /stong pa'i go cha bla na med/ /mtshan ma'i yul kun bcom nas kyang / /thams cad du ni rgyal bar gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra ka ba tsa ka ba ma na hūṃ/ ming dang mtshan mar ma grub par/ /mi gnas ma bral 'dus ma byas/ /chos kyis ①dbyings kyis bsrungs pas na/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs so/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa man hang hūṃ baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rin chen 'bar ba'i dbang mchog 'dis/ /bla med chos kyi rgyal po'i rtags/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /rab tu brtan par dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ rat+na sarba mu dra ma me a/ a bi shi na tsa/ swa bha wa ra ga ba pā na ti duti ku ru phaṭa/ mnyam pa nyid las ma yengs shing / /don rnams yid la dran par bya//dpal chen kun bzang bsgrub thabs 'di/ /bla ma'i lung la nges brtsams pasadu//khro rgyal ye shes sku gsung thugs/ /'gro ba kun gyis 'grub par shog /khro bo yang dag sgon ma/ slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //44—533

༄ga /lha'i ma sgom pa'i man ngag①go bi ma la'i lha sku sgom pa'i man ngag go/ ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ de ba ka ya mu tra sa ma ta ①ba tre na ma/ bod skad du/ lha'i sku sgom pa'i man ngag /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmigs dang bdag nyid rdzogs gsal ba/ /rnal 'byor rim pa bshad par bya/ /bsam gtan dgra las ring gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis gnas su bsdad par bya/ /bsdu ba'i rgyan gnyis 'tshogs byas pas/ /bsgom thabs rim pa gnyis yod de/ /thun mong khyad par dbye ba'o/ /rab gnas byas pa'i gzugs brnyan la/ /kun tu brtag cing dmigs pa bsdu/ /mi yi mig gis bltar yod par/ /shin tu 'dris pa nyid du bya/ /sa phyogs stong pa thams cad dag /gzugs brnyan nyid du gsal mthong na/ /thun mong zhi gnas gsal ba'i tshad/ /dmigs pa bsdu zhing yul la brtag /de la shin tu 'dris par bya/ /bdag nyid phyag rgya nyid 44—535

du sgom/ /rims kyis pa dang cig char pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i yi ge sgom pa dang / /thugs rten phyag mtshan sgom pa dang / /rdzogs pa'i sku ru sgom pa dang / /rig pa lha ru rdzogs tshul gsal/ /dang po dbu'i gtsug tor gsal/ /de nas zhal gyi mdangs la be+eb/ /de nas thugs kyi dpal be+e'u la/ /de nas yan lag gdan khri gsal/ /de nas lha grangs 'khyud tshad sgom/ /nyungs 'bru tsam dang ri rab tsam/ /gang la bzhag par 'dug pa ni/ /ting 'dzin phyogs gcig gsal ba'i rtags/ /mar me me tog dag la sgom/ /chu yi rgyun dang rlung dag la—/ /rig pa slab pa gong ma bzhin/ /nyi zla 'bar klong dag la sgom/ /de bzhin ldan pa'i gsang sbyor slab/ /spyi skyon khyad par skyon rnams shes/ /spyi skyon rnam pa bdun yin te/ /g.yeng ba drug gi rang bzhin dang / /bar du gcod pa bcu drug dang / /khyad par skyon dgu de bzhin shes/ /bdud kyi spyod yul bco brgyad dang / /sgrib pa lnga'i don brtag pa'o/ /de ltar gsal ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rig pa rang snang nyid du shes/ /rig 'dzin sa la gdon mi za/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'bras bu 'char/ /rig pa thugs kyi gsal rab 'di/ /kun la chad ①na bka' chad 'byung / /'di yi yon tan gang yin pa/ /'gro ba kun gyis thob par shog /slob dpon bi ma las mdzad pa rdzogs sto// //44—536
bsdur mchan/535 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ti/536 ①〈〈pe 〉torachad/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2580)44wa 537

༄ga /phyag rgya bzhi pa'i bsam gtan bzhugs so//①༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi lha la phyag 'tshal nas/ /phyag bya'i rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i phyir/ /lung dang man ngag rjes 'gro ba/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa dgrol bar bya/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /phan nus bco lnga thob byas te/ /sngon du dpung bskyed phyi nang gi/ /'byel gcad shes bya yang chub par/ /gang gi rkyen rigs ci rigs bsdu/ /phyi bzhin bde ba'i yan lag bya/ /'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i rdung mtshams dag /dur rkun shugs kyis dor bar bya/ /sems can ma lus thams cad la/ /snying rje'i thag pa ma chad par/ /bu gcig 'dra bar blo bzhag ste/ /ma bral gdung bas skyab par bsam/ /sngon du yo byad lhag pa lnga/ /song bas bkra shis lo rgyus ldan/ /tsha grang mnyam zhing nye ring spangs/ /gsum spangs gsum ldan rna nyan med/ /'tshe bas mi tshugs yid dang zhing / /mun 44—538

dang snang ba ran pa btsal/ /des der 'dod bzhin 'tshams par bya/ /me long ngos ltar byas pa der/ /bsrung phyir byugs bdug tshul bzhin te/ /lhab lhub bri zhing brten bzhugs bya/ /shar nas chu lha'i phyogs ltas te/ /khru gang maṇ+ḍal bye dor can/ /steng du 'ba' li a mṛ ta/ /bzhag ste pi par stan la 'dug /gzhon nu ma yi gdu bu ltar/ /gcig pu rgyu bas myur nyid du/ /byang chub chen po 'dod pa yis/ /bya ba'ang che chung rjes su 'gro/ /de la rim par mos bya ba'ang / /snying la ri bong can steng du/ /dza las 'dod kyis bla ma dang / /rigs lnga de rigs 'dzin pa rnams/ /drangs te gang yin rten nyid la'o—/ /de blar bla ma gnas byas te/ /sems dpa' rigs bzhi 'khor du yang / /byas te dbang po nyid du bsam/ /de la yan lag bdun rdzogs nas/ /yongs gyur 'od bsdus bdag sbyangs te/ /hūṃ zhes las kyi sems dpar bskyed/ /de nas byin gyis brlab par bya/ /bdud rtsi chu bdag sa bon gyis/ /sbyangs te bdud rtsi rgya mtshor bskyil/ /mtheb srin nyi zlas hri bzung la/ /dgug pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad du/ /bzlas te nam mkha' bdud rtsir bsdu/ /ji ltar mos snang bsam pa bya/ /nyi zla yig gnyis der thim nas/ /nyams sgrib bsal zhing bha lim bsang / /mi mthun phyogs la gtor byas na/ /drag po gtum po'ang lhan ṣ+per 'gyur/ /oṃ t+pahūṃ sarba pañca a mri ta hūṃ hri tha/ oṃ bi shud dhe a m+bi ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dharma a mri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas hūṃ oṃ.oṃ/ 'phros 'dus/ rmad du byung ba'i bha li nyid/ /rang rig smra bsam yul 'das par/ /sbyang dang lhun grub cir yang snang / /de phyir mos snang ma lus pa'i/ /mchod pa'i dngos gzhi nyid du rlab/ /oṃ ba 44—539
