ling ta/ te tsho ma la ni/ ba la ba ti gu khya sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de/nam mkha' gang ba'i lha mor bya'o/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan rnams ni/ /shin tu mi dmigs dbyings su bsgom/ /de nas bdag dang 'gro ba rnams/ /ma 'gags gnyis med snying rje bsam/ /shin tu dman pas de bzhin nyid/ /bdag gi dngos po hūṃ du bsam/ /bri yi mig gis bltar yod par/ /yang nas yang du 'dris pa dang / /'od zer gang po 'phro bar bya/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi gang ba dang / /be+er yang hūṃ la bstem par bya/ /hūṃ nyid mi dmigs dbyings su thim/ /thim gyur dbyings nas a dkar 'bar/ /thams cad ar ni gyur par bsgom/ /de bzhin nyid du 'dris gyur nas/ /a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /a ma gsal bar 'byor gyur nas/ /nyi zla gang ba sgril bar bsgom/ /hri gsal pad+ma chags med bsgom/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /nyi zla gdan dang gzhal yas khang / /thams cad 'dus shing 'phra bar bsgom/ /'od 'phros dbyings su slar bsdus nas/ /de dkyil yi ge hūṃ gnas par/ /mthing kha mtsher la gsal ba yi/ /'od zer 'phros pas rnam par bsgom/ /'od 'phros dbyings su sbar bsdus nas/ /shin tu rdo rje phra bar bsgom/ /rdo rje 'od 'phros gsal 'bar nas/ /dbyings su yang ni bstem par bya/ /de nyid sems dpa'i skur gyur nas/ /shin tu 'phro zhing 'dus par sgom/ /de bzhin med pa gsal gyur nas/ /sku gcig rdo rje dril 'bar sgom/ /de bzhin nyid du gyur pa dang / /dbu gsum phyag drug nyid du bsgom—/ /gang bsgoms yi ge so so las/ /bskyed de snga ma ji bzhin bsam/ /spyir ni gang bsgoms kun tu 'dra/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'du/ /gang 44byed540

rung gnas gcig gnas gsum dang / /gnas lnga dag tu bya ba/ gdan stengs tsit+tar ye shes sems/ /lha gsum rigs lnga'i dbang ldan bya/ / ka ya bka ①sogs gsum brgyad bsngags/ /brjod de byin dbang nga rgyal bya'o/ /sa ma dza/ e khya nyi/ se gol kyo ga ta yi rgyas/ /byon la ma rag gshegs par bya//dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bsnyims brtan la/ /mchod pa kun bzang rnam lnga dang / /rnam gnyis 'byor pa dbul bar bya/ /che ba'i yon tan brjod byas te/ /dus gsum 'phags la bzod par gsol/ /gang yin yab yum rtsa bas mchod/ /gsum dang lnga la rang sngags brjes/ /ma hā pañca a mri ②ta/ kha nyi brjod pa shin tu shis/ /'bru gsum rim par gnas blangs te/ /'phro 'du rdo rje gsum thob pas/ /nga rgyal chen pos skyed ①pa'i phyir/ / ka ya bka rjosogs sngags kyis bskul/ /oṃ wabyuhūṃ/ pu ra to sa bo ka ma la ma le badz+ra/ a mri ta/ ha ran pra titsa/ bha ga wan⑤/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ a la la hoḥ/ pa na pe na/se nu su ra to/ nyi pu pa ra mur dusarba ta tha ⑦ga ta si ta 'u/ sa ma yo ta mu/sarba ma hā su ti sa ti'u zhes brjod/ de nas lha la lha 'am/ chos nyid ye shes rol par dbul/ /de nas ye shes gnas bcas par/ /mdun du phye la rang sngags kyis/ /bzlas pa skyon bcu spangs pa yis/ /gsal ba gsum dang ldan par bya/ /dang po gsum dang bar thugs dang / /tha ma phra mo sku 'phro 'du/ /yang na rdo rje bzlas pa 'am/ /yang na mkha' zhal 'du 'phro bya/ /srog ldan bzlas pa bskyed pa dang / /thun mong nyid dam bzlas sngags shis/ /'du 'phro bdag gi gnas thim nas/ /bstod de yongs gyur bdag la bsdu/ /byen dbang dngos grub thob bsams la/ /go bgo lus bsrungs ⑧tshul bzhin bya/ /44—541

spyod lam 'gro nyal 'dug longs spyod/ /rnam bzhi nang gi sbyin bsreg bya/ /de grol yang na 'di ltar spyad/ /gang bsgoms nyid dam gzugs sgra dri/ /ro reg chos yul lha mo drug /dkar ser sngo dmar ljang dkar mo/ /gzugs mdzes pi wang pog por can/ /mkhar gzhong ros gang lha'i gos/ /rdo rje las mtshan dar mo ta①/ /thogs pa sgo drug thim bsams na/ /thun mong zhen las de grol te—/ /mthong thos ma spangs 'dzin dang bral/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan rigs lnga yisaske/ /mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis po/ /slas su mdzad ces khas blangs phyiraske/ /lhag ma mchod sbyin bya bar gces/ /gal te mchod pa mi spyogs na/ /a mi ④ta 'am nying 'dzin mchod/ /blo yi shes rab che chung las/ /rim pa bzhin du sgom par bya/ /yang na gcig char sgom par bya/ /rang rig lhun grub rang gsal las/ /snying po dran pas skur skyed snede/ /dbang byin ldan par bsam bya ba/ /nyi zla gza' skar dus gcig tu/ /chu dkyil dang bar gsal ba bzhin/ /dbab drang bstem brtan la sogs kun/ /rjes su 'thun byas spyod lam 'bad/ /de ltar rnal 'byor gnas pa'i tshe/ /g.yo thob goms brtan mu bzhi yis/ /mig dud srin me nyi ltar 'byung / /dang po mig rgyu dud rjes 'byung / /'di tshe bying rgod 'gyur ba bdun/ /bying ba'ang 'dron dang dpa' byed rkyen/ /mun dang rab rib bsnye bsnyo la/ /sgom dang dran pa brten pa dang / /'dod chags rga lam bying bar myung / /de min ma goms dbang bsgyur bying / /yang na stong dmigs brtson pas bying / /'du byed rten dang grogs 'chal rgod/ /ma goms bral dang rgod pa dang / /so sor rtog brten rgod pa 'byung / /dbyibs dang kha dog grangs dang tshad/ /cha lugs bzhugs 44—542

tshul 'gyur ba dang / /kha dog 'ba' zhig snang ba dang / /rim par nub pa brtag par bya/ /'di tshe rgyu yang bsreng bkru bcag /yon tan bsam zhing sdong por gdags/ /dmigs pa brjed dang le lo dang / /dogs dang btang snyoms chog mi shes/ /byung na spong ba'i 'du byed brten/ /tha ma chog shes mi nyams bya/ /nub na gtso bo spyi la sgom/ /mi ldan bye brag nyid la sgom/ /du ma gcig gi gsal byed ltar/ /'gyur bas dman pas phyogs gtad gces/ /ca co 'byung rkyen yid 'phrog dang / /'grog rga bying dgod rgyu bsten dang / /bar bar mi mthun spyod pa dang / /mthun pa mi bsten nyams par 'gyur/ /des de thun tshod khams rab 'bring / /rab kyi nyin mtshan thad mnyam tshod/ /'phel 'grib rim pas mnyam shes bya/ /mnyam pa'i tshad la dkar nag gi/ /sum cha bar tshe thun drug bcad/ /nag po stod smad thun rer bya/ /'bring gi dkar po bzhi cha las/ /thun drug nag po stod smad du/ /tha ma nag pos btang snyoms la/ /dkar po bzhi cha thun brgyad do/ /de dag bar bar thun bcad de/ /ma sun thun tshod gyen du spar/ /gtong tshe dal bus 'grogs thabs min/ /de bzhin 'jug pa snyoms la 'jug /nag po tshe na stod smad du/ /rab rib ma spangs 'jug mi bya/ /mi gsal yun rings 'khrug sun dbyung / /nyams shing mi mos 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /gsal bar thung ba bar mi bcad/ /de yang 'byung rkyen ma yin pa'o/ /yang na chu tshod 'pho bas brtag /de min grangs sam grib ma'ang rung / /de 'ang khams gcad dus dang gnas/ /shes bya spyir ni tsha grang snyoms/ /de brten me'i nad ldan pas/ /shin tu drod dang tsha ba'i tshe/ /ser kha nyin gung mtshan phyed la/ /'jug pa'i tshe na de 'khrug 44—543

pas—/ /de tshe bsel ba'i zas gnas bsten/ /'phel 'grib cha yis spong zhing 'dug /sa'i cha ldan rnal 'byor pas/ /grang zhing shin tu grang zhing pa'i/ /dpyid dang srod dang snga dro cha/ /de 'phel ldang bas drod bsten brtsal/ /de bzhin rlung dang ldan pa yis/ /grang dang shin tu grang ba'i dus/ /sos ka tho rangs phyi dro'i dus/ /zhu rjes 'a gas pas 'thun par bya'o/ /me tog chu ldan stong gsum tshe/ /'thun bsten dkar la sgom mi bya/ /de bas rnal 'byor mthar bya'i phyir/ /du gshang thos 'khor sgyug bro zhing / /'khrug pa sa g.yos brtag byas tshe/ /gso ba'i cho ga rgyas par bya/ /de ltar 'bad pas thob pa yis—/ /mun pa me khyer lta bu snang / /de tshe me long khyad par sgrib/ /ma goms zhun du btang snyoms la/ /'dir sgrib btang snyoms ga la rung / /'di la sngon gyi skyon 'bring cha/ /sgrib po sgra sogs rkyen cha lnga/ /sgrib pas shin tu bcos par gces/ /de rgyus goms tshe chu klung tshul/ /mun la bstan pa'i mar me bzhin/ /brgya bzhi ba spu rgyan chan chad/ /shin tu gsal bar snang ba'i tshe/ /chog mi shes pas rtsol bas nyams/ /ched du byed rnams sgribs ①pa'i phyir/ /btang snyoms gnas pas thun rkyang nus/ /bstan pa'i cho ga mi dgos so/ /dran pas dus mtshungs rang gsal tshe/ /mi men mchod sogs mtshan ma mthong //brtan pa'i mu la nyi shar tshul/ /nyi5 mtshan phyed par gnas pa khrul/ /bdud kyi spyod yul thams cad mthong / /shugs snang ci mthong rang gi sems/ /snang phyir de la dga' brod med/ /gnyis med don gyis chags mi byed/ /de ltar spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /tshe sgrub ngo lon rab mchog ste/ /'chi bdag bsru bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de phyir de la zhen par bya/ /gang zhig rkyen gyis bcad ⑧44—544

bzad pa'ang / /'pho ba'i rnam shes lhar gsal bas/ /las ngan rgyun gcod dang po pa'ang / /de dang 'phrad par the tshom med/ /srin bu'ang ni sgrub pa por—/ /'gyur te mar me rnam smin rigs/ /khyung dang seng ge ji lta ba'o/ /mar me 'das pa'i nyi ①lta bu/ /phyag rgya chen po 'das kyang smin/ /thob pas 'pho ba'i dran pa gces/ /gal te dgon pa skyob pa na/ /kun kyang rang rig snang ba'i lha/ /ma rtog dngos la gdod nas med/ /rtog pa dran pas rang zhi ba'ang / /dman pas grong dang grogs skyon bsam/ /dgon pa'i yon tan bsam par bya/ /bu ram mngar ba'i sgras bshad pa/ /ro ni myong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig bu ram zos pa'i tshe/ /mngar ba'i ro ni stsong 'gyur bzhin—/ /ting 'dzin mngags pa brjod tsam gyis/ /ma sgoms grub par ga la 'gyur/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor 'bad byas nas/ /des ni byang chub snying po len / /bsgoms pa'i mi yis grogs gar spyod/ /'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur ma yin/ /de ltar yun rings rnal 'byor na/ /lus dang ngag dang sems dag dang / /rtags dang nges par 'byung ba yin/ /dang po stan la bzod pa dang //shig dang reg pa phra mo rnams/ /mi tshor nyung dang dri mi 'byung / /mun pa'i skye mched choms pa dang / /khams bde mi bde med sogs 'byung / /ting 'dzin zas kyis 'tsho bar 'byung / /gang gi ②bden 'jug grub pa dang / /gang la dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /rig pa ting 'dzin gsal ba dag /rmi lam du 'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'gyu ba'i dbugs la dbang thob ste/ /skal par gnas dang 'pho ba dang / /ji ltar dga' ba bzhin du 'grub/ /mngon shes drug dang cho 'phrul bzhi/ /'byung zhing rdzogs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de sngon skye 44—545

mched rnam gsum mthong / /tha mal bcu yang zhar la mthong / /ting 'dzin bsgyur tu rung nas ni/ /mi spyogs med pa ①thob pa'i tshe/ /de ltar goms rtogs rnal 'byor des/ /ji ltar dbang bsgyur bzhin 'grub phyir/ /mtshan ma 'byung ba'ang bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /gang ltar mos pa'ang goms la sbyor/ /ting 'dzin mthar sus byas pa yis/ /rnal 'byor chen pos mthong 'di la/ /mkha' la 'phyo dang rig 'dzin gnas/ /chu rgyun bzlog mi 'gul/ /ri brag la sogs thogs med 'dzul/ /chu la mi 'bying mes mi tshig /dug dang mtshon gyis tshugs mi 'gyur/ /mi snang ba dang mang por sprul/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /lha srin rnams la dbang bsgyur dang / /tshe dang dus la bsring bstung dang / /stong gsum nyungs 'brur shong ba dang / /nyungs byedas stong gsum bskyed pa dang / /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /sbrul dang gcan gzan gdug pa rnams/ /khyi bzhin phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur/ /bdud dang gdug pa la sogs pas/ /tshugs par mi 'gyur bran bzhin 'gyur/ /lus ma spangs par rig 'dzin sa/ /lus dang phung por bcas pa yis tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin 'grub/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshe nyid kyis/ /bla med kun tu bzang por 'gyur/ /ye shes bsod nams longs spyod kyis/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs mchog brnyes/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /so sor thar pa'i lam yang ston/ /de ltar 'bad de brtson byas na/ /'bras bu mngon du ma gyur kyang / /byang chub sems la gnas bco bas/ /dper na mngal dang sgo nga yang / /mngon du mi 'byung sgribs 'gyur yang / /rtsal chen 'dul ba 'byung ba bzhin/ /rnam rtog gzugs ni bor ma thag /thams cad 44—546

kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /rigs 'dzin dam pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam pa'i/ /dngos grub mchog rnams yongs su rdzogs/ /bde ba can gyi zhing yang 'thob/ /byang chub mchog la rol par 'gyur/ /lha mi rnams kyi ston pa po/ /lus ngag sems la dbang thob nas/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /tshad med bzhi la dbang byed 'gyur/ /bde ba'i ro mchog kun la spyod/ /skye rga na 'chi med sogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal zad pa'i go 'phang thob rang sems ma nges cir yang snang / /de phyir ye shes rgyu yin phyir/ /gang bsgoms ming du ma bsgyur yang / /gang bsgoms de ltar de brtas na/ /bsrings nas brtson pas gang 'dod de/ /mngon sum dga' bar red par 'gyur/ /yi dam lha yi mtshan nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /lha spangs dge spyad don med 'gyur/ /dam tshig bsrungs dang sngags bzlas dang / /phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad pa bzhi/ /brtson 'grus che zhing brtan par bzung / /rnal 'byor brtson 'grus chung gyur na/ /mi 'grub nyen yang che bar gsungs/ /ji ltar ral gri so la nan tan du/ /skyes bu'i myur du ma bzung na/ /nges par lag pa gcod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin nan tan med pa'i gsang sngags pa/ /'chi'am yang na 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /de bas bar chad rtson med na/ /dper na sa bon tshig pa la/ /'bras bu 'dod pa dang 'dra ste/ /grub pa'i 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /mi khom 'khor bar brgyud par 'gyur/ /sngags 'chang bsal por rtogs bya ba/ /sngags shes rab tu bsgrags pa ni/ /don dam kun rdzob dbyer med pa'i/ /mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge go /de la 44—547

sogs pa'i yi ge lnga/ /phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid ni/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi gshegs pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs dang yi ge lnga/ /bdag dang dbyer med phyag rgya che/ /gsal la brtan pa'i yon tan ldan/ /yid bzhin ma chags dbang bsgyur te/ /goms shing brtan par bya ba yin/ /rnal 'byor las su rung rnams kyis/ /phyag rgya chen po rdzogs 'gyur cing / /gsang ba yid gnyis med pa na/ /dkyil 'khor chen po 'bar bar 'gyur/ /lha'i sku no gsal bsgoms na/ /bsod nams gzugs sku 'thob par 'gyur/ /de nyid chu zla'i tshul shes na/ /ye shes tshogs chen thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di tshe phyi chos spyod bcu'i/ /gcig cha blangs te gzhan dor bya/ /lkug pa'i brtul zhugs spyad par byos/ /gnyid chang le lo bcos brda bsrung / /'di ltar ston pa'i bla ma de/ /rgyal yum rigs 'dzin yab yin phyir/ /lus la dbang ba'i rgyal po bas/ /shin tu lhag pa'i bkur ste bya/ /drin chags bskyed pa'i pha ma bas/ /shin tu gtso bor blang bar bya/ /tshe 'di tsam gyi sdug bsngal rmis/ /bla med byang chub thob pa'i phyir/ /spyod dang sdug bsngal bzod par bya/ /btang snyoms tsam gye tshul bzung min/ /dang po nas bzung rdzogs bar du/ /dam pa de la ma ltos par/ /rang gar spyad pas 'grub pa ni/ /ma byung mi 'byung 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de phyir longs spyod lngas mtshon phyir/ /snying gi mchog ni thob par bya'o/ /don 'dir sbyin pa'i rim pa'ang snod/ /yid bzhin mdzod 'byor bka' gnas/ /phyi nang theg pa bstan bcos dang / /stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi rnams/ /spyod dang sgom dang bzlas pa dang / /sdom pa kun la mkhas pa yis/ /bsgom pa'i sran dang chos phyogs dang / /bstan par 'dzin 44—548

par nus pa yi/ /gsang ba'i snying po mchog tu gtad/ /gzhan la brnyad par ma yin no/ /mi 'khrugs blo zab rkyen thub cing / /yid bzhin sbyor bas mos pa la/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig bstan/ /zla dang bcas pas dam tshig ste/ /sbyor ba gnyis ka mkhas pa dang / /lung dang tshad du ldan thub dang / /gzhan la bsnyad par ma byed cig /bstan pa mchod par byed pa po/ /nye ba'i bsnyen pa dam tshig la/ /bsgrub pa bsnyen pa nye bsnyen pa/ /ci nus par ni shin tu brtson—/ /sems can ngang tshul kun bor nas/ /gang gi yid kyang mi 'khrug cing / /mchod pa stobs la ①tshogs la rub/ /bud med 'gugs pas gtso la 'bul—/ /bzung thub sdegasang la mkhas pa yis/ /nges pa can la shin tu gtad—/ /gzhan du bstan par mi bya'o/ /bud med dang ldan dam srun cing //blo rdo dad che chos la gus/ /chags pa ran par bka' nyan cing / /gnas la dga' zhing lung nyan la/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig bsgrub/ /mchod pa'i gnas shom sdom pa bsrung / /rigs nges dpyo ①bzod yon tan ldan/ /ser sna spangs la shin tu gtad/ /bud med yon tan kun yod kyang / /thog med phyal par 'dod pa spyod/ /'dod chags kun dang 'thun spyod la/ /rtsa ba dang du blang ba dang / /'tsham par lha yi sku bstan te/ /nye bsnyen gsal rjoba'i man ngag rnams/ /nams kyang sbyin par mi bya'o/ /de la sbyor stangs de bstan nas—/ /gzhan du bstan par ma gsungs so/ /dam tshig mi ldan spyod pa rtsing //bting ⑤nas bstan pa mi 'dzin pa/ /'dod chags spel bar mi byed cing / /nges pa'i don ni mi ston la/ /dbang dang bslab pa'i rim pa rnams/ /rim par 'tsham par rab tu sbyin/ /gnas ngan pho mo 'dod spyod na/ /spro thung 44—549

'dod chags rab tu che/ /blo zhan phrag dog sgo skur can/ /gnyid che chang dad brtson 'grus chung / /sbab la mi gus nan tan med/ /slob dpon mi dran srun sems chung / /gal te dam la gnas na yang / /gsang sngags dam pa 'dzin pa la/ /mngon du dga' bar mi nus te/ /blta zhan bka' las 'das pa dang / /'grol bar dka' zhing nus mthu zhan/ /mun dang rkog dang skye bo la/ /gar dbe+en 'phrad par 'dod par spyod/ /'dod chags dga' lam de dag la/ /dngos kyi don dang mthun pa las/ /gsang ba'i snying po sbyin mi bya/ /skal pa'ang 'jig rten bar dag tu/ /thugs kyi bde ba mi spro zhing / /nams kyang bstan par mi bya'o/ /dper na gru gang chu klung gis/ /pha rol 'gro ba'i sems can dang / /rtswa dang shing la sogs bsdus te/ /chu las brgal ba'i gzings bcas nas/ /de las 'jug ste legs brgal nas/ /bor de bde bar 'gro ba ①ltar/ /de bzhin 'khor ba'i pha rol gyi/ /chos kyi mal ni skyed byas la/ /chos dang chos min rnam spangs nas/ /byang chub bde ba thob pa bzhin/ /zab mo yi ni chos spel to/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs lam nas/ /sngags rig rnam rtog ma byed cig /rnal 'byor gcig don khong chud nas/ /dben par song ste sgom byas nas/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol zhing / /tshe 'di nyid las sangs rgyas kyi/ /yon tan rnam pa mang po 'thob—/ /rin chen gser gling gru brgal len la chu srin nya mid dag /'byung 'joms ded dpon mkhas pas gnyen pos bzlog nas gter blangs nas/ /dbul bral lta bur 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ting 'dzin gru brgal nas/ /bdun gter len dgra 'joms byed dbul sel 'di bsdus yongs la bsngo/ /phyag rgya 44—550

bzhi pa'i bsam gtan rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/538 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉pozhar 〉〉star bkod/541 ①〈〈pe 〉〉tā ya bāka ②〈〈pe 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉po bskyed/ du〈〈pe 〉〉ka ya bāka dhi〈〈pe 〉〉blon/ me〈〈pe 〉〉mu/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉shā/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉bsrung /542 ①〈〈pe 〉〉te/ ②〈〈pe 〉stan/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉bskyed/544 ①〈〈pe〉〉sgrib/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉par ②〈〈pe 〉〉bcas/545 ①〈〈pe〉mi ma/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanas/546 ①〈〈pe 〉〉par/549 ①〈〈pe 〉〉wal/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉thug ⑧〈〈pe 〉stanapyod/ du〈〈pe 〉stanasang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉zinating /55༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉bar/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2581)44wa 551

༄ga /khro bo phyag rgya gcig pa bzhugs so//①༄7/ /dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal chen kun bzang sku gsung thugs/ /bsgrub thabs dam pa ma 'ongs phyir/ /dur khrod gnas brtags byin ldan par/ /phyi nang yo byad bsdu byas te/ /sngon du bya ba rdzogs pa yis/ /gza' skar nyi ma bkra shis dus/ /'byung po gsum mnyes mgu byas te—/ /phyi rol 'grul rnams gcad byas nas/ /rmad byung mnyes pa'i yan lag kun/ /rgyas pa'i byi dor steng du bgram/ /sa la sogs la phyag rgya yang / /mig gi rten yang mngon par bri/ /gsang 'dug so ma stobs shes pas/ /yan lag brgyad kyi tshul bzung la/ /las kyi rgya phyir de bsdus te/ /rnam gsum byin rlabs dam sri gcad/ /rgyu yi ting 'dzin cung zad rnams/ /gnas rten dur khrod rgyan dang gdan/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i yan lag bcas/ /rkyen sngags stobs las gza' skar tshul/ /mazing nag g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang 44—552

tshul dgur ldan/ /g.yas g.yon rdo rje dung dmar bsnams/ /chas brgyad gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /g.yon nas rig mas lags 'khyud de/ /'bras bu'i rnal 'byor de rdzogs nas/ /thugs kyi sngags kyis snyan gsan dbab/ /bod pa e nyi dor gsol te/ /rngam pa'i glu yis bstod mchod nas/ /rtsa ba'i sngags nyid kyis bstem①/ /tista badz+ras brtan pa la/ /dam gnad zil gdan pas mchod/ /kun bzang khrus gsol phyi mchod nas/ /dam rdzas ba lin stan 'gan dang / /'dod yon me tog chen pos mchod/ /mtshan bcus bstod cing sgras mnyes bya/ /smon 'dod gsol nas las rdzogs dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i bsnyen pa bya/ /'bru brgyad nyid dam bskyed la bcas/ /gsal gsum srog dang ldan byas pas/ /mtshan mthong bdag gzhan don bya'o/ /rnam bzhi ma nyams longs spyod kyis/ /sbyin bsreg bya ba rnal 'byor ro/ /de bsnyus gzhal yas bdag por bsam/ /byin rlabs mkha' 'gro mchod zin nas//las bcol 'dod yon sbyin pa btang ②/ /phyag rgya bsdus bskyed go bsrung dpang / /gzhal yas lha dang phrin las kun/ /mchod par rang rig spyal shes pas—/ /ye shes rol pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /ma nyams dpal chen las 'char/ /dpal chen kun bzang sku gsung thugs/ /bsgrub thabs rnal 'byer phreng ba'i don—/ /bdag dang gzhan phyir bris pa yis①/ /mtha' yas 'khor lo'i sa thob shog/ //44—553

dag /spyod yul sbyong ba'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba bzhugs/①byed/ /rgyal mchog nyid la bsgomapaste phyaga'atshal nas/ /thams cad ci byed pa'i spyodayul thams cad lha'am chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i sbyong ba'i tingange'ibasam gtan bshad 'og nas bshad/ /ltaba'isgothams cad bsdurabadang ltabartogs pa'i don la bsgom pa dang / /rnam par rtog pa'i rkyen bcosapa dang 'gro nyal 'dug sdod spyod lam sa pas yon tan 'char bar bstan pa'o sbyang zhing sgrib pa byed rtags mabyed bstan pa'o/ /ma nor ba'i phabla ma la mnyes pas bsam gtan gyi don zhugadam ngag gi don/ /dben pa'i gnas dgon pa'i tha mar rgyang grags gcig la bya'o/ /mnyan bsam bshad pa'i gnas par bya dgon par/ /ma nor mi bslu bas yang dag pa'i lta ba phyin ci ma log pa ji ltar btsal/ /chosanyidamanor pa'idon chosanyid gang lags pa'igasungs shes bris—/ /gzhal bya ste bdag dang gzhan ltar snang ba'i chos 'diltar lokalaso so skye bo la snang ba'i chos rnams kun byed drug so sor mthong ba ste/ /sngags kyi gol pa yin pas mi bden pa yin te rang rgyud rdzas can sdem poyor pos yod ma yin/ /rang bzhin rtag pa byed pa po phya'am dbang phyug gi ril por rgyur lta ba 44byed555

mu stegs phra men spyod rig byed mtha' gsang bar sma la sogs pa'o de babyu/na rtag dang chad par lta ba de ltar yod pa min/ /phyi chos nang semasardulaphra zhing sems zab pa yod pa de min/ /kun rdzob du dngos po 'di sems don dam par rang gi rig pa sems phyin ci ma log par grub pa'o 'khrul par mthong ba 'alnga/la pa nyid sngags phyi cha shas rgyu 'bras su song bas sngags kyi bden pa dbyer med ma mthong bas/ /don dam stong pa dang kun rdzob snang ba gnyis su 'dod pas ris dmyal bas bshal ma rir mthong des 'dre ma yin sngags pa snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa de thabs kyi theg pa chen po ni rnal 'byor byang dang du kha dag /kun rdzob tu'ang dbyer med de/ /lta ba mtho dman de tsam mo/ /zhes pas 'phags so gzhan yang lta ba don dam ye shes kyi kun rdzob lhas/ bden pa gnyis su med pas 'bras bu la lo du byed pas so/ /dbu ma la sogs pa 'og ma 'khrul pa la mdangs nas 'o/na sngags kyi byang chub sems kyi ma' na nyid ci zhes dris pa'o/ /yin na rtag tu pho byed par rigs 'dre bas bsags kyang mor mi skye bar rigs phor snang ma ris su grub pa med 'dri yang phor yang ma dgags 'dre pho mo ma yin rme ning min/ /'o na mtshan med do zhe na mtshan med phomo'imam yin rigs rgyud min de bas na bdag 'khor ba dang skya ngan las 'das pa gnyis ka'i ngo bo dbyer med yin pa ltar chos kun rig par bya'o/ /mtho dman du snang tsam na gcig tu nges pa med pas gnas su ma yin 'o na de ltar dbu mar song ngo zhe na gang 'a nga ཿ/na pho mo la sogs pa kun sems yin pas snang ba la'ang ma spangs la rang bzhin med de blo'i yul du'ang med de smra bsams las 'das so/ /dngos po ring lo rgyud kyi rtogs par bya ste dper na gzhi gser la chos bzangs su bzos bsgyur nad ①snod ngan bar snang la sku gzugs byas na mchod gnas bzang por snang ba ltar bahā/zug ngo bo gser du bco lnga ste 'khrul sems bdag gzhan 'khor bar snang / /rtog pa'i sems mya ngan las 'das par snang de rang rig pa dngos gzhi thams cad pa sems nyid mi thun pa mang sna chosags par snang bas/ /snang yang yul ma grub ste phyize/la gzugs sgra la sogs rang rgyud kyi rdzas med de snga bltar ro rdzas mthod semasarang gi ye shes ma 2)na te/ /yul dang shes pa tha dad snang ba nyid na zer zug tu med de 'o na snang ba 44byed556

spong ngam zhe na snang sbyo/da nyid na bems su snang ba mi spong bar rang sar rnam par dag pa'o/ /'on sems su yod do zhe na sems dang rnam rig ltar mi 'dod de de sbyo/rab snang ba sku/ 3/sa spyo/ dal du dbu tha ba'i 'khor ba'i chos tan ma grub/ /yul semasadakyil 'as ra rtogs pa'i ngang la 'as ra ba tanamed chos thams cad ye nas rang rgyas so dbyings su ye shes su phyag rgya'i ngal du/ /'o na rang rgyud do zhe na rje/ 3)nga) dngosapo rang rgyu/2) par grub pa ma yi/na pas sems nyid yin pas gzhi rtsa ba dang / /grub mtha' ni sku dang sku shegs b.re/na pa sems rang rig shes 'khor 'das su snang ba mi 'gog pas kun rdzob rang snang ba ma spangs la ngo bo med pas don dam gnyis gdod nas gnyis med snang stong gang gi yang 'dod pa med pas res 'jog dang bral gnyis su ce/da ma/le lag las mdun ma byas nyid 'dus byas snang ces so/ /rgyu 'byung ba lnga ther zug med pas sems su dag sbyo/ dag pa dang 'jis bu kun rdzob dgapa ni phung po lnga lharadang / /don dam du chos so cog dbyings ye shes so ṣ+pem bzhire rang bzhin dag dbyings dang ye shes kyang dbyer med pa'i chos skur cig cing dag /rang chos nyid ye nas :shen dngos po ring lo rgyus kyi shes par rang bzhin gyi tan dag pa'i mnyam pa'i rtogs pa'i bdag nyid chen po sten gyis gsal bar rtogs pa'o las yiban parab 'phraladubarje/zab min pa/ /de'i yon tan bstan pa'i phyir mthong bas dngos po chos nyid du sbyo/da yul rig pa snang ba dang stong pa dbu ma gang du'ang ma mthong ba nyid chos nyid mthong ba ste nga ga me long bzhin du rig pa dang gsal pazabayul mthong ba med 'a sdomar brtogs pa'i gzungs kyis zin pa rtan du 'khor bar mi 'ag pa'o/ /gnyis su med pa'i rten des na 'a ṭa rab bdang byu/ ngan las 'a das gnyis su rigs rgyud so sor nges pa med pas de lta na 'bras bu'i zeg pa yin pa'o/ /'khor 'das gud gud gnyis par nges pa'i rim pa rgyud gnyis su chad pa med de/ /'khor 'das gnyis so so min nges na zla na gnyis bsgrub tu med pa rin po che 'ching bu ltar 'gyur ba/ nga phyin ci log yang dag lam gyis bcos su med par 'gyur ba mdze lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sngags kyi don ma mthong bar sgom na don med de rgyal dmangs su 'bab pa lta bu'o gang zag ltabamathong ba'i lta ba rtogs pa gces par bstan don 44byed557

med pa/ /lta ba med par dgon pa bstan pa nor ba ste dgon pa'i dbe+en lam gang dge ba rang rgyud pa bsgom pa smin par ——pa/ nga de'i nye bas mi brgyal la 'byongs pa chu 'jug pa slar srog 'dor ba dang 'dra'o mun pa'i don med par bsgoms pa 'ang 'du shes med pa dang bsam gtan bzhi dang snyoms 'jug bzhi dang mu stegs su gol nas 'ag mo khams su brtsang bar 'gyur/ /skyon yod pa des na sgom pa'i dang po thog ma gang ba rtogs pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa don shes pa na de nyid thams cad mkhyen pa te ces so ba/byunges// /sa/nga pa/ba/ gsang sngags kyi de bzhin nyid mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ste ngo bo sna tshogs su snang yang snang tsam na ther zug pa med pas yod pa min rig pa cir yang snang bas med pa min pas mtha' 'a bra' bas ma da pa ce/da sngags kyis don grub pa'i mtha' bstan pa'i phyir gnyis :sgozug yod med gnyis pas 'das so/ /byang sems ther zug pa med pas rtag pa med pa 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pas chad cesad thams cad rang rig pa nyid la spyod yul med pas 'dre/ 'o/nga cesad bzhi/ /chos nyid de bzhin nyid ni 'di kho na'o zhes mi bzad pas/ gnyen pos mi brlag pas zla)ba snying pos mi glag pa med 'gag med rigs rgyud bral ba rang byung ye shes su gnas mtha' rnams med/ /dbu ma ltar snang ba med par ma song te yod pa 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir med pa ma yin skye 'gag la sogs pa ril kyang ma spangs te de gnyis su med pa kun gyi dngos gzhi'o/ /med pa med de snying po'i don dbu ma la rten ma 'cha' ste don dam pa 'ba' zhig gtsor bzang bar bzung na sngags kyi don mi mthong ba'i sgrib pa yin rnam pa kun ldan bsam brjod bral ba'o/ /bsgom pa'i dgos ched ni gnyis te rnam par rtog pa'i sgrib pa mun pa sbyang ba'iphyir dang / /byang chub don du gnyer ba'i phyir ma nor don la rtogs pa'i dus de nyid du chos nyid bsdom pa la 'jug te 'du 'dzi longs spyod mi chos srid spangs te baspyab phyir du bsam gtan la 'jug/ /dgos byed yod pa de yi rtogasapa chos nyid de tshe de la btson pas 'jug par bya'o/ /bsgom pa de'i sngon du byang sems rtogs pa dang snying rje dang sems bskyed la sogs pa byu/ ba jordogs byu/sa te/ /khams gsum thar pa la 'god par 'di la spang kong tsha tsha ste 'don rab tu byung ba'i sde pa yang snying rjer byas ste gzugs tshogs mchod sbyin sreg nad pa la sogs pa la phan par bya'o sems bskyed parabyasgrib sbyang ba'iphyirabasod nams bsag /phan 44byed558

tshun 'byel chags khazas sogs pa gsal bar bya/ /blamaladabang rdzogs par nos la mnyes pa sna tshogs kyi thugs mnyes par byas gdam ngag zhu/ /bar chad nad kyi bar chad bsrung ba (rig sngags sman dang sman yig )bsrung ba'i las skyabs 'gro dang gtor ma dang bzlas pas bar chad bzlog gsungs jordob/sa babyu1ma/ bgegs kyi bar chad bsrung ba (sngags dang gu gul nyungs kar/〉 dgra'i bar chad bsrung ba'o (go mtshon/) /bsam gtan gyi cha rkyen dang phung po'i cha rkyen gyur pa bsam gtan gyi cha rkyen bla ma yod na rab med na grogs nyams can dang man ngag gi yi ge ris dang bka' lung dang mthun rkyen bsdu'o kun bsdu 'o/sa/ /'du 'dzi spang ba'i phyir de nas phyi 'di yul zhing bran khol dang nang gi gnyen mtshan 'brel ba rnams/ /rkad dang mi bde ba spang zhing / /gang du bde bar 'gro bar bya ces so/ /bsgom pa'i 'gal rkyen rnams nga/pag 'byeng/ de dag las ring du 'gro'o du mas bshugs te spang / /bkra shis lo rgyud yod pa'i gnas gtam rgyud dang gtsug lag dang mthun pa'o gtam rgyud ni gang byed pa der grub pa thob pa'i lo rgyus ni stag lung dang mkhar chu'i brag dang li yul ljang ra mugs po lta bu'o/ /gtsug lag khang dang mthun pa la gnyis chos kyi dang lo ka'i gtsug lag khang pa mthun par sa gzhung bzang ba'i dgon pa brlan chung ba tsha grang snyoms pa snang sel ran par brtsigs la zhal zhal byi dor bya bgegs mi gnas par bya ba'i ched du gu gul gyis bdug a sri tas sang ngo / /pa/be/skya/ nga gzhu 'dom lnga brgya yod pa de rgyang grags gcig go de la dgon pa zhes bya'o batha la te 'dug sa yang / /khams rab rib dang mag mog dang nyag nyog dang gnyid ma dag pa la bsgom na khams ldog sgom nyams par 'gyur bas bsangs te sel ba la sgom mo/ /bla ma sen re ri nyin gung khams bsang ces drang ngo bsangs pi par stan la 'dug /theg pa chung ngu'i thun mong bu la khams gsum sems can thams cad bu dang 'dra bar bsam te bsgoms pas bu thob pa dang ma nu thams cad bskyabs te thar par gdon zhes snying rje/ rang bzhin 'khrul pa rgyu ma rig pa rkyen las dang nyon mongs pa 'bras bu du kha brgyad dam bcu gcig la dmigs te snying rje ba'o thag ཿ/ bcad sngags la ltos na yo ga man chad snying rje'i yul lo thabs chung pa 'bras bu thag ring ba rtsol bas nyams thag pas so/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka chos kyidon bzhi 'dod phyir rnal 'byor brtsam/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung 'brel bsgom pa'i blo 44byed559

(1na can tshigagikha 'phrul che baspalo byed spug yar la dga' ba'o skam 'cha' ba/ /serasnas blam dang dkon mchog la gces pa'i nor mchog mi gtong zhing / /nganathabs dang g.yo sgyus yon mi 'bul bar thabs legs kyi gdam ngag 'gru ba ni/ bla ma'i chaban ngag 'bru b.rabyed pa/ /'a nga na rag na bshes byed skyid kyi rogs byed pa'o slob dpon la chos kyi 'a dre/'ab balnga sa nabla ma cha nyes chi/ dra// /bla ma'i gzhung dang rgyud kyi don gyi bcud bor nas gzhag man ngag sngon la zhus nas de nas gang dgar 'dor ba dang / /tshig 'ga' rnyed phye phrug lung pa brnyed pa bzhin byed pa na'ang gzhanalaspel byed cing / /zang zing gi nor rdzas dang 'jig rten pa'i kheng grags ched dang don du gnyer ba la/ /dusanam zhar gdam ngag bstan par mi bya ste 'o na bstan pa la skyon ci yod zhe na/ /slob ma sgod ngan la bstan na slob dpon de dang slobamaderangan 'gro brtsang bar 'gyur des na rkyen de dag las bzlog pa'i yon tan la sbyin par bya'o/ /de tha snyad kyi jugag 11gas rgya ma11 ma bshad kyang / /bsam gtan gyi man ngag 'di ster stenapa'ibla ma la/ /rangagisnying gi snying du snying bas gces par nan tan bya/ /snying pa gces pa de ltar spyod yul sbyong ba'i de yang bla ma srog tu 'dzin byed cing man ngag snying du 'chang byed pa'i slob bu de la spyod par bya ces so man ngag 'di yang bcad/ /spyod yul sbyong ba'i bsam gtan/slob dpon be+e ma la mi tras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //chos 'di sgom chen mi nus pa la mi sbyin/ 'di las zab pa med do/ /'grel pa rma rin chen mchog gis mdzad pa yod par snang // //44byed567

༄na lung lnga'i rtsa ba bzhugs so// ragyi/ /rgya gar skad du/ /su tra tan gh+ra ②la sran ma pra ti smas: ka ru na sa ta na ma ka ra ma ra ya dhe ba: karma ku ru ma la sa da na ma bhu ha man tra ti sa to ka pra ti saṃ: sgo ha u tod ta sarba ma hā ra tsa: bod skad du: mdo rgyud rtogs pa'i sgon ma zhes bya ba: thugs rje spyan thag gi gnas: mdzad pa lha'i cho 'phrul: phrin las mthar phyin pa'i sgrub pa: gsang sngags nges par byed pa'i don: gsal bar byed pa'i sgon ma: lung thams cad kyis rgyal po chen po'o: :bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po ye shes rig pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: :de nas 'dir ni rab bshad pa: :kun gyi lung chen 'di yin te: :yong le bskal pa bsam yas shing : :brjod du med par gnas pa yi: :phyogs bcu rnams dang dus gsum du: :bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang : :mdzad pa'i phrin 44byed569

las sna tshogs pas: :'gro ba'i phrin las tshim mdzad cing : :ya mtshan byin rlabs rmad po che: :cho 'phrul rnam pa mang bstan yang : :don rdzogs gzhan la phan par ni: :thams cad kun kyi dgongs rgyud gcig :mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong stiyangs su: :rig pa'i ye shes stong gsal bas: :chos sku thig le chen po'i ngang : :sangs rgyas nyag gcig spyod yul lo: :kun gzhi ma bcos byang chub sems: :de bzhin nyid gcig dbyer med la: :ma rig 'khrul pa'i snang ba yis: :bzung 'dzin dngos por rtog pa yi: :gdul bya thabs kyis bzung ba'i phyir: :thugs rje'i dpyangs thag rgyun chad med: :che ba'i chen po sangs rgyas rnams: :'gro ba drug la sogs pa kun: :byams pa'i thegs pas 'dzin pa yis: :byed pa po dang bya ba dang : :dmigs pa'i gnas su nges so zhes: :ma bcos thig le rdzogs pa las: :rang byung ngang las skur snang ba'i: :de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs: :thugs rje'i mdzad pas sangs rgyas kyang : :gnas lugs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi: :ji bzhin pa yi don de la: :sangs rgyas sems can dbyer med cing : :ye sangs rgyas su lhun gyis grub: :ma btsal bsal dang bzhag pa med: :rgyun gyi rnam pas rtog min kyang : :sgra tsam nyid du bstan nyid na: :gol sgrib rang sar dag pa yi: :chos nyid mu mtha' mnyam nyid kyis④: :mtha' bzhi ma spangs mi gnas la: :sangs rgyas zhes ni de nyid bzhed: :brda' yis brtags pa'i sangs rgyas la: :che ba'i yon tan bsam yas shing : :gzhal dang grangs las 'das mod kyang : :'dor bzhag sku dang ye shes so: :lnga dang bzhi dang gsum dang gnyis: :de bzhin gcig gi 44byed570

sku rnam phye: :ngo bo nyid dang rnam smin dang : :chos dang longs spyod sprul pa lnga: :rnam smin rgyu mthun sprul pa ste: :de nas thub pa'i sgu mchog bzhi: :ngo bo nyid sku bral 'bras zhes: :sangs rgyas gsung las sku gsum nyid: :mdor na sems nyid sangs rgyas te: :de nyid ma yin sems can zhig :'ga' yang yod pa ma yin pas: :ma bcos ye nas mngon sangs rgyas: :kun kyang bral ba'i 'bras bu ste: :de phyir ngo bo nyid sku gcig: marnam pa'i ye shes bzhi dang dgu: :me long gzhan dang mnyam pa nyid: :so sor rtogs dang bya ba grub: :chos dbyings shes pa'i ye shes so: :de nyid dngos dang mdon pa gnyis: :skye 'gag gnyis la'ang tha snyad du: :so so'i rgyud dang bcas nyid do: :kun gzhi dang ni nyon mongs yid: :yid dang sgo lnga'i rnam shes dang : :chos kyi dbyengs las yang dag 'byung: :des na rgyu dang 'bras bu zhes: :bral ba tsam la brtags pa'o: :ma nor ma bcos dpal gyi dpal: :lhun gyis gnas pa'i sangs rgyas la: :thugs rje bya ba'i yul gang las: :sgyu ma'i sprul pa rab tu bzung : :yang dag nges pa'i don nyid la: :byed dang bya ba mi dmigs kyang : :sngon du gces pa'i 'bras bu las: :thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa shar: :gzhi lam 'bras bu rnams phye bas: :thugs rjes rnam pa gsum yin te: :sems can dang ni chos la dmigs: :dmigs med snying rje chen po zhes: :phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgyal ba yis: :dgongs brgyud gcig pas yang dag gsungs: :de ltar thugs rjes rjes bzung bas: :gdul bya gang dang gang dag la: :gsung rab du ma'i gsung rab rnams: :sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du: :rnam pa 44byed571

du mar gsal ba dag :gsung ba med bzhin gsung bar snang : :thugs rje'i 'jug pa sna tshogs pas: :ji ltar 'os pas gdul mdzad de: :phyi rol byed pa'i sde rnams la: :de dang der snang ston pas gsungs: :gang yang chad par lta 'dod la: :'di ltar snang tshod 'di lta ste: :sems can skye ba snga phyi dang : :thams cad mdon pa'i sangs rgyas dang : :sgog tu 'gyur ba'i 'gro med dang : :dbang phyug dang ni byed po dang : :las dang 'bras bu las med pas: :tshu rol skabs 'di mdzes so zhes: lha'i bla ma'i gzugs nyid kyis: rgyang 'phen pa yi bden pa gsungs: gang zhig drang srong rjes slob cing: rgyu dang 'bras bu gnas 'dod la: shes bya bdag dang gtso bos te: bdag ni byed med pyong ba'o: gtso bo'i rang bzhin rnam 'gyur zhes: rgyal ba'i rjes 'byengs ser skyas bshad: de bzhin bdag dang gtso bo las: rdzas dang de las byung ba yis: rtag dang mi rtag smra byed la:dus gsum gyis ni rjes su la: srog dang srog ma yin pa la: rten dang sdom pa bral ba la: bcings dang thar dang bsod nams dang : 'gro dang 'ong bas go 'phangs dgu: gcer bus ngal dub spyod pa yis: zhal zas 'dod pa rnams la bstan: dbang phyug nyid dang shes bya'i gnas: rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi: bye brag 'du ba drug nyid kyis: de shes dbang phyug mchod legs pas: thar zhes rig pa can dag dang : bye brag pa la rab dgongs te: ra la na'i tshul gyis gsungs: la lar khyab 'jug gtsor byas nas: thams cad 'di nyid kyis sprul cing : shes pas bdag nyid shes min te: mchod sbyin dang ni khrus byas pas: sdig dang sgrib pa zad 'gyur zhes:44—572

spyod pa la la tshangs par bstan: de gzhung 'ga' gcig sems tsam du:byed pa po dang dge mi dge: dus khams yon tan stong pa rnams: spyod cing rnam par goms pa na: bdag nyid gcig pu kun 'dus pas: don dam yin zhes tshangs pa smra: dge sbyong go'u ta ma'i gzugs: thub dbang rgyal ba mchog gis kyang : ji lta ji ltar 'dul gyur pa: de bzhin thub pa'i bstan par gsungs: kha cig la ni gang zag dang : dus gsum shes par bya ba'i gnas: rdzas su 'du ste lus sems gnyis: tha dad dus mtshungs don dam du: yul sems bden par smra rnams kyang : chos kyi bdag zhes nges par brtan①: de 'drar kha cig ma dgongs te: ji ltar snang yang sems nyid la: rnam par 'jig don sems kyi gzhi: skyes te 'dra ba'i chos bdag nyid: de ni dam pa'i don yin te: bden par grub ces rgyal bas gsungs: thams cad sems su smra 'dod la: kun tu rtags dang gzhan dbang dang : yongs su grub pas shes bya gsum: ji ltar snang ba'i don gnyis dang : gnyis med shes pa'i rab dbye bas: ngo bo nyid gsum bden gnyis te: rig snang shes pa ma lus la: bdag ces kun tu brtags pa dang : don shes na yang ma rigs ⑤pas: bslad pa'i snang ba kun brtags par: smra zhing sems kyi snang ba la: yod dang med pa'i gzhung du snang :gang yang ngo bo nyid med 'od: bden pa gnyis la rab brten nas: sgyu ma rab tu mi gnas pa: nges par bden zhes thub pas gsungs: bde gshegs gsung gi ngo bo las: grub mtha' so sor snang ba rnams: sangs rgyas sa la drang ba'i phyir: bstan pa'i dbye ba gsungs pa yin: tha mal pa 44—573

las blo bzlog phyir: mu stegs byed kyi bstan pa ste: de'i 'dod blo so so'i tshul: mya ngan 'da' bar drang ba'i phyir: mchog gyur sangs rgyas bstan pa ste: de'i 'grub mtha' so sor gsungs: nyan thos sde dang rang sangs rgyas:blo tshan sems rtog dbu ma pa: rgyu 'bras mnyam nyid las sbyar phyir: bya ba'i rgyu sogs so sor gsungs: bde gshekas thugs rje chos kyi char:brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yang : gdul bya'i sgrib pa bral phyir te:sangs rgyas 'phel ba'i phyir ma yin: kha cig drang ba'i tshul gyis so: kha cig skyo ba bskyed pa ste: kha cig brod pa bskyed pa'o: mdor na de dag thams cad kyang : thugs mchog dgongs rgyud gcig gis gsungs: mdo dang rgyud dang cho ga dang : le'u dum bur rab phye dang : rtog pa la sogs ji snyed pa: thugs rje rgyun gyi spyang thag go: :'phags pa'i thugs rje gsum nyid kyis: bzung par bya ba'i gnas nyid dang : :log par zhugs dang nges par 'dzin: mnyam pa nyid du shes pa'o: thog mtha' med pa'i dus kyi dbyings: 'phel 'grib med par gnas pa ni: chos rnams kun gyi dngos gzhi ste: bde gshegs thugs kyi snying po'o: de las sems dang sems byung gis: sna tshogs yul gyi dngos por bzung : des bskyed rgyu gsum ngo bo nyid: gnas lugs ye don ji bzhin pa'i: mtshungs par bstan pas ma rig pa: kun grol kun tu btags pa yin: de bskyed log par zhugs pa yang : the tshom bskyed dang slarobazung zhing : de la chad dang rtag brtags la: 'jig tshogs mthar 'dzin nyid du 'gyur: log zhugs ji ltar brtags don la: chags sdang nga rgyal skyes pa ni: btang mi 'bral zhing zlos sems 44byed574

pas: log pa las kyang log par zhugs: gzhan yang khong khro skye ba dang :lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs la: mchog tu 'dzin pa log lta rnams:log pa las kyang de bzhin zhugs: de dag kun tshogs 'dus pa las: shing rta chen po'i 'phang lo bzhin: rigs drug gnas su 'khor gyur te: rang rang sdug bsngal nyams su pyong : 'gro la dmigs pa'i thugs rje yis: spyang thag gis ni de mi gtong : nges par 'dzin pa thugs rje'i gnas: rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung ba ni: chos nyid dngos po'i gnas lugs so: gzugs dang sems dang sems las byung : 'dus byas khams dang 'dus ma byas:brtag cing shes pa'i bzhir bzhag ste: dad dang dran dang ting 'dzin ni:brtson 'grus dang ni shes rab rnams: rjes su dran phyir gang bcas te:shes rab rgyu yis rab bskul te: rang rang lta bas nges par bzung : 'di yang kha cig med ces na: tha snyad 'dzin pas bskur ba 'debs: ma la nges par yod do zhes: yang dag don la sgro 'dogs te: de yang kha cig 'dus ma byas: rtag pa gcig pu'i dngos por smra: kha cig 'dus ma byas pa'i don: mi rtag du ma'i dngos por brtag: la las gnyis ka brjod med shes: la las thams cad dngos med par: bden par grub pa'i don du brtags: des na nges 'dzin bsam mtha' yas: mdor na don rnams ji snyed kun: yod dang med dang tha dad dang : gcig pa nyid de brtag bzung bas: mtha' cher lhung zhes lung 'dir bshad: mthar 'dzin nges pa'i blo can rnams: ma dmigs pa'i snying rje 'dzin: dmigs med thugs rje'i spyang thag yul: mnyam pa nyid du shes pa ni: phung po khams dang skye 44byed576

mched dang : gnas lugs ngo bo nyid dag pa'i: mdor bsdus bden gnyis ma lus rnams: rtags snang blo bzhag grub pa'i mtha': bzhir bzhag rang byung ye shes kyis: rig pa'i blo yis 'ub chub pa'i: de rgyu dngos dang dngos med mtha'i: mthar thug spyod pa mkhas pa yin: de phyir mnyam nyid rtogs zhes pa: yod med rtags chad mu bzhi la: skyon bzhi rtags bzhi sgra 'thun pas: mtha' zhes so sor bzhag pa ste: don la khyad 'phags mnyam pa grol: de yang tshig yin der 'dzin grol: des na thams cad mnyam nyid de: 'ub chub kun 'dus mnyam pa'i dbyings: dbyer med lhun grub chen po la: dag dang ma dag gnyis med de: thams cad bral ba'i ngang nyid pas: chos rnams thams cad sangs rgyas yin: de ltar rgyu bral mnyam nyid cing : thams cad ye gcig chen po la: dmigs med thugs rje chen po'o:mi g.yel dpyangs thag rgyun du 'dzin: 'di ni 'gyur med ma chad pa: ma bcos lhun gyes grub pa'o: mdo rgyud rtogs pa bsdus pa'i sgon ma las:lung thams cad kyi rgyal po: theg chen dpyangs thag gnas kyi lung bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o:: ::de nas kun gyi de nyid don: lung chen bsdus pa rab bshad bya: phyogs bcu dus gsum 'jig rten na: ci skye 'jig med par rab brtan pa'i: bde bar gshegs pa kun rnams kyis: gsung gi phrin las tha dad kyang : de'i sku'i che ba las: mdzad pa lha'i cho 'phrul byung : de nyid bsam yas brjod med de: mdor bstan brgyud ces bya bar smos: rgyud ni byedal pa'i don 44byed576

yin te: de 'dir mtshungs pas rgyud kyi mchog : lha zhes bya ba byang chub sems: de ni brgyud du rab tu brjod: tha snyad tsam du phye ba ni: gzhi lam rnams bu gsum du brjod: gzhi ni gnas pa'i don de nyid: lam ni rnal 'byor bsgrub pa po: 'bras bu mthar thug pa yi las: rgyud ni rnam pa gsum zhes brjod: phung po khams dang skye mched rnams: ye nas ma bcos lha bdag nyid: gzugs ni rnam par snang mdzad de: tshor ba stsong ba rin chen 'byung : 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas la: 'du byed don yod kun tu 'grub: rnam shes mi bskyod rdo rje sems: ye nas ma bcos ji bzhin gnas: sa dang sha ni spyan ma ste: chu khrag ma ma ki ru 'grub: me drod gos dkar mo zhes bya: rlung dbugs lha mo sgol ma'o: mig gi skye mched sa yi snying : rna ba phyag na rdo rje ste: sna ni nam mkha'i snying po'o: lce ni spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid: lus ni sgrib pa kun sel nyid: yid kyi skye mched 'jam dpal yin: gzugs ni gzugs kyi rdo rje ma: sgra yang de bzhin sgra rdo rje: dri dang ro ni rdo rje ste: reg chos nyid kyang rdo rje ma: lus rnams dag pas lha mo'i tshogs: ngo bo nyid kyi lhun rmis grub: de dag so sor rab phye ba'i: rigs dang ye shes ltas pa'i: lnga lnga ru ni 'gyur ba ste: rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin no: kun la khyad par che ba las: mdor na dam pa rigs brgya ste: bye ba'i rigs la grangs med 'gyur: rigs kyi dbye ba ji snyed pa'i: de bzhin gshegs pa sa khams te: rdo rje rigs mchog rnam par shes: rin chen rigs ni me'i khams: pad+ma'i rigs las chu zhes bya:las kyi rigs tshogs rlung yin pas: khams lnga'i rang bzhin rigs la ni:44—577

de nyid kho na rigs lnga'o: rigs kyi dbye ba lnga nyid kyang : sa dang chu ni lus kyi sku: de bzhin me rlung gsung du brjod: rnam par shes pa thugs rang bzhin: sku dang gsung thugs dbyer sped pa'i: gsang ba chen po'i rigs gcig nyid: gcig dang mang po'i rnam dbye kun: phung po khams dang skye mched dang : yid dang chos dang dus bzhi dang : thar cha bzhi dang 'gro ba drug: rang bzhin rnam par dag gnas las: bde gshegs rgyal ba bzhi bcu ste: zhi ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: bcos med ngo bo nyid kyi 'grub: rang bzhin gdod nas zhi ba yis: dpal chen po la phyag rgyar brjod: rol pa'i cho 'phrul 'gag med pas: thogs med dus nas rang gis khro: ji ltar snang srid ma lus kyang : rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rol pa las: gzhan du gnas pa ma yin te: lha'i mchog las lha'i ngang : dug snang snang ba gtso bo'i sku :'dod chags rta mchog rgyal po ste: rdo rje zhe sdang he ru ka: nga rgyal ya ma gshed rgyal po: phrag dog rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku:gti mug che mchog te ru ka: ser sna byang sems mngon rdzogs rgyal: gdung ba'i sems ni rdo rje chos: khong khro dregs pa kun 'dul yin: snar dang 'tshig pa stobs ldan nag :nyon mongs rtsa ba re re yang : so so'i bye brag lnga lnga ste: de dag rigs bzhi so so'i 'khor: nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dag :sna tshogs pa'i 'khor yin te: mdor na 'di ltar snang ba yis:srid gsum 'jig rten ma lus pa: snod du snang ba gzhal yas khang :bcud ni lha'i tshogs yin te: dag pa lo ka dag pa'i klong : rnam dag chen por lhun gyis grub: 'byung ba lnga'i yum lnga'i klong : gnas shing brten pa'i 44—578

las rnams kun: gzhal med khang dang da la yin: pha dang ma ni yab dang yum: bu dang bu mo sras po'o: phyi nang brtse ba'i 'khor rnams ni: da la can gyi lha nyid 'khor: bran dang mngags gzhugs dmangs kyi tshogs:bka' nyan las byed pho nya'i tshogs: brgyan bcas mtshan dang dpe byad ste:tshig brjod snying po gsum gyi sgra: longs spyod mchod pa kho na ste: yon tan tshig thos bstod pa'o: 'phro zhing 'jug pa bya byed las: mdzad pa'i phrin las 'di nyid yin: chags par byed pa chags pa'i tshul: 'jigs pa 'jigs pa srid mthar byed: stong par shes pa stong pa nyid: sngar bzhin gnas bshad gnas pa'o: 'di ltar sems nyid sna tshogs su: snang zhing srid pa'i dngos po kun: rang bzhin rnam dag lha'i dbyings: lha'i rol pa lha'i sku: de bzhin dngos rnams ma lus pa: ye nas lha'i rang bzhin pas:lha'i gzhi zhes rab tu brjod: de ni rgyud du shes bya ste: dus rnams kun tu 'brel pa'o: bde gshegs lha'i dngos po yis: lam zhugs rnams la sgyu mar sprul: cho 'phrul bsgod bya'i skur snang yang : rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i rgyud ces bya: skyes bu chags pas rab gdungs pa: zhi ba'i go nas sbyor byed pas: bsod nams tshogs ni rab bsags pas: mi rtogs mi dmigs de bzhin nyid: lhan ṣ+per gnas pa thugs rjer shar: sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin yi ge'i mchog :thams cad bskyed byed rang bzhin no: 'byung ba yum lnga'i rang bzhin no: 'byung ba yum lnga'i dkyil 'khor du: ye shes gzhal yas lhun gyis rdzogs: gdan stengs sa bon las bskyed pa'o①: rigs gcig rigs brgya rigs lnga yis: sku dang bsdus pa bzhi bcu gnyis: gnyen lcug 44—579

'khril ldem gzhon tshul can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar:mtshan dang dpe byed ma 'gags chos: rang rig byang chub sems las byung :dbyings nas spyan 'dren dbyer med bstem: gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal te: mchod bstod dgyes mdzad phrin las bcol: gsang sngags bsnyen pa'i bzlas brjod kyis: nye bar byas te si ti blangs: bzod par byas la don lam bya: mi dmigs mi rtogs chags bral bas: chos nyid dbyings ni dge rtsar bsngo: 'di ni zhi ba zhi mdzad lha: mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul bsam brjod pa: 'dod pa can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir: sangs rgyas rol mor gar mdzad do: shin tu gdug pa'i zhe sdang can: sdug pa'i sgo ni khro bo ste:'tshams bcad bgegs skrad gdugs ①pa 'dul: sngon du 'gro ba'i bya ba bdun: rdzogs nas ting 'dzin gsum bsgoms ②zhing : 'byung ba lnga dang ri rab bskyed: rin chen dur khrod rab 'bar ba'i: gzhal yas mdzes shing 'jigs par bsgoms①: de dbus gdan stengs rgyu mchog las:bskyed pa'i gtso bo rdzas dang bcas: so so'i 'khor dang rab ldan pas:sgeg dang 'jigs dang dpa' ba dang : gzhed dang gshe rngam khro ba dang :snying rje zhi ba'i tshul 'chang bas: gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa yis: de 'dra'i 'jigs byed chen po'i dgu: bskyed dang spyan drangs gnyis su med:bstem bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod pas mchod: bstod dang sngags bzlas rjes bya'i rim: dus drug dus bzhi dus med du: rab tu 'bad pas gang bsnyen zhing : bsgrub pa rnams ni lam gyi nyams: rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i bsgom pa ste: khro bo chen po stobs mchog gi: lam dang lam kyi brgyud du gsungs:44byed580

zhi dang khro bo'i skur gsal bas: chags dang zhe sdang rab gsal te: gzhan gyi don du skur snang ba: thog med 'bras bu de'i mchog: de ni 'byel pas brgyud ces bya: gzhi lam 'bras bu dbyer med pas: gzhi dang 'dra ba'i lam bsgoms pas: de'i 'bras bu rab tu snyoms: :thugs rjes mdzad pa sku rnams dang : :'gro ba'i don la rab tu brtson: :zhi ba la ni zhi ba ste: :khro bo can la khro bo'i sku: :'dod chags can la chags pa'i tshul: :zhe sdang can la de'i tshul: :ma rig pa la gti mug byed: :ser sna la ni 'jungs pas so: :phrag dog phrag dog dag gi 'dul: :zhi la zhi ba rgyas pa 'ang de: :dbang chen la ni dbang bsdud tshul: :drag shul can la de nyid kyis: :tshar gcod gzugs su ston par mdzad: :rigs drug 'gro ba drug gi gtso: :thub byed drug gi sku rang bzhin: :skyes pa la ni skyes pa'i gzugs: :bud med la ni bud med de: :mkhan po slob dpon rgyal po dang ::bram ze rje rigs dmangs dang bran: :tshong dpon dmag gi me tse ba: :tha na dud 'gro yan chad gzugs: :gang gis 'dul ba der ston te: :mthun pas mthun pas 'dul bar byed: :'dod pa spangs la dka' thub dang ::bde ba 'dod yon longs spyod kyis: :srog 'jog can la sbyin par 'dod: :tshul khrims bsrung dang ma nyams dang : :bsam gtan bsgom dang g.yeng la sogs: :gang gis 'dul dang de ltar ston: :ji ltar 'tshams pa'i don sbyar nas: :skyes bu mthun pas 'dul 'gyur bas: :'di ni mdzad pa'i bya bas te: :'bras bu'i rgyud du rab tu 'dod: :mdor na brgyud ces bya ba'i don: :dngos po'i gnas lugs bzhi yin te: :gzhi las gzhan pa'i 44byed581

'bras bu med: :'bras bu'i byed las 'das pa yis: :lam gyi bsgom pa ga la mchis: :de bas rgyu dang 'bras bu dang : :lam zhes grags pa btags pa tsam: :'di ltar snang ba 'di kho na: :lha nyid yin te de las gzhan: :chos dbyengs spros pa med pa yis: :de ni don dam kun rdzob zhes: :lung chen kun las gsungs pa yin: :'di ni lung chen mdor bsdus pa: :sangs rgyas 'phrin las bstan pa yis: :rmad du byung ba'i cho 'phrul kun: :rab tu bsdus min rgyas min par: :rdo rje sems dpas bstan pa ste: :'dir bstan pa la the tshom med: :de bas ma 'ongs skye bo kun: :yid gnyis spangs pas 'dud par bya: :'di ni sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra: :de bzhin gzugs brnyan sprul pa dang : :smig rgyu dri za'i grong dang mtshungs: :sangs rgyas mdzad pa bsam yas pa: :ma mdzad pa la mdzad pa che: :thams cad rang rang lta bur nges: :e ma chos nyid spros dang bral: :e ma ho rang gzhan ma 'gags snang : :e ma rol pa bla na med: :e ma sgyu ma phyag rgya che: :e ma thugs rje ma lus 'dzin: :sprul pa'i sku ste lha yi mchog:lha rnams nyid la gnyis med 'dus: :mdo rgyud rtogs pa bsdus pa'i sgon ma las: :lung thams cad kyi rgyal po: :mdzad pa cho 'phrul lha'i lung bstan pas te gnyis pa'o: :rdzogs so:: ::mthar thug ye nas don chos sman rdzas te: :rnam dag dgongs pa de don rdzogs: :lha dang de la mchod rdzas sngags: :sku dang chos nyid snying po dang : :sgra dang si ti shes pa yis①: :ma lus thugs kyi dgongs par 'dus: ::44byed582

dus gsum shes bya gcig pu nyid: :bde chen 'bras bu kun 'dus pa:yongs rdzogs sku gsum mthong ba yis: srid gnas gcod dang sprul pa dang :'khor lo bzhi'i don spyod pas: sku'i dgongs pa mthar thug cing : 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gshin gyi rje: ma lus 'joms par byed pa'i gshed:mnyam nyid brtan par rab bsgrub pa'i: mtshon pa'i dbye dang gdul bya'i thabs: lta spyod dgongs pa'i don dag gis: gsung gi dbang phyug phrin las don: ma lus mnyes par byed pa'i yul: gcig dang du ma'i mthar thug pa'o: theg pa rim par bsgod pa dang : sa dang lam la sbyar ba dang :gsang sngags la shan 'byed pa yi: rig pa nyid kyi dgongs par thug: phrin las rgyu bzhi rab brten cing : thabs dang de las 'byung ba yin: rnam bzhi zab mo'i don byed cing : mthar phyin dgongs pas de ltar bshad:lus gnas nyid dang de la g.yos: rnal 'byor gral dang lo ka snang : drag shul sngags dang gab pa'i gter: phyi nang gsang ba nyer spyod cing : yongs rdzogs sku la sbyor ba yis: gsang chen de'i mthar thug don: bsgrub mchog bstod bskul rbad pa yis: nyer ston so so'i las grub cing : snang ba gsum pas kun sbyor ba: bzung yul ma grub tshul shes shing : rang gi ngang gis 'phrin las grub: bde spyod mchod bstod mthar thug pa'i: sngags dang dam tshig ting nge 'dzin: srog 'phrog gnas pa gnad la dbab: rang gi mtshan ma mngon spyod kyis: phrin las tha dad nye bar bsgrubs: stong srog gcig gis bcad pa yis: khams gsum 'dul bar rab tu gshis: bya ba'i bye brag sna tshogs kyis: ngang nyid chen por yongs spyad nas: thig le 44—583

sbyor ba bde bar rol: 'di ni rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor te: zab don mchog tu mngon sangs rgyas: gsang ba dpag dka' rgyud kyi don: ma lus bsdus la ①bsgrub lugs drug: bsnyen pa'i nye gnas bsgrub pa dang : nye bar bsgrub dang sgrub chen po: khyad par las la sbyar ba rnams: theg chen lung du gsal bar gsungs: gsang sngags snying po yid 'ong sgra: brgya stong la sogs grangs bcad nas: rgyun tu bzlas shing brjod pa ni: rnal 'byor gsang ba'i snying po'o: dben pa'i gnas su ngag gzhan spangs: de nyid 'bad pas nyer ston ②te: thun mabyedas bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyis: le lo med par rtag sbyin pa: sgrub pa yin te de dag nyid: grangs dang dus dang mtshan ma dang : rim pa bzhin du rab sbyar nas: rdul tshon dkyil 'khor cher gzhug cing : sngon 'gro bsrung dang mtshams bcad dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags rnams kun: mthong zhing brnyan snepar bsgrub byed pa: nye ba'i bsgrub pa zhes bya'o: rtags thob bsgrub pa chen po ni: 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yis: tha mal pa dang mchog tu 'gyur: lo ka tha mal si ti ni: phran tshegs las dang dngos grub zhes: rgyal ba mchog gis gsungs pa na: zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug :bskrad dang bsgral ba la sogs pa: las kyi bya ba rnam mang po: gang la 'dod pa des bsgyur cing :dgos pa med pa'i sems kyis 'grub: dngos grub chen po mchog bshad pa: mkha' la spyod dang rkang mgyogs dang : sa 'og spyod dang chu la 'chags: me dang rlung gis mi brdzi dang : mi snang ba dang 'chi ba med:mig dang rna ba sna dang lce: lus dang yid ni dag byas pas: sgog gyur ring 44byed584

ba'i yul 'dzin cing : lha dbang dag pa ma lus mthong : rgyal ba'i thabs mchog bsam yas la: rgya chen rgyun du gsungs pa rnams: so so'i rtags rdzogs rab tu sgrub: 'di dag tha mal bsgrub pa che: sa ti chen po gter bar byed: de nas gang 'dod las la sbyar: 'bad pa med par gzhan don spyod: kun 'dren lcags kyu lta bur 'gyur: las la spyor zhes de la bya: 'di ni lung kun bsdus pa yis: phrin las mthar phyin bsgrub pa ste:dpa' bo don pos gsungs pas na: nges pa'i lung du shes par bya: mdo rgyud rtogs pa bsdus pa'i sgon ma zhes bya ba las: lung thams cad kyi rgyal po:phrin las mthar phyin sgrub pa'i lung bstan pa ste gsum pa rdzogs so:: ::de nas gsang sngags zab mo'i don: nges par 'byed pa'i lung chen po:gsang chen rig pa'i gter gyur pa: rgyal bas dka' byed rab tu bshad:'di ltar gsang sngags zhes bya ba: theg pa dman la gsang 'os shing :yid skyob phyir na gsang sngags te: de ni nges pa'i don yin no: ma man zhes ni yid yin te: tra las yid ni skyob par byed: ma lus yid skyob byed pas na: gsang sngags zhes ni rab tu brjod: ma ni gang zag dngos po'i bdag :tra ni chos bdag bzung 'dzin dngos: gsang ba gnyis med mnyam pa nyid: gsang sngags zhes ni nges par brjod: ma ni rang rig ye shes te:tra ni gzhan las gsal bar byed: gsang ba gnyis med zhi bar rtogs:kun la bsngags pas gsang sngags so: ma ni rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin: tra ni de la gnas med gsal: sgyu ma rab tu mi gnas don: dbyer med mthong ba 44—585

gsang sngags don: ma ni ①'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras te: tra ni spros bral mya ngan 'das: gsang ba'i snying po gnyis med shes: yang sgrub bral bas gsang sngags so: ma ni sems dang ngo bo la: tra ni sna tshogs rig pa'i yul:yul sems kun gyi thugs la gnas: chos rnams tha dad bya ba med: khyad par med cing mtshan med par: gang gi mthong zhing shes pa dag :de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin: gnyis rtags dngos po rnam par grol: gsang sngags nges pa'i don chen te: 'di ni sangs rgyas chos dang ni: dge 'dun rnams kyi bstan pa yin: 'di ni brgyud kyi don mchog de: lung rnams kun gyi bla ma yin: 'di ni gsang ba'i mdzod yin te: bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi gter: 'di ni sems can kun gyi sems: rnal 'byor dam ②kun gye lam: 'di ni byang chub sems rnams kyis: brlabs chen spyod pa bsgod pa'i lam: yang dag nges pa'i lam yin te: bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs klong brdol: snang grags dngos po thams cad kun: ye nas dbyings su gcig pa'o: mdo rgyud rtogs pa bsdus pa'i sgon ma: lung thams cad kyi rgyal po las: gsang sngags nges pa'i don gyi lung bstan pa ste bzhi pa'o:rdzogs so: :de nas gzhan yang gnas lugs bzhi: ma bcos ngang du btang snyoms las: rtag tu mnyam par 'jog pa yi: gsal byed sgon ma'i lung 'di bshad: gang yang yang dag gsang ba'i don: thob par 'dod pas spang blang dang : dgag bsgrub spros pa la sogs pa'i: mtha' gnyis po ni 44byed586

dor byas te: gnyis su med la mnyam gnas bya: 'du shes 'di ni spang mnyam du: gang gi 'du shes 'byung ba ni: 'du shes spros las spyod pa ste:shes pa tsam las 'di mi thar: 'du shes kyis ni kun shes phyir: 'dzin pa yang ni de bstan te: yang dag 'du shes mi 'dzin pa: dben pa'i don du rab tu bstan: gcig pur dbe+en pa gang sems pa: nam zhig sems dpa' med par 'gyur: bsam pa dag la mi sems na: bsam pa nyid kyang med par 'gyur: chos kun sgyu ma ltar shes na: shes bzhin dran pas zin pa yis: btang snyoms 'du shes rab bzhag nas: dang po'i las kyi sa chog yin: chos rnams 'di dag bsam mi khyab: bsam dang blang bral rang bzhin zhi: de bzhin mtshan mar rab shes na: rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas mthong : de nyid skye 'phor gyur pa na: sems ①bzhin du ni 'gyur bar byed: sems la dbang ni thob pas na: de dag yul ni 'od gsal lo:nying 'dzin nyams pa med pa yis: shin tu brtag dka' phra zhing zab: 'du shes thams cad spangs pas te: de phyir ting nge 'dzin zhes bya: rtags pa med cing rnam rtog med: bzung ba med cing gtan du med: dmigs med thogs pa med pas te: de phyir ting nge 'dzin zhes bya: de la nam zhig sangs rgyas te: chos kun la ni don sems med: ma yengs pa yis ji bzhin blta: de phyir ting nge 'dzin zhes bya: skyon yon brtsol ba gzhan dag gis⑤: ma bcos sus kyang ma byas par: rang gis ngang gis gsal bzhin na: tha snyad tsam du bsgom zhes bya: 'di la mthong dang mthong bya med:de phyir yul gyi mngon zhen med: de nas chags dang sdang ba med: dngos 44—587

por snang yang dngos mi snang : bral dang shes pa'i gnas pa gang : blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa: gdengs thag chod pa'i drod yin no: gdeng chen thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas: spyod pa'ang de bzhin gnyis med par: 'gags med stobs kyi dpyad bya ste: mkha' la rgyu ba'i gar mkhan bzhin: 'di la spang bya yod ma yin: mi blang ba yang ga la yod: 'di la mi dpyad 'ga' yang med: mi shes pa yang yod ma yin: mi sgrub pa yang med pas te:'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang : nga rgyal phrag dog nyon mongs lnga:thabs kyi zin dang rang bzhin shes: nyon mongs chen po mi spang ste: de bas yang bar bya ba med: de ma rtogs par bdag ltar bcings: rgyal ba dgongs pa'i tshig la brten: bdag med pas ni nyon mongs bcad: 'gro ba drug tu 'arnams par 'gyur: byang chub sems kyi khu ba ni: dkar dmar gnyis dang bshang dang gci: sha chen por ni gyur pa rnams: rigs lnga ye shes lnga rang bzhin: 'phags pa mchod dang dbang bskur dang: bdud rtsi myang dang brten bzlog phyir: chos rnams mnyam dang brtul zhugs kyis:dang du blang bar bya ba yin: tshig tsam la brten bdag med spyod: mi dge ba yi 'bras bur 'gyur: sbyor sgol ma byen len dang brdzun: ngag tu blang pos mi dge'i chos: 'thun 'jug 'tsham ①pa'i spyod pa ste: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i thabs chen yin: sgrar rjes 'brangs nas rang gar spyod: thur du kha ltas dmyal bar rtsang : gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed dang : rnam par shes ste phung po lnga: zag pa med pa'i rang bzhin gyis: sku lnga ye shes lngar shes pas: 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'i chos: mi shes pa ni yod ma yin:44byed588

thams cad sku dang ye shes lnga: bsgrub par bya ba dmigs pa ni: 'di ni mi sgrub yod min te: des na kun gyis sgrub gcig po: de nyid rtogs pa ci dgar spyod: rnam grol sgyu ma'i byed bstan pa'o: de nyid gsal dang sgrib med pas: dur khrod gsal ba gcan zan gnas: lha min yi dwags lam la sogs: 'jigs dang ya nga'i gnas rnams su: thogs pa med par rab tu rgyu: dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshogs nang du: lha mo rnams dang mnyam du rol: 'di ni brtul zhugs spyod pa ste: sngags kyi spyod mchog bla na med:skad cig nyid la 'bras bu ster: 'di la bsrung ba'i tshul khrims med: ngo pa'i rnam rtog yod ma yin: gang zhig tshul khrims ldan par rtogs: gnyis 'dzin tshul khrims ngan par gsungs: tshul khrims mi ldan gang rtogs pa:gnyis su med pa'i tshul khrims mchog :'di 'dra'i gsang chen ma shes pas:sdig pa 'ga' zhig dgos pa med: 'khor ba'i sa bon rnam par shes: sa bon yod na 'bras bu 'byung : rtsig pa yod na ri mo bzhin: dngos su shes na 'gag par 'gyur: rang gi sems ni ma mthong bas: lta ba'i dra bar 'jug par 'gyur: nga rgyal khengs pas 'khrul rjes rtogs: sred len ma rig mdud pas bcings: nyin mtshan 'dod pa'i yon tan sems: de dag lhas dang grong du rgyu: sems can yongs su grol zhes smra: 'gro la snying rjes bdag la yod: kun la phan sems de bzhin te: zhe sdang 'dod chags sred sems kyis: chos nyid 'tshe ba'i tshul chen brjod: 'tshe dang snying rjes 'dus pa ni: nam yang yod pa ma yin no: des na de dag bzlog pa'i phyir:sna tshogs thabs kyi 'dul ba'i thabs: thog ma med nas 'khor ba na: byis 44—589

pa dngos la zhen pa yis: gsang ba'i don gyi gnod mi la: byams pa'i thugs rjes bzung nas kyang : shing lo gzugs kyi byis pa rnams: brid nas 'dzin pa rnam par bzlog :dngos po'i don gyi bzung rnams la:'khor ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa yis: skyo ba chen pos rab bskul nas:dam pa'i don la bzud par bya: gsum la sogs pa skyabs 'gro zhing :byang chub sems kyi rnam pa yis: pha rol phyin drug spyod pa la: gsang mchogs ①gzhung du dbang bskur te: yongs su rdzogs shing spro ba la:bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan: rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems:mi shigs thig le'i don rtogs na: gsang chen mnyam pa chen po yi: mtha' la bkrol te klong du bskyal: 'di ni 'jig rten thams cad kyis: dngos grub mchog gi bsnyen pa ste: skyes mchog chos kyi rgyal po che: rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan rnams la bshad: 'di ni lung gi lung chen te: zab cing 'jug pa'i bla na med: gsang ba las kyang cher gsang ste: gsang ba chen po'i mchog gyur pa'i: mtha' yas mngon par mthong ba ste: mthar thug gnas su phyin pa'o: 'di yis phyi nang thams cad du: snang grags srid dang zhi ba kun:mnyam grol chen po'i klong nang du: thams cad ma lus brdar sha bcad: de ltar rgyal ba ma lus pa'i: zidagongs brgyud gcig tu bsdus pa ni: lung mchog 'dus te dus gsum gyi: rgyal bas sems can don 'dul phyir:mdo dang brgyud pa rtogs pa las: yang dang yang du bstan te gsungs: rdo rje sems dpa' bla na med: rdo rje chos ni rgyal po ste: rigs ②'dzin mi'i thod pa can: gtso chen byang chub sems dpa' yis: rgyal ba rnams la yang 44byed590

yang thos: snyigs dus 'gro la phan pa'i phyir: rgyud las lung du byung ba ni:mkha' 'gro rnams la brgyud nas ni: ma 'ongs rnal 'byor skal ldan kyi:thugs kyi dkyil du gsungs don rnams: ma nor brgyud du gsal bar gyur:mdo rgyud rtogs pa bsdus pa'i sgon ma las: lung thams cad kyi rgyal po gsal bar byed pa'i sgon ma'i lung bstan pa ste lnga pa'o: :bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i thugs rje dpyang thag :mdzad pa lha'i cho 'phrul: phrin las mthar phyin sgrub pa:gsang sngags nges pa'i don gsal bar byed pa'i sgon ma: lung thams cad kyi rgyal po rdzogs so:: ::rgya gar gyi mkhan po slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : bod kyi lots+tsha ba bai ro tsa na bdag gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o: :rgyal po'i bla dpe'o: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: nyang gi gter ma'o: :44—591

bsdur mchan/569 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tra ka57༷ 4)〈〈pe 〉〉klongs/ 90〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/573 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bstan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rig579 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i/58༷ ①〈〈pe 〉stanadug ②③〈〈pe 〉〉bsgom/582 ①〈〈pe 〉stan/584 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsten/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉brtan/586 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dor/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉pa/587 ①〈〈pe 〉〉 can/ ②〈〈pe 〉stan/588 ①〈〈pe 〉toratshams/59༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉pachog ②〈〈pe 〉〉rigabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2584)44wa 592

༄ga /dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i gtor ma'i cho ga①༄ dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i gtor ma'i cho ga bzhugs so// rag /rgya gar skad du/ shri ma hā ma ya sa ma yā ba li bi dha/ bod skad du/ dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i gtor ma'i cho ga /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skad cig tsam gyis stong par bsams la/ de nas hūṃ brjod de/ hūṃ las skad cig tsam gyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / ra ba dang dra ba'i nang du khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed la/ bdag nyid kyang mdun du te ru ka'i gzugs su byas la/ yi ge 'bru drug pa dang / 'bru gsum pa dang / cod pan gyi lha dran pas bsrung bar bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu yi dang ram̐ la rlung dang me bskyed la/ a las thod pa bskyed| de'i nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga bsam/ de'i steng gi bar snang la zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje bskyed/ rlung gis me sbar mes bdud rtsi bskol 44—593

ba'i 'od kyis zla ba dang rdo rje yang thim nas lha'i bdud rtsir gyur te/ de'i steng du ā+oṃ bsam/ de'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyis bdud rtsi bkug ste bstems la yi ge 'bru gsum gyis sngags lan gsum bzlas pas byin gyis brlab po/ /de nas snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyis bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas/ ā+oṃ shri he ru ka ma hā badz+ra a gad ta ya a gad ta ya/ pra be sha ya pra be+e sha ya bhan dha ya bhan dha/ to sha ya to sha ya/ sarba badz+ra dha ki ni na ma/ hri da hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/zhes brjod pas dam tshig dkyil 'khor la bstems la/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod do/ /de nas lha rnams dang dur khrod brgyad kyi bdag mo rnams kyi lce la hūṃ las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam bsams la/ de'i rtse mor hūṃ bsgoms te/ de'i 'od zer gyis bdud rtsi drangs nas/ gsol bas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thob par bsam mo/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ①shri hi ru ka ma hā badz+ra bra tits+tsha oṃ bha lo hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ ④bud dha dha ki ni pra tits+tsha me bha lo ā+oṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra dha ki ni pra tits+tsha me bha lo hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ rat+na dha ki ni pra tits+tsha me bha dzi tram̐ phaṭa/ā+oṃ pad+ma dha ki ni pra tits+tsha oṃ bha bo hri phaṭa/ ā+oṃ be+e shwa dha ki ni pra tits+tsha me bha lo a phaṭa/ā+oṃ sarba dha ki ni pra tits+tsha rma bha lo ho phaṭa/ de nas de nyid lnga pas bstod pa ni/ /mi skyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyengs ni mkhas chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dga'/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin byi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /dngos nyid dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che//44byed594

mi rtog nam mkha'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa mnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rtogs pas/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung ①du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /ngo bo med cing gnas pa med/ /de ltar chos 'di shes nas kyang / /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /ā+oṃ a hūṃ yul che ge mo zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i khe tra pa la i rda bha lo byut+na 1sna/ ma ma sa pa ri wa ran pa sarba panalca/ sarba pa paṃ bya ti bi ga rna sharnyi ku ru/ dha na dha bya u u ro gyi/ pu ting pu rul sarba bha yo rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā/sems can thams cad nad med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur nas//sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad gyur pa'i/ /lam de nyid du 'gro bar shog /ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang / /ma bsgral ba rnams sgrol byed cing / /rnal 'byor bstan chos gnas pa ni/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /de'i 'og tu yi ge 'bru gsum gyis zhi ba la sogs pa'i las bcol lo/ /de nas ā+oṃ a:hūṃ mu zhes brjod/ se gol lan gsum brdabs te gshegs su gsol ba'o//dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i gtor ma'i cho ga /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ku ku ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs sto// //44—595

kho dran pa gcig pa dang sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i man ngag bzhugs so// ༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ e ka smṛta②/ bod skad du/ dran pa gcig pa/ rdo rje he ru ka'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rdo rje yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gang gi lam dran gcig pa rab bshad bya/ /rang snying yi ge'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis/ /'khor lo bkug ste bla med yan lag bdun/ /bsgrubs ①nas don dam bsgom bya hūṃ yig las/ /snod kyi 'jig rten chu skyes gdan bcas bsgom—/ /hriḥlas zhal bzhi kha ṭī gzhu dang mda'/ /ka pā lar bcas mnyes bya rang snying thim/ /lha dang sngags kyi de nyid bsgom/ /bzlas pa rab tu sbyor bar bya/ /yang na sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ /rang thabs dang 'dus go cha dang / /rdo rje rnam gsum byin rlabs nas/ /oṃ yig zlas pa'i sbyor ba bya/ /rnam lnga'i rlung dang thig le ni/ /snying gar gcig bsdus yi ge bzang / /nyi 44—597

zla'i dbus na rab brtan mi g.yo ba/ /'dir mthong spro ba'i sbyor shes 'od zer dang / /du ba me khyer sgron ma mkha' rnam lnga/ /mthong bas phra mo rab tu brtags par bya/ /rdzu ①'phrul chen mo'i man ngag yon tan brgyad 'thob par byed pa dang / don dam pa bla na med pa sgrub par byed pa'o/ /stod la'i man ngag go/ //bsdur mchan/597 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉skosata/ ②〈〈pe 〉thasgrub/598 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2586)44wa 598

ragyi/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ma yo pa de sha /bod skad du/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i man ngag /te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smras pa/ las kyi rdo rje re ga phyed bcas bdun/ /thig le rlung gi bdag nyid las 'gro 'ong / /rlung dang sngags dbyer med pa'i de nyid gang / /dbang po'i lam las bde ba'i mngon shes lnga/ /'byung 'gyur ā li kā li mnyam byas te/ /lte ba'i ri mor sbyar bas stengs ②du 'bar/ /'og tu bdud rtsi thigs pa'i tshul rmis 'bab/ /steng 'og gcig gnyis dag tu sbyar/ /yul dang dbang po'i grong 'joms pa/ /rlung 'gog gsang ba de dag go/ /rlung dang thig le'i bde bsgrub pas/ /khams gsum dag gis ①lam mchog gi/ /bud med ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /spyan sogs rig ma'i sbyor bas spyad/ /ro 'dzin sbyor bas mi phyed bcings/ /rlung gi sbyor bas mi yi sna/ /sna yi rtse mo'i dbus su sbyar/ /skad cig 'bar 44—599

dang 'dzag par byed/ /snying ga'i dpa' bo zhu ba ste/ /de yang rang bzhin med pa'o/ /bde ba chen po sngags su brjod/ /de dag gong bu'i gzugs gcig ste/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs 'thob/ /dri za'i sems can rmi lam lus/ /rags dang phra ba'i dngos thim pa/ /sku gsum rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom/ /mgrin pa'i pad+mar yi ge dze+e /yang na nor bur rtag tu bsam//sbyor ba 'di ni shin tu gsang / /dang po'i lus ni de nas slar/ /sbom po'i khams la yang dag 'jug /yang dag mtha' la de 'gro ste/ /rnal 'byor gnyid dang yang dag ldan/ /de nas/ dpag tshad brgya yi khyen tsam du/ /'di ni rab tu snang bar byed/ /rig pa dang bcas dpa' bo ni/ /rgyan rnams spros dang me tog bcas/ /mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dod pa spyad/ /gong bu khu ba bu mo dag /bkug nas 'dod pa'i longs spyod bya/ /nyi zla rlung gi sbyor bas rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur te/ de nas yang / 'di yis sgyu 'phrul chen mor 'gyur/ /yon tan brgyad dam mchog yang na/ /dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rig mar lhan cig 'od gsal nas/ /kha ṭī ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /shrī te ru ka snying ga /me ni sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ /nam phyed dus su glu blang ste/ /'di yis rdzogs sangs rgyas par 'gyur/ /kā li zla ba na da sogs/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor 'dir shes bya//gnyis med chos kyi rnal 'byor te/ /rtse ba'i sems kyis 'dir brjod pa'o/ /de ltar sgyu 'phrul chen mo shes/ /'byung po ma kun rab grub 'gyur/ /kasbra la dang klu bod zhabs/ /klu dang khyi mo'i zhal snga nas/ /dharmas kyang ni de ltar bshad—/ /de nas bdag gis grub pa yin/ /slob dpon byā la'i zhabs 44—600

dngos grub brnyes pas mdzad pa dharma'i zhal snga nas kyi rim pa dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i man ngag rdzogs sto// //ma hā ma ya'i man ngag dang po 'di rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo budha ②nā tha'i gsung las tā ra nā thas bsgyur ba'o// //phyi ma'i gu ru'i rdo rje'i spun nidzā ṇa shrī las glegs bam steng nas zhus pa'o// //bsdur mchan/599 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉lteng / ①〈〈pe 〉rga/6༷1 ①〈〈pe 〉ro/da dha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2587)44wa 601

༄ga /rdo rje bdud rtsi gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa/①༄ rdo rje bdud rtsi gzhan gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṣ+ṭa ta nags kyi rin chen gyi zhal snga nas rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud las byung ba paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsa ba bzhon nu dpal gyi 'gyur ba bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzā m+bi bhi sa ma ya tri ta yo/ bod skad du/ rdo rje bdud rtsi gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa/ rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor kyi phreng ba las ma gsungs pa'i rdo rje bdud rtsi gsum po gang yin pa ni/ rgyud las phyung nas bri bar bya ste/ rdo rje bdud rtsi gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ rdo rje gur gyi nang / chos 'byung gi snying por gnas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbus su gsang ba'i pad+ma bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du dpal bdud rtsi hūṃ mdzad khro bo'i gzugs can/ go rī kha dog dkar po'i snying gar zhabs g.yon pa gnas pa'i rol pa'i zhabs/ sku mdog sngon po rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon byi zhal 44byed602

gsum po sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po ste/ zhal dang po mche ba cung zad gatshigs pa/ drag tu cher bzhad pa dang bcas pa/ phyag drug pa rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'chang ba ste phyag gnyis po phan tshun rgyab sbyar ba mthe'u chung mdud cing / sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya'o—/ /g.yas dang g.yon dag gis mda' dang gzhu dag bsnams pa/gzhan dag gis ke li tī la ma dang / rdo rje mtshon cha ma'i nu ma 'dzin pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i glegs bam cod pan la sogs pa'i rgyan du 'dzin pa/ 'od dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can/ shar du rdo rje dregs ma sngon mo/ sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal gsum ma/ rdo rje dang bdug spos dang gzhu dang mda' dang 'khor lo dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho ru rdo rje mtshon cha ma gser gyi mdog /gser dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal gsum ma/ rtsa ba dag gis gzhu dang mda'/ g.yas dang g.yon pa dag gis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan/gzhan dag gis zhags pa dang rdo rje bsnams pa/ nub tu reg bya rdo rje ma pri yang ku ltar sngo bsangs/ thra yang ku ltar sngo bsangs dang dkar bo dang dmar po'i zhal gsum ma/ rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis snying gar rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yas dang g.yon dag gis gzhu dang mda'/ gzhan dag gis rdo rje dang 'khor bo 'dzin pa/ byang du ke li kri la ma dmar mo/ dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po'i zhal/ tsū ta'i snye ma dang mda' dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang gzhu dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la shar du gling bu ma dmar mo/dmar po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ gling bu 'bud pa'i tshul dang thal mo sbyar ba dang / gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'i phyag /lho ru pi wang ma ser 44—603

mo ser po dang dmar po dang dkar po'i zhal/ pi bang brdung ba'i tshul dang /thal mo sbyar ba dang / gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'i phyag /nub tu mu kuṇ+ḍa ma dkar mo dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po'i zhal/ mu kuṇ+ḍa brdung ba'i tshul dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'i phyag /byang du mu ra dza ma/ du ba'i mdog /dud kha dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ mu ra rdza brdung ba'i tshul dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'i phyag /dbang ldan du/ sgeg mo dmar mo/ dmar po dang / dkar po dang / dmar ser gyi zhal/ gzhu dang mda' dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang /rdo rje dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i phyag mer phreng ba ma gser gyi mdog /gser dang dkar po dang / dmar po'i zhal/ rtsa bdag gis me tog gi phreng ba dang /g.yas ba/nga g.yon dag gis thal mo sbyar ba dang / gzhan dag gis gzhu dang mda' bsnams pa/ bden bral du glu ma ut+pal sngon po'i mdog sngon po dang /dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ 'khar rnga dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang /gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'i phyag /rlung du gar ma gser gyi mdog /gser dang / dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ gar byed pa dang gzhu dang mda' dang thal mo sbyar ba byas pa'i phyag /rim pa gsum pa la shar du byams pa gser gyi mdog /mchog sbyin dang / nā ga ke sa ra'i phyag /'jam dpal gser gyi mdog /mchog sbyin dang / po ti'i phyag /lhor namyo/ mkha'i snying po ut+pal sngon po'i mdog phyag na ral gri/ phyag na rin chen dmar po phyag na rin ①che/nub tu kun tu bzang po'i gser mdog phyag g.yas na me tog /'jig rten dbang phyug shel lta bu mchog sbyin dang pad+ma'i phyag /byang du sgrib pa thams cad 44byed604

rnam par sel ba gser gyi mdog phyag g.yas dri ba'i tshul/ phyag g.yon pa kur ①brten pa/ sa'i snying po ljang gu g.yas phyogs su thal mo sbyar ba/ dbang ldan du dri ma dmar mo ②dmar ba dang dkar ba dang nag po'i zhal/ rtsa ba'i phyag gis dri'i dung / gnyis pa dag gis thal mo sbyar ba/ gzhan dag gis gzhu dang mda' bsnams pa/ mer me tog ma dkar mo dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po'i zhal/ thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba/ me tog gi snod dang / gzhu dang mda' dang 'khor lo'i phyag /bden bral du bdug spos ma du ba'i mdog dud kha dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ bdug spos kyi snod dang thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba/ gzhu dang mda' dang 'khor lo'i phyag /rlung du mar me ma gser gyi mdog gser dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ kong bu dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar ba/ mda' dang gzhu dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo'i phyag /shar gyi sgor lcags kyu dmar po dmar po dang dkar po dang / dmar ser kyi zhal/lcags kyu dang ral gri dang mda' dang gzhu dang sdigs mdzub dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i phyag /lhor rdo rje zhags pa dkar po/ dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po'i zhal/ zhags pa dang ral gri dang mda' dang gzhu dang sdigs mdzub dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag /nub tu rdo rje lcags sgog ser po/ ser po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ gnyis dag gis lcags sgog dang / gzhu dang mda' dang / ral gri dang sdigs mdzub kyi phyag /byang du rdo rje dril bu ljang gu ljang gu dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ dril bu dang ral gri dang mda' dang gzhu dang / sdigs mdzub dang rdo rje'i phyag /sgo skyong bzhi po khro bo'i gzugs can/ rdo rje dregs ma la sogs pa rdo rje dril bu'i mthar thug pa'i 44—605

lha rnams ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i glegs bam gyis mtshan pa'i cod pan/ sna tshogs pa'i rin po ches brgyan pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor byi steng du rol pa'i gdan rang mdog dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bdud rtsi'i sngags ni/ hūṃ zhes pa'o/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ rdo rje gur kyi nang du/ chos 'byung gi snying por gnas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+mar nyi ma'i steng du/bcom ldan 'das he ru ka sngon po khro bo'i gzugs can/ sngon po dang / dud kha dang / ser po dang / dkar bo'i zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ rtsa ba dag gis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas pa/ g.yas rnams na rdo rje dang rgyu ma dang mgo bo dang rtse gsum rnams so/ /g.yon rnams na kha ṭī ga dang thod pa dang srin po'i mgrin pa nas bcangs pa dang rus pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /mche ba gcigs shing thod pa'i phreng ba dang / rdo rje bdud rtsi'i glegs bam kyis mtshan pa'i ①cod pan/ sgyu ma'i phreng bas phreng bar byas pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan kyis brgyan pa/ rol pa'i gdan shes rab ma med pa'o/ /shar du gcigs pa dang bcas pa ma ser mo/ ser po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal phyag g.yas dang cig shos kyi phyag drug rnams ni/ ral gri dang rdo rje dang mgo bo dang kha ṭī ga dang thod pa dang rus pe'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho ru gshigs pa ma dkar mo dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po'i zhal/ ral gri dang rus pa'i phreng ba dang / rdo rje dang kha ṭī ga dang thod pa dang mgo 'dzin pa'i phyag /nub tu gtum mo sngon mo sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ ral gri dang rdo rje dang mgo bo dang rgyu ma'i phreng ba dang kha ṭī ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i 44byed606
